article_content: Mass spectrometers are sophisticated, highly sensitive analytical devices that play a vital role in modern society. They are indispensable for fields such as medical diagnostics, food safety, and detecting hazardous chemicals. Now, researchers led by Dr. Jonas Warneke at Leipzig University’s Wilhelm-Ostwald-Institute for Physical and Theoretical Chemistry are pioneering a new use for these instruments: the direct chemical synthesis of novel molecules. Their approach involves modifying mass spectrometers to act as tools for assembling new compounds. Recently, the team synthesized a novel substance by combining a charged molecular fragment with nitrogen from atmospheric air. This breakthrough offers promising possibilities for building new molecular structures and has been documented in the journal ‘Angewandte Chemie’. The journal’s cover highlights the idea of 'harvesting' molecules created from fragments—similar to selecting seeds from a box—in the gas phase and then collecting them into a typical synthesis flask. One of the central pursuits in chemistry is developing new ways to break and form chemical bonds. Dr. Warneke explains that when chemical bonds in charged molecules break, the resulting 'reactive fragments' are often highly unstable and reactive, making them difficult to manage using conventional synthesis methods. Inside a mass spectrometer, these fragments are contained within a vacuum, reducing the risk of unwanted side reactions. By introducing specific molecules, such as nitrogen—which is typically unreactive—these fragments can be coaxed into forming new compounds. Previously, this strategy allowed reactive fragments to engage in unusual reactions, including with noble gases—elements that are extremely challenging to bind. Although the concept of controlling these reactive fragments in mass spectrometers is decades old, the resulting compounds were only produced in minuscule amounts and could not be further utilized, as they were usually destroyed during analysis. Traditionally, chemists gained valuable insights from these experiments but were left with no physical samples. The new research changes that: using preparative mass spectrometers, the Leipzig team generated enough of a new substance—formed from a reactive fragment and nitrogen—that it could be physically collected, seen, and studied. Currently, the amounts produced are suitable mainly for applications like thin film technology, but this pioneering use of preparative mass spectrometry could open new avenues in manufacturing microchips, solar cells, and biologically active coatings.
translated_content: Nau'ikan na'urorin duba nauyin ƙwayoyin halitta (mass spectrometers) manyan na'urori ne masu hankali sosai waɗanda ke taka muhimmiyar rawa a yau. Ana amfani da su wajen binciken lafiya, tabbatar da kariyar abinci, da kuma gano haɗarin sinadarai. Yanzu, masana kimiyya karkashin jagorancin Dr. Jonas Warneke a Jami'ar Leipzig, Wilhelm-Ostwald-Institute for Physical and Theoretical Chemistry, na kirkirar sabon amfani ga waɗannan na'urori: haɗa sabbin sinadarai kai tsaye ta wannan na’ura. Sabuwar dabararsu ita ce gyara mass spectrometers don su zama kayan haɗawa sabbin ƙwayoyin sinadarai. Kwanan nan, ƙungiyar ta kirkiri wani sabon abu ta haɗa ɓangaren ƙwayar sinadari mai cajin lantarki da nitrogen daga iska. Wannan ci gaban na iya taimakawa wajen gina sababbin tsare-tsaren kwayoyin halitta, kuma an wallafa shi a mujallar ‘Angewandte Chemie’. Fatar mujallar ta nuna hoto mai bayyana fasahar ‘girbe’ ƙwayoyi daga ɓangarori kamar zaɓar iri a cikin akwatin iri a yanayi na gas, sannan a tattara su a cikin flask na hadawa. Ɗaya daga cikin manyan burin kimiyyar sinadari shi ne samar da sabbin hanyoyin karya da haɗa sababbin igiyoyin sinadarai. Dr. Warneke ya bayyana cewa idan an karya igiyar sinadari a cikin ƙwaya mai cajin lantarki, ragowar da aka samu yana da matuƙar saurin haɗuwa da wasu sinadarai, kuma yana da wahalar sarrafawa ta hanyar gargajiya. A cikin mass spectrometer akwai iska mai ƙaƙƙarfan matsewa (vacuum) wanda ke rage haɗarin haɗa sinadarai ba tare da iko ba. Ta hanyar shigar da wasu sinadarai kamar nitrogen—wanda yawanci baya amsa—za a iya tilasta waɗannan ragowar su shiga sabbin haɗin gwiwa. A baya, wannan dabara ta ba da damar ragowar sinadarai su shiga al’amura na musamman da irin su noble gases—waɗanda su ne mafi wahalar shiga haɗi a kimiyya. Kodayake tun shekaru ana amfani da dabarar sarrafa waɗannan ragowar a cikin mass spectrometer, amma ana samun su ne kaɗan-kaɗan kuma ba a iya amfani da su sosai saboda galibi suna lalacewa yayin gwaji. A da, masana sun fi samun ilimi daga irin waɗannan gwaje-gwaje fiye da samfurin hannu. Amma binciken da aka yi yanzu ya sauya wannan: ta hanyar amfani da sabbin mass spectrometers, ƙungiyar Leipzig ta samar da sabon abu mai mahimmanci—wanda aka yi daga ragowar sinadari da nitrogen—da za a iya gani da ido, kama, da amfani da shi a wasu gwaje-gwaje. Yanzu haka, adadin da ake samu ya fi dacewa da aikace-aikace irin su fasahar sanya fina-finai masu laushi (thin film technology), amma wannan fasaha na iya buɗe sabbin damar masana’antu kamar ƙera microchips, cells na rana da kuma rufin kayayyakin da ke aikin lafiya.

article_content: James Corden, the actor and co-writer behind 'Gavin & Stacey,' has spoken in favor of the BBC's plan to transition BBC3 into an online-only channel through iPlayer, aiming for this to happen in 2015. This change is intended to save around £50 million per year, with the goal of using that money to reinforce other programming, especially on BBC1. Corden believes that BBC3’s core audience—mainly young people—are already accustomed to watching shows online. However, several well-known entertainers, such as Jack Whitehall, Matt Lucas, and Richard Bacon, have advocated to keep the channel on TV, arguing that BBC3 plays an essential part in promoting emerging comedic talent. They have started campaigns, particularly on social media, to contest the move. BBC3 initially aired notable productions including 'Gavin & Stacey,' 'Little Britain,' and 'Bad Education,' many of which shifted to larger audiences on BBC's prime channels. Corden has noted that BBC3’s focus on developing new material was critical for launching shows like his own. Still, he expresses doubt that today's BBC3 would commission similar projects, as its priorities have evolved. Critics of the transition stress BBC3’s importance for nurturing new creative acts, evidenced by over 225,000 petition signers objecting to the move. Celebrities such as Jack Whitehall stress the channel’s vital role for novel comedy and live music. On the other hand, Corden points to the rise of platforms like Netflix and Hulu, suggesting this shift is in line with changing viewer habits toward streaming. He also mentions that several BBC3 series, like 'Bad Education,' already attract substantial audiences via iPlayer. Many viewers, especially enthusiasts of BBC4—which specializes in documentaries and arts—favor the move to protect BBC4 from potential cuts, seeing its offerings as indispensable. This decision reflects changing media consumption trends among young audiences, but triggers ongoing debate among celebrities, presenters, and the public about how best the BBC can support new talent and future programming.

article_content: A Gmail glitch that occurred between January 15 and 22 resulted in thousands of emails being accidentally deleted or misreported. This was believed to be the second Gmail bug in two weeks. The problem caused actions such as delete or report spam to be applied to the wrong email, potentially impacting thousands of users. Google stated that the bug has now been fixed and urged people to check their Trash and Spam folders for missing emails. The company has not explained the cause of the glitch. Many Gmail users reported being locked out of their accounts, unable to access the service, or missing emails at the end of the week. On January 24 at 2:12pm, Google acknowledged the problem and said they were investigating. The following morning, Google confirmed the issue and stated it had been resolved. During the glitch, actions performed on one email, like deleting or reporting as spam, were incorrectly applied to a different email. Approximately 0.2% of Gmail users were affected, mainly those using mobile browsers, offline versions, and Gmail apps on iOS devices. Google reassured users that the bug has been fixed and any missing data should be restored, but urged users to check their Trash folders as a precaution. This glitch is considered separate from another Gmail outage that occurred the previous week. Many users took to Twitter to complain using the hashtag #whengmailwasdown. Yahoo, a competing email provider, tweeted several times about Gmail's service disruption but later deleted those tweets and issued an apology for their actions. Google encouraged all users to carefully check their Trash and Spam folders for any emails mistakenly deleted or marked as spam before February 14, 2014, and move any needed messages back to their inbox. A similar incident affected a Californian user of Microsoft’s Hotmail, receiving thousands of blank emails after a glitch. The outage apparently caused email addresses to be automatically inserted into new messages. Yahoo itself experienced a similar outage the previous month, with some users unable to access their account for up to a week.

article_content: State-owned Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) will begin oil production this month from its long-delayed deep-sea project in the Krishna Godavari (KG) basin, Bay of Bengal. This is expected to help reverse years of declining output, a senior ONGC official said. "Production from the Cluster-2 project in the KG-DWN-98/2 block is planned to start this month, with output gradually increasing," ONGC Director (Production) Pankaj Kumar told PTI. An FPSO, or Floating Production Storage and Offloading vessel, is already stationed in the block. After several missed deadlines, ONGC asked Shapoorji Pallonji Oil & Gas (SPOG) to prepare the Armada Sterling-V FPSO to receive first oil this month. Oil production from Cluster-2 was originally set for November 2021 but was delayed by the pandemic. Kumar noted ONGC will initially bring three to four wells online, adding more later. "Initial output may be 8,000 to 9,000 barrels per day." The KG deep-sea terrain is technically challenging. ONGC is keen to avoid mistakes made in the nearby KG-D6 block run by Reliance Industries. Gas production in the region is less complex, but rapidly opening oil wells can lead to sand and water issues. The ONGC approach emphasizes drilling more wells and producing at optimal, not maximum, rates, an official explained. ONGC’s first consignment of crude will go to its subsidiary, Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Ltd (MRPL), where it will be tested to determine grade and price. Armada Sterling-V is 70% owned by SPOG and 30% by Malaysia's Bumi Armada. The FPSO has waited since January 2, 2023 (connected on December 27, 2022) to begin oil operations, with missed deadlines in May, August, September, and October 2023. "These reservoirs are highly complex. We must ensure everything is ready before starting," said Kumar. Five M-field wells at about 400 meters depth will supply initial oil via flexible hoses to the FPSO. Later, A and P1 oilfield wells will also connect. Eventually, 13 wells producing oil and associated gas will link to Armada Sterling-V. Peak oil output of 45,000 barrels per day is expected in 2024-25. At that stage, a tanker is set to dock every two weeks to move oil to refineries. About 2 million metric standard cubic meters per day (mmscmd) of gas will flow with oil at first; larger gas output (7–8 mmscmd) is expected after May 2024. McDermott, the contractor, must install the delayed Control and Process Platform (CPP) and Living Quarters & Upstream Platform (LQUP), built by Malaysia’s Sapura Energy. The platform is ready to be shipped to India early next year, with gas production set to start mid-2024. Expected output is now less than projections made in 2018, when ONGC estimated spending USD 5.07 billion for capital and USD 5.12 billion for operational expenses over 16 years. Kumar said ONGC expects to halt declining crude oil production next financial year, and natural gas output is likely to increase. ONGC’s KG-DWN-98/2 (also called KG-D5) block is offshore the Godavari delta in the Bay of Bengal, roughly 35 km from Andhra Pradesh, in water 300–3,200 meters deep. It adjoins Reliance Industries’ KG-D6 and contains multiple discoveries in three clustered groups, with Cluster-2 prioritized. Cluster-2 is sub-divided into 2A and 2B, originally planned to produce 23.52 million tonnes of oil and 50.70 bcm of gas over the project’s life. Cluster 2A was estimated to hold 94.26 million tonnes of oil and 21.75 bcm of associated gas, while Cluster 2B was projected with 51.98 bcm of gas. Initial plans had Cluster 2A producing 77,305 barrels of oil per day and 3.81 mmscmd of gas for 15 years, and Cluster 2B delivering 12.75 mmscmd of gas from eight wells over 16 years. Revised estimates are 45,000 bpd of oil and up to 2.5 mmscmd from 2A and about 9 mmscmd from 2B. In other business updates: India's Income Tax Department is probing Apple, Google, and Amazon subsidiaries for possible tax liabilities. Indians now top Dubai’s real estate investor list. Razorpay, a digital payments firm, may relocate its parent to India from the US—a move that could involve significant US tax payment.

Wannan zai taimaka wajen dakatar da raguwar samar da mai da aka fuskanta tsawon shekaru, inji wani babban jami’in ONGC. "Zamu fara samar da mai daga aikin Cluster-2 a yankin KG-DWN-98/2 wannan watan, sannan a karu a hankali," in ji Daraktan (Samarwa) na ONGC, Pankaj Kumar, ga PTI. Bayan jinkiri da dama, ONGC ta umarci Shapoorji Pallonji Oil & Gas (SPOG) da su shirya Armada Sterling-V FPSO don karbar man farko cikin wannan watan. Aikin samar da mai daga Cluster-2 an yi niyyar farawa tun watan Nuwamba 2021, amma annobar COVID-19 ta jinkirta shi. Kumar ya ce za a fara da rijiyoyi uku zuwa hudu, daga baya za a hada wasu. "Farkon samarwa zai kai ganga 8,000 zuwa 9,000 a rana." Yankin teku mai zurfi na KG yana da kalubale sosai ta fuskar fasaha. ONGC na kokarin kaucewa matsalolin da aka fuskanta a makwabcin KG-D6 na Reliance Industries. Samar da iskar gas ba shi da wahala sosai a yankin, amma bude rijiyoyin mai da sauri na iya haifar da matsalar kasa da ruwa shigowa. Manufar ONGC ita ce samarwa ta hanya mai kyau, ba tare da hanzari ba, kamar yadda wani jami'i ya bayyana. Za a aika da man farko ga kamfanin reshen ONGC, Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Ltd (MRPL), inda za a gwada inganci da farashi. Armada Sterling-V FPSO kashi 70% mallakar SPOG ce, 30% daga Bumi Armada na Malaysia. Tun 2 ga Janairu, 2023 jirgin FPSO ke jiran fara aiki, bayan da aka hada shi a 27 ga Disamba, 2022. Lokutan da aka sanya na farawa sun hada da Mayu, Agusta, Satumba da Oktoba 2023. "Wadannan rijiyoyin suna da matukar wahala. Dole ne mu tabbatar da komai kafin mu fara," in ji Kumar. Za a fara da rijiyoyin M guda biyar a zurfin kusan mita 400 da za a hada da bututun roba zuwa FPSO. Daga baya, za a hada da rijiyoyin A da P1. Za a hada jimillar rijiyoyi 13 masu samar da mai da iskar gas da Armada Sterling-V. Ana sa ran kololuwar samar da ganga 45,000 a rana nan da 2024-25. Lokacin kololuwa, jirgin daukar mai zai zo kowane mako biyu don jigilar man zuwa matatun mai. A farkon lokaci, za a samu iskar gas 2 mmscmd tare da mai. Babban samar da iskar gas (7-8 mmscmd) ana sa ran farawa a Mayu 2024. Kamfanin McDermott ne zai girka Control and Process Platform (CPP) da Living Quarters & Upstream Platform (LQUP) wanda Sapura Energy na Malaysia ke kera. Tashar ciyawa a shirye take ta shigo ruwan Najeriya farkon shekara mai zuwa. Samar da iskar na sa ran farawa tsakiyar 2024. Yanzu kididdigar samarwa ta ragu idan aka kwatanta da yadda aka yi hasashe a 2018, lokacin da ONGC ta kiyasta dala biliyan 5.07 don manyan ayyuka da dala biliyan 5.12 na kula da aiki a shekaru 16. Kumar ya ce ONGC na fatan dakatar da raguwar samar da mai a shekara mai zuwa, tare da karin gas. Yankin KG-DWN-98/2 (ko KG-D5) yana bakin kogin Godavari cikin Tekun Bengal, kilomita 35 daga gabar Andhra Pradesh, da zurfin ruwa daga mita 300 zuwa 3,200. Ya makale da KG-D6 na Reliance Industries kuma yana dauke da abubuwan gano mai a rukunoni uku, inda aka fifita Cluster-2. Cluster-2 an raba shi gida biyu—2A da 2B; an expecting samar da tan miliyan 23.52 na mai da biliyan 50.70 cubic metre na iskar gas a rayuwar aikin. Cluster 2A nada tan miliyan 94.26 na mai da 21.75 bcm na iskar gas, 2B nada 51.98 bcm iskar. An zata Cluster 2A zata samar da ganga 77,305 na mai da 3.81 mmscmd na iskar gas na tsawon shekaru 15. Cluster 2B na da 12.75 mmscmd daga rijiyoyi 8 tsawon shekaru 16. Sai dai yanzu ana sa ran ganga 45,000 a rana da iskar gas 2.5 mmscmd daga 2A da kusan 9 mmscmd daga 2B. Hakanan, Razorpay na shirin dawo da asalin kamfanin zuwa Indiya daga Amurka, wanda zai iya jawo babbar biyan haraji a Amurka.

article_content: The beloved 'igloo' home of Luke Skywalker from the Star Wars saga faced real-life destruction, prompting fans of the franchise to intervene. After learning about the deteriorating condition of the iconic set in the Tunisian desert, two British fans joined forces with a group led by Belgian Mark Dermul. Collectively, Star Wars enthusiasts raised £7,000 to fund a restoration project, traveling to the remote location to save the dome-shaped structure made famous in the 1977 film. Mark Dermul later shared a YouTube video expressing gratitude to everyone who contributed their time and money to restore the landmark, which had become rundown over the years. Among the renovation team was Terry Cooper, a 42-year-old science fiction writer from Cardiff, who decided to get involved after seeing the site's decline. 'It's such an iconic building for fantasy fans. It just needed a relatively small investment and some effort to save it,' he said. The restoration team spent a week in the harsh desert climate, working in temperatures as high as 115°F to re-plaster and repair the structure, which is constructed from plywood and chicken wire. Other film fans sent them off with encouragement, famously saying, 'May the force be with you.' After their efforts, the newly refurbished white igloo now stands out against the flat desert sands, once again recognizable to fans around the world. Terry Cooper described the damage he found on a previous visit as 'quite dramatic,' emphasizing that without intervention, the site could have been lost. Cooper, known for his Kangazang! novels—one of which was narrated in audio format by former Doctor Who star Colin Baker—felt it was important to restore the location. The set, originally created for Star Wars in 1977 and named after the Tunisian village Tataouine, remains a significant destination for global fans. The igloo, representing Luke Skywalker's home with his foster family, was memorably destroyed on screen by stormtroopers from the Galactic Empire—making its real-life preservation even more meaningful to the Star Wars community.

Bai dauki kudi ko ƙoƙari mai yawa don ceton sa ba.’ Tawagar ta shafe sati guda tana aiki cikin zafi a hamada, inda yanayin zafin rana ya kai 46°C (115°F), suna gyaran bango da sauran sassan ginin da aka yi da katako da wayar ƙarfe. Sauran masoyan fim din sun taya su murna da fatan alheri: 'May the force be with you.' Bayan kokarinsu, sabon igloo mai farin launi ya fice sosai a cikin hamadar, kuma masoyan fim ɗin daga sassa daban-daban na duniya suna ci gaba da sha’awar wurin. Terry Cooper ya bayyana cewa a ziyararsa ta baya, lalacewar ginin ta kasance 'mai girma matuƙa,' yana jaddada cewa da ba a yi wani abu ba, wurin zai yi wani hali. Cooper, sanannen marubuci litattafan Kangazang! — ɗaya daga ciki tsohon tauraron Doctor Who, Colin Baker, ya karanta shi a sautin audio — ya ce yana da muhimmanci a gyara wannan wuri. Ginin, wanda aka kirkira tun lokacin fim ɗin Star Wars na 1977 kuma aka saka masa suna daga kauyen Tataouine a Tunisia, ya ci gaba da zama mahalli ga masoyan fim a duniya. Igloo ɗin na wakiltar gidan Luke Skywalker da iyalinsa, wanda mayaƙan Galactic Empire suka lalata a fim—hakan yasa gyaransa a zahiri ya kasance mai mahimmanci ga masoyan Star Wars.

article_content: Philip Poroma, representing the IBB International Golf and Country Club in Abuja, emerged as the overall winner of the 63rd Nigeria Independence Anniversary Golf event. The tournament began on Monday and concluded on Sunday night with the announcement of champions across various categories. Poroma, an amateur golfer with a handicap of 14, played a gross score of 80 and a net of 66, outperforming more than 500 participants to claim the coveted trophy. In addition to being awarded a green jacket, he received the star prize: a PAN car. Expressing his happiness, Poroma stated he was surprised but proud to win and dedicated the victory to Nigeria. He also commended the persistence of all participants, reminding that only one winner could emerge. Senator John Enoh, the Minister of Sports Development, officiated the grand finale. He described golf as a wonderful game, applauded the club’s dedication and highlighted how sports promote inclusiveness, diplomacy, friendships, and business networks. In international match-play, Nigeria triumphed over Uganda by 8.5 to 6.5 in doubles, beat Cameroon 5.5 to 1.5 in doubles and 15.5 to 3.5 in singles, and won against Ghana by 13.5 to 3.5 in doubles and 19.5 to 10.5 in singles.

Poroma, mai rangadin 14 a matsayin dan wasan kwallon golf, ya buga gros 80 da net na 66, ya zarce sama da ‘yan wasa 500 don lashe kyautar. Bayan an ba shi riga mai launin kore, ya samu kyautar mota ta PAN a matsayin babban lada. Yayin da yake bayyana farin cikinsa, Poroma ya ce bai yi tsammanin zai ci ba, amma yana alfahari da nasarar, kuma ya sadaukar da nasarar ga Najeriya. Ya kuma yaba da jajircewar duk masu shiga gasar, yana tunatar da cewa dole sai an sami guda daya da zai lashe. Sanata John Enoh, Ministan Ci gaban Wasanni, ne ya jagoranci kammala gasar. Ya bayyana golf a matsayin wasa mai kyau, ya yabawa kokarin kulob din da yadda wasan ke hada mutane, yana karfafa zumunci da yanayin kasuwanci. A gasar kasa da kasa, Najeriya ta doke Uganda 8.5 da 6.5 a wasa biyu, ta doke Cameroon 5.5 da 1.5 a wasa biyu da 15.5 da 3.5 a wasan guda, sannan ta doke Ghana 13.5 da 3.5 a wasa biyu da 19.5 da 10.5 a wasan guda.

article_content: Shaela Evenson, a literature and physical education teacher at Butte Central Catholic School in Montana, was terminated after becoming pregnant outside of marriage. The Diocese of Helena confirmed that Evenson was dismissed for violating her employment contract, which requires teachers to uphold Catholic moral and religious teachings in their professional and personal lives. Catholic Schools Superintendent Patrick Haggarty explained that the Church teaches the sacrament of marriage is a holy union between a man and a woman and expects teachers to act as role models for students. Evenson had taught sixth, seventh, and eighth grade literature and physical education at the school for over eight years. Principal Kerrie Hellyer said Evenson was let go on January 10 after the diocese received an anonymous letter revealing her pregnancy. Hellyer described Evenson as an excellent teacher. According to diocese spokesman Dan Bartleson, the school does not typically investigate the private lives of its employees, but felt obligated to take action once informed about the situation. Evenson is now pursuing legal action. Her attorney, Brian Butler, plans to file a discrimination complaint with the Federal Equal Opportunity Commission, alleging her dismissal violated her rights under Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964. The case has sparked backlash in the community and on social media, with many urging the Church to show compassion. Some Catholics referenced recent actions by Pope Francis—such as baptizing children born out of wedlock—as examples of understanding. Similar controversies have occurred elsewhere, including a case in Seattle where Catholic school vice principal Mark Zmuda was dismissed after entering a same-sex marriage.

Shugaban makarantu na Katolika, Patrick Haggarty, ya ce cocin na koyar da cewa aure ibada ce tsakanin namiji da mace, kuma malamai na matsayin abin koyi ga ɗalibai. Evenson ta koyar wa aji na shida, bakwai da takwas darasin litattafai da wasanni sama da shekaru takwas. Shugabar makarantar, Kerrie Hellyer, ta ce an kori Evenson ranar 10 ga Janairu bayan coci ta karbi wata wasika daga wani ba a bayyana ba game da cikinta. Hellyer ta ce Evenson malamai ce mai nagarta. Kamar yadda kakakin cocin Dan Bartleson ya ce, makarantar ba ta saba bincike kan rayuwar ma’aikata ba, amma dole suka dauki matakin da ya dace bayan an turo musu da bayanin. Evenson yanzu tana shirin garzaya kotu. Lamarin ya jawo martani daga al’umma da shafukan sada zumunta, inda da dama ke bukatar cocin ta nuna jin kai da tausayi. Wasu Katolika sun yi nuni da irin misalin da Pope Francis ya bayar—kamar yadda ya bai wa yara da aka haifa ba tare da aure baftisma—alamar fahimta da karɓa. Irin wannan rikicin ya faru a wasu wuraren ma, ciki har da wata makarantar Katolika a Seattle, inda aka sallami mataimakin shugaban makaranta Mark Zmuda bayan ya yi aure da abokin zamansa namiji.

article_content: Hundreds of firefighters, police officers, medical staff, National Guardsmen, and volunteers braved dangerous conditions—including lightning, heavy hail, gas leaks, and relentless rain—to search for survivors after a destructive tornado struck Joplin, Missouri. Many first responders searched through debris even as their own homes had been destroyed. Despite personal hardship, their efforts led to the rescue of 17 people on Monday, according to Joplin's city manager, Mark Rohr. Richard Serino, Deputy Administrator of FEMA, praised their dedication, saying, "To say their work is commendable is an understatement." More than 400 to 500 firefighters, public works staff, and city employees arrived unprompted on Monday morning to assist. Community support in Joplin is strong, as described by Rohr: "Joplin is a city of neighbors helping neighbors. With this spirit, we will overcome." Difficult weather persisted throughout Monday, with thunderstorms that temporarily halted searches. Two responders were reportedly struck by lightning while searching through debris (no details given on their condition). Gas leaks and downed wires added further hazards, with gas smells and scattered debris throughout the city. The National Weather Service forecasted a 45% chance of further tornado outbreaks in the region—including Joplin—between 4 p.m. and midnight on Tuesday. Over 1,000 first responders provided aid, including personnel from Kansas City and other areas. The emergency effort also involved 110 highway patrol officers and 250 National Guardsmen, with another 450 standing by. Medical professionals rushed to help at St. John's Regional Medical Center, despite damaged roads and difficult access. Dr. Jim Roscoe, leading the triage unit, noted the overwhelming assistance provided by healthcare workers arriving from miles away. The devastation has taken a psychological toll on responders, with Governor Jay Nixon acknowledging the hardships they face but affirming their determination to continue searching for survivors. "We are going to cover every foot of this town and make sure every person is accounted for," Nixon said.

article_content: The Premier League has a TV revenue system designed for balance, guaranteeing each team a substantial base payment, with further funds depending on league ranking and TV exposure. If TV income were instead divided by viewership totals, giant clubs like Liverpool and Manchester United would end up with much larger paydays. In the 2013-14 season, Liverpool took home £97.5 million—the league’s highest TV revenue haul. But if the payout reflected pure audience numbers, they'd have earned £172.3 million, nearly £75 million more. Manchester United would have seen similar results, with a potential £70 million increase to £159.5 million if their payments were tied to their large audiences. The distribution system advantages smaller clubs with fewer fans and televised matches. For example, Fulham received £63.3 million—almost £37 million above what their TV audience would warrant, which is only £26 million under a viewer-based model. Each Premier League team is awarded a basic £52.2 million. The remaining pool from £1.56 billion is divided up based on both league standing and how often teams are broadcast live. This method ensures the most popular and highest-ranking teams get less than if payouts were strictly by audience, helping prevent a huge financial gap. For 2013-14 season data, the Broadcasters’ Audience Research Board (BARB) tracked viewership for all 154 live Premier League games. On average, over a million people tuned in for each match, with marquee events—like Liverpool vs. Chelsea (2.7 million viewers) or Manchester United vs. Arsenal (2.5 million)—drawing even larger crowds. Matches with less wide appeal, such as Crystal Palace vs. West Ham (251,000), drew fewer viewers. Over the season, Liverpool had 28 live games that gathered a total of nearly 37 million viewers, while Fulham featured in just eight broadcasts, drawing about 5.8 million total viewers. Even looking at averages per game, Liverpool’s audience nearly doubled Fulham’s. This more equal distribution is credited for the Premier League’s competitiveness, contrasted with places like Spain where clubs negotiate separate TV deals and major teams like Real Madrid and Barcelona control most TV income. Ultimately, while this system caps earnings for England’s big clubs despite their popularity, it strengthens league parity and excitement.

Idan ana raba kudin ne daidai da yawan masu kallon wasannin, kungiyoyin manya kamar Liverpool da Manchester United za su samu fiye da yawan kudi sosai. A kakar 2013-14, Liverpool ta samu £97.5 miliyan daga kudin talabijin, mafi yawa a gasar, amma idan an raba kudin bisa yawan masu kallo, za su samu £172.3 miliyan, kusan tazarar £75 miliyan. Haka zalika, Manchester United za ta samu tazarar £70 miliyan, jimla £159.5 miliyan idan an bi tsarin masu kallo. Tsarin rarraba kudin yana taimakawa kananan kulob din da ke da karancin magoya baya da kuma wasanni kai tsaye. Misali, Fulham ta karba £63.3 miliyan—sama da £37 miliyan idan aka kwatanta da £26 miliyan da za ta samu ta bin tsarin masu kallo. Kowane kulob yana samun kudi £52.2 miliyan na asali. Sauran kudaden da suka rage daga £1.56 biliyan ana rabawa ne bisa matsayi a tebur da yawan sau da aka nuna wasanninsu kai tsaye. Wannan tsari yana tabbatar da cewa manyan kulob din ba su samu dukkan kudin da ya dace da yawan magoya bayansu ba, yana rage babbar tazara. A kakar, hukumar BARB ce ta tantance yawan masu kallo a wasanni 154 da aka nuna kai tsaye. Talakawan kallo sun kai sama da miliyan daya kowanne wasa, inda manyan wasanni irin su Liverpool da Chelsea (2.7 miliyan) ko Man United da Arsenal (2.5 miliyan) suka fi jan hankali. Wasannin da ba su da fice irin su Crystal Palace da West Ham (251,000) sun fi karancin kallo. Liverpool ta buga wasanni 28 da aka nuna kai tsaye inda duka masu kallo sun kusan milyan 37, yayin da Fulham aka nuna sa takwas kacal suka tara milyan 5.8. Ko da a matsakaici, Liverpool ta ninka Fulham wajen yawan masu kallon kowanne wasa. Wannan tsari yana taimakawa gasar Premier League ta ci gaba da kasancewa mai daidaito fiye da kasashe kamar Spain, inda manyan kulob din ke da ikon cin gajiyar kudaden TV, musamman Real Madrid da Barcelona. A takaice, tsarin yanzu yana rage kudaden da manyan kulob din suke samu duk da yawan magoya bentuk, amma hakan yana kara karfin daidaito da gasar.

article_content: A legal battle among Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.’s children centers on the fate of his Bible and Nobel Peace Prize. The last public use of King’s Bible was at President Barack Obama’s 2013 inauguration. Since then, both the Bible and the Nobel medal have been kept securely, as the late civil rights leader’s children disagree over their future. Martin Luther King III and Dexter Scott King, who manage The Estate of Martin Luther King Jr. Inc., support selling the prized items to a private buyer, citing financial needs. Their sister Bernice King strongly opposes the sale, asserting these artifacts are deeply tied to their father's legacy and should not be sold. A Fulton County Superior Court judge, Robert McBurney, is scheduled to rule on the ownership dispute or may allow the case to proceed to trial. Bernice King, the administrator of her mother Coretta Scott King’s estate, contends that the Nobel medal was gifted to Coretta and belongs with her estate. The siblings' disagreements over their father’s legacy have resulted in at least five lawsuits in the past decade. In 2006, the family sold more than 10,000 of Dr. King’s papers for $32 million to Morehouse College. Appraisals estimate the Nobel medal could fetch between $5–$20 million in a private sale, and the Bible up to $1 million. Museums and historians emphasize the societal value of keeping such items on public display. Currently, the Nobel medal is secured in a safe deposit box, and the Bible is also in a protected location known only to the siblings. A replica of the medal is displayed at the King Center. Family relations have often been strained by disputes over Dr. King’s legacy, with previous conflicts involving the use of his image, likeness, and memorabilia. The court’s decision is expected to determine the future of these historically significant artifacts.

article_content: Liberia has just finished a closely contested run-off presidential election, with incumbent leader George Weah facing off against experienced statesman Joseph Boakai. In the first voting round on October 10, Weah narrowly edged ahead of Boakai by only 7,126 votes, leading to a highly anticipated second round. This presidential election stands out as the first conducted after Liberia’s civil wars without the involvement of a United Nations mission. Weah, favored especially by young voters, highlights his achievements in infrastructure and education, while promising to address corruption and raise living standards. However, opponents argue that his government has not made sufficient progress in fighting corruption or reducing youth unemployment. Liberia is still overcoming the challenges of its two past civil wars and recovering from the severe effects of the Ebola epidemic. Joseph Boakai, who previously served as vice president, brings extensive experience, although some have expressed concern about his age affecting his leadership. The outcome may ultimately be influenced by endorsements from former candidates and how those who cast invalid votes in the first round choose to vote this time. Voter participation is expected to be lower than the record 79 percent turnout from the previous round, which included parliamentary elections. Although there were some tensions during the campaign, the day of the election ran peacefully overall. Election observer Attahiru Jega from ECOWAS praised the calm atmosphere and orderly process observed at polling stations in Monrovia. While Liberia’s economy recorded almost 5 percent growth last year, the World Bank reports that over 80 percent of the population still struggles with food insecurity.

article_content: As Congress works to avoid a looming government shutdown, tensions in the Capitol have reached a high point. While thousands demonstrate outside in support of Israel, confrontations among lawmakers have turned unusually intense. Rep. Tim Burchett (R-TN) claims former House Speaker Kevin McCarthy (R-CA) elbowed him in the back during an NPR interview. Burchett, who voted to remove McCarthy as Speaker, demanded answers in front of NPR reporter Claudia Grisales. Initially, Burchett joked about it but soon shouted, 'Why’d you elbow me in the back, Kevin? Got any guts?' The two exchanged words as Burchett pursued McCarthy, who insisted it was just a crowded hallway and any contact was accidental. Tensions flared elsewhere as well. Sen. Markwayne Mullin (R-OK) challenged Teamsters President Sean O’Brien to a physical fight during a Senate committee hearing, after O'Brien’s critical comments online. Committee Chair Bernie Sanders (I-VT) quickly intervened to defuse the situation, reminding them of their responsibilities as senators. At a House Oversight Committee hearing, a separate heated argument erupted between Chairman James Comer (R-KY) and Rep. Jared Moskowitz (D-FL), with the exchange devolving into personal insults. article_content: WeWork has begun closing certain coworking spaces as it reportedly prepares to file for bankruptcy. In September, the company announced plans to renegotiate all its leases and exit any locations considered 'unfit or underperforming.' Some of these closures are now underway. A WeWork spokesperson told Insider on Thursday that the company is ending its tenancy at New Kings Beam House in Central London. According to WeWork members at the affected building, who spoke to the BBC, the company informed them via email that this and other 'unprofitable' sites are closing. WeWork described the move as a preplanned strategy to 'improve liquidity and strengthen our balance sheet.' The spokesperson did not specify how many locations in the UK would be shutting down but emphasized that the region remains important for the company. Once valued at $47 billion, WeWork now faces the prospect of bankruptcy after years of rapid expansion and financial challenges. Its share price has declined by nearly 99% since it went public in 2021, with shares trading at $1.22 as of Thursday morning. The Wall Street Journal and Reuters reported on Tuesday that WeWork could file for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the coming days, following an August warning by the company that there was 'substantial doubt' about its ability to remain in business. Previously the most valuable tech startup in the US, WeWork has undergone a dramatic reversal. Supported by Softbank's Vision Fund and generating significant interest in Silicon Valley, founder Adam Neumann once claimed the company would 'change the world.' However, analysts questioned the lack of a clear business plan and whether WeWork should be considered a tech or real estate company—a distinction with implications for investor expectations. They warned that WeWork’s model, which involved trading long-term liabilities for short-term income, posed risks not only to itself but also to the wider real estate industry, due to the company's responsibility for leasing millions of square feet in major cities. Experts, like Columbia Business School professor Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh, have cautioned that WeWork’s collapse could have significant repercussions for commercial real estate in American cities. The company struggled to recover from its failed 2019 IPO, which was postponed after its valuation plunged by 70% in about a month. Adam Neumann resigned amid revelations of major losses and management issues, as well as a controversial corporate culture. WeWork also attracted attention for creating its own financial metric, 'community-adjusted EBITDA,' which critics said overlooked key operating costs and drew comparisons to questionable valuation practices from the dot-com era. After leaving WeWork in 2019, Adam Neumann founded Flow, a rental housing company with similarities to his previous venture. Although Neumann has been vague about Flow's business model, the company has received $350 million in investment from Andreessen Horowitz.

article_content: Cricket legend Sachin Tendulkar congratulated Virat Kohli on Wednesday after Kohli broke Tendulkar's record for most one-day international (ODI) centuries. Kohli scored his 50th ODI century during the World Cup semi-final against New Zealand at Mumbai’s Wankhede Stadium, which is also Tendulkar’s home ground. Tendulkar shared on X (formerly Twitter), 'The first time I met you in the Indian dressing room, you were pranked by teammates into touching my feet. I couldn't stop laughing that day. But soon, you touched my heart with your passion and skill. I couldn't be happier that an Indian broke my record — and to do it on the biggest stage, at my home ground, is the icing on the cake.' Kohli had previously matched Tendulkar’s record of 49 ODI centuries during a World Cup match against South Africa, which also coincided with Kohli’s 35th birthday. In the semi-final, Kohli went on to score 117 runs as India set a formidable total of 397-4. Renowned commentator Harsha Bhogle praised Kohli’s achievement on social media, and Home Minister Amit Shah also congratulated Kohli, writing on X: 'Kudos to Virat Kohli for achieving the historic milestone of scoring his 50th century in ODI cricket. This is a testimony of your outstanding sportsman spirit, dedication and consistency. The nation is proud of you.' In other news, India’s economy is expected to grow by 6.7% in the July-September quarter, driven by a strong services sector. The telecom industry is debating a proposal to beam TV content directly to mobile devices without a cellular data connection, citing concerns about the technology's readiness. Additionally, the government is considering raising the GST evasion threshold for arrests and prosecution from ₹2 crore to ₹3 crore to reduce harassment and facilitate ease of doing business.

Sultan al-Jaber, president of the COP28 climate summit in Dubai, has denied allegations that the United Arab Emirates (UAE) is using the event to secure oil and gas deals. This follows a BBC report citing leaked briefing documents, which suggest the UAE planned to discuss fossil fuel agreements with 15 nations. At a news conference, Mr. al-Jaber called the allegations "false, incorrect, and inaccurate," asserting that these claims aimed to undermine his leadership of COP28. The BBC responded that its investigation was rigorously researched, adhering to the highest editorial standards.

In addition to his COP28 presidency, al-Jaber serves as CEO of state oil company Adnoc and renewables firm Masdar. The leaked documents, obtained by the Centre for Climate Reporting together with the BBC, were prepared by the UAE’s COP28 team for meetings with at least 27 foreign governments before the summit, which begins on 30 November. The materials detailed talking points—such as a proposal for China in which Adnoc expresses readiness to evaluate joint opportunities in liquefied natural gas projects in Mozambique, Canada, and Australia, and for Colombia, where Adnoc offers support to develop its fossil fuel resources. Similar points were outlined for 13 other nations, including Germany and Egypt, signaling interest in collaboration on fossil fuel projects.

At the press conference—which the BBC was not invited to—al-Jaber maintained, "Never did I see these talking points, nor have I used them in any discussions." He emphasized the UAE's long-standing approach of building relationships and denied any necessity to use COP28 for commercial gain. Amnesty International and other organizations have demanded his resignation from Adnoc, citing concerns about a potential conflict of interest.

COP28, hosted by the UAE in Dubai, will convene global leaders—including King Charles III—to pursue the goal of limiting long-term global temperature rise to 1.5°C, as recommended by the UN climate science body. Achieving this will require a 43% cut in greenhouse gas emissions by 2030 compared to 2019 levels. Al-Jaber reiterated that all his meetings with governments have focused exclusively on the climate agenda of COP28, striving for cooperative action to keep the 1.5°C target within reach. He concluded by requesting respect for the UAE's record of transparency and partnership throughout the COP process.

Wannan ya biyo bayan rahoton BBC da ke cewa wasu takardun sirri da aka samu sun nuna cewa UAE na shirin tattaunawa da kasashe 15 kan yarjejeniyoyin danyen mai da iskar gas. A taron manema labarai, Mista al-Jaber ya ce wannan zargi "ba gaskiya ba ne, ba daidai ba ne kuma ba sahihi ba ne," yana mai cewa ana wannan zargi ne don bata masa suna a matsayin shugaban COP28. BBC ta ce bincikensu ya cika ka’idojin daukar rahoto na sama.

Baya ga shugabancin COP28, al-Jaber shi ne Shugaba kuma Daraktan kamfanin man fetur na kasa, Adnoc, da kuma kamfanin makamashi mai sabuntawa, Masdar. Takardun da aka samu—da Cibiyar Rahoton Sauyin Yanayi tare da BBC suka samo—an shirya su ne daga tawagar COP28 ta UAE don ganawa da wakilan gwamnatoci 27 kafin fara taron a 30 ga Nuwamba. Takardun sun dauki batutuwan tattaunawa, ciki har da na kasar Sin inda Adnoc ke nuna aniyar yin hadin gwiwa wajen nazarin damar LNG a Mozambique, Kanada da Ostiraliya, da kuma na Kolombiya inda Adnoc ke nuna shiri taimakawa ci gaban albarkatun mai. Haka kuma akwai irin wadannan batutuwa ga kasashe 13, kamar Jamus da Misira, yadda ake nuna sha’awa hadin kai a aikin fosil.

A taron manema labaran—inda BBC bata samu halarta ba—al-Jaber ya bayyana, "Ba zan ce na taba ganin wadannan batutuwan ba, balle in yi amfani da su a wata hira." Ya jaddada yadda UAE ke daukar kafaffen matakan gina dangantaka, yana musanta bukatar amfani da COP28 don cin moriyar kasuwanci. Amnesty International da wasu kungiyoyi sun bukaci ya sauka daga mukaminsa a Adnoc saboda damuwa da yiwuwar rikici da maslaha.

COP28 da za a gudanar a Dubai zai hada shugabannin duniya, ciki har da Sarki Charles III, domin kokarin takaita dumamar yanayi zuwa 1.5°C kamar yadda kungiyar kimiyyar sauyin yanayi ta MDD ta tanada. Ana bukatar rage fitar hayakin gurbata iska da kashi 43 cikin 100 zuwa shekarar 2030 idan aka kwatanta da shekarar 2019 don cimma wannan buri. Al-Jaber ya nanata cewa duk tattaunawarsa da gwamnatocin kasashen waje sun shafi ajandar COP28 na sauyin yanayi ne kadai, domin a hada kai a cimma burin 1.5°C. Ya roki masu sauraro da su girmama tarihin gaskiya da hadin kai na UAE a cikin tsarin gudanarwar COP.

article_content: Feng Mingshan, a 54-year-old man from Gaoba Town in Shaanxi Province, China, has lived in near isolation for the past 20 years. He resides in a cave situated 50 metres up a vertical cliff, which he reaches by climbing up handholds he has chiselled into the rock. Since leaving his hometown in 1993 to avoid social contact, Feng has adapted the cave for comfortable living by installing a front door and hanging curtains. Feng is known to shun most modern conveniences and is often seen without clothing. Photographs show him climbing into and out of the cave, often carrying sticks. Over the years, he has worked to enlarge the cave's interior using only a hammer, clearing a path through the surrounding ravine. Locals note that Feng generally leaves his cave at night but is adept at making the difficult climb. Many in the nearby villages admire his resourcefulness, though authorities have expressed concern about his lifestyle. Feng was diagnosed with intermittent psychosis and received brief treatment. Town mayor Xu Min stated that officials are monitoring Feng and will continue efforts to persuade him to move into a nursing home.

Tun bayan da ya bar garinsu a shekarar 1993 domin kaucewa mu'amala da mutane, Feng ya gyara kogon yana saka kofa da labule don saukaka rayuwarsa. Feng baya amfani da yawancin kayan zamani kuma akasari ba ya saka kaya. Hotuna sun nuna shi yana hawa yana sauka daga kogon ba tare da kaya ba, yana dauke da itatuwa ko garma. Tsawon shekaru, Feng yana fadada kogon da guduma, sannan ya bude hanya a cikin kwarin da ke kusa. Mutanen kauyukan da ke kusa suna cewa Feng yawanci yana fitowa daga kogon da dare, kuma yana iya hawan tsaunin cikin sauki. Shugaban gari Xu Min ya ce suna ci gaba da lura da shi tare da kokarin ganin ya koma gidan jinya mafi dacewa.

article_content: New research reveals that our brains have separate neural circuits that control how much salt we crave and how much we can tolerate. According to a study published in Cell, a set of neurons at the front of the brain helps determine when foods or drinks are ‘too salty,’ while another set at the back adjusts our desire for salt. Lead author Yuki Oka, professor of biology at Caltech, explains that sodium craving and sodium tolerance are managed by distinct types of neurons. This discovery is significant, as salt overconsumption is a major health issue linked to high blood pressure and increased risks of heart disease and stroke, notes Nirupa Chaudhari from the University of Miami, who was not involved in the research. While humans and animals generally dislike very salty substances, experiments in mice found that when the body’s salt levels drop, tolerance—and even preference—for salt increases. This boost in salt appetite is triggered by neurons in the back of the brain, which sense low sodium in the bloodstream. Stimulating these neurons makes animals seek out and consume salt. Meanwhile, neurons in the front of the brain continually assess how salty consumed foods and drinks are, typically enforcing an upper limit. But when sodium levels are dangerously low, body signals can override this limit, allowing higher salt intake. The researchers also found that prostaglandins, hormone-like substances known for their roles in pain and inflammation, help mediate changes in salt tolerance. This insight could one day lead to drugs that help people avoid eating too much salt. Salt has historically been scarce, shaping evolution and even causing wars, Chaudhari points out. Understanding how the brain regulates salt intake could eventually help create better, more palatable salt substitutes—an area where previous attempts have failed due to poor flavors. Future research will need to explore not just brain processes, but also how substitutes interact with our taste buds.
translated_content: Sabon bincike ya gano cewa kwakwalwarmu tana da wasu hanyoyi guda biyu masu zaman kansu da ke sarrafa yadda muke son gishiri da yawan gishirin da za mu iya dauka. Bisa ga binciken da aka buga a mujallar Cell, rukuni na kwayoyin halitta a gaba-gaban kwakwalwa ke tantance lokacin da abinci ko abin sha ya yi gishiri sosai, yayin da wani rukuni a bayan kwakwalwa ke daidaita burinmu na neman gishiri. Yuki Oka, babban marubucin binciken kuma Farfesa na ilmin halittu a Caltech, ya bayyana cewa sha'awar sodium da juriya ga sodium suna karkashin kulawar kwayoyin halitta daban-daban. Wannan bincike yana da muhimmanci domin yawan cin gishiri na da nasaba da matsalolin hawan jini da kuma hatsarin cututtukan zuciya da bugun jini, in ji Nirupa Chaudhari daga Jami'ar Miami, wacce ba ta shiga cikin binciken ba. Duk da cewa mutane da dabbobi ba sa son abinci mai yawan gishiri, gwaje-gwaje kan beraye sun nuna cewa idan yawan gishirin jiki ya ragu, juriya ko kuma sha’awa ga gishiri na kara yawa. Wannan karuwar sha’awa ga gishiri na faruwa ne sakamakon kwayoyin halitta a bayan kwakwalwa da ke gano lokacin da sodium ya yi kasa a jini. Idan aka motsa wadannan kwayoyin, dabbobi kan nemi gishiri. A lokaci guda kuma, kwayoyin halitta a gaba-gaban kwakwalwa suna duba yawan gishirin abinci ko abin sha da mutum ke ci, inda suke tsara iyaka. Amma idan sodium ya ragu sosai a jiki, sakonni daga jiki na iya kawar da wannan iyaka, wanda ke bai wa mutum damar daukar karin gishiri. Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa prostaglandins, wasu sinadarai masu kama da hormone da aka fi sanin su wajen ciwo da kumburi, suna taimakawa wajen sauya yadda jiki ke daukar gishiri. Wannan fahimta na iya taimakawa wajen samar da magunguna da za su hana mutane amfani da gishiri da yawa. Gishiri tarihi yana da matukar muhimmanci, domin yana daya daga cikin abubuwan da suka sa aka yi yaki a da, a cewar Chaudhari. Fahimtar yadda kwakwalwa ke sarrafa cin gishiri na iya taimakawa a wajen samar da nau’in madadin gishiri mai dadi – wani abu da ya taba fadi a baya saboda rashin dadin dandano. Dole ne bincike na gaba ya lalubo yadda madadin gishiri zai hada da dandanon mu ba wai tsarin kwakwalwa kadai ba.

article_content: Inter Milan midfielder Saphir Taider is set to join Southampton on an initial loan, with an option for a permanent transfer valued at £7 million, after successfully completing a medical on Tuesday. Taider, a French-born Algeria international, comes to Southampton as part of the deal that saw Dani Osvaldo join Inter Milan. The 22-year-old was previously offered to West Ham during the transfer window and is scheduled for a medical in the morning before signing a season-long loan agreement. Southampton manager Ronald Koeman expressed enthusiasm over Taider’s arrival, emphasizing his quality and the increased competition he will provide within the squad. Koeman has been actively bringing in new players after several key departures from the team this summer. Meanwhile, Italian striker Dani Osvaldo, who left Southampton following a reported training ground altercation with teammate Jose Fonte, has completed his move to Inter Milan after traveling to Italy over the weekend. Southampton are also reportedly in negotiations to loan Inter winger Ezequiel Schelotto. The 25-year-old, born in Buenos Aires but holding an Italian passport and one appearance for the Italian national team, spent part of last season with Parma, where he scored four goals in 16 matches. Schelotto’s agent, Bruno Carpeggiani, confirmed that talks with Southampton are ongoing and that they are waiting for the deal to reach completion.

article_content: India, which depends on pulse imports to cover domestic shortages, has expressed concern over delays in tur (pigeon pea) dal shipments from Mozambique. The government has asked Mozambique to speed up the clearance of consignments at its ports. Consumer Affairs Secretary Rohit Kumar Singh raised the issue in a meeting with Mozambique High Commissioner Ermindo A Pereira, pointing out that trade-related procedural problems since July 2023 have delayed the export of tur from Mozambique. As a result, shipments are awaiting clearance at Mozambican ports. Singh highlighted the urgency of clearing these consignments and urged Mozambique to ensure a smooth export process. He also noted the importance of upholding the bilateral memorandum of understanding (MoU) on tur trade, reflecting the countries' commitment to their producers and consumers. During the meeting, the Mozambican High Commissioner assured that steps would be taken to resolve these issues and ensure a steady supply of tur exports to India. This is important for maintaining the availability and affordability of tur dal for Indian consumers in coming months. India produces about 25-27 million tonnes of pulses each year and imports 2-3 million tonnes. This year, the area sown to pulses during the kharif season dropped to 122.57 lakh hectares as of September 22, due to poor rainfall in major pulse-producing states.

Sakataren Harkokin Masu Amfani da Kayayyaki, Rohit Kumar Singh, ya tattauna batun da Jakadan Mozambique, Ermindo A Pereira, inda ya bayyana matsalolin da suka shafi kasuwancin tur tun watan Yuli 2023, wanda ya janyo jinkirin fitar da kaya daga Mozambique. Hakan yasa kayan sun tsaya jiran izinin fita daga tashar Mozambique. Singh ya jaddada bukatar gaggauta saki wadannan kaya tare da rokon Mozambique ta tabbatar da saukin fitar da tur zuwa India. Ya kuma yi nuni da muhimmancin kiyaye yarjejeniyar fahimta (MoU) tsakanin kasashen biyu kan kasuwancin tur, wadda ke nuna kudurin kasashen ga manoma da masu amfani. A lokacin taron, Jakadan Mozambique ya tabbatar da cewa za a dauki matakan da suka dace don magance matsalolin da suka taso da tabbatar da cigaba da fitar da tur zuwa India. Wannan yana da muhimmanci don tabbatar da wadatar da saukin dal din tur a kasuwar India watanni masu zuwa. India na samar da ton miliyan 25 zuwa 27 na wake-wake a duk shekara, kuma tana shigo da ton miliyan 2 zuwa 3. Bana, fadin da aka noma wake-wake lokacin damina ya kai eka miliyan 12.257 a ranar 22 ga Satumba, sakamakon karancin ruwa a wasu muhimman jihohin samar da wake-wake.

article_content: A Los Angeles judge has determined that rapper A$AP Rocky will stand trial for allegedly shooting at his former friend and collaborator during an incident near a Hollywood hotel in 2021. Judge M.L. Villar made the decision after a preliminary hearing with testimony from two witnesses, concluding there is enough evidence for the prosecution to proceed. Rocky faces two felony counts of assault with a semiautomatic firearm and, if found guilty, could face up to 24 years in prison. The November 6, 2021, confrontation involved Rocky—real name Rakim Mayers—and Terell Ephron, a former close friend and collaborator from their school days in New York. Tensions between them escalated, culminating in Ephron’s claim that Rocky pointed a gun at him and later fired, grazing Ephron’s hand. Prosecutors presented Ephron’s testimony and surveillance footage as central evidence. LAPD Detective Frank Flores testified that Rocky was identified in the footage, but no firearm was found, and shell casings were discovered by Ephron rather than police officers. When handed in, these casings yielded no fingerprints. Rocky’s defense lawyer, Joe Tacopina, questioned the reliability of Ephron’s account, noting the absence of immediate physical evidence at the scene and highlighting the minor nature and delayed treatment of Ephron’s injury. Tacopina argued that key evidence, like the weapon itself, was never located by authorities. After the ruling, Tacopina expressed confidence in Rocky's eventual vindication and stated that Rocky, who shares two sons with singer Rihanna, wants to protect his family from the stress of the trial. Beyond music, A$AP Rocky is prominent in fashion and is well known for his relationship with Rihanna. He previously faced legal issues in Sweden in 2019, a case that received attention from then-President Donald Trump. Rocky’s early albums topped the Billboard charts, though he has recently focused on fashion and family life.

Alkalin M.L. Villar ya yanke wannan hukuncin bayan sauraron shaida daga mutane biyu, inda ya bayyana akwai isassun hujjoji domin ci gaba da shari'ar. Rocky na fuskantar tuhuma biyu na laifin kai hari da bindiga mai sarrafa kanta, kuma idan an same shi da laifi, zai iya shafe shekaru 24 a gidan yari. Aikata laifin ya faru a ranar 6 ga Nuwamba 2021, tsakanin Rocky—da ake kira da sunansa na ainihi Rakim Mayers—da Terell Ephron, tsohon aboki da abokin aiki tun lokacin makaranta a New York. Rikici ya tsananta tsakanin su har Ephron ke zargin Rocky ya nufi bindiga a kansa sannan daga bisani ya harba, wanda ya jikkata hannunsa. Masu gabatar da kara sun gabatar da bayanai daga Ephron da kuma bidiyon tsaro a matsayin manyan hujjoji. Da aka kai harsasan gun ‘yan sanda, ba a samu alamun yatsu a kan su ba. Lauyan Rocky, Joe Tacopina, ya kalubalanci sahihancin bayanan Ephron, ya lura da cewa hujjoji kai tsaye ba su da yawa a wurin da abin ya faru, da kuma cewa ciwon Ephron ya yi rauni ne kadan kuma ya ja lokaci kafin neman magani. Ya kuma jaddada cewa an kasa gano muhimmin hujja kamar bindigar kanta. Bayan hukuncin, Tacopina ya bayyana tabbaci cewa Rocky zai fita lafiya daga wannan shari'a, ya kuma ce mawakin, wanda ke da ‘ya’ya biyu da Rihanna, yana kokarin kare iyalinsa daga matsin lambar shari’ar. Bayan waka da fa’ida a duniyar kaya, A$AP Rocky shahararren ne saboda dangantakarsa da Rihanna, kuma ya taba tsunduma cikin shari'a a Sweden a shekarar 2019, abin da ya ja hankalin tsohon shugaban kasa Donald Trump. Kundin wakarsa na farko sun kai matakin farko a Billboard, amma a yanzu ya fi karkata zuwa harkar kaya da kula da iyali.

article_content: WASHINGTON – The United States is hosting the annual APEC summit this week in San Francisco for the first time since 2011. Leaders from the 21-member Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation group will convene to discuss how to boost trade and economic growth across the Pacific region. A major focal point of the summit is a face-to-face meeting between President Joe Biden and Chinese President Xi Jinping. The conference takes place amid tense U.S.-China relations and ongoing global conflicts like the Israel-Hamas war and Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. APEC stands for Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation. Established in 1989 with 12 members, it now has 21, including China, Russia, Japan, the U.S., and Australia. These economies represent about 40% of the world’s population and nearly half of global trade. The annual summit brings together heads of state and key economic officials. Russia will have minimal representation due to its ongoing invasion of Ukraine. The U.S. hopes this year’s summit will help make APEC economies more resilient, especially in response to climate change and the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic, which strained supply chains worldwide. Biden and Xi last met in person during the 2022 G20 summit in Bali, Indonesia. Since then, tensions have increased due to incidents like the downing of a Chinese balloon over the U.S., Chinese cyberattacks, and disagreements over trade and the Taiwan Strait. Despite rising tensions, U.S. and Chinese officials have met more frequently in an effort to improve relations. Still, this summit is not expected to significantly change the dynamic between the two countries. APEC focuses on economic issues, not military ones, and includes both 'economies' and non-state entities like Hong Kong and Taiwan to allow broad participation. Its primary strength is encouraging cooperation and reducing trade barriers without formal agreements. The U.S. now emphasizes economic competition with China, seeking partners for manufacturing alternatives and promoting the Indo-Pacific Economic Framework, launched after the U.S. left the Trans-Pacific Partnership. APEC has faced disruptions in recent years: meetings were held virtually during the pandemic, Chile withdrew from hosting in 2019 due to protests, and there have been demonstrations at recent summits. Conflicts like the Ukraine war and Israel-Hamas war may cause divisions among members, making a joint statement at the summit’s conclusion uncertain. Taiwan will again be represented by Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. founder Morris Chang, while Hong Kong’s Financial Secretary Paul Chan will attend in place of Chief Executive John Lee, who is under U.S. sanctions. A potential U.S. government shutdown and concerns over American political stability may also overshadow the event, as Moody’s Investors Service recently downgraded its outlook on U.S. government debt to 'negative.' Traditionally, APEC leaders pose for a group photo wearing local attire, but it’s unclear if this custom will continue this year. The last U.S. host, President Obama, chose not to uphold it.
translated_content: WASHINGTON – Amurka tana karɓar taron shekara-shekara na APEC a wannan makon a San Francisco, karo na farko tun 2011. Shugabanni daga ƙasashe 21 da ke cikin haɗin gwiwar tattalin arzikin Asiya da Pasifik za su taru don tattauna hanyoyin bunkasa kasuwanci da ci gaban tattalin arziki a yankin Pasifik. Babban abin kallo a taron shine haɗuwar Shugaba Joe Biden da Shugaba Xi Jinping na China. Taron yana gudana ne a lokaci da dangantakar Amurka da China ke cike da ɗumamar siyasa, yayin da rikicin Israel da Hamas da mamayar Rasha a Ukraine ke cigaba. APEC na nufin Haɗin Gwiwar Tattalin Arziki ta Asiya da Pasifik. An kafa shi a 1989 da ƙasashe 12, yanzu ya kai 21, ciki har da China, Rasha, Japan, Amurka, da Ostiraliya. Wadannan ƙasashen na dauke da kusan kashi 40% na yawan mutanen duniya da kuma kusan rabin harkokin kasuwancin ƙasa da ƙasa. Taron shekara-shekara na haɗa shugabanni da manyan jami’an tattalin arziki. Rasha za ta sami ƙarancin wakilci saboda mamayarta Ukraine. Amurka na fatan wannan taron zai taimaka wa ƙasashen APEC su fi ƙarfi, musamman duba da canjin yanayi da illar cutar COVID-19 wacce ta kawo cikas ga samar da kayayyaki a duniya. Biden da Xi sun gana a karon karshe a taron G20 na 2022 da aka yi a Bali, Indonesiya. Tun daga lokacin dangantakarsu ta tsananta saboda batutuwan balon leƙen asiri daga China a Amurka, harin yanar gizo, da sabani kan harkokin kasuwanci da yankin Taiwan. Duk da haka, jami'an Amurka da China sun kara yawan tattaunawa don kyautata dangantaka, amma ba a sa ran wannan taron zai kawo babbar sauyi ba. APEC na mai da hankali kan al'amuran tattalin arziki, ba na soja ba, kuma tana kunshe da “kasashe” da yankuna masu cin gashin kansu kamar Hong Kong da Taiwan domin samun damar shiga daidai. Ƙarfinta shi ne hada kai da rage shingayen kasuwanci ba tare da tilas din yarjejeniya ba. Amurka yanzu na mai da hankali ga gasa a fannin tattalin arziki da China, tana neman kulla hulda da sauran ƙasashe don musanya masana'antu da kuma tallafa wa tsarin tattalin arzikin Indo-Pacific da aka fara bayan Amurka ta fice daga Trans-Pacific Partnership. APEC ta sha fama da matsaloli a ‘yan shekarun nan: an gudanar da taro ta yanar gizo a lokacin cutar, Chile ta janye bakunci a 2019 saboda zanga-zanga, kuma an yi zanga-zanga a wasu taruka. Rikicin Ukraine da na Israel da Hamas na iya haifar da rashin jituwar ra'ayi tsakanin mambobi, don haka babu tabbacin fitar da sanarwa ta hadin gwiwa a karshen taron. Taiwan za ta karo wakilci ta hanyar wanda ya kafa Kamfanin Tattalin Arzikin Lantarki na Taiwan, Morris Chang, yayin da Sakataren Kudi na Hong Kong, Paul Chan, zai tarar da babbar jami’in Hong Kong John Lee wanda ke kan takunkumin Amurka. Yiwuwar rufe gwamnatin Amurka da matsalolin siyasar cikin gida su ma za su iya tasiri taron, ganin cewa Moody’s Investors Service kwanan nan ta rage hasashen bashi na Amurka zuwa “mummuna.” A wasu lokutan, shugabannin APEC na yawan ɗaukar hoto suna sa kaya na gargajiya, amma har yanzu ba a san ko za a dawo da wannan al’adar bana ba. Lokacin da Amurka ta yi bakunci a baya, Shugaba Obama bai amince da hakan ba.

article_content: Baghdad, Iraq (CNN) – The Iraqi government has accused a manufacturer of supplying fake bomb detectors to the country and announced plans to take legal action against the company. According to government spokesman Ali al-Dabbagh, three Iraqi investigations found that while most of the bomb detectors were functional, some were fake and ineffective. He did not specify which devices were involved or provide details about the investigations. Al-Dabbagh stated that the fake detectors have been removed from Iraqi streets and replaced with working devices, though it was not immediately clear how many units were replaced. The government said it will also investigate those involved in contracting or importing the devices and sue the company responsible, which was not named in the statement. Earlier this year, Iraq announced an investigation into the ADE651 device after concerns emerged that it was a hoax. The handheld detector is widely used at checkpoints in Iraq and Afghanistan to identify explosives. The British government has banned the export of the ADE651, made by UK company ATSC, over fraud concerns. The company declined to comment to CNN, citing ongoing legal proceedings. There was no immediate response from the company following Tuesday’s announcement by Iraq. The firm's website was under maintenance, and phone calls to the listed company number went unanswered. Police in the UK have arrested and questioned Jim McCormick, ATSC’s managing director, on suspicion of fraud. In addition, the Thai government reported that a similar device, the GT200, failed comprehensive tests conducted by scientists and the military. The Thai government is considering legal action against its manufacturer. Global Technical, the UK-based maker of the GT200, disputed the test results, claiming they contradicted independent evaluations and the experiences of numerous users worldwide. Both the ADE651 and GT200 rely on technology that some scientists argue is little more than a car antenna mounted on a plastic box, functioning similarly to dowsing rods used to locate water.
translated_content: Bagadaza, Iraq (CNN) – Gwamnatin Iraq ta zargi wani kamfani da samar da na'urorin gano bama-bamai na karya kuma ta sanar da shirin daukar matakin shari'a a kansa. Kakakin gwamnati, Ali al-Dabbagh, ya bayyana cewa bincike uku da aka gudanar a kasar sun gano cewa mafi yawan na'urorin suna aiki, amma wasu na karya ne kuma ba su amfani. Bai fayyace sunan na'urorin ko cikakkun bayanai ba. Al-Dabbagh ya ce an cire na'urorin da ba sa aiki daga titunan Iraq kuma an maye gurbin su da na'urori na gaskiya, kodayake ba a bayyana adadin su ba. Gwamnati za ta ci gaba da binciken wadanda suka shigo da na'urorin da kuma kamfanin da ke da alhaki, wanda ba a bayyana sunansa ba. A farkon bana, Iraq ta sanar da bincikar ADE651 bayan an samu shakku cewa bogi ce. Ana amfani da wannan karamar na'ura a wuraren binciken ababen hawa a Iraq da Afghanistan domin gano bama-bamai. Gwamnatin Burtaniya ta hana fitar da ADE651, wanda kamfanin ATSC daga Birtaniya ke samarwa, saboda zargin damfara. Kamfanin bai zanta da CNN ba saboda shari’a na gudana. Babu wata martani daga kamfanin bayan sanarwar ranar Talata. Shafin kamfanin yana gyara, kuma ba wanda ya amsa kiran waya daga lambar da aka bayar. ‘Yan sanda a Birtaniya sun kama kuma sun tuhumi Jim McCormick, babban darektan ATSC, bisa zargin damfara. Har ila yau, gwamnatin Thailand ta bayyana cewa wata na’ura makamanciyar haka, GT200, ba ta ci jarabawar da masana kimiyya da soja suka yi ba. Gwamnatin Thailand tana tunanin daukar mataki a kotu kan masana'antar ta GT200. Global Technical, kamfanin Birtaniya mai samar da GT200, ya karyata sakamakon gwajin yana mai cewa sakamakon ya sha banban da nazarin wasu hukumomin gwaji masu zaman kansu, da kuma gogewar masu amfani da na’urar a duniya. Dukka na’urorin ADE651 da GT200 na amfani da fasahar da wasu masana kimiyya ke cewa ba ta da inganci, sai dai ana kwatanta ta da sandar dowsing da ake amfani da ita wajen nemo ruwa.

article_content:
Expedia Group announced on Thursday a $5 billion share buyback plan after delivering better-than-expected profits for the quarter, driven by robust travel demand and higher rates that boosted margins. Shares of the online travel company, which owns brands like Vrbo and Hotels.com, rose 10% in after-hours trading.

US travel firms have recently experienced a jump in international travel bookings as eased restrictions, a strong dollar, and expanded remote work have encouraged more business and leisure trips. Earnings for third-quarter were lifted by increased bookings around Independence Day and Labor Day.

Between July and September, Expedia reported an adjusted profit of $5.41 per share, above analysts’ forecasts of $4.93 (according to LSEG data). Gross bookings increased by 7% year-on-year to $25.69 billion, while revenue grew by 8.6% to $3.93 billion, topping expectations.

Farashin hannun jarin kamfanin, mai mallakar Vrbo da Hotels.com, ya tashi da kashi 10% bayan kasuwar dare.

A cikin kwanakin baya, kamfanonin balaguro na Amurka sun sake samun karuwar ajiyar balaguro zuwa kasashen waje, sakamakon sassaucin dokoki, karfi dala, da kuma yawaitar aiki daga gida wanda ya sa mutane da dama ke tafiye-tafiye don kasuwanci da hutu. Karin ajiyar otel da jirgi a lokutan Independence Day da Labor Day ya taimaka wajen bunkasa kudaden shiga na zangon uku.

A tsakanin Yuli da Satumba, Expedia ta samu riba ta dala $5.41 kan kowanne hannun jari, wanda ya haura hasashen masana na dala $4.93 (bisa ga bayanan LSEG). Jimillar ajiyar balaguron ta ta karu da kashi 7% zuwa dala biliyan $25.69, yayin da kudin shiga ya tashi da kashi 8.6% zuwa dala biliyan $3.93, duka sun fi tsammanin da aka yi.

article_content: Victoria Beckham, a renowned singer, fashion designer, and mother of four, is leveraging her public profile to support those in need by auctioning over 600 personal wardrobe items for charity. In collaboration with theoutnet.com, proceeds from this exclusive sale will benefit mothers2mothers, a non-profit organization working to empower women living with HIV through education and employment as 'mentor mothers' to prevent the transmission of HIV from mothers to their children. Victoria's support was inspired by her visit to South Africa, where she met Dr. Mitch Besser, founder of mothers2mothers, and learned about their impactful work. Moved by the experience, Victoria decided to contribute by organizing a sale of her distinctive clothing and accessories. The curated sale includes standout pieces from her career—designer dresses, shoes, hats, bags, jewelry, and outfits from events such as the MTV Video Music Awards and the pre-World Cup party. Ten especially iconic items will be sold through the 'Going, Going, Gone' reverse auction, where prices decrease at regular intervals until the pieces are purchased. Victoria carefully selected the items alongside her mother and sister, ranging from Spice Girls era outfits to memorable ensembles worn with David Beckham or at major fashion moments. Stephanie Phair, President of The Outnet, commended Victoria's dedication, while Dr. Mitch Besser highlighted the significant impact funds will have in extending education, support, and empowerment to more HIV-positive mothers, reducing the risk of mother-to-child transmission. The campaign not only raises essential funds but also heightens awareness, channeling Victoria Beckham's influence to make a meaningful difference in the global fight against HIV.

Tare da hadin gwiwar theoutnet.com, kudaden da za a samu daga wannan siyarwa za su taimaka wa mothers2mothers, wata kungiya mai zaman kanta da ke karfafa mata masu dauke da cutar HIV ta hanyar ilimantarwa da samar da aiki a matsayin 'mentor mothers' don hana yada HIV daga uwa zuwa danta. Victoria ta samu kwarin gwiwa ne bayan ziyarar da ta kai Afirka ta Kudu inda ta hadu da Dr. Mitch Besser, wanda ya kafa mothers2mothers, ta kuma ga kai tsaye irin aikin alherin da suke yi. Wannan kwarewa ta motsa zuciyarta, har ta yanke shawarar taimakawa ta hanyar shirya wannan siyarwar kayayyakin nata na musamman. article_content: Television wildlife presenter and botanist David Bellamy is putting his extensive collection of historic microscopes and scientific slides up for sale as he and his wife Rosemary prepare to move from Durham, their home since 1960, to France. Bellamy, renowned for hosting popular nature programs in the 1980s and 1990s, has collected around 12 brass microscopes—including notable pieces like the rare George Adams New Universal microscope from 1746 (valued up to £7,000) and a Watson 'Van Heurck' binocular microscope from 1890 (estimated at £5,000). Also part of the collection are wooden cabinets containing thousands of microscope slides showcasing examples of flora and fauna from the British Isles. Expected to sell for about £20,000, the collection will go under the hammer in 24 lots at a Tennants Auctioneers sale in Leyburn, North Yorkshire, on October 29. Kegan Harrison, a specialist at Tennants, highlighted the value of the collection’s unique history and connection to Bellamy’s distinguished career. Bellamy first gained attention in 1967 as an environmental consultant for the Torrey Canyon disaster, later presenting and authoring numerous works on botany and environmental topics, such as 'Bellamy on Botany' and 'Bellamy’s Backyard Safari.' In addition to television, Bellamy lectured at Durham University until 1982 and still holds an honorary professorship for Adult and Continuing Education. He is also known for his critical stance on theories of man-made global warming and opposition to wind farms.
translated_content: Mashahurin mai shirya fina-finan dabi’a da masanin kimiyyar tsirrai, David Bellamy, zai sayar da tarin na'urorin hangen ƙwayoyin cuta da slayid ɗin kimiyya saboda shi da matarsa Rosemary za su bar Durham, inda suka zauna tun 1960, zuwa Faransa. An san Bellamy da shirya shirye-shiryen yanayi sanannu a shekarun 1980 da 1990, inda ya tara kimanin na'urorin hangen ƙwayoyin cuta na tagulla guda 12, ciki har da George Adams New Universal microscope na 1746 (kimanin £7,000) da Watson 'Van Heurck' binocular microscope na 1890 (kimanin £5,000). Tarin na da kabad na itace masu ɗauke da dubban slayid na kimiyya da ke nuna nau'ikan tsirrai da dabbobi daga sassan Birtaniya. Ana kyautata tsammani za a siyar da tarin a farashin kimanin £20,000 a mazubi 24, a Tennants Auctioneers da ke Leyburn, North Yorkshire, ranar 29 ga Oktoba. Kegan Harrison, kwararre a Tennants, ya bayyana muhimmancin tarihin tarin da kuma alakarsa da rayuwar aikin Bellamy. Bellamy ya fara fitowa fili a 1967 a matsayin mashawarcin muhalli wurin hatsarin jirgin mai na Torrey Canyon, daga bisani kuma ya gabatar da shirye-shirye da littattafai game da kimiyya irin su 'Bellamy on Botany' da 'Bellamy’s Backyard Safari.' Baya ga aikin talabijin, Bellamy malamin jami'a ne a Durham har zuwa 1982, kuma har yanzu yana riƙe da matsayin Malami mai Girma ga Adult and Continuing Education. Sannan, an san shi da ra'ayin akasin dumamar yanayi da suka da gonakin iska.

article_content: President Bola Tinubu will depart Abuja today for Berlin, Germany, to attend the G20 Compact with Africa (CwA) Conference on November 20, 2023. The conference, hosted by German Chancellor Olaf Scholz, will be held alongside the fourth G20 Investment Summit, jointly organized by the German government and German business associations. According to Ajuri Ngelale, Tinubu’s Special Adviser on Media and Publicity, key topics at the conference include energy, trade, investment, infrastructure, and new technologies, all aimed at enhancing economic and business cooperation among participating countries. President Tinubu will join other leaders from CwA member states, international organizations, and bilateral partners to discuss practical steps to boost investment in critical sectors. He will lead Nigeria’s delegation at the summit, continuing his efforts to attract foreign direct investment. This visit demonstrates diplomatic reciprocity, as Tinubu honors an invitation from Chancellor Scholz, following Scholz’s visit to Abuja and Lagos in late October 2023. During their October discussions, Tinubu stressed the need for increased German investment in Nigeria’s transportation, mining, and energy sectors. He also highlighted Nigeria’s status as Germany’s second-largest trading partner in Africa. Trade between Nigeria and Germany rose from two billion to three billion euros between 2021 and 2022, reflecting growing economic ties.

A cewar Ajuri Ngelale, mai ba Tinubu shawara kan harkokin yada labarai, batutuwan da za a mayar da hankali a kai sun hada da makamashi, kasuwanci, zuba jari, ababen more rayuwa da sabbin fasahohi, domin karfafa hadin kan tattalin arziki da kasuwanci tsakanin kasashen da ke halarta. Shugaba Tinubu zai hadu da sauran shugabanni daga kasashen CwA, kungiyoyin kasa da kasa, da abokan hulda domin tattauna matakan da za su taimaka wajen kara jari a muhimman fannoni. Zai jagoranci tawagar Najeriya, yana ci gaba da kokarinsa na jawo zuba jari daga kasashen waje. Ziyarar tana nuna dakyar hadin gwiwar diflomasiyya, inda Tinubu ya amsa gayyatar Firayim Ministan Jamus, bayan ziyarar Scholz zuwa Abuja da Legas a karshen Oktoba 2023. Kasuwanci tsakanin Najeriya da Jamus ya karu daga biliyan biyu zuwa biliyan uku na euro tsakanin 2021 da 2022, wanda ke nuna karfafa dangantakar tattalin arziki.
