article_content:
Di Patston, who recently resigned as the Wallabies’ business manager, left her position after enduring considerable stress linked to incidents involving rugby player Kurtley Beale. Her resignation follows ongoing inquiries by the Integrity Unit into two occurrences: accusations that Beale sent explicit and mocking text messages about her in June, and a reported verbal dispute between Beale and Patston during a team flight last month. At a press conference, coach Ewen McKenzie disclosed that Patston is currently reliant on strong medication as she deals with the aftermath.

McKenzie commended Patston’s dedication and impact on the team, voicing significant concern for her wellbeing and emphasizing his sense of responsibility, especially since he was involved in bringing her onto the team from his previous coaching role at the Queensland Reds. He also strongly denied suggestions of any inappropriate relationship with Patston.

Meanwhile, the media has questioned Patston’s professional qualifications and criticized the Australian Rugby Union’s recruitment process, intensifying the situation. Wallabies player Christian Leali'ifano expressed that Patston’s exit felt like losing a motherly supporter, highlighting her supportive role. In contrast, Wallabies captain Michael Hooper spoke up for Beale, asserting that he should remain with the team.

This controversy has drawn widespread media attention, overshadowing the team’s preparations for their pivotal upcoming Bledisloe Cup match against New Zealand.

Di Patston, wadda ta zama tsohuwar manajan kasuwanci na Wallabies, ta ajiye aikinta bayan fuskantar matsin lamba sakamakon matsalolin da suka shafi dan wasa Kurtley Beale. Murabus dinta na zuwa ne yayin da hukumar kula da gaskiya ta kungiyar ke ci gaba da bincike kan abubuwa guda biyu: zargin Beale da tura sakonni masu zagi a watan Yuni da kuma wani sabani tsakanin su a jirgi a bara.

A taron manema labarai, koci Ewen McKenzie ya bayyana cewa Patston tana amfani da magani mai karfi domin kokarin magance abin da ta tsinci kanta a ciki. McKenzie ya bayyana Jin dadinsa da goyon baya ga aikin Patston tare da nuna damuwa kan yanayin da take ciki da kuma nauyin dake kansa, ganin dai shi ne ya dauko ta tun daga Queensland Reds. Ya kuma musanta rade-radin dangantaka ta sirri tsakaninsu.

A lokaci guda, kafofin yada labarai sun fara binciken cancantar aiki ta Patston da kuma sukan yadda Australian Rugby Union suka daukota aikin, wanda ya kara dagula al'amura. Christian Leali'ifano ya bayyana cewar ficewar Patston a matsayin uwa ce da suka rasa, yana mai bayanin irin gudummawar da ta bayar. Shugaban 'yan wasa, Michael Hooper, ya kare Beale yana mai cewa yana da muhimmanci a bar shi cikin kungiyar.

Wannan rikicin ya jawo hankalin jama’a da dama, yana shafar shirya wasan Wallabies da New Zealand da ke tafe a Bledisloe Cup.

article_content: Brian Grazer, the 62-year-old Hollywood producer, is getting ready to tie the knot for the fourth time after recently proposing to Veronica Smiley, 40, who is the chief marketing officer at SBE. The engagement happened on the rooftop of Santa Monica's Huntley Hotel and was almost derailed when Grazer briefly lost the diamond ring, but he managed to recover it quickly. Smiley, who previously dated British comedian John Cleese in 2008, said yes to Grazer's proposal and announced their engagement on Instagram. The couple is now making wedding plans. Grazer has been married three times before—to Theresa McKay (1972), Corki Corman (1982), and screenwriter Gigi Levangie (1997)—and has three sons and a daughter. He was also engaged in 2011 to Vietnamese artist Nguyễn Thị Châu Giang, but the wedding did not take place. Well-known for his work in film and television, Grazer co-founded Imagine Entertainment with Ron Howard in 1986. His productions have earned more than $13 billion worldwide, and he won the Academy Award for Best Picture in 2002 for 'A Beautiful Mind.' Grazer's projects have received 43 Oscar nominations and 131 nominations at the Emmys. He is currently working on a new season of '24' and the biopic 'Get On Up' about James Brown, with Mick Jagger as a collaborator.

An yi bukin na musamman a saman ruf din Otal Huntley da ke Santa Monica, inda abubuwa suka kusa tabarbarewa saboda Grazer ya gaza gano zoben, amma daga baya ya tsinta. Smiley, wacce ta taba soyayya da dan barkwanci Bature, John Cleese, a shekarar 2008, ta amsa bukatar Grazer kuma ta bayyana farin cikinta a Instagram. Su biyun sun fara shirin bikin aure. article_content: Following the catastrophic train accident in Lac-Megantic, Quebec, Montreal, Maine & Atlantic Railway's chairman, Edward Burkhardt, visited the town to listen to local residents and convey his concerns. The tragedy involved a runaway oil train that derailed and exploded, resulting in at least 28 deaths and around 30 missing people, as reported by authorities. Burkhardt’s appearance three days after the incident was met with strong resentment from the community, who criticized his late arrival. He explained that his staff had been present since the beginning and that he stayed behind to avoid interfering with emergency operations, yet many felt his absence contributed to their distress and blamed him for the disaster. During Burkhardt's visit, several frustrated residents confronted him—including Pierre L'Heureux, who demanded his imprisonment, having lost friends and neighbors in the explosion. Efforts by Burkhardt to arrange meetings with officials and responders were unsuccessful, as they were preoccupied with recovery efforts. Burkhardt said his goal was to start a healing process, but acknowledged his limited public relations skills. He insisted he felt considerable sympathy for those affected and disputed claims of indifference toward the victims. However, the community's anger made him decide against returning to Lac-Megantic until the situation is less volatile. On the accident’s cause, Burkhardt pointed to brake failure as a clear factor but acknowledged the situation’s complexity, with investigations ongoing. The train engineer, previously known for a spotless safety record, was suspended; Burkhardt expressed doubts about the engineer’s claim of setting all required hand brakes. He emphasized that any internal charges against the engineer would involve a thorough and fair review with union representation. Burkhardt said the priority is a just investigation rather than adding to the engineer’s difficulties. Overall, the incident has left Lac-Megantic in mourning and searching for answers, with tensions between residents and railway leadership still high.
translated_content: Bayan mummunan hatsarin jirgin kasa a Lac-Megantic, Quebec, shugaban Montreal, Maine & Atlantic Railway, Edward Burkhardt, ya ziyarci garin don jin ra'ayin jama'a da nuna damuwarsa. Hatsarin ya faru ne sakamakon jirgin mai da ya gudu da kansa ya kuma fashe, inda aka tabbatar da mutuwar mutane akalla 28 yayin da kusan 30 ba a san inda suke ba, a cewar hukumomi. Zuwan Burkhardt bayan kwana uku da afkuwar hatsarin ya haifar da fushi daga mazauna garin, wadanda suka soki jinkirin zuwa nasa. Ya bayyana cewa ma'aikatansa sun isa wurin tun farko, ya kuma yi nisa ne saboda kar ya cika wajen masu aikin ceto, amma da dama sun ji rashin kasancewarsa kuma sun danganta shi da alhakin hatsarin. A lokacin ziyarar, wasu daga cikin mazauna sun fuskanci Burkhardt da fushinsu—musamman Pierre L'Heureux, wanda ya yi kira a tasa shi gidan yari. Duk kokarin Burkhardt na shiga tattaunawa da jami'ai da masu aikin ceto bai yi nasara ba saboda suna cikin kokarin ceto. Burkhardt ya ce manufarsa ita ce a kawo sasanci, sai dai ya amince ba shi da kwarewa sosai a harkar mu'amala da mutane. Ya jaddada jin tausayinsa ga wadanda abin ya shafa tare da musanta zargin rashin damuwa. Sai dai fushin jama'a ya sa ya yanke shawarar kada ya dawo Lac-Megantic har sai abubuwa sun lafa. Dangane da dalilin hatsarin, Burkhardt ya tabbatar cewa matsalar birki ce ta jawo, amma har yanzu bincike na ci gaba bisa rikitar lamarin. An dakatar da injiniyan jirgin wanda ya kasance da kyau a aikinsa tun farko; Burkhardt ya nuna shakku ko injiniyan ya dauki dukkan matakan kariya da suka dace. Burkhardt ya nanata cewa duk wani tuhuma za a gudanar da bincike mai gaskiya tare da wakilcin ƙungiyar kwadago ga injiniyan. Ya ce ainihin bukata ita ce a tabbatar da adalci ba tare da kara jefa injiniyan cikin matsala ba. A karshe, lamarin ya bar al'ummar Lac-Megantic cikin bakin ciki da neman adalci, yayin da ake ci gaba da samun rashin jituwa tsakanin jama'a da shugabannin kamfanin jirgin.

article_content: UEFA Euro 2024, a major football tournament, will take place in Germany from June 14 to July 14, 2024. Star teams from across Europe will compete for the title. The Euro 2024 draw is scheduled for December 2, 2023, in Hamburg. The final match will be held on July 14, 2024, at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Tickets went on sale from October 3 to October 23, 2023. If you missed this window, there will be additional opportunities to purchase tickets once teams are confirmed in 2024. Ticket prices for group stage matches range from €30 to €200. Prices increase in later rounds, with final match tickets costing between €95 and €1,000. Important dates include: Play-off semifinals on March 21, 2024, and play-off finals on March 26, 2024. The opening game will be on June 14 in Munich Football Arena (Allianz Arena). The Round of 16 takes place from June 30 to July 2, quarter-finals on July 5–6, semi-finals on July 9–10, and the final on July 14, 2024. England's Harry Kane, Bukayo Saka, and Phil Foden are highlighted among the players to watch. Note: Financial and airline business news from the original article has been omitted for relevance.

article_content: Prime Minister David Cameron has faced criticism for using a Royal Air Force jet to return to the UK from his summer holiday in Portugal after just one day, due to official duties. Cameron traveled with his wife and three children to Portugal for a planned ten-day break, but returned to attend the closing ceremony of the Commonwealth Games. After attending the ceremony, he is scheduled to travel by RAF plane to France and Belgium for First World War commemorations, before returning to Portugal on a commercial flight at his own expense. Opposition politicians argue that the Prime Minister should have postponed his holiday to avoid the cost to taxpayers. Cameron's travel itinerary involves covering approximately 3,700 air miles over three days. Labour MP Thomas Docherty and colleague Steve Pound questioned why the holiday could not have been scheduled after these official events. Cameron, who has previously come under fire for frequent holidays, maintains he remains in control of government affairs from abroad. His family will also holiday in Cornwall later this summer. Other political leaders, including Labour leader Ed Miliband and Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg, are also taking summer holidays. Miliband is spending two weeks in France and Clegg recently visited Spain with his wife Miriam. Downing Street stated that the Prime Minister is entitled to use official government transport for work-related duties.

Cameron ya tafi tare da matarsa da 'ya'yansa uku zuwa Portugal don hutu na kwanaki goma, amma ya dawo gida domin halartar bikin rufe Wasannin Commonwealth. Bayan bikin, an shirya ya tafi da jirgin soji zuwa Faransa da Belgium don bikin tunawa da yakin duniya na farko, kafin ya koma Portugal da jirgin kasuwanci da kudinsa. article_content: A family is celebrating the birth of its first baby girl in 90 years. Rubi Victoria Porter was born at Lincoln County Hospital on March 29, weighing 7lbs 8oz. Her parents, Rudi and Vicky Porter from Newark, Nottinghamshire, chose not to find out the baby's sex during scans, so Rubi's arrival was a wonderful surprise. Proud father Rudi held baby Rubi as they gathered for a family photo that included her grandfather Chris Porter, great-grandfather Thomas Porter, and uncle Liam Porter. Vicky, aged 27, said the midwife handed her the baby immediately after birth, so she was the first to discover they had a daughter. 'I was over the moon when I saw I had a little girl,' Vicky said. Rudi, 29, admitted he cried when Rubi was born. He said, 'After all this time of the family having only boys, it was a real shock to finally have a girl.' The last girl before Rubi was Elizabeth Porter, born on January 2, 1922. Her brother, Tom Porter (now 82), is Rubi's great-grandfather. Tom and his wife Betty, 81, have three sons: Chris (58), David (52), and Kevin (50). Each son had two boys of his own. Chris is the father of Rudi and Liam (28). David's sons are William (14) and Thomas (11), while Kevin's are Harrison (14) and Ben (11). Rubi's great-grandmother, Betty Porter, said it was amazing to finally have a girl born into the family. 'I had given up hope. Everybody is thrilled we've got a little girl.' Rubi's grandmother, Lorraine Porter, said most people expected another boy. Her mother, Margaret Pollard, made cardigans in every colour, just in case. Lorraine added, 'Everyone was really surprised after all this time. Rubi's really broken the mould.'

article_content: KYIV: Germany will provide Ukraine with another military aid package valued at 1.3 billion euros ($1.42 billion), which will include four additional IRIS-T air defense units, German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius announced in Kyiv on Tuesday. To date, Berlin has committed to supplying Kyiv with eight IRIS-T systems, with three already delivered. Ukraine primarily uses these systems to defend against Russian missile strikes. The support package will also include 20,000 155mm artillery shells and anti-tank mines, Pistorius told reporters during a press conference with his Ukrainian counterpart, Rustem Umerov. 'I am sure this will help you in your fight against Russian aggression,' Pistorius said. 'This underscores that we stand with Ukraine in the long term and reliably.' Pistorius also noted that the artillery shells are in addition to 140,000 155mm rounds Germany has pledged to deliver next year. (Conversion rate: $1 = 0.9168 euros.)

article_content:
When you enter a store, you might not notice that an unseen element is already working to persuade you to make a purchase. This phenomenon, known as scent marketing, is well-established in Europe and the U.S., but remains relatively new in Asia. The concept involves infusing a signature fragrance into a retail space to encourage customers to linger—and potentially make a purchase.

Oriental Watch Co., a leading luxury watch retailer with branches across Asia, adopted this strategy by partnering with Hong Kong-based Skywork Design Ltd. to create a unique store scent reflecting the brand. The fragrance lab developed a distinctive green tea aroma, chosen by Skywork's founder, Daniel Fong, to mirror the company's Chinese identity. "When you see a watch, it's easy to forget it. But when you smell something, it stays with you," says Fong. "Scent appeals directly to our emotions."

For the past four months, all 12 Oriental Watch stores in Hong Kong have been using the green tea fragrance. Salesman Ken To isn’t certain the scent directly increases sales, but he notes customers appear more relaxed and often spend more time browsing, particularly near the scent diffuser. "We can engage customers for longer, which hopefully leads to more sales," To explains. "Our staff appreciate it, too—it eases the stress of selling high-value watches."

Daniel Fong launched Skywork Design Ltd. after 20 years in advertising, noticing a gap in scent marketing within Hong Kong and China. By leveraging his professional network, his business quickly gained momentum. Major clients now include teen fashion retailer 2%, Peninsula Arcade, and Hang Lung Properties. Skywork became profitable just four months after opening.

While many scent companies focus on hotels and casinos to enhance guest experience, Fong targets retail, working directly with marketing teams to boost both sales and brand image.

Fashion chain 2% employs a bubble-gum scent—"juicy, girlish, sweet," according to Fong—distributed through in-store diffusers. Fong recalls overhearing a teenage girl recognize the store purely by its scent, a moment he took as a sign of the fragrance’s branding power. After observing increased sales, 2% expanded the scent program from two stores to all 35 locations in Hong Kong, with plans for future expansion in mainland China.

Tech giant Samsung also hired Fong to design a custom scent for its Galaxy S3 smartphone promotional roadshows in Asia, aiming to convey the product’s nature-inspired theme. Although Fong couldn’t disclose the exact fragrance formula, the result, as described by a reporter, was reminiscent of cologne with a metallic twist—more “gadget” than “nature.”

With growing demand, an international bank has asked Fong to develop a “scent of money” for its Hong Kong offices, blending floral chypre and metallic notes. “I’m still considering the final formula,” Fong says.

Manufar ita ce a yada ƙamshi na musamman a cikin shago domin jawo hankalin masu siyayya su zauna naɗan lokaci—da fatan za su sayi kaya.

Kamfanin Oriental Watch Co., babban mai sayar da agogon alfarma a Asiya, ya rungumi wannan hanya, tare da haɗin guiwa da Skywork Design Ltd., wani kamfani na Hong Kong da ke ƙwarewa wajen tsara tsare-tsaren ƙamshi. Lab ɗin ya ƙirƙiro wani ƙamshin koren shayi, wanda Daniel Fong, wanda ya kafa Skywork, ya zaɓa domin ya dace da asalin kasar Sin na Oriental Watch Co. "Idan ka duba agogo, mai yiwuwa ka manta. Amma idan ka ji ƙamshi, zai daɗe a zuciyarka," a cewar Fong. "ƙamshi yana aiki kai tsaye da bangaren jin daɗi na kwakwalwarmu."

Shekaru hudu da suka gabata kenan tun da shagunan Oriental Watch guda 12 a Hong Kong suka fara amfani da wannan ƙamshi na koren shayi. Duk da cewa wasu kamfanoni sun mai da hankali kan otal-otal da kasinoni don ƙawata wurin zama, Fong ya mai da hankali ne kan muhimman shagunan sayar da kaya da masu tallace-tallace, don ƙara tallace-tallace da ƙarfafa alama.

article_content: The annual Mobo Awards, dedicated to celebrating black music and culture, will take place in Sheffield for the first time in 2024. Founded in 1996, the Music of Black Origin Awards have long championed artists across genres such as grime, hip hop, and R&B. Organisers have confirmed that the 26th ceremony will be held at Sheffield's Utilita Arena on 7 February 2024. Sheffield City Council expressed excitement at the announcement. Council leader Tom Hunt said, "With Sheffield's rich musical history and our reputation for hosting major events, we're proud to recognise and honour outstanding British and international talent across a range of genres. 2024 will be a big year for Sheffield, and we can't wait to roll out the red carpet." The 25th Mobo Awards took place in London in 2023, hosted by YouTubers Chunkz and Yung Filly. Some of the biggest winners included Knucks, Dreya Mac, Little Simz, Central Cee, and PinkPantheress. Nile Rodgers was honoured with the Lifetime Achievement Award. The event also featured performances by Nile Rodgers, Craig David, Kojey Radical, and Cat Burns, and included a special tribute to music entrepreneur Jamal Edwards, performed by Emeli Sandé.

article_content: Beach visitors in Queensland are being urged to watch for venomous sea snakes, which are more common along the coast at this time of year. Recently, the Australia Zoo Rescue Unit recovered five sea snakes washed up on Sunshine Coast beaches. These included two elegant sea snakes from Kawana, one olive headed sea snake in Coolum, and a yellow bellied sea snake from Peregian, all found on Tuesday. On Friday, an additional olive headed sea snake was spotted at Peregian. The snakes were taken to the wildlife hospital, but sadly, one elegant sea snake and the yellow bellied sea snake died from their injuries before they could be treated. Sea snakes, or coral reef snakes, spend most or all of their lives at sea and are highly venomous. Their bites can lead to muscle pain, weakness, drooping eyelids, vomiting, and can result in paralysis or even death. Experts recommend seeking immediate medical help for any suspected sea snake bite, as symptoms might not be obvious at first. No deaths from sea snake bites have been recorded in Australia, though some have occurred overseas. Toby Millyard, manager of the Australia Zoo Rescue Unit, noted that sea snakes are often found on beaches during this season because strong swells may push them ashore. Some snakes require veterinary care for illness or injury, while others just need a period to recover before being released. Millyard advised the public not to handle sea snakes due to their venom, recommending that people call the Rescue Unit instead. Sea snakes are easily recognized by their paddle-shaped tails, which differentiate them from land snakes.

A kwanakin baya nan, ƙungiyar ceto ta Australia Zoo ta dauko macizai biyar da ruwa ya fitar zuwa bakin tekun Sunshine Coast. Wannan ya hada da elegant sea snakes guda biyu daga Kawana, olive headed sea snake guda daga Coolum, da yellow bellied sea snake daga Peregian, duk an same su a ranar Talata. A ranar Juma’a kuma, an sake samun wani olive headed sea snake a Peregian. Dukkan macizan aka kai asibitin dabbobi na zoo, amma abin takaici, elegant sea snake guda ɗaya da yellow bellied sea snake sun mutu kafin a samu damar ba su magani. Millyard ya shawarci jama’a da kada su taba macizan da suka gani saboda gubansu, maimakon haka a kira kungiyar ceton don taimako. article_content: Russia has officially confirmed its control over a group of military dolphins previously operated by Ukraine, potentially utilizing them for underwater naval operations against Western forces. The dolphins, specially trained for military tasks, were seized by Russia when it annexed Crimea in March. Russian authorities have now stated there are no plans to return them to Ukraine. The dolphins are trained at the Crimean State Oceanarium, a facility acquired by Ukraine after the dissolution of the Soviet Union, and which now operates under the Russian Defence Ministry. Acting Sevastopol governor Sergei Menyailo confirmed jurisdiction over the facility has been fully transferred to Russian authorities. Moscow now oversees 13 elite dolphins and several sea lions, all trained for complex naval functions such as mine detection, placing explosives on enemy vessels, or defending against hostile divers. Some animals are also trained for rescue and anti-sabotage missions. The Soviet Union began using dolphins for navy operations in Sevastopol in 1973 during the Cold War. NATO has increased patrols in the Black Sea due to ongoing tensions connected to the Ukrainian crisis, raising the possibility that Russia could deploy these dolphins in military operations involving Western ships. In addition to their military roles, some dolphins at Sevastopol previously assisted with therapy for children suffering from various conditions. These dolphins have now been reassigned to continue this work under Russian administration. The facility in Sevastopol is one of only two centers in the world dedicated to training dolphins for military use, the other being run by the US Navy in San Diego. The article also notes recent economic challenges faced by Russia, including the rouble hitting an all-time low against the US dollar, due to falling oil prices and increased sanctions from the US and European Union over Russia’s involvement in the Ukraine crisis. These sanctions have limited Russian access to foreign capital, further weakening the currency. The article highlights that last year, three of five dolphins went missing during a naval exercise, apparently in search of mates, but later returned. Yury Plyachenko, a former Soviet naval anti-sabotage officer, explained that such behavior is typical of dolphins, especially during mating season.

Yanzu Moscow na da dolphins guda 13 da wasu seals da aka horar da su don gano bama-bamai, saka abubuwan fashewa a jiragen abokan gaba, da kare kansu daga mafarauta a karkashin ruwa. Wasu kuma su na aikin ceto da dakile hare-hare a boye. Tarayyar Soviet ce ta fara wannan horo tun 1973 a Sevastopol, lokacin yakin cacar baka. Wannan ya sa Rasha ta fi samun wahala wajen samun jarin kasashen waje. A bara, dolphin guda uku daga cikin biyar sun bata yayin gwajin soja saboda neman abokan zama amma daga baya sun dawo. article_content: Although Las Vegas appears bustling with tourists—casinos crowded and shows sold out—Nevada’s economy still lags behind. The state has the nation’s second highest unemployment rate, around 9%, and its housing market is yet to recover. Federal Reserve Chair Janet Yellen recently told Republican Senator Dean Heller that a full economic rebound for Nevada may still be several years away. The state’s struggles point to bigger issues across the U.S. economy. For decades, tourism—especially casinos—drove Nevada’s prosperity. Before the 1990s, Nevada and Atlantic City held a near-monopoly on gambling, but as other states legalized casinos, Las Vegas shifted its focus to upscale hotels, entertainment, and fine dining, building a new image centered on luxury. This transformation brought a wave of construction jobs and boosted incomes for residents, many of whom lacked college degrees but enjoyed wages above the national average. Still, this blue-collar boom was built on risky foundations. Las Vegas relied on large numbers of high-spending visitors, often paying for luxury vacations by refinancing homes. When that financial support dried up, the city realized its expensive attractions no longer matched customer budgets. The financial crisis hit not just casinos but also housing and retail jobs linked to tourism. Six years later, Nevada has yet to rebound fully. Casinos nationwide have largely recovered since the recession, with over $37 billion spent in 2012—just shy of 2007’s peak. However, most of this spending now goes to convenient, local casinos. Nevada's revenues remain 20% below peak, and due to higher operating costs, profitability has dropped by half. Employment in Nevada’s casinos fell between 2012 and 2013. These jobs were among the top-paying in the industry, which helps explain why national casino wages are still 7% below 2007 levels, despite industry-wide revenue recovery. A return to the old boom is unlikely. Although just 14% of Americans strongly disapprove of gambling, 38% now say they personally avoid it, up from 27% in 2004. The popularity of online gambling among younger people and basic, budget casinos among older customers further weakens the demand for luxury experiences that defined Las Vegas. As more Americans have less money to spend, Las Vegas’s high-end business model seems increasingly unsustainable—a trend with broad implications beyond the gambling industry.

Jiha ce ta biyu a mafi yawan marasa aikin yi a Amurka, kusan kashi 9%, kuma har yanzu kasuwar gidaje bata warke ba. Shugabar Babban Bankin Amurka Janet Yellen ta shaida wa Sanata Dean Heller na Republican cewa cikakken farfadowa ga tattalin arzikin Nevada na iya daukar lokaci mai tsawo. Wadannan matsalolin na Nevada sun bayyana gagarumar barazana ga tattalin arzikin Amurka gaba daya. Shekaru da yawa, yawon bude ido da caca su ne ginshikin arzikin Nevada. Kafin shekarun 1990, Nevada da Atlantic City sun fi karfi a harkar caca, amma da wasu jihohi suka fara amincewa da gidajen caca, Las Vegas ta koma ga otal-otal masu alatu, nishadi da abinci mai daraja—hakan ya sa ta zama cibiyar jin dadin masu kudi. Wannan ci gaban ya samar da damammakin aikin gini da kuma iya samun kudin shiga mai kyau ga mazauna—koda ba da yawa daga cikinsu suka da digiri ba. Duk da haka, wannan arziki na ma’aikata ya dogara ne da bakuncin matafiya masu kashe kudi sosai, mafi yawan lokuta suna samun dama ta hanyar sake rancen gidansu. Da wannan hanya ta bushe, Las Vegas ta gane jin dadinta ya fi karfin yawancin baƙi. Rashin kwanciyar hankali a ari bai kawo cikas ga gidajen caca kawai ba, har da kasuwar gidaje da kasuwanni da ke dogaro da yawon bude ido. Bayan shekaru shida da aukuwar matsala, Nevada ba ta dawo da matsayinta ba. A duk fadin Amurka, harkar caca ta dawo bakin tasa, sama da dala biliyan 37 an kashe a shekarar 2012—kusan daidai da matsayin 2007. Amma yawan wannan kudi ana kashewa ne a gidajen caca kusa da gida. Kudaden shiga na gidajen caca na Nevada har yanzu kasa ya ke da kashi 20% daga babbar ribar baya, kuma saboda tsadar gudanarwa, ribar ta ragu da kusan rabin da aka saba samu. Aiki a gidajen caca na Nevada ya ragu tsakanin 2012 da 2013. Wadannan aikace-aikacen na daga cikin mafi alheri a kasuwar caca, dalilin da ya sa albashin ma’aikatan caca bai kai na shekarar 2007 ba, duk da dawowar kudin shiga. Dawo da zamani irin na baya abu ne mai wahala. Kodayake kashi 14% na Amurkawa kawai ke kiyayya da caca, yanzu kashi 38% suna kin sa kansu cikin caca, daga kashi 27% a shekarar 2004. Matasa sun fi karkata ga caca ta yanar gizo, da tsoffi suna son gidajen caca masu araha—wannan yana sa rashin yiwuwar Las Vegas ta ci gaba da tsari irin na alatu. Yayin da karin Amurkawa ke fuskantar ragin kudi da walwala, tsarin kasuwancin alatu na Las Vegas na kara fuskantar kalubale—abu da ya shafi kowa ba masu sha’awar caca kawai ba.
post_content: Behind all the glitz in Vegas, Nevada’s economy is still hurting—unemployment near 9%, housing still weak, and casino jobs shrinking. Tourists keep coming, but the good times aren’t back. #LasVegas #Economy #RealityCheck

article_content: Two employees at Marsh Ltd, an insurance office in Christchurch, were unknowingly observed after hours while engaging in intimate behavior. The lights in their office were left on, making their actions visible to people at the Carlton Bar and Eatery across Papanui Road, who recorded and photographed the event before sharing it online. The incident took place last Friday night and quickly attracted the attention of bar patrons. The bar's band reportedly stopped playing as people watched from across the street. Online posts about the event received thousands of likes and shares, adding to the widespread attention. Grant Milne, Marsh Ltd’s chief executive, said the company had identified the individuals involved and had launched an internal investigation. He noted that disciplinary actions, including possible dismissal, were being considered. Milne also stated that the behavior did not meet company standards and that the incident had caused significant embarrassment due to the publicity. James Murdoch, the owner of the Carlton Bar and Eatery, confirmed that the bar is communicating with Marsh Ltd about the event. He noted it was unexpected for both businesses and that, depending on the investigation’s outcome, the employees involved might only receive a warning if the conduct is not judged as serious misconduct.

article_content: During the Second World War, a lone MI5 agent known as 'Jack King' played a pivotal role in neutralizing hundreds of Nazi sympathisers in England. Today, declassified files reveal his true identity as Eric Arthur Roberts, a modest bank clerk from Epsom. Despite a quiet life and an unremarkable banking career, Roberts’ exceptional undercover work prevented critical intelligence—including recommendations for intensified bombing raids—from reaching Nazi Germany. MI5 identified Roberts' unique knowledge of pro-Nazi groups, despite his limited German and ordinary background. Selected by Maxwell Knight, MI5’s renowned agent handler, Roberts posed as an undercover Gestapo officer. He successfully infiltrated and controlled groups of Nazi supporters who believed they were aiding Berlin, while in reality, Roberts was feeding their secrets directly to MI5. Headquartered at Blenheim Palace for much of the war, MI5 used Roberts’ intelligence to monitor the activities of traitors in London and southern England. Nazi sympathisers, employing invisible ink and coded messages, tried to leak information on Home Guard operations and technological advances like radar. Thanks to Roberts, their efforts were thwarted, and MI5 chose not to prosecute to preserve future operations. The traitors went to their graves unaware their actions had benefitted British intelligence. One file recounts an April 1943 meeting between Roberts and three women discussing a recent air raid. The files highlight their lack of remorse for casualties, reflecting the chilling attitudes within these circles. While many of ‘Jack King’s’ exploits were only uncovered with the declassification of MI5 papers, Roberts’ fate after the war remains unknown.
translated_content: A lokacin Yakin Duniya na Biyu, wani mutum daya tilo daga hukumar leken asiri ta MI5 da ake kira ‘Jack King’ ya taka gagarumar rawa wajen dakile daruruwan masu goyon bayan Nazi a Ingila. Yanzu kuma an bayyana asalin sunansa: Eric Arthur Roberts, mai aiki a banki daga Epsom. Ko da yake rayuwarsa tamkar ta talakawa ce, aikin sirri da ya gudanar ya hana bayanan sirri masu muhimmanci, ciki har da shawarwari game da kara kai hare-hare, isar da bayanai zuwa Nazi a Jamus. MI5 ta gano Roberts saboda iliminsa na musamman a kan kungiyoyin masu goyon bayan Nazi, duk da karancin ilimin harshen Jamus da yanayin rayuwarsa mai sauki. Maxwell Knight, babban kwararre a leken asiri na MI5, ne ya fahimci kwarewarsa. Roberts ya sanya kansa a matsayin jami’in Gestapo na bogi, inda ya iya shiga kungiyoyin masu goyon bayan Nazi da suka yi imanin suna taimakawa Berlin, alhali kuwa Roberts yana turawa MI5 duk bayanan sirri da suka bayar. MI5, da ke da hedkwata a Blenheim Palace a lokacin yakin, ta yi amfani da bayanan Roberts wajen sa ido kan masu cin amanar kasa a London da kudancin Ingila. Wadanda ke goyon bayan Nazi sun yi amfani da tawada marar ganuwa da sakonni na sirri don aikawa da bayanai kan ayyukan Home Guard da ci gaban fasahar rediyo. Godiya ga Roberts, MI5 ta dakile wadannan yunkurori, kuma ta yanke shawarar kada ta kai su kotu don kare wasu ayyukan sirri. Wadanda suka yi cin amanar kasa sun mutu suna zaton sun taimakawa Hitler. Daya daga cikin takardun ya ruwaito wata ganawa da aka yi a Afrilu 1943 tsakanin Roberts da mata uku da suka tattauna game da wani harin jirgin sama na Jamus. Takardun sun jaddada rashin damuwa da aka nuna ga wadanda wannan hari ya shafa. Wasu daga cikin ayyukan ‘Jack King’ sun bayyana bayan an bude takardun MI5, amma har yanzu ba a san abin da ya faru da Roberts bayan yakin ba.

article_content: Passenger flights at Luton Airport have begun returning to normal after a major fire tore through a terminal car park on Tuesday evening. The blaze caused a significant structural collapse, though no serious injuries were reported. Commercial flights resumed just after 15:00 BST on Wednesday. The airport reported that flights are now 'operating as normal.' Terminal car park one has reopened, but only for vehicle collection. Passengers are advised to check with their airlines for the latest information. An investigation has started into the cause of the fire. Bedfordshire Fire and Rescue Service believes it originated in a diesel-powered car before spreading throughout the building. The airport acknowledged the distress the incident caused to car parking customers and stated that it is working hard to answer questions, thanking customers for their patience and understanding. Arriving passengers can use the long-stay and mid-stay car parks, and a temporary drop-off point is available at the mid-stay car park. Terminal car park one is open only for collecting vehicles. The Dart shuttle remains closed, with replacement bus services in operation. Some passengers faced disruptions. Chris Penhall had her car parked in the damaged car park, but her flight was redirected to Gatwick. She received emails from the airport and was told to inform her insurers about the situation. Ms. Penhall expressed doubts about recovering her car. Patricia Marianska, traveling from Slough to Warsaw, experienced minor delays and a short walk from the mid-stay car park but reported no significant inconvenience. Lucy Smith and Elizabeth Webster, traveling to Amsterdam, encountered repeated flight rescheduling and delays, spending more than 12 hours at the airport before departing Wednesday evening. Ms. Smith described the experience as stressful but was ultimately relieved to reach her destination. Emily Cozens stayed overnight in Luton before catching an early flight to Lithuania. She managed to park at the airport and said there was some initial confusion but staff were helpful. Labour councillor Javeria Hussain, chair of Luton Rising (the Luton Borough Council company that owns the airport), stated that the Dart shuttle will remain closed as a precaution, though it was not damaged. Further checks are needed before it can reopen. The council and Luton Rising are coordinating with the airport operator regarding the heavily damaged car park. Luton is the UK’s fifth largest airport, serving over 13 million passengers in 2022.

Patricia Marianska, daga Slough zuwa Warsaw, ta fuskanci kadan daga jinkiri da tafiya na kusan minti biyar daga wurin ajiyar mota na matsakaici amma ba ta fuskanci matsala ta musamman ba. Javeria Hussain, shugabar Luton Rising (kamfanin Majalisar Luton da ke da filin jirgin), ta ce za a ci gaba da rufe motar Dart har zuwa kammala bincike kodayake ba ta sami lahani ba. Majalisar da Luton Rising suna aiki tare da mai gudanarwa dangane da wurin ajiye motar da gobara ta shafa sosai. Luton shi ne filin jirgin sama na biyar mafi girma a Birtaniya, inda ya kai sama da fasinjoji miliyan 13 a 2022.

article_content: Helle Thorning-Schmidt made history by becoming Denmark's first female Prime Minister after leading a coalition of center-left parties, known as the 'Red bloc,' to victory over incumbent Lars Loekke Rasmussen. Despite last-minute rumors about her marriage and her husband's sexuality, Thorning-Schmidt and her supporters celebrated a narrow win, ending a decade of center-right governance. Thorning-Schmidt, 44, who married Stephen Kinnock—the son of former UK Labour leader Neil Kinnock—in 1996, described the victory as a 'day of change' and emphasized the historical significance for Denmark. The 'Red bloc,' which includes the Social Democrats, Social Liberals, Socialist People's Party, and the Red-Green Alliance, won a slim majority of five seats in Denmark’s 179-seat parliament, with voter turnout reaching 87.7%. Thorning-Schmidt will now negotiate to form a center-left government, focusing on addressing Denmark’s economic challenges, such as a growing deficit (projected at 4.6% of GDP next year) and a struggling banking sector, with nine banks having been taken over by the state since 2008. Among her campaign promises are plans to review strict customs controls at the German and Swedish borders—criticized as contrary to EU free movement agreements—and to undo some austerity measures by increasing taxes and public spending. She has advocated for Danes to work 12 minutes more per day as a way to boost national productivity, which her party argues could stimulate economic growth. The Social Democrats’ success marks a comeback after their worst election result in a century just four years ago. Throughout the campaign, Thorning-Schmidt and her family faced intense media scrutiny, including rumors about her marriage and accusations regarding tax arrangements by her husband, Stephen Kinnock, who works in Switzerland. Despite these challenges, Thorning-Schmidt, who holds a master’s degree in political science from Copenhagen University, expressed optimism about Denmark’s future and pledged to begin government formation talks immediately.
translated_content: Helle Thorning-Schmidt ta kafa tarihi, ta zama mace ta farko da ta zama Firayim Ministan Denmark, bayan ta jagoranci kawancen jam’iyyu masu ra’ayin gaba da dama, wato ‘Red bloc,’ zuwa nasara a kan Lars Loekke Rasmussen. Duk da jita-jitar da ta fito a ƙarshen zaɓe kan aurenta da kuma jinsin mijinta, Thorning-Schmidt da magoya bayanta sun yi murnar wannan babban nasara wadda ta kawo ƙarshen shekaru goma na mulkin dam-tsakiya. Thorning-Schmidt, mai shekaru 44, ta auri Stephen Kinnock—ɗan tsohon shugaban Labour na Burtaniya, Neil Kinnock—a 1996, ta bayyana wannan nasara da cewa ‘ranar sauyi’ ce tare da jaddada tarihinta ga Denmark. ‘Red bloc’, wadda ta haɗa da Social Democrats, Social Liberals, Socialist People’s Party, da Red-Green Alliance, ta samu rinjayen kujeru biyar kacal a cikin Majalisar Dokoki mai kujeru 179, inda kaso 87.7% na jama’a suka kada ƙuri’arsu. Thorning-Schmidt za ta fara tattaunawa wajen kafa gwamnati mai ra’ayin gaba da dama, da nufin magance matsalolin tattalin arzikin Denmark, ciki har da gibin kasafi (wanda aka kiyasta zai kai 4.6% na GDP badi), da matsalar bankunan cikin gida, inda gwamnati ta karɓe bankunan tara tun 2008. Cikin alkawuran ta, akwai duba kan dokokin kwastan a iyakokin Jamus da Sweden (wanda jama’a ke ganin sun sabawa yarjejeniyar EU na yancin zirga-zirga), da kuma janye wasu matakan takaita kashe kudi ta hanyar ƙara haraji da kashe kudi a ayyukan jama’a. Ta gabatar da ra’ayin cewa a kara awanni goma sha biyu a ranar aiki don karfafa samarwa, wanda jam’iyyarta ke ganin zai farfado da tattalin arziki. Nasarar Social Democrats ta nuna dawowa bayan faduwar da suka fuskanta shekaru hudu da suka gabata—mummunan sakamako mafi muni cikin shekaru 100. A lokacin yakin neman zaɓe, Thorning-Schmidt da iyalinta sun fuskanci matsin lamba daga kafafen watsa labarai, ciki har da jita-jita kan aurenta da maganganun biyan haraji daga mijinta, Stephen Kinnock, wanda ke aiki a Switzerland. Duk da wadannan kalubalen, Thorning-Schmidt mai digiri a kimiyyar siyasa daga Jami’ar Copenhagen, ta nuna fata ga makomar Denmark tare da shirin fara tattaunawar kafa gwamnati nan da nan.

article_content: Mario Monti, a seasoned economist, has been named to form a new Italian government as the designated prime minister. He started deliberations with leaders of different political parties on Monday, discussing the structure of his impending administration. These discussions will proceed into Tuesday. Monti clarified that while his government is expected to function until the end of spring 2013, Parliament can dismiss it at any time if it loses confidence. He highlighted the necessity of tackling Italy’s pressing economic troubles and making economic growth and social equity his administration’s core focus. Italy faces a daunting economic scenario, shouldering a national debt of about €1.9 trillion (roughly $2.6 trillion), amounting to 120% of the country’s GDP, alongside stagnant growth. To lead the government, Monti must secure support from a Parliament composed of heterogeneous parties, with Silvio Berlusconi’s People of Freedom (PDL) party still the dominant force. Berlusconi has expressed his intention to remain politically active. Italian political dynamics are also being influenced by some leaders' calls for earlier elections, while all parties wait to hear more about Monti’s proposed cabinet and policy direction before fully endorsing him. Leaders from the Values Party, Alliance for Italy, and the Radical Party have conditionally expressed support, pending further information about Monti’s plans. Monti was chosen for the post following Berlusconi's resignation amid a deepening financial crisis, a move celebrated publicly by many Italians waving flags and singing the national anthem. Despite uncertainty about his political future, Berlusconi has stated he will continue to lead his party. Known for his significant contributions in European Union financial and competition policy—earning him the nickname 'Super Mario'—Monti enjoys a strong reputation in international circles. President Giorgio Napolitano described him as talented, knowledgeable, and respected. If Monti formally accepts the mandate, he must soon present both his cabinet and government program to Parliament, which will have ten days after his swearing-in to vote on whether to confirm his government in both chambers. Italy’s situation reflects a larger European debt crisis. Greece recently appointed Lucas Papademos prime minister, following George Papandreou’s resignation under similar economic pressures. Markets continue to scrutinize Italy’s bond yields, which remain high even after successful bond auctions, demonstrating persistent investor concern. Officials and observers alike hope Monti’s expertise and international standing can unify Italy’s political landscape and reassure global markets, though significant challenges remain in balancing the demands of disparate parties with the urgent need for fiscal stability.

Kasuwannin kudi na kallon yadda ribar bashin Italiya ke tashi har yanzu, duk da sayar da wasu takardun bashi cikin nasara, hakan yana nuna cewa masu saka jari har yanzu na da damuwa da yanayin tattalin arzikin kasar. In the years following the Great Recession, advanced economies experienced a notable rise in support for anti-establishment and populist parties. This trend contributed to greater political polarization, more divided parliaments, heightened policy uncertainty, and, at times, lower economic growth. During this period, several European countries implemented significant fiscal austerity measures to address high levels of public debt. However, these policies often faced strong public opposition, sparking anti-austerity movements.

A recent study investigates the complex relationship between fiscal austerity and increased political polarization. Drawing on a comprehensive regional database that covers over two decades and more than 200 European elections, the study finds a clear connection: fiscal consolidation is linked to a greater share of votes for extreme parties, a drop in voter turnout, and increased political fragmentation. Notably, recessions triggered by austerity measures have an even more pronounced effect, boosting distrust in government and deepening social divides.

The economic impact of austerity is equally significant, resulting in reduced regional output, employment, investment, consumption, and wages. The evidence reveals that recessions driven by austerity measures encourage higher support for extreme parties, especially during difficult economic times.

Ultimately, austerity is more than an economic policy—it has the power to reshape political landscapes by increasing public distrust and strengthening extreme parties. The complex interplay between fiscal decisions, politics, and the economy underlines the far-reaching consequences of austerity. When considering such measures, it’s important to recognize that their effects extend well beyond financial statistics—they can fundamentally influence both political stability and economic wellbeing.

article_content: For nearly two weeks, the House Republican Conference has been in limbo after the removal of Rep. Kevin McCarthy of California from the role of Speaker. His departure created an urgent leadership vacuum and stirred internal strife among Republicans. Initially, Rep. Steve Scalise of Louisiana was seen as the likely successor, but he fell well short of the 217 votes needed to win the speakership and ultimately withdrew from consideration. Next, Rep. Jim Jordan of Ohio, known for his prominent oversight efforts and strong support among conservatives, emerged as a contender. However, a bloc of GOP members remains hesitant to back him, reflecting the ongoing divisions within the party. These deep fractures are reminiscent of the turbulent GOP politics of the 1990s. Before the 1994 midterms, then-House Minority Whip Newt Gingrich introduced the 'Contract with America,' a conservative blueprint promising major House reforms if Republicans seized control. After Republicans won, Gingrich became Speaker, but his handling of government shutdowns in 1995 and 1996 and the push for President Clinton's impeachment eroded his standing, leading to his resignation before the 1999 Congress. Rep. Bob Livingston of Louisiana was slated to replace Gingrich, but he unexpectedly withdrew after admitting to extramarital affairs, prompting Republicans to turn to Rep. Dennis Hastert of Illinois. While Hastert temporarily unified the conference, underlying tensions persisted. Throughout the 2000s and 2010s, the GOP maintained modest House majorities, which helped conceal the unrest among its most conservative members. President George W. Bush’s tenure saw party unity post-9/11, but the rise of the Tea Party in 2010 empowered conservatives who challenged both Democrats and their own party’s leadership. John Boehner became Speaker in 2011 but clashed with far-right conservatives over spending and other issues, leading to his resignation in 2015. Paul Ryan, who succeeded him, also faced criticism from conservatives, especially regarding his support for Donald Trump. Despite legislative achievements like the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Ryan announced he would not seek reelection in 2018, and Democrats regained the House. The chaotic 15-ballot Speaker vote in January, which led to McCarthy's election, foreshadowed difficulties ahead. A rule change allowing a single member to move to vacate the Speaker made McCarthy vulnerable, especially as he tried to balance demands from hardliners within a slim GOP majority. Ultimately, most of the eight Republicans who voted to remove McCarthy found his leadership insufficient, particularly in pushing for deeper spending cuts and an impeachment inquiry into President Biden. While GOP infighting in the 1990s was less visible to the public, current divisions are deeper and more impactful. The next Republican Speaker, even one as conservative as Jordan, will have to navigate these persistent challenges. The ongoing struggle between mainstream and hardline conservatives means building a cohesive party will require unprecedented efforts, especially given the party’s narrow majority and reduced tolerance for defections.

Bayan sun ci zabe, Gingrich ya zama Shugaban Majalisa, amma yadda ya tafiyar da rufe gwamnatin tarayya na 1995 da 1996 da kokarin tsige Shugaba Clinton ya raunana matsayinsa, har ya sauka kafin Majalisar 1999. Rep. Bob Livingston daga Louisiana ne aka shirya zai maye gurbin Gingrich, amma ya janye bayan ya amsa aikata almundahana, hakan yasa suka koma ga Rep. Dennis Hastert daga Illinois. Shekarun 2000 zuwa 2010, GOP ta riƙe rinjayen kuri’u kadan, abin da ya ɓoye rashin jituwa tsakanin manyan da masu tsaurin ra’ayinta. Lokacin Shugaba George W. Bush, jam’iyyar ta shaku bayan harin 9/11, amma tashin 'Tea Party' a 2010 ya sake karfafa masu tsaurin ra’ayi wadanda ke kalubalantar shugabancin su da na Democrat. John Boehner ya zama Shugaban Majalisa a 2011 amma ya sami sabani da masu ra’ayi sosai, musamman kan kudade, wanda ya sa ya sauka a 2015. Ko da nasarar dokar ragin haraji ta 2017 (Tax Cuts and Jobs Act), Ryan ya tabbatar da cewa ba zai sake tsayawa takara ba a 2018, kuma Democrats suka kwace majalisar. Har ila yau, zaben Shugaban Majalisa na kwalaben 15 a Janairu da ya kawo zaben McCarthy ya nuna gagarumin kalubale. Sabuwar ka’ida da ke ba dan majalisa guda damar neman Shugaban ya sauka ta sa McCarthy cikin hadari, duba da kokarinsa na biyan bukatun masu tsaurin ra’ayi a cikin rinjayen kuri’u sharadi. A karshe, mafi yawan daga cikin ‘yan Republican takwas da suka taimaka wajen tsige McCarthy sun ga jagorancinsa bai wadatar ba, musamman wajen neman karin rage kashe kudade da kokarin binciken tsige Shugaba Biden. Ko da yake rikicin GOP a shekarun 1990 ba a sari a fili ba kamar na yau, rabuwar kai yanzu ta fi tasiri. Duk wanda zai zama Shugaban Majalisar nan gaba, ko Jim Jordan mai tsaurin ra’ayi ne, dole ne ya fuskanci wa’adin sabbin kalubale. Kokarin hade jam’iyyar tsakanin manya da masu tsaurin ra’ayi zai bukaci kwazo sosai, musamman ganin ‘yar rinjaye kadan da rashin hakurin juriya ga masu sabawa.

article_content: Solar energy has faced challenges on Earth due to costly and inefficient panels. Now, scientists see outer space as a new hope for clean power—and Japan is leading the charge. The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) plans to realize space-based solar energy within 25 years. JAXA is preparing a test this year to wirelessly transmit hundreds of watts across 50 meters, an early step toward a vast 1-gigawatt solar power station in orbit—enough to rival a nuclear power plant's output. The vision places giant solar collectors 36,000 kilometers (22,400 miles) above Earth, where they would gather sunlight non-stop using mirrors and photovoltaic panels. Collected energy would travel as microwaves to a man-made island in Tokyo Bay, covered with billions of antennas to convert the signal back into electricity and fed to Tokyo through submarine cables. Japan pursues this innovation partly because of the Fukushima nuclear disaster and a shortage of space for conventional renewables, making alternative energy sources a necessity. Engineers assure safety, explaining that the microwave beam is much too weak to pose any risk—even to birds. Separately, the Shimizu Corporation has proposed the Luna Ring: a belt of solar panels stretching 11,000 kilometers (almost 6,800 miles) around the moon’s equator. This lunar project would send collected energy to Earth using microwaves and lasers, potentially providing as much as 13,000 terawatts, far more than current global consumption. Shimizu argues their plan could deliver limitless power and help fight global warming. As technology advances and environmental concerns grow, Japan is striving to pioneer a new era of sustainable energy from space.

Yanzu haka, masana suna duba sararin samaniya a matsayin mafita don samar da makamashi mai tsafta—Japan na jagorancin wannan kokari. Hukumar Bincike ta Sararin Samaniya ta Japan (JAXA) na da shirin samar da hasken rana daga sararin samaniya cikin shekara 25 masu zuwa. JAXA na shirin yin gwaji bana don tura wutar lantarki mara igiya mai karfin watt dari-acikin nisan mita 50—mataki na farko kafin samar da tashar rana ta gigawatt 1 a sararin samaniya, daidai da wutar tashar nukiliya. Wannan tsarin zai sa manyan na’urorin tara hasken rana su kasance a nisan kilomita 36,000 (mil 22,400) daga doron kasa, inda za su tara hasken rana kullum ta madubai da na’urorin panel na lantarki. Za a aika makamashin da aka tara zuwa wani tsibiri a Tokyo Bay ta hanyar igiyar microwave, inda miliyoyin antenna za su canza shi zuwa lantarki sannan a aika zuwa Tokyo ta igiyar karkashin teku. Japan na kokarin samar da wannan fasaha ne bayan hatsarin nukiliya na Fukushima da kuma karancin fili da ya dace da sabbin hanyoyin makamashi. Injiniyoyi sun tabbatar da cewa beam din microwave din ba mai hadari bane—even ga tsuntsaye. A wata hanya, Kamfanin Shimizu ya bullo da shirin Luna Ring: zoben panel na solar mai fadin kilomita 11,000 (kimanin mil 6,800) da zai zagaye matakin tsakiyar wata. Wannan tsarin zai aika makamashi daga wata zuwa duniya ta igiyar microwave da hasken laser, yana iya samar da terawatt 13,000—fiye da makamashin da ake amfani da shi a duniya. Shimizu na fatan wannan tsari zai kawo makamashi marar iyaka da taimakawa rage dumamar yanayi. Yayin da fasaha ke ci gaba da damuwa kan muhalli ke karuwa, Japan na son zama jagaba wajen samar da sabuwar hanyar makamashi daga sarari.

article_content: Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar expressed optimism about resolving tensions with Canada through diplomacy. The dispute began after Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau alleged Indian agents’ involvement in the killing of Khalistani separatist Hardeep Singh Nijjar in Surrey, Canada. Jaishankar noted continued communication between both countries and hopes for a mutually acceptable solution. He emphasized the need for reciprocity, stating that sovereignty and sensitivity must be respected by both sides. "There is room for diplomacy here. My Canadian counterpart agrees, and we have stayed in contact," Jaishankar said at a media event. "I hope we find a way forward. Sovereignty and sensitivity can’t be one-way streets. Every country may have concerns, and I am always open to discussing legitimate issues, but those conversations must consider my concerns as well," he added. Relations worsened after Trudeau’s public accusation against India in September regarding Nijjar’s June killing. India responded by suspending visa services for Canadians and asking Canada to reduce its diplomatic staff in India, after which Canada withdrew 41 diplomats and their families. On broader issues, Jaishankar said, "Many countries, including India, uphold free speech, but that doesn’t justify advocating violence, extremism, or separatism." He asked, "If any country thinks such actions are right, would they accept it for themselves? Usually, there’s no answer." In business updates: India approved its first 100% FDI in the defense sector, allowing Sweden’s Saab to set up a rocket manufacturing plant. State Bank of India (SBI) reported an 8% rise in quarterly profit thanks to strong loan demand and reduced provisions. Byju’s posted ₹3,569 crore in revenue for FY22, with its core business’s Ebitda loss narrowing from the previous year.

article_content: New York Mayor Bill de Blasio faced boos and heckling from the newest members of the New York Police Department during his speech at their academy graduation ceremony. Several boos were heard at Madison Square Garden as de Blasio addressed 884 new officers. According to the New York Post, at least one cadet shouted 'traitor!' When de Blasio mentioned that the new officers would encounter problems they didn't cause, someone in the crowd responded, 'You created them!' which was met with applause. Despite the negative reactions, Mayor de Blasio continued his remarks and thanked the recruits for their service to New York City. The event highlights ongoing mistrust between the mayor and some NYPD officers. Recently, hundreds of officers turned their backs on de Blasio during the funeral for Officer Rafael Ramos, who, along with Officer Wenjian Liu, was killed in Brooklyn. These tensions have worsened after the mayor expressed sympathy toward protesters following a grand jury's decision not to indict an NYPD officer in the Eric Garner case. In his response to the grand jury's decision, de Blasio, who has a biracial son, shared how he has advised his son Dante about police interactions and the risk of discrimination. Patrick Lynch, president of the Patrolman's Benevolent Association, has harshly criticized de Blasio, saying he had 'blood on his hands' after the killings of Ramos and Liu. Police Commissioner Bill Bratton has commented that strained relations between de Blasio and rank-and-file officers may persist for some time. Meanwhile, the city and the police union are engaged in contentious contract negotiations, which are now headed to arbitration, adding to the tension. Mayor de Blasio and Patrick Lynch, a prominent critic, met again recently at an award ceremony for the top graduating squad sergeant, where Lynch's son Kevin was among the graduates.
translated_content: Mai girma magajin garin New York, Bill de Blasio, ya fuskanci ihu da tsangwama daga sababbin jami’an ‘yan sanda a lokacin da yake jawabi a bikin yaye su daga makarantar horo. An ji saukar ihu a Madison Square Garden lokacin da de Blasio ya yi magana gaban sababbin jami’ai 884. Jaridar New York Post ta ruwaito cewa akalla daya daga cikin daliban ya furta 'makaryaci!' Lokacin da de Blasio ya ambata cewa sababbin jami’an za su fuskanci matsaloli da ba su jawo ba, wani cikin taron ya amsa da cewa, 'Kai ne ka jawo su!' wannan ya samu tafi da murna. Duk da irin wannan martani, magajin gari de Blasio ya ci gaba da jawabi ya kuma gode wa sababbin jami’an saboda kokarinsu wajen bautawa birnin New York. Wannan al’amari ya kara nuna rashin yarda tsakanin magajin gari da wasu daga cikin jami’an NYPD. Kwanan nan, daruruwan ‘yan sanda sun juya baya ga de Blasio a jana’izar jami'i Rafael Ramos, wanda aka kashe tare da jami'i Wenjian Liu a Brooklyn. Wannan rashin jituwa ya kara tsananta bayan da magajin gari ya nuna tausayi ga masu zanga-zanga bayan wata babbar kotu ta ki gurfanar da dan sanda kan kisan Eric Garner. A martaninsa bayan hukuncin kotun, de Blasio wanda yana da da bature da bakar fata (biracial), ya bayyana yadda yake ba dansa Dante shawarwari game da hulda da ‘yan sanda da hadarin nuna wariya. Shugaban kungiyar ‘yan sanda ta Patrolman's Benevolent Association, Patrick Lynch, ya soki de Blasio da kakkausar magana, inda ya ce yana da 'jini a hannunsa' bayan kisan Ramos da Liu. Kwamishinan ‘yan sanda, Bill Bratton, ya ce rashin jituwa tsakanin de Blasio da mafi yawan jami’an na iya ci gaba da kasancewa na wani lokaci. A yanzu haka, fadar gwamnatin birni da kungiyar ‘yan sanda suna cikin tattaunawar kwangila mai tsanani wacce ake shirin kaiwa ga sauraron kotu, lamarin da ke kara dagula al’amura. Magajin garin de Blasio da Patrick Lynch, babban mai suka, sun sake gamuwa kwanan nan a wani taron bayar da lambar yabo ga serjan da ya fi kowa fice daga ajin, inda danshi Lynch, Kevin, yana daga cikin wadanda aka yaye.

article_content: Sculptor Brandon Vickerd, a Professor of Visual Arts at York University in Toronto, has created a thought-provoking pair of sculptures that look like ordinary people at first glance. Upon closer inspection, the 'figures'—dressed in hooded tops and trousers—reveal heads crafted from an array of taxidermied animals, including ducklings, raccoons, skunks, and squirrels. Most of the animals came from a Toronto taxidermist, though the ducklings were sourced from China. Vickerd titled the works 'Passenger' and 'Passenger II' and strategically placed them in busy public spaces in Montreal, Quebec, and Hamilton, Ontario, to observe the responses of passers-by. Vickerd’s intent was to subtly disrupt people's daily routines and prompt reflection on the relationship between humans and animals in urban environments. He explained that reactions ranged from surprise and amusement to discomfort, with many people stopping to take photos. In particular, children were quick to spot the statues, often reacting with excitement and curiosity. Describing his approach, Vickerd said, 'I aim to insert an anomaly into the viewer’s everyday experience. These works reference comical cartoon clichés while contrasting our conceptual understanding of nature with the reality of animals living alongside us.' According to Vickerd’s spokesperson, the sculptures playfully explore the intersection between humans and animals in city spaces, initially blending in as everyday commuters. Only on closer inspection do viewers realize these are animals, artistically arranged and dressed, working together to mimic a human form.
translated_content: Mai zanen gumaka Brandon Vickerd, Farfesa a fannin Visual Arts a Jami’ar York dake Toronto, ya kirkiri gumaka guda biyu masu jan hankali waɗanda a farko kallo za ka iya ɗauka a matsayin mutane na gaskiya. Idan ka duba sosai, za ka fahimci cewa gumakan—masu sanye da huluna da rigunan hoodie da wando—masu kan da aka hada daga namun daji daban-daban da aka yi musu magani, kamar kananan agwagwa, birai, bares, da beraye. Yawancin namun dajin an samo su daga wani mai aikin maganin namun daji a Toronto, sai dai kananan agwagwa daga kasar China aka samo su. Vickerd ya sanya wa gumakan suna 'Passenger' da 'Passenger II', ya kuma ajiye su a wurare masu cike da jama'a a biranen Montreal, Quebec, da Hamilton, Ontario, don ganin yadda mutane za su dauka. Manufar Vickerd ita ce ya jawo hankalin mutane cikin rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum, ya kuma jan su tunani game da dangantaka tsakanin mutane da namun daji a cikin birane. Ya bayyana cewa martanin mutane na kunshe da mamaki, annashuwa, ko ma ɗan tsoro, tare da masu yawa suna ɗaukar hoto da su. Yara su ne akan fi fara lura da gumakan, suna nuna farin ciki da sha’awa. Yayin da yake bayani, Vickerd ya ce, 'Ina son sa wani abu daban cikin abinda mutane ke gani a kullum. Wannan aiki yana nuni da barkwanci irinsu na kartun, yana nuna bambanci tsakanin tunaninmu game da dabi'ar dabbobi da yadda suke zaune tare da mu.' Mai magana da yawunsa ya ce, gumakan suna bayyana mu’amala tsakanin mutane da namun daji cikin birni cikin sigar wasa. Da fari gumakan suna iya kama da mutane a hanya, sai dai idan mutum ya kalle su sosai ya fahimci cewa dabbobi ne an shirya su cikin kaya suna kaman mutum.

article_content: On the morning of June 18, 2011, a devastating house fire occurred in Derby, UK, after three-year-old Dontay Mosley accidentally set fire to the family’s living room carpet using a gas oven lighter. His mother’s partner, Joseph Perkins, smelled smoke and rushed downstairs, but was forced back by the flames. Milly Mosley, Dontay's mother, managed to rescue her son and escape the house with Joseph and one of their two pet cats. Unfortunately, their dog, Boss, and cat Fluffy were affected by smoke inhalation. Firefighters managed to revive Boss, but Fluffy could not be saved. The fire destroyed all of the family’s possessions—resulting in thousands of pounds' worth of damage—including Dontay’s upcoming fourth birthday presents. Milly, aged 24, expressed both her sense of loss and gratitude, saying, 'We have lost everything but we are very lucky to be alive.' She explained that Dontay had unintentionally started the fire, as he didn’t understand the consequences of his actions. After the blaze began at around 7:30am, the family’s dog Boss ran back into the house searching for Milly’s six-year-old daughter, Destiny Thomas, not knowing she wasn’t home. Boss collapsed from smoke inhalation but was revived by firefighters with oxygen. Fire crews limited the fire's spread to one room but the rest of the house suffered extensive smoke damage. The Mosley family is now staying with relatives while awaiting emergency accommodation from the local council. Milly revealed their private rented home did not have smoke alarms installed. The family has received support from the community, with strangers donating goods after Milly’s sister Nicola posted about their loss on Facebook. Milly shared that Dontay, who is now receiving lessons at the fire station, did not comprehend the seriousness of the event or the harm caused.

Abokin mahaifiyarsa, Joseph Perkins, ya ji kamshin hayaki kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin ya sauko ƙasa, amma wutar ta hana shi shiga. Mahaifiyarsa, Milly Mosley, ta ceto danta tare da fita daga gidan da Joseph da ɗaya daga cikin kulinta biyu. Abin baƙin ciki, kare su Boss da mage Fluffy sun sha hayaki sosai. Gobarar ta lalata duk dukiyoyinsu — inda aka yi asarar dubban fam — har da kyaututtukan zagayowar ranar haihuwar Dontay na hudu. Iyalin Mosley yanzu suna wurin ’yan uwa yayin da suke jiran matsugunin gaggawa daga majalisa. Milly ta bayyana cewa gidan da suke haya ba a sanyawa makarar hayaki ba. Iyalin sun sami taimako daga al’umma, inda mutane da dama suka kawo ƙaya bayan Nicola, ’yar’uwar Milly, ta faɗa a shafin Facebook. article_content: Patrick, an executive coach and mindfulness instructor with a background as a tech executive in finance, now leads Creative Balance Coaching. He explains that many technically skilled professionals struggle to communicate their ideas effectively to senior executives. What seems logical to tech experts doesn't always resonate with leaders. Let’s examine why this disconnect happens and how to overcome it. Technical specialists often start by explaining background and challenges before stating their main point—a method great for storytelling but less effective in executive settings. This habit can cause decision-makers to lose interest or miss the message before it’s delivered. Busy executives prefer hearing the key point right away. They usually want to know: What’s the main point? What’s being asked of me? How long will this take? Is it urgent? What options have been tried? To improve communication, try reversing your approach: 1. Lead with your main ask or idea. 2. Note the urgency if needed. 3. Clearly share your top recommendation or question. 4. Indicate how long the conversation will take and offer to provide more details as needed. 5. End with a quick confirmation, such as asking, 'Does that work?' For example: 'Susan, can I get your approval to hire a tech writer for the SuperBig project? We’ve found a promising candidate but need to move quickly to secure them. Can I review costs and deliverables with you? It should only take about ten minutes—is that alright?' Conversely, the less effective method involves lengthy context first, risking that executives will get distracted or interrupted before reaching your key point. Apply this concise pattern both to your main message and within details as you present them. Avoid delivering excessive background unless asked for more information. Specialists may feel this approach oversimplifies their expertise or loses necessary detail. Recognizing this reluctance is a common hurdle. If so, consider experimenting with this executive-focused approach and collect feedback from colleagues. Clearly and succinctly sharing your ideas with leaders is a crucial skill. With practice, it can become less challenging and even enjoyable. Finally, Forbes Coaches Council is an invitation-only network for leading business and career coaches.

Ya bayyana yadda da dama daga cikin kwararrun fasaha ke fuskantar matsalar isar da ra’ayoyinsu kai tsaye ga manyan shugabanni. Abin da ke da ma’ana a gare su sau da yawa ba ya ba shugabanni tasiri. Bari mu bincika dalilin wannan bambanci da yadda za a shawo kansa. Kwararrun fasaha na sha’awar farawa da bayanan tushe da matsaloli kafin su bayyana mahimmin batu—salon da ya dace a cikin labari amma ba ya yin tasiri sosai wajen ganawar shugabanni. Wannan na iya sa shugabanni su gaza fahimta ko su rasa sha’awa kafin a kawo ainihin sako. Shugabannin da ke da aikin da yawa na son a faɗa musu kai tsaye mahimmin batun. Yawanci tambayoyinsu su ne: Menene mahimman bayanai? Me nake da alhakin yanke hukunci akai? Nawa lokaci wannan zance zai dauka? Shin yana da gaggawa? Wanne matakai aka dauka har zuwa yanzu? Don saukaka fahimta, canza tsarin isar da sako: 1. Fara da abinda kake bukata ko batunku na farko. 2. Bayyana dalilin gaggawa (idan yana da gaggawa). 3. Faɗi shawararka mafi girma ko tambayarka guda ɗaya. 4. Bayyana tsawon lokacin tattaunawar da yi alkawari don bayar da karin bayani idan ana bukata. 5. Rufe da tambaya mai sauki kamar, 'Ya ya kuka gani?' Misali: 'Susan, ina neman amincewarki mu dauki marubucin fasaha don aikin SuperBig. Muna da wanda muka zaba, amma dole mu yi gaggawa kafin a dauke shi. Zan iya bayyana maki tsadar aikin da abin da za a cimma? Zai dauki minti goma kacal—ya ya kika gani?' Maimakon haka, hanyar da ba ta da tasiri ita ce kasancewa da bayani mai tsawo kafin sakon ya iso, wanda zai iya jawo shugabanni su rasa hankali ko a katse ka kafin kai ga batun da kake so. Yi amfani da wannan tsarin kai tsaye a duk sako gaba daya da cikin bayanai. Ka kaucewa yiwa abokan aiki sharhi mai yawa sai idan sun bukata. Wasu kwararru na iya ganin wannan tsarin yana rage ingancin iliminsu ko ba shi da bayani sosai. Fahimtar wannan tunani mataki na farko ne. Idan ka gano hakan ya shafi rayuwarka, gwada wannan tsohon salon kuma neman shawarwari daga abokan aiki. Iya bayyana sako a sarari ga shugabanni muhimmiyar kwarewa ce. Da koyi da kai, za ta zama mai sauki ko ma abin sha'awa. Daga karshe, Forbes Coaches Council kungiya ce ta musamman da ke tattaro kwararrun masu ba da horo da masu tallafawa kasuwanci.

article_content: Looking for a fresh way to experience the beauty of fall? Go beyond the usual scenic drives and hikes by exploring some unique adventures across the United States—just act quickly, as the leaves are already changing and dropping. Try hiking with llamas: El Paseo Llama Expeditions in Taos, New Mexico, offers guided hikes where friendly llamas carry gear and, for kids under 60 pounds, even provide rides. The tours, which welcome all skill levels, take you through beautiful aspen forests and the scenic Sangre de Cristo Mountains, with options ranging from half-day outings to eight-day expeditions. Prices begin at $74 per person, varying with group size, days, and equipment needs. Glide on a Segway: In Manchester, New Hampshire, Segway of Manchester provides fall foliage tours by Segway, letting you ride smoothly through vibrant, leaf-filled streets. Guided tours last two or three hours, priced at $69 and $99 respectively. Soar above the landscape: For a thrilling overhead view, Lookout Mountain Hang Gliding in Rising Fawn, Georgia, near Chattanooga, Tennessee, lets beginners and seasoned flyers alike train for hang gliding. Try their introductory day package with ground training and a tandem flight at 2,000 feet—available for ages 12 and up at $199. Float in a balloon: Napa Valley Balloons in California arranges serene hot air balloon rides that drift over colorful vineyards and mountain scenery. Rides include a continental breakfast and end with sparkling wine at a champagne breakfast. Standard rates are $240 per person. Similar balloon experiences are available from Napa Valley to Asheville, North Carolina, and upstate New York. Ride a steam train: The Steam Railroad Institute in Owosso, Michigan, offers a fall foliage trip to Alma, Michigan, on October 23. With coach tickets at $99, passengers can watch the changing autumn scenery in comfort and style. Steam train rides can also be found throughout the country, from Connecticut and West Virginia to Indiana and more. According to Rich Beattie, executive editor at TravelandLeisure.com, these adventures provide exciting and memorable ways to enjoy the changing colors of autumn beyond the traditional drive.

Gwada yawo da rakuma: El Paseo Llama Expeditions a Taos, New Mexico, na ba da yawon shakatawa inda rakuma ke ɗaukar kaya, kuma yara ƙanana (ƙasa da kilo 27) za su iya hawa. An bude wa kowa ko da ba daɗe ko sabo, tare da bi ta cikin dazukan aspen da tsaunukan Sangre de Cristo, daga rabin rana zuwa kwana takwas. Farashi yana farawa daga $74 kowanne mutum, dangane da kwanaki, yawan mutane da kaya. Gudana a Segway: A Manchester, New Hampshire, Segway of Manchester na bayar da zagayen kallon ganye ta Segway, inda za a bi titi cikin launin kaka. Jagorancin na awa biyu ($69) ko uku ($99). Hawa sama da hang-glider: Don kallon ganye daga sama, Lookout Mountain Hang Gliding a Rising Fawn, Georgia, kusa da Chattanooga, Tennessee, na baiwa masu sha’awa horo da tashi tare da malami har sama da kafa 2,000—ga masu shekaru 12 da sama, $199. Hawa kwale-kwale mai iska: Napa Valley Balloons a California na daukan mutane a balun, suna shawagi kan gonakin inabi masu launin kaka da tsaunuka. Hakan na kunshe da karin kumallo sannan a ƙarshe giya. Farashi $240 kowanne mutum. Ayyukan haka suna samuwa daga Napa Valley zuwa Asheville, North Carolina da New York. Hawa jirgin haya mai tururi: Steam Railroad Institute a Owosso, Michigan, na yi wa mutane kallo da jin daɗin ganye zuwa Alma, Michigan, ranar 23 ga Oktoba. Tikin coach $99 ne. Hakanan akwai jiragen haya na kaka a jihohin Connecticut, West Virginia, Indiana da sauransu. A cewar Rich Beattie, babban editan TravelandLeisure.com, irin waɗannan yawon shakatawa masu kayatarwa ne don jin daɗin kaka fiye da hanya ta mota kaɗai.

article_content: George 'Funky' Brown, the drummer, founding member, and one of the main songwriters of the pop-R&B group Kool & The Gang, died in Los Angeles last night after a battle with lung cancer. He was 74. Brown, along with bassist Robert 'Kool' Bell, his brother Ronald Bell on tenor saxophone, and lead vocalist James 'J.T.' Taylor, was one of the songwriters behind the band’s iconic hits such as 'Jungle Boogie,' 'Hollywood Swinging,' 'Celebration,' and 'Get Down on It.' His death was reported by TMZ. According to Brown's official biography on the Songwriters Hall of Fame website, the Jersey City, N.J., native developed an early interest in jazz drummers like Elvin Jones, Art Blakey, and Jack DeJohnette. While still in high school, his neighbor and future bandmate Ricky West introduced him to Ronald Bell and trumpeter Robert Mickens. By the mid-1960s, they were playing jazz clubs together. In 1969, the group, previously known as the Jazziacs and other names, became Kool & The Gang and crafted a unique blend of jazz, soul, funk, rock, and pop that became their signature sound. The band’s breakthrough came in 1973 with the album 'Wild and Peaceful,' featuring the hits 'Jungle Boogie' and 'Hollywood Swinging.' Throughout the 1970s and 1980s, Kool & The Gang enjoyed a series of hits including 'Ladies’ Night,' 'Get Down on It,' 'Joanna,' 'Cherish,' and the chart-topping 'Celebration.' The group won a Grammy in 1978 for their contribution to the 'Saturday Night Fever' soundtrack, which sold more than 16 million copies in the U.S. alone. Their song 'Open Sesame' was also featured in the film. In total, Kool & The Gang won two Grammys, seven American Music Awards, and were inducted into the New Jersey Hall of Fame. The band sold 7.5 million albums in the U.S. and over 70 million worldwide. They also opened for Van Halen on the band’s 2012 tour with lead singer David Lee Roth. Brown is survived by his wife and five children. He spoke about his battle with cancer in an interview with KCAL News just last month.
translated_content: George 'Funky' Brown, ɗan buga ganga, wanda ya kafa kuma daya daga cikin manyan masu rubuta waƙoƙi na ƙungiyar pop-R&B Kool & The Gang, ya rasu a Los Angeles jiya bayan fama da cutar sankarar huhu. Yana da shekara 74. Brown tare da Robert 'Kool' Bell (mai bugun bass), ɗan uwansa Ronald Bell (saxophone), da mawaƙin gaba James 'J.T.' Taylor, sun rubuta muhimman waƙoƙin ƙungiyar kamar 'Jungle Boogie', 'Hollywood Swinging', 'Celebration', da 'Get Down on It.' TMZ ne ya fara ba da rahoton rasuwarsa. Cewar tarihin Brown a shafin Songwriters Hall of Fame, mutumin Jersey City, N.J., ya fara jan hankalin sa ga masu buga ganga na jazz irin su Elvin Jones, Art Blakey, da Jack DeJohnette tun yana ƙarami. Tun suna makaranta, makwabcinsa kuma abokin ƙungiyarsa, Ricky West ya haɗa shi da Ronald Bell da mai busa ƙaho Robert Mickens. Zuwa tsakiyar shekarun 1960s, sun fara buga waƙoƙi a kulab ɗin jazz tare. Shekarar 1969, ƙungiyar da a da ake kiranta Jazziacs da wasu sunaye, ta koma suna Kool & The Gang tare da samar da salon wakar jazz, soul, funk, rock da pop da ya zama alamar su. Babbar damar ƙungiyar ta zo a 1973 da kundin 'Wild and Peaceful', mai dauke da waƙoƙin 'Jungle Boogie' da 'Hollywood Swinging.' Daga shekarun 1970s zuwa 1980s, Kool & The Gang sun kawo jerin waƙoƙin nasara irin su 'Ladies’ Night', 'Get Down on It', 'Joanna', 'Cherish', da 'Celebration' mai tafiya a saman jerin waƙoƙi. Kungiyar ta lashe lambar yabo ta Grammy a 1978 saboda gudunmawarsu ga kundin waƙoƙin 'Saturday Night Fever', wanda ya sayar da fiye da miliyan 16 a Amurka kaɗai. Har wa yau waƙarsu 'Open Sesame' ta fito a cikin fim din. Gabaɗaya, Kool & The Gang sun lashe Grammy guda biyu, American Music Awards bakwai, kuma an shigar da su cikin New Jersey Hall of Fame. Sun sayar da kundin waƙoƙi miliyan 7.5 a Amurka da sama da miliyan 70 a duniya gaba ɗaya. Sun kuma buga waƙa kafin Van Halen a lokacin zagayen wasannin su na 2012 tare da mawaƙin Dave Lee Roth. Brown ya bar matarsa da ‘ya’ya guda biyar. Ya tattauna game da yakinsa da sankarar kansa a wata hira da KCAL News a bara.
post_content: Sad news for music lovers: George 'Funky' Brown of Kool & The Gang has passed away at 74 after battling lung cancer. He helped create huge hits like 'Celebration' and 'Get Down on It.' #RIPFunkyBrown #KoolAndTheGang
