article_content: If you want to buy a house in Argentina, you’ll need U.S. dollars. This is because the Argentine peso has been significantly devalued over the last 75 years, making it less desirable for major transactions among those with substantial wealth. The U.S. dollar dominates. Importantly, the Federal Reserve does not 'supply' dollars directly to Argentina. Dollars circulate in Argentina because there is productive economic activity and a demand for goods and services that warrant dollar transactions. Many traditional economic schools—including Keynesian, Monetarist, Austrian, and Supply Side—often view central bank policy as the driving force behind economic activity and inflation. They assume that money is supplied by central banks and that controlling the money supply can manage inflation. However, even if every U.S. dollar disappeared tomorrow, economic production would quickly give rise to new currencies. Money in circulation is a direct result of economic output. Recent debates show disagreements among economists about the Fed’s ability to control inflation. Some claim that, since they view the Fed as causing inflation, it must also be the solution; others contest that currency devaluation comes only from a lack of monetary standards. Nonetheless, history shows the Fed hasn’t controlled key devaluations. In 1933, President Franklin D. Roosevelt devalued the dollar against gold, despite objections from Fed Chairman Eugene Meyer. In 1971, President Nixon ended the dollar’s link to gold, again over Fed Chairman Arthur Burns’s objections. The Fed was powerless in both cases. The belief that the Fed can manage inflation by matching the supply of dollars to demand is mistaken. What really gives currency stability is a clear monetary standard, not central banks manipulating money supply. Historically, when currencies were defined by gold, investors trusted long-term government bonds because of this stability. It wasn’t the central banks matching supply and demand, but the gold standard itself that gave credibility to money. Since the U.S. dollar’s break from the gold standard in 1971, the currency has suffered periods of instability and inflation. The Fed does not truly control the so-called money supply; the amount of money is determined by economic production. That’s why the dollar is used for transactions globally, such as buying homes in Argentina. Attempting to increase the money supply by 'printing' more dollars doesn’t necessarily result in more dollars circulating—often it has the opposite effect, as seen with the devalued currencies in Argentina, Iran, and Venezuela. Contrary to some economic thinking, inflation is not simply a result of having 'too much money.' Rather, excess currency is a consequence of inflation: when people lose trust in a currency, it circulates less. Stable money requires a well-defined standard respected by producers. To combat inflation, it’s necessary to return the dollar to a defined standard.
translated_content: Idan kana son sayen gida a Argentina, sai ka mallaki dalar Amurka. Wannan saboda peso na Argentina ya ragu daraja sosai cikin shekaru 75 da suka wuce, don haka ba a yarda da shi wajen manyan hada-hada, musamman a tsakanin masu arziki. Dalar Amurka ce ke tashe. Muhimmanci, Babban Bankin Amurka (Federal Reserve, ko Fed) baya aika daloli kai tsaye zuwa Argentina. Daloli suna yawo a Argentina ne saboda tattalin arzikin kasa yana da koshin lafiya da kuma bukatar kayayyaki da ayyuka da ke dauke da darajar daloli. Makarantun tattalin arziki irinsu Keynesian, Monetarist, Austrian, da Supply Side sukan ce dokokin babban banki su ne ginshikin tattalin arziki da hauhawar farashi. Suna tunanin cewa babbar cibiyar kudi ce ke samarwa tare da iya sarrafa yawan kudade don shawo kan hauhawar farashi. Amma, koda duk dalolin Amurka sun bace kwatsam, samar da kayayyaki da ayyuka zai sa a sami sabbin kudade a kasuwa cikin lokaci. Yadar kudade na da dangantaka da irin arzikin da ake yi. A kwanan nan, masana tattalin arziki na da sabani kan ikon Fed na tafiyar da hauhawar farashi. Wasu na ganin tunda su suka dora laifi a kanta, to ita ce mafita; wasu kuma na ganin rashin tushe mai karfi ne ke haddasa durkushewar kudi. Sai dai tarihin ya nuna cewa a lokuta masu mahimmanci, Fed ba ta iya dakatar da faduwar darajar kudi ba. A shekarar 1933, Shugaban Kasa Franklin D. Roosevelt ya rage darajar dalar Amurka a kan zinariya, duk da adawa daga Shugaban Fed na lokacin, Eugene Meyer. Hakazalika, a 1971 Shugaba Nixon ya yanke alakarta da zinariya lokacin da Arthur Burns ke shugaban Fed. Ba a iya hana hakan ba. Kokarin cewa Fed za ta iya daidaita hauhawar farashi ta hanyar sarrafa adadin daloli da ake da bukata ba daidai ba ne. Abu mafi muhimmanci da ke ba kudi kwanciyar hankali shi ne samar da tushe mai karfi, ba kawai wasa da yawan kudi daga babban banki ba. A tarihin da kudaden kasashe ke da tushe ga zinariya, masu saka jari sun amince da takardun bashi na dogon lokaci saboda wannan sahihancin. Ba daidaitawar babban banki da bukata ba ce ta ke ba da tabbaci, sai daidaitaccen tushe kamar zinariya. Bayan cire dalar daga zinariya tun 1971, an sami wasu lokuta na rashin kwanciyar hankali da hauhawar farashi. Fed ba ta da cikakken iko kan yawan kudade; arziki da samar da kayayyaki ne ke kayyade hakan. Saboda haka ne ake amfani da dala wajen manyan mu'amaloli a duniya, har da siyan gida a Argentina. Kokarin kara yawan kudade ta hanyar bugawa bai tilasta samun karin kudin da ke yawo ba—sau da yawa hakan na karya darajar kudi, kamar yadda aka gani a Argentina, Iran, da Venezuela. Akasin yadda ake tunani, ba yawan kudi da ke haifar da hauhawar farashi kai tsaye ba. A gaskiya, yawan kudin mara daraja yakan biyo bayan hauhawar farashi—idan mutane ba sa yarda da kudi, yawan mu'amalarsa ya ragu. Kudin da ke da tushe mai karfi ne ke da samun tabbaci daga masu samar da kaya. Idan ana son yakar hauhawar farashi, a maido da tushe mai kyau ga dala.

article_content: "Fancy Nancy" is being developed as a live-action film, assembling a notable creative team. Shawn Levy, known for directing "Night at the Museum" and "Real Steel," has signed on as producer. Tina Fey, recognized for her work on "30 Rock" and as the writer of "Mean Girls," is in negotiations to join Levy as co-producer, sources tell Entertainment Weekly. The "Fancy Nancy" storybooks, created by author Jane O'Connor and illustrator Robin Preiss Glasser, follow a young girl with a passion for extravagant dress and using fancy words like "bonjour." Since its debut in 2005, the series has released at least 46 books through HarperCollins, selling over 20 million copies and inspiring dolls, toys, and popular birthday party themes. 20th Century Fox has optioned the series for adaptation by 21 Laps Entertainment, Levy's production company. Fey is expected to remain behind the scenes in a producing role, rather than acting. Levy and Fey previously worked together on the 2010 film "Date Night." Both have daughters, giving them a personal connection to the story. For more, visit EW.com. © 2011 Entertainment Weekly and Time Inc. All rights reserved.

Tina Fey, da aka fi sani da aikinta a "30 Rock" da kuma rubuta "Mean Girls," tana cikin tattaunawa don haɗa kai da Levy a matsayin co-producer, kamar yadda majiyoyi suka sanar wa Entertainment Weekly. article_content: The 2024 Audi Q8 e-tron represents a significant step in Audi’s transition to electric vehicles, especially within the luxury SUV market. It maintains Audi’s iconic design elements, including the familiar four-ring logo, now adapted for the electric era. The vehicle’s styling is an evolution of past models, integrating electric powertrains seamlessly into Audi’s traditional design language. On the exterior, the Q8 e-tron continues to exhibit a distinctive presence akin to previous models, complemented by unique e-tron touches. Its shape combines elegance and assertiveness, while the body’s sculpted lines help improve aerodynamic efficiency, crucial for maximizing driving range. Signature LED tail lights distinguish the Q8 e-tron from its gasoline-powered counterpart. The front grille, a hallmark of Audi design, has been reimagined for electric driving, featuring fewer openings to reduce drag. This closed-off grille reduces airflow and highlights the absence of a combustion engine, signaling a move towards more sustainable luxury transportation. Inside, the Q8 e-tron offers a modern yet welcoming environment. The expansive dashboard is enhanced by horizontal lines that create a sense of space. The central touchscreen, slightly angled towards the driver, offers an intuitive and user-friendly experience. The Audi Virtual Cockpit provides a customizable, high-resolution display for essential information. Subtle ambient lighting highlights the quality materials and craftsmanship throughout the interior. Details like polished aluminum inlays and thoughtfully chosen textures create an unmistakably premium atmosphere. The e-tron branding inside is understated but present, reflecting its electric identity. From the driver's perspective, the seating area is ergonomically designed for both control and comfort. The multifunction steering wheel offers a touch of sportiness and is optimized for comfort, while controls and switchgear are well placed for ease of use. The Q8 e-tron starts at $74,400 for the Premium model. The Premium Plus version, priced at $78,800, adds luxury features like a Bang & Olufsen sound system, ventilated front seats, a top-view camera system, and Matrix-design LED headlights that enhance both functionality and comfort. On the road, the Q8 e-tron delivers a quiet, comfortable ride with soft suspension and agile handling thanks to four-wheel steering. However, its weight can cause noticeable body roll during quick maneuvers. Although the dual electric motors provide 402 horsepower and all-wheel drive in Sport mode, acceleration trails behind rivals like the BMW iX and Tesla Model X. The SQ8 e-tron variant offers nearly 500 horsepower and accelerates from 0-60 mph in 4.2 seconds, aligning more closely with its competitors. While the EPA estimates a maximum range of 285 miles per charge, real-world driving often results in lower figures. For example, typical driving with moderate acceleration and use of climate control produced a range of about 225 miles. Still, fast-charging enables up to 80% battery replenishment in roughly 30 minutes. Overall, the 2024 Audi Q8 e-tron blends future-focused electric mobility with Audi’s well-known luxury, design, and attention to detail. Despite strong competition, its blend of comfort, technology, and sustainable features helps establish it as a contender in the growing segment of luxury electric SUVs.
translated_content: Audi Q8 e-tron na shekarar 2024 tana nuna babbar gaba da Audi ke ci wajen komawa kan mota masu lantarki, musamman a cikin sahun motoci masu annashuwa. Fitilun LED na baya na musamman ne kuma suna bambanta Q8 e-tron da wadda ke amfani da mai. Kofar gaba ta motar, daya daga abubuwan da ke bayyana Audi, an sabunta ta don zamani na lantarki, inda aka rage budewa domin sarrafa iska. Wannan kofar da aka rufe na nufin rage shigar iska da kuma nuna babu injin mai, alamar matsawa zuwa motocin lantarki masu annashuwa. A ciki, Q8 e-tron tana bada jin dadi na zamani da annashuwa. Dashboard dinta ya bazu a gaba, tare da layuka madaidaiciya don kara fadi. Allon tabawa na tsakiya yana karkata dan kadan zuwa direba, yana saukaka amfani. Hakanan, Audi Virtual Cockpit yana nuna hoton bayanai masu muhimmanci da za a iya sauya su gwargwadon bukata. Haske mai laushi yana haskaka ingancin kayan aiki da kwarewa a cikin motar. Shinge na aluminium mai sheki da zababbun kayayyaki suna kara daɗin gani da taba. Alamar e-tron a cikin mota tana da sauki amma ana iya ganinta, tana nuna alamar zaɓin lantarki. Daga wurin direba, an tsara kujerar da kyau don sauki da iko. Stiyari mai ayyuka da yawa yana da dan alamun wasanni kuma an tsara shi don bada annashuwa, sai kuma maballan sarrafa mota da aka tsara don sauki. Farashin Q8 e-tron yana farawa daga dala $74,400 a Premium. Samfurin Premium Plus, wanda ke kan dala $78,800, yana da karin alatu da fasali kamar Bang & Olufsen sound, kujerun gaba da ke busa iska, kyamarar sama da fitilun Matrix-design LED da ke kara amfani da jin dadi. A hanya, Q8 e-tron tana bada sahihiyar shiru da jin dadi, tare da dakali mai laushi da saukin sarrafa tuki ta stiyari mai taya hudu. Amma dai, nauyin mota yana bayyana idan an juya da sauri. Injunan lantarki biyu na ba da 402 hp da all-wheel drive a yanayin Sport, amma saurin ba kamar BMW iX da Tesla Model X ba ne. Samfurin SQ8 e-tron na ba da kusan 500 hp, yana 0-60 mph cikin sakan 4.2, irin na abokan hamayya. Kodayake EPA ta kayyade tafiyar mil 285 a cikakken cajin, a zahiri ana samun kasa da haka. Misali, akuya na tafiya da matsakaicin gudu da amfani da AC, mil 225 aka samu. Amma, cajin gaggawa yana iya cika batir zuwa 80% a kusan mintuna 30. A takaice, Audi Q8 e-tron ta 2024 ta hada ci gaban lantarki da alatu da zane irin na Audi. Duk da hamayya a kasuwa, jin dadi, fasaha da dorewar da take da su sun taimaka mata zama zakara a sahun motoci masu alatu na koren kere-kere.

article_content: Mali's army has taken control of Kidal, a key town in the country's north that ethnic Tuareg rebels had held for nearly a decade. Kidal has long been a stronghold for a Tuareg rebel group central to Mali's persistent political and security crises. The army, reportedly supported by Wagner group mercenaries, fought for Kidal over the past three days. However, the head of Mali’s junta stated that the mission is 'not complete.' Col Assimi Goita, Mali's interim president, posted on X that his goal was to secure the country's territorial integrity. The army has urged civilians in Kidal to stay calm. The Permanent Strategic Framework (CSP), an alliance mostly made up of Tuareg armed groups, said it withdrew from Kidal 'for strategic reasons', according to a statement quoted by the AFP news agency. The group added, 'The fight continues.' On Monday, the Malian army reported being opposed only by 'a series of low-intensity skirmishes' from what it described as 'the alliance of terrorist armed groups.' Mali’s central government lost control of much of the north more than a decade ago, following a Tuareg rebellion initially sparked by calls for a separate state. The security situation was later complicated by Islamist militants. This instability has resulted in three coups since 2012. A 2015 agreement that intended for largely Tuareg separatists to be integrated into the army and for control of Kidal to return to Malian authorities was never implemented. From 2013, French troops assisted Mali in its fight against Islamist militants. However, unresolved issues led Mali’s current military leadership to reject French support, with the last French soldiers leaving in 2022. The junta has since sought help from the Russian Wagner group, although the authorities have not formally acknowledged the mercenaries' presence. The UN peacekeeping mission is also withdrawing from Mali, while rebels and Islamist fighters attempt to seize vacated bases.
translated_content: Sojojin Mali sun karbe Kidal, wani muhimmin gari a arewacin kasar da 'yan tawayen Tuareg suka rike fiye da shekaru tara. Kidal ta kasance cibiyar wata kungiyar 'yan tawaye Tuareg da ke tsakiyar rikicin siyasa da tsaro a Mali. Rahotanni sun ce, sojojin sun samu taimako daga mayakan Wagner, sun fafata tsawon kwanaki uku don karbe Kidal. Amma shugaban gwamnatin soji ya ce aikin bai kammala ba tukuna. Kanar Assimi Goita, shugaban rikon kwarya na Mali, ya wallafa a X cewa burinsa shi ne tabbatar da cikakken ikon kasa. Sojojin sun roki fararen hula masu zama a Kidal da su kwantar da hankali. Kungiyar Permanent Strategic Framework (CSP), wanda mafi yawan mambobinta 'yan bindiga Tuareg ne, ta ce sun fice daga Kidal ne 'don dalilai na dabaru', kamar yadda AFP ta ruwaito. Kungiyar ta kara da cewa, 'Yaki na ci gaba.' A ranar Litinin, sojojin Mali sun bayyana cewa abokan hamayyarsu sun tsaya ne kawai da 'yan gumurzu marasa tsanani daga kin da suka kira 'kungiyoyin 'yan bindiga masu tsattsauran ra'ayi'. Tun sama da shekaru goma da suka gabata, gwamnatin Mali ta rasa iko da yawancin arewa bayan wani tawaye da Tuareg suka tayar da nufin samun ‘yancin kai. Rikicin ya kara tsananta ne bayan masu ikirarin kishin addini suka shiga cikin lamarin. Wannan rashin kwanciyar hankali ya haddasa juyin mulki har sau uku tun bayan shekarar 2012. Yarjejeniyar da aka cimma a 2015, wadda ke nufin a hade yawancin ‘yan tawaye Tuareg cikin soja da kuma mika ikon Kidal ga gwamnati, bata tabbata ba. Tun daga 2013, sojojin Faransa sun taimaka wa Mali wajen yaki da masu ikirarin kishin addini. Amma matsalar ta ki ci ta ki cinyewa, wanda ya sa gwamnatin soji ta soke taimakon Faransa, inda sojoji na karshe suka bar kasar a 2022. Yanzu gwamnatin mulkin soja na Mali ta nemi taimakon mayakan Wagner daga Rasha, ko da yake ba a taba fitar da wata sanarwa kai tsaye daga hukumomin kasar ba. Hukumar zaman lafiya ta MDD ma tana ficewa daga Mali yayinda ‘yan tawaye da masu tada kayar baya ke kokarin kwace cibiyoyin da aka bari.

article_content: Bohdan Yermokhin, a 17-year-old from Mariupol, Ukraine, became the focus of international concern after being relocated to Russia during the ongoing conflict. Orphaned for years, he was with relatives when Russian troops seized Mariupol in April 2022. Lawyer Kateryna Bobrovska reported that Russian officials transported him to Moscow, where he was placed with a foster family and given Russian documents. As his 18th birthday neared, Yermokhin received a military draft summons for service in Moscow. Guardian Irina Rudnitskaya confirmed his student status at a Russian college and claimed he wouldn't be deployed immediately, as new recruits typically do not take part in operations. Yermokhin's fears of conscription came to light after he publicly appealed to Ukraine's President Zelenskyy for assistance in returning home. This request prompted intervention from officials. Russia's Commissioner for Children’s Rights, Maria Lvova-Belova, issued a letter approving his return, a development also announced by Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine’s human rights official. Disputes surfaced, as Russian authorities previously asserted that Yermokhin wanted to stay in Russia—a claim refuted by Bobrovska, who alleged her client was pressured into signing statements. Earlier, Russian border authorities stopped Yermokhin as he tried to escape to Belarus. Eventually, Lvova-Belova acknowledged Yermokhin's change of heart and said he'd travel back to Ukraine, accompanied by legal representatives to reunite with relatives. Yermokhin’s situation is not isolated; Ukrainian officials accuse Russia of forcibly relocating over 100,000 children from occupied areas, placing many with Russian families in what the UN considers a war crime. The International Criminal Court issued arrest warrants for Lvova-Belova and Russian President Vladimir Putin for these alleged illegal child transfers.
translated_content: Bohdan Yermokhin, matashi mai shekara 17 daga Mariupol a Ukraine, ya jawo hankalin duniya bayan aka kai shi kasar Rasha a lokacin yakin da ke gudana. Tun yana yaro ba shi da iyaye, yana zaune da 'yan uwansa lokacin da sojojin Rasha suka mamaye Mariupol a watan Afrilu 2022. Lauyarsa, Kateryna Bobrovska, ta bayyana cewa hukumomin Rasha sun dauke shi zuwa Moscow, suka mika shi ga wata iyali masu reno tare da bashi takardun zama dan kasa na Rasha. Yayin da yake gab da cikar shekara 18, Bohdan ya samu takardar kiran shiga aikin soja a Moscow. Mai kulawarsa a Rasha, Irina Rudnitskaya, ta tabbatar da cewa yana makaranta a kwaleji, kuma ta kara da cewa irin wadannan sabbin dalibai ba a tura su yaki nan take. Tsoron a dauke shi aikin soja ne yasa Bohdan ya nemi taimako ta faifan bidiyo ga Shugaban Ukraine, Zelenskyy, yana rokon a taimaka masa ya koma gida. Wannan sanya hannu yasa jami'an kasa suka shiga lamarin sosai. Kwamishinar kare hakkin yara na Rasha, Maria Lvova-Belova, ta fitar da wasika da ke amincewa ya koma Ukraine, sannan Dmytro Lubinets, jami'in kare hakkin dan Adam na Ukraine, ya sanar da hakan. An samu sabani tsakanin hukumomin kasashen biyu, inda Rasha ta ce Bohdan yana so ya ci gaba da zama a kasar, amma lauyarsa ta ce an danne shi ya amince da hakan. A baya, jami'an tsaron iyakar Rasha sun kama Bohdan a kokarinsa na tserewa zuwa Belarus. A karshe, Lvova-Belova ta sanar da cewa Bohdan ya bayyana cewa yana son komawa Ukraine yanzu, kuma za a raka shi da lauyoyi har ya hadu da 'yan uwansa. Matsalar da ta shafi Bohdan tana daya daga cikin zarge-zargen da Ukraine ke yi wa Rasha na dauke dubban yara daga yankunan da suka mamaye, suna sanyawa a cikin iyalan Rasha, lamarin da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ke dauka a matsayin laifin yaki. Kotun Duniya ta fitar da sammacin kama Lvova-Belova da Shugaba Vladimir Putin saboda irin wadannan daukar yara ba bisa ka’ida ba.

article_content: London, England (CNN) -- Visitors to Britain ahead of the 2012 London Olympics can expect a warmer welcome, thanks to a new etiquette guide from VisitBritain, the national tourism agency. The guide provides tips to help hospitality workers—from hoteliers to taxi drivers—understand and respect different cultures. According to Sandie Dawe, chief executive of VisitBritain, 'Overseas visitors spend more than £16 billion ($25 billion) a year in Britain, making a significant contribution to the economy and supporting jobs nationwide. Offering a friendly welcome to foreign visitors is vital, especially with hundreds of thousands expected for the Olympic and Paralympic Games in 2012. This advice is just one way VisitBritain is helping the tourism industry better serve all customers.' The tips were compiled by VisitBritain staff who are natives of the featured countries and will be included in an online resource for the tourism sector. Examples from the guide include: - Japanese visitors may smile when they are angry, embarrassed, or sad, not just when happy. Avoid talking to them with your hands in your pockets, staring, being late, or blowing your nose in front of them. Avoid showing the soles of your shoes while seated. - For Argentinians, pouring wine backward into a glass signals hostility. Their humor may lightly tease about clothing or weight. - Winking is considered rude in Hong Kong, and pointing should be done with an open hand instead of the index finger. Avoid discussing topics like failure, poverty, or death. - Visitors from the United Arab Emirates may take offense if staff seem bossy. They appreciate when people are knowledgeable about Arab culture. - South Africans may refer to traffic lights as 'robots,' and 'Howzit' is a casual greeting. Placing your thumb between your forefinger and middle finger is a rude gesture. - With Brazilians, avoid asking personal questions about age or salary. - When meeting Mexicans, it's best not to discuss poverty, illegal immigration, earthquakes, or the 1845-46 war with America. When indicating height, note that a downward-facing palm is used only for animals. - Never call a Canadian an American. Some Canadians are sensitive about being mistaken for U.S. citizens. - When complimented by a Chinese visitor, politely deny the compliment to show humility instead of saying 'thank you.' - Snapping fingers with Belgians may be considered impolite, and avoid discussing the country's internal linguistic or political differences. - Physical contact should be avoided during first meetings with people from India, as it might be taken as offensive. - Do not stereotype Poles as heavy drinkers; excessive drinking is frowned upon in Poland.

Jagoran yana ba da shawarwari don taimakawa ma'aikatan otal-otal da direbobin tasi su girmama al'adu daban-daban. A cewar Sandie Dawe, babbar shugabar VisitBritain, 'Baƙi daga ƙasashen waje suna kashe fiye da £16 biliyan ($25 biliyan) duk shekara a Burtaniya, suna taimakawa tattalin arziki da samar da ayyukan yi. Yin maraba da kyau ga baƙi yana da matuƙar muhimmanci, d especially tunda dubban mutane za su halarci gasar Olympic da Paralympic ta 2012. Wannan shawarwari hanya ce da VisitBritain ke taimaka wa masana’antar yawon shakatawa wajen kulawa da kowa.' Ma'aikatan VisitBritain daga ƙasashen da aka ambata sun tattaro shawarwarin, kuma za a saka a cikin wata mahada ta yanar gizo don ma'aikatan yawon shakatawa. Wasu shawarwarin sun haɗa da: - Murmushin 'dan Japan ba koyaushe ke nuni da farin ciki ba; yana iya nuni da fushi, jin kunya ko bakin ciki. Ka guji magana da hannunka a aljihu, kallo kai tsaye, makara ko perlu da hanci a gabansa. Kada ka nuna kafarka yayin zama. - Ga 'yan Argentina, zuba giya a baya cikin gilashi yana nuna matsala. Barkwancinsu na iya zuwa ne akan tufafi ko kiba. - Winking ba daidai ba ne a Hong Kong, ka yi nuni da hannu duka maimakon yatsa. Ka guji zancen rashin nasara, talauci ko mutuwa. - Baƙin daga United Arab Emirates ba sa so a nuna musu izza. Suna mutunta wanda ya fahimci al'adunsu. - 'Yan Afirka ta Kudu suna kiran fitilun titi da 'robots', 'Howzit' kuma gaisuwa ce. Saka babban yatsa tsakanin yatsa biyu bai dace ba. - Ga 'yan Brazil, guji tambayoyi na sirri kamar shekaru ko albashi. - Idan ka haɗu da 'yan Mexico, guji magana game da talauci, zaman ba bisa ka'ida ba, girgizar ƙasa ko faɗan da Amurka 1845-46. Nuna tsawo da tafin hannu yana nuni da dabbobi ne kawai. - Kada ka kira 'dan Kanada 'dan Amurka, wasu sun fi jin dadin a bambanta. - Idan 'dan Sin ya yi yabo, ka amsa da tawali'u maimakon godiya. - Firkita yatsa a gaban 'yan Belgium ba dai-dai ba ne. Guji magana kan bambancin harshe ko siyasa. - A guji taba 'yan Indiya a ganawar farko, saboda hakan na iya zama rashin ladabi. - Kada a nuna cewa 'yan Poland suna shan giya da yawa; hakan ba ladabi ba ne a wurinsu.

article_content: On Saturday, protesters marched in Washington, D.C., to oppose government surveillance programs that were revealed this year through disclosures by Edward Snowden. The demonstration marked the 12th anniversary of the Patriot Act, the law that authorized such surveillance. Carrying signs saying ‘Stop Mass Spying,’ ‘Thank you, Edward Snowden,’ and ‘Unplug Big Brother,’ demonstrators gathered outside the U.S. Capitol, voicing their concerns about online monitoring by the National Security Agency (NSA). One protester read a statement prepared by Edward Snowden ahead of the rally. Organizers estimated more than 2,000 people attended, although Capitol Police typically do not provide crowd sizes. The protest brought together an unusual alliance of liberal privacy advocates and members of the conservative Tea Party, both critical of what they described as unlawful government spying on Americans. Protester Michael Greene said, 'As a conservative, I don't want the government collecting, storing, and using information about me.' Jennifer Wynne, another demonstrator, added, 'We have learned about widespread privacy abuses and a lack of oversight. We need Congress to act.' Although Snowden could not attend in person, his presence was felt through placards and his message, which was read aloud by activist Jesselyn Radack. ‘In the last four months, we've learned that the U.S. Intelligence Community secretly built a system of pervasive surveillance,' Radack read from Snowden’s statement. ‘No phone call or internet transaction in America goes unnoticed by the NSA. This is not about party lines or just terrorism.' The statement called government surveillance unconstitutional and urged people from all walks of life to oppose it. It cited the Fourth Amendment’s protection against unreasonable searches and seizures, declaring mass surveillance has no place in the United States. The rally came amid reports that the U.S. had spied on leaders of more than 70 countries, which fueled international distrust of American data-gathering practices. The event was organized by 'Stop Watching Us', a coalition of approximately 100 advocacy groups including the American Civil Liberties Union, the Electronic Frontier Foundation, Occupy Wall Street NYC, and the Libertarian Party. Since Snowden’s revelations, these groups have urged Congress to reform the laws enabling NSA's secret data collection. The Obama administration and several lawmakers continue to defend the NSA programs as essential for national security, stating they have prevented attacks and are overseen by Congress and the courts. Snowden's disclosures also suggested that the U.S. monitored German Chancellor Angela Merkel’s phone, leading to diplomatic tensions. In an online letter, Stop Watching Us called on Congress to end mass surveillance and ensure accountability for intelligence agencies, especially under the Patriot Act. ‘It is time for reform,’ the statement concluded. ‘Elections are coming, and we’re watching you.’
translated_content: A ranar Asabar, masu zanga-zanga sun yi tattaki a birnin Washington, D.C., don nuna adawa da shirye-shiryen leƙen asiri na gwamnati da Edward Snowden ya fallasa wannan shekarar. Wannan zanga-zangar ta gudana ne a ranar cika shekara 12 da kafa dokar Patriot Act, dokar da ta ba da damar irin waɗannan ayyuka. Da kwalaye dauke da rubuce-rubuce irin su ‘Dakatar da leƙen asiri na yawa,’ ‘Mun gode Edward Snowden,’ da ‘Kashe Babban Dan Uwa,’ masu zanga-zanga sun taru wajen harabar Capitol, suna nuna damuwar su kan yadda National Security Agency (NSA) ke saka ido ta yanar gizo. Wani mai zanga-zangar ya karanta jawabin Edward Snowden da aka rubuta kafin zanga-zangar. Masu shirya taron sun kiyasta fiye da mutane 2,000 ne suka halarta, duk da cewa ‘yan sanda da ke Capitol ba su fitar da kimanta adadin jama'a ba. Wannan zanga-zangar ta hada masu fafutuka na kare sirri daga bangaren 'yan lefi da kuma mambobin Tea Party na bangaren mazan jiya — duka suna adawa da abin da suka kira leƙen asiri na gwamnati a kan Amurkawa ba bisa ka'ida ba. Wani mai zanga-zanga, Michael Greene, ya ce: 'Ni dan kwadago ne, kuma ba ni so gwamnati ta tara bayanai na, ta ajiye su, ko ta yi amfani da su akaina.' Jennifer Wynne, wata mai fafutuka, ta kuma kara da cewa: 'Mun fahimci irin rashin kiyaye sirrin da ke faruwa da rashin sanya ido mai kyau. Dole ne mu nemi Majalisar dokoki ta dauki mataki.' Ko da yake ba a samu Snowden ba a wajen zanga-zangar, an ji muryarsa ta wajen alluna da kuma jawabin da Jesselyn Radack, wata mai fafutuka, ta karanta. ‘A cikin watanni hudu da suka wuce, mun gano cewa jami'an leƙen asiri na Amurka sun gina tsarin leƙen asiri mai fadada sosai,’ kamar yadda Radack ta karanta daga jawabin Snowden. ‘Babu kowacce kiran waya ko zirga-zirgar intanet a Amurka da ba ta ke karkashin idon NSA. Wannan ba batun jam’iyyu ko ta’addanci ba ne kawai.’ Jawabin ya bayyana cewa irin wannan leƙen asiri ba ya dace da kundin tsarin mulki, yana kuma kira ga kowa, daga matasa har manya, da su tashi su kalubalanci wannan hali. Jawabin ya kara jan hankalin taimakon ‘Fourth Amendment’ wadda take hana gwamnati yin bincike ko kama bayanan jama’a ba bisa ka’ida ba, yana mai cewa leƙen asiri ba shi da gurbi a Amurka. Zanga-zangar ta zo a daidai lokacin da aka rahoto cewa Amurka ta yi leƙen asiri a kan shuwagabannin fiye da kasashe 70, lamarin da ya haifar da rashin yarda daga kasashen waje game da tsarin tattara bayanan Amurka. Taron ya samu shirya wa ne ta kungiya mai suna 'Stop Watching Us', haɗin gwiwar kusan kungiyoyi 100 ciki har da American Civil Liberties Union, Electronic Frontier Foundation, Occupy Wall Street NYC da Libertarian Party. Tun bayan fallasar Snowden, waɗannan kungiyoyin na matsa wa Majalisa ta garambawul dokokin da suka bai wa NSA damar tara bayanai a gushe. Gwamnatin Obama da wasu ‘yan majalisa sun ci gaba da kare shirin NSA, suna masu cewa yana da matukar muhimmanci wajen kare tsaro, kuma majalisa da kotu na sanya ido akai. Bayyanar bayanan Snowden ta nuna cewa Amurka ta saurari wayar Chancellor Angela Merkel na Jamus, abin da ya janyo sabani da Jamus. A wata wasika da aka wallafa a intanet, ‘Stop Watching Us’ ta roki Majalisa ta dakatar da leƙen asiri gadan-gadan da tabbatar da gamayyar lissafin ayyukan hukumomin leƙen asiri, musamman karkashin Patriot Act. ‘Lokacin gyara ya yi,’ in ji jawabin. ‘Zaben na gabatowa, kuma mu ma muna kallonku.’

article_content: London's abandoned rail and tube lines have seen many creative reuses over the years, serving as bomb shelters, impromptu party spaces, and film sets. Now, a new idea seeks to bring life back to the city's forgotten tunnels: transforming a section beneath Oxford Street into an underground mushroom garden. The project, called 'Pop Down,' proposes converting part of the disused 'Mail Rail' tunnel—originally used to transport mail around London until its closure in 2003—into a mushroom farm and pedestrian walkway. The walkway would be illuminated from above by glass-fiber, mushroom-shaped sculptures at street level. Fletcher Priest Architects, the London-based creators, believe underground tunnels offer the perfect environment for urban mushroom cultivation. They also envision pop-up 'Funghi' cafés at either end of the tunnel. 'Pop Down' recently earned the top prize in the 'High Line for London' competition, organized by the UK's Landscape Institute, in partnership with the Mayor of London and the Garden Museum. The contest, inspired by New York’s successful High Line park, received 170 submissions; High Line founders Joshua David and Robert Hammond helped serve as judges. Other notable entries included 'The Lido Line' by [Y/N] Studio, which aims to transform a stretch of Regent's Canal from Little Venice to Limehouse into a public swimming area. Innovative concepts such as 'Barge Walk,' a floating park/farm/wetland near Canary Wharf, and 'Bridge-It,' which imagines building parks over, under, and alongside current railway lines, also received high commendations. Penelope Curtis, director of Tate Britain, commented, 'During this Olympic summer, it was clear that London's public spaces are more vibrant than ever. There is now a strong desire to make our outdoor areas more accessible and enjoyable.' Shortlisted competition entries are on view at the Garden Museum until October 21.
translated_content: Tsofaffin layin dogo da layin jirgin ƙasa a London sun sha samun amfani iri-iri a shekarun baya, kamar mafakar bama-bamai, wajen biki kai tsaye, da kuma wurin daukar fim. Yanzu, wata sabuwar dabara na kokarin dawo da rayuwa cikin manyan bututun birnin: canza wani bangare a ƙasa da Oxford Street zuwa lambun namomin kaza a karkashin ƙasa. Aikin mai suna 'Pop Down', yana nufin sauya wani ɓangare na tsohuwar hanya mai suna 'Mail Rail' – wacce ake amfani da ita wajen safarar wasiku a London har zuwa rufewa a 2003 – zuwa gonar namomin kaza da hanyar tafiya a ƙasa. Hanyar za ta sami haske daga sama ta hanyar sassaken gilashi mai kama da namomin kaza a saman titi. Fletcher Priest Architects, kamfanin da ke London da ya kirkiri aikin, na ganin cewa bututu a ƙasa na da kyau don noman namomin kaza a birni. Hakanan suna hangen bude kafet-cafen 'Funghi' a duka bangarorin hanyar. 'Pop Down' kwanan nan ya samu lambar yabo ta farko a gasar 'High Line for London' wadda Hukumar Kula da Lafazin Gida ta UK tare da hadin gwiwar Mayor din London da Garden Museum suka shirya. Gasa ta samo wahayi daga shahararriyar High Line a New York, inda aka shigar da sama da aikin 170; Joshua David da Robert Hammond na High Line sun kasance cikin masu tantancewa. Wasu ayyuka masu ban sha'awa da suka shiga gasar sun hada da 'The Lido Line' daga [Y/N] Studio, wanda ke da burin canza wani bangare na Regent's Canal daga Little Venice zuwa Limehouse zuwa wurin wanka na jama'a. Ayyuka kamar 'Barge Walk,' da ke gina lambu mai iyo/kifi/makarfi kusa da Canary Wharf, da 'Bridge-It,' wanda ke kawo tsarin lambuna a sama, ƙasa da gefen layin dogo na yanzu, suma sun samu yabo. Shugabar Tate Britain, Penelope Curtis, ta ce, 'Cikin wannan lokacin na Olympics, an ga fili-filin jama'a a London suna kara cike da rai fiye da da. Yanzu akwai bukata sosai don amfanar da waje-wajen mu na waje sosai da kuma jin daɗi.' Manyan ayyukan da aka zaba za su kasance a wurin nuna fasaha na Garden Museum har zuwa 21 ga Oktoba.

article_content: Kevin McEnroe, the 27-year-old son of tennis legend John McEnroe and Oscar-winning actress Tatum O'Neal, was arrested on drug charges in Manhattan, according to police. McEnroe was taken into custody late Tuesday after police officers observed what they believed to be a drug transaction on an East Village street corner, said NYPD Sgt. Jessica McRorie. He faces two counts of criminal possession of a controlled substance. According to police, McEnroe was found carrying six clear plastic bags containing a substance believed to be cocaine, a Clorazepate pill, 20 Oxycodone pills, 10 morphine pills, and 10 unidentified orange pills. On Wednesday, McEnroe was arraigned in Manhattan Criminal Court. Prosecutors requested a $5,000 bail, but the judge released McEnroe on his own recognizance. He is scheduled to appear in court again on October 16. McEnroe's attorney, Isabelle Kirshner, declined to comment. A second man was also arrested at the scene, according to a law enforcement official. Kevin's mother, Tatum O'Neal, was previously arrested in 2008 in Manhattan on misdemeanor drug possession charges after allegedly buying crack cocaine. She later pleaded guilty to a lesser charge. O'Neal won an Oscar at age 10 for best supporting actress in 'Paper Moon.' She is the daughter of actor Ryan O'Neal and was previously married to John McEnroe, with whom she has three children. In a related case, Robert Downey Jr.'s son, Indio, was also arrested on drug charges. Reporting by CNN's Shimon Prokupecz and Rande Iaboni.

A ranar Laraba aka gurfanar da McEnroe a kotun laifuka ta Manhattan. Masu gabatar da kara sun nemi a sa masa beli na dala 5,000, amma alkalin ya sake shi ba tare da ajiya ba. article_content: Global research firm Kantar has identified early signs of recovery in India's fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector. Demand for daily groceries and essentials increased by 7.2% year-on-year in the September quarter. Rural sales volumes grew by 6.2%, while urban markets saw an 8.4% increase compared to last year. Marico, the company behind Parachute and Saffola oils, reported a strong start to the second quarter, observing increased demand in both urban and rural areas in July. However, overall market sentiment, especially in rural areas, declined during August and early September due to insufficient rainfall and rising food prices. "We have observed some recovery since mid-September and are optimistic about a gradual increase in consumption as the festive season begins, and with stable retail and food inflation and ongoing government spending," Marico Managing Director Saugata Gupta told investors recently. Kantar tracks a wide range of products, including branded and unbranded goods, unlike Nielsen, which focuses on branded retail sales. The firm's data, which lags by one quarter, analyzes both household consumption and primary company sales to distributors. Growth in consumer goods was aided by a low base last year and higher uptake of essential food categories, such as atta. Despite most festivals falling in the December quarter this year, the segment still experienced robust growth last quarter. "The gap between urban and rural markets is narrowing every quarter, and it's possible that both could perform equally well by year-end," said K Ramakrishnan, Managing Director for South Asia at Kantar's Worldpanel division. "We appear to be at the start of a sector turnaround that has faced challenges in recent quarters." Atta, a staple and widely purchased product, significantly impacts FMCG data. Government programs offering free foodgrains also affect overall market statistics. All segments grew in the last quarter, with food and beverages leading at 8.7%, especially due to increased demand for snacks and convenience foods. Excluding atta, market growth was 4.2%. Tata Consumer reported improved sales during the quarter compared to last year, even though rural markets remain under pressure. "We have noticed the impacts of inflation and uneven monsoons, and an increase in MGNREGA (rural jobs) activity," said Sunil D'Souza, Tata Consumer's Managing Director. "Recently, two-wheeler sales have increased, so we remain cautiously optimistic. Our guidance remains for mid-single-digit volume growth, and we are on track to achieve this more quickly than before." HUL, citing NielsenIQ data, noted an 8% rise in FMCG market volumes during the September quarter, with urban volumes up 10% and rural improving by 7%. In other business news: Apple Inc achieved record quarterly revenue in India in the September quarter, with double-digit year-on-year growth, according to CEO Tim Cook. India, the world's second-largest smartphone market, remains a key area of focus for Apple. Meanwhile, luxury car buyers in India are getting younger, with two out of five Audi buyers now under 40. Mercedes-Benz and BMW have reported similar trends, with Indian buyers being among the youngest globally for these brands. Separately, the upcoming merger between Sony and Zee Entertainment is uncertain. ZEEL's Chief Executive, Punit Goenka, continues to be investigated by SEBI for alleged misallocation of company funds.
translated_content: Kamfanin bincike na duniya, Kantar, ya gano alamun farfadowa a bangaren kayayyakin masarufi masu saurin sayarwa (FMCG) a Indiya. Bukatar kayan girki da abubuwan bukatuwa ta karu da kashi 7.2% a cikin shekarar daya da ta gabata a zangon watan Satumba. Sayarwa a yankunan karkara ta tashi da kashi 6.2%, yayin da birane suka samu karin kashi 8.4% idan aka kwatanta da shekaran da ta wuce. Kamfanin Marico, mai kera Parachute da Saffola, ya bayyana cewa zangon biyu na bana ya fara da kyau, inda aka ga karuwar bukata a birane da karkara a watan Yuli. Sai dai an fuskanci dan saukin kasuwa musamman a yankunan karkara a watan Agusta da farkon Satumba saboda karancin ruwan sama da tashin farashin abinci. "Mun ga dan farfadowa tun daga tsakiyar watan Satumba kuma muna da kwarin gwiwa cewa cinikin zai rika karuwa a hankali da zuwan lokutan bukukuwa, da kwanciyar hankalin farashin kaya da ci gaba da kashe kudin gwamnati," in ji Daraktan Gudanarwa na Marico, Saugata Gupta, ga masu hannun jari kwanan nan. Kantar na bibiyar kayayyaki iri-iri, harda na kamfanoni da marasa lakabi, sabanin Nielsen wanda ke duba kayayyakin da aka lakaba kawai a shaguna. Bayanai na Kantar na tafiya da jinkiri na zangon kwata daya, suna binciken cinikin da akeyi a gida da kuma na farko da kamfanoni ke kaiwa masu rabawa. Ci gaban kasuwa ya samu ne sakamakon matakin kasa da aka fito daga shekaran da ya gabata da kuma yawan sayar da kayan abinci na asali kamar atta. Duk da yawancin bukukuwa sun fada zangon Disamba bana, bangaren ya ci gaba da nuna karuwar da karfi a zangon baya. "Tazarar da ke tsakanin kasuwar birane da karkara na raguwa kwata-kwata, kuma mai yiwuwa su zo daidai kafin karshen shekarar," in ji K Ramakrishnan, Daraktan Kantar na South Asia, Worldpanel. "Muna ganin kamar muna fara bullowar farfadowa ga bangaren da ya fuskanci kalubale kwanan nan." Atta, kayan abinci da ake yawan saya, na bayyana tasiri sosai a kididdigar FMCG. Shirye-shiryen gwamnati na bayar da hatsi kyauta suma na da tasiri a kididdiga. Dukkan bangarori sun habbaka a zangon baya, inda abinci da abin sha su ka fi karuwa da kashi 8.7%, musamman sabili da kara sayayya kayan ciye-ciye da saukin amfani. Idan aka cire atta, kasuwa ta karu da kashi 4.2%. Kamfanin Tata Consumer ya samu karin siyarwa a zangon baya idan aka kwatanta da shekaran da ya gabata, ko da yake kasuwar karkara tana fama da matsin lamba. "Mun lura da tasirin hauhawar farashi da rashin tabbas na damina, tare da karuwar ayyukan MGNREGA (shirin aikin gona na gwamnati)," in ji Sunil D'Souza, Daraktan Tata Consumer. "Kwanan nan kuma an ga karin siyar da babura. Saboda haka, muna da dan kwarin guiwa. Har yanzu muhimmin hasashenmu shine gudana da hauhawar ciniki daidai matsakaici, kuma muna kokarin cimma hakan cikin sauri fiye da dā." HUL, yana amfani da bayanan NielsenIQ, ya nuna cewa kasuwar FMCG ta karu da kashi 8% a zangon watan Satumba, inda birane suka kara da kashi 10% yayin da karkara ke da kashi 7%. A wasu labaran kasuwanci: Apple Inc ta cimma sabon tarihi na samun kudi mafi yawa a Indiya cikin zangon watan Satumba, inda tayi karin ribar kashi biyu a cikin dari daga shekarar da ta gabata, a cewar Shugaban kamfanin Tim Cook. Indiya, kasuwa ta biyu mafi girma ta wayar hannu a duniya, na da mahimmanci ga Apple. A bangaren motoci masu tsada, matasa masu siya a Indiya na dada yawa, inda biyu cikin biyar masu siyan Audi ke kasa da shekaru 40. Kamfanonin Mercedes-Benz da BMW ma na da irin wannan hali, inda Indiyawa ke daga cikin matasa mafi yawa masu siyan wadannan motoci a duniya. A gefe guda kuma, hadewar da ake shirin yi tsakanin Sony da Zee Entertainment na cikin rudani. Babban Darakta na ZEEL, Punit Goenka, har yanzu na fuskantar bincike daga SEBI kan zargin karkatar da kudaden kamfani.

article_content: Washington (CNN) -- In the days following the 2012 presidential election, Martin Mendez, a Latino Republican, felt disappointed as polls showed President Barack Obama had won a second term with strong support from Hispanic voters. Mendez, who had campaigned for Mitt Romney in Denver, recalled that many Hispanics saw Romney as favoring the wealthy, while Obama was seen as supporting ordinary people. Mendez argued that Republicans often wait too long to reach out to minority communities, a pattern he believes needs to change. The growing influence of Latinos, Black Americans, women, and young people in American politics has been evident for years. Demographers expected the U.S. population would eventually become more diverse, which is now impacting the national political landscape. Earlier in 2012, Mitt Romney acknowledged the Republican Party's challenge with minority voters, particularly Hispanics. He noted that if the Hispanic voting bloc became as loyal to Democrats as the African American bloc, it would create difficulties for the Republican Party. For several election cycles, women have made up more than half of voters but have not always received significant political attention. Meanwhile, Latino political activism and African Americans’ pursuit of political gains have resulted in historic participation, aiding Obama’s re-election. This coalition of minorities, women, and young voters helped Democrats make substantial gains in the 2012 election. Researchers at the Pew Research Center, Paul Taylor and D'Vera Cohn, noted that minority groups could become the majority of the U.S. population by 2050. In 2012, minorities accounted for 37% of the population and cast a record 28% of presidential votes. For the first time, women and minorities will hold the majority of Democratic Party seats in the House, according to Bloomberg News, while Republicans remain predominantly white and male. According to CNN exit polls, 55% of women and 45% of men voted for Obama, while 44% of women and 52% of men supported Romney. Obama’s support among Hispanic voters was especially strong in states like Nevada, Colorado, and Florida. The minority population continues to grow and will play an even greater role in politics in coming years, potentially changing power dynamics in many states. David Bositis, a senior analyst, remarked that the era of conservative dominance by white voters is ending and that campaigns targeting only white voters are unlikely to succeed. Although Obama did not achieve comprehensive immigration reform in his first term, the issue remains central for both parties. Expert Andra Gillespie said future legislative battles over immigration will test both the Republicans’ outreach and Obama’s ability to build coalitions. A record number of women, 20, will serve in the U.S. Senate, including Tammy Baldwin (the first openly lesbian senator), Mazie Hirono (Hawaii), and Debbie Fischer (Nebraska), among others. The New Hampshire congressional delegation will be all female. Jennifer Lawless, of American University, cautioned that electoral strategies that help win women’s votes do not automatically translate into policy changes benefiting women. Ballot initiatives in various states highlighted both progress and continued divisions: Maryland and Maine passed marriage equality; Maryland approved in-state tuition for undocumented immigrants, while Montana imposed restrictions on state services for undocumented immigrants and required parental notification for minors seeking abortions. Florida rejected limiting abortion coverage for state employees. Rob "Biko" Baker, director of the League of Young Voters, expects issues such as immigration, climate change, marriage equality, and youth incarceration to remain central to public policy in future elections. Young voters, he notes, are especially concerned about climate change and marriage equality. Elected officials, he suggests, should connect these issues to job creation. Mendez feels encouraged after attending a Colorado Hispanic Republicans event. Formerly a Democrat, he joined the GOP due to his positions on issues like abortion, firearms, and taxes. He hopes more people will be open to considering the Republican Party. "The last two days, I’ve felt down about the election," he said. "But today I’m hopeful. We don’t need to make a huge change, just a gradual one."
translated_content: Washington (CNN) -- A cikin kwanaki kadan bayan zaben shugaban kasa na 2012, Martin Mendez, ɗan Republican Latino, ya shiga damuwa yayin da rahotanni suka tabbatar Shugaba Barack Obama ya sake lashe wa'adi na biyu da karfin goyon bayan masu zabe 'yan Hispanic. Mendez, wanda yayi kokarin tallata Mitt Romney a Denver, ya bayyana yadda akasarin 'yan Hispanic suka ga Romney a matsayin mai amfani da masu kudi, yayin da Obama ya fi wakiltar masu talauci. Mendez ya bayyana cewa jam'iyyar Republican suna daukan lokaci kafin su kusanci al'ummomin da su ba yawa, kuma yana ganin lokaci yayi da hakan ya canza. Tasirin Latinos, bakaken fata, mata da matasa a siyasar Amurka yana kara karfi a duk shekara. Masana kididdiga sun dade suna hango cewa Amurka za ta kara samun bambancin jinsi da al'adu, wanda hakan yana tasiri ga siyasar kasa yanzu. Tun farkon 2012, Mitt Romney ya fadi kalubalen da jam'iyyarsa ke fuskanta wajen samun goyon bayan masu zabe daga bangaren da ba fararen fata ba, musamman 'yan Hispanic. Ya ce idan wannan rukuni na masu zabe ya zama masu biyayya ga Democrat kamar bakaken fata, zai sanya jam'iyyar samun matsala. Shekaru da dama, mata sun fi yawan masu zabe, amma ba lallai a rika mayar da hankali wajen neman kuri'unsu a siyasa. Hakazalika, matasa da 'yan Latino masu fafutuka da gwagwarmayar siyasar bakaken fata sun taka rawa wajen ci gaban zabe, musamman na Obama. Wannan hadin kai tsakanin kabilu, matasa da mata ne ya taimaka wa Democrats samun nasara sosai a zaben 2012. Masu bincike na Pew Research Center, Paul Taylor da D'Vera Cohn, sun ce daba mayar da kabilun da ba fararen fata ba suka zama mafi rinjaye a kasar nan da 2050. A 2012, sun kai kashi 37 cikin 100 na yawan jama'a, suka kuma zuba tasa'uru 28 cikin 100 na kuri'un zabe. Karo na farko, mata da sauran kabilu zasu rike mafi yawan kujerun Democrat a Majalisar Wakilai, yayin da Republicans suka fi yawan fararen fata da maza, cewar Bloomberg News. Rahoton fitowar kuri'u na CNN ya nuna cewa kashi 55 cikin 100 na mata da kashi 45 na maza sun zabi Obama. Romney ya samu kashi 44 cikin 100 na mata da kashi 52 cikin 100 na maza. Goyon bayan Obama daga 'yan Hispanic ya fi tasiri a jihohin Nevada, Colorado da Florida. Yawan al'ummar da ba fararen fata ba yana karuwa sosai, da zai kara taka rawa a siyasance a jihohi da dama a nan gaba. David Bositis, babban mai nazari, ya ce zamanin da fararen fata ke mulki a siyasa yana karewa, kuma harkar siyasa ta mayar da hankali inda fararen fata kaɗai ba za ta yi tasiri ba. Ko da ba a cimma gyara doka kan shige da fice ba a lokacin wa’adin farko na Obama, batun yana da muhimmanci ga jam’iyyun biyu. Andra Gillespie, masanin kimiyyar siyasa, ta ce dokokin shige da fice masu zuwa za su zama jarabawa ga Republicans da kuma Obama wajen hada kai. Zai kasance da tarihin mata guda 20 zasu shiga Majalisar Dattawa, ciki har da Tammy Baldwin (ta farko wadda take bayyana kanta budurwar mace), Mazie Hirono (Hawaii), da Debbie Fischer (Nebraska), da sauransu. Wakilan New Hampshire a Congress duka mata ne. Jennifer Lawless daga jami'ar American ta ce dabarun da suka sa jam'iyya ta samu kuri'un mata ba lallai su canza matsayin mata a dokoki ba. Kananan dokoki sun nuna cigaba da sabani: Maryland da Maine sun amince da aure tsakanin jinsi guda; Maryland ta amince da daliban da ba su da takardun zama su biya kudin makaranta kamar 'yan kasa; Montana ta dakatar da ayyukan gwamnati ga wadanda ba su da takardar zama da kuma bukatar sanar da iyaye kafin matasa 'yan kasa da shekaru 16 su nemi zubar da ciki. Florida ta ƙi rage wa ma'aikatan jihar inshora ta zubar da ciki. Rob 'Biko' Baker, daraktan League of Young Voters, yana ganin batu kamar shige da fice, yanayi da 'yancin aure na matasa, da inganta shari'a game da matasa za su ci gaba da zama jigogi a siyasa nan gaba. A cewarsa, matasa suna matukar neman karin bayani kan sauyin yanayi da 'yancin aure. Yana ba da shawara ga shugabannin siyasa su kara hada wadannan batutuwa da samar da ayyuka. Mendez ya kara samun kwarin guiwa bayan taron Colorado Hispanic Republicans. Tsohon dan Democrat ne da ya koma Republican saboda ra'ayinsa a kan abubuwa kamar zubar da ciki, makamai da haraji. Yana fatan wasu za su bude ido su ba Republican dama. 'Kwanaki biyu da suka wuce, na dan ji bakin ciki game da zabe,' in ji shi. 'Amma yanzu na samu sauki. Ba sai mun canza komai ba, mu fara da karami.'

article_content: The planned acquisition of Fincare Small Finance Bank by AU Small Finance Bank is currently awaiting regulatory approval. Industry leaders anticipate that other small finance banks, especially those operating for less than a decade, may also seek mergers—either with competitors, non-bank lenders, or fintech companies—to achieve faster growth and diversify their products. AU Small Finance Bank’s proposed acquisition of Fincare could inspire additional mergers within the sector, as larger balance sheets would strengthen these banks’ ability to compete, particularly in attracting public deposits. Fincare’s Managing Director, Rajiv Yadav, noted that this is a rare 'good bank-good bank' merger in the banking sector, and the first of its kind among small finance banks. He expects more banks to explore similar strategic options. Mergers and acquisitions are gaining momentum in the small finance banking space. Recently, fintech company Slice acquired North East Small Finance Bank, signaling both regulatory comfort and new opportunities for consolidation. For AU Small Finance Bank, acquiring Fincare would grant entry into the microfinance segment and a stronger presence in southern India, where it currently holds just 2% of its branches. Suryoday Small Finance Bank’s Managing Director, R. Baskar Babu, stated that such mergers are based on opportunities and strategic fit. Larger balance sheets help small finance banks qualify for universal bank licenses, offering greater flexibility in capital allocation and lending. However, merely meeting the minimum operational years does not guarantee the size, scale, or service quality required for such a license, according to Yadav. Data from Crisil show that assets under management for small finance banks grew at a 29% compound annual rate between FY18 and FY23. Although past rumors of a merger between Clix Capital and Suryoday Small Finance Bank were denied, Suryoday’s management continues to look for strategic opportunities. Most small finance banks were created to provide financial services to unserved or underserved populations, with eight out of the twelve current SFBs in India having roots in microfinance. Rajiv Yadav emphasizes that the sector offers room for many small finance banks to thrive, particularly in the underbanked market. In his view, successful mergers depend on strategy and the benefits they bring, rather than simply aiming for larger numbers. Separately, the Income Tax Department in India is investigating the local units of Apple, Google, and Amazon over possible tax non-compliance related to transfer pricing practices. These investigations began in 2021 and involve detailed information requests from the companies. Additionally, Indians have become the largest group of investors in Dubai’s real estate market, influencing the city’s property landscape. Digital payments firm Razorpay is considering moving its parent company to India via cross-country merger, which may result in a US tax outlay of $250–300 million. article_content: In the highly competitive tech industry, demand for machine learning (ML) engineers is at an all-time high. However, hiring top ML talent is only the first step. To fully leverage their expertise and maintain long-term commitment, organizations must implement effective retention strategies. This article outlines how to develop and apply these strategies to support the career growth and satisfaction of ML engineers while highlighting their vital contributions. ML developers are central to unlocking machine learning’s transformative power for organizations. They design and maintain ML models that turn data into actionable insights, leading to smarter decisions, streamlined operations, better customer experiences, and innovation across fields. ML engineers possess specialized skills in mathematics, statistics, programming, and domain knowledge. They build ML pipelines, choose appropriate algorithms, optimize model performance, and ensure systems are scalable and efficient. Their insights help businesses gain a competitive edge in a fast-changing market. Hiring ML developers is important, but keeping them poses unique challenges. As machine learning is a dynamic field, continuous learning and professional growth are essential. ML engineers thrive on solving new problems and working on advanced projects. To retain them, organizations should focus on career advancement and creating an environment that encourages growth and innovation. Without these, companies risk losing engineers to competitors offering better development opportunities. Career development is crucial for retaining ML engineers, who are passionate about solving complex challenges and staying current with technology. Organizations should: - Define clear career paths, outlining roles like ML researcher, data scientist, or AI architect, and the skills and steps needed for advancement. - Invest in continuous learning by supporting conferences, workshops, online courses, and access to important resources, and encouraging further education. - Pair junior engineers with experienced mentors to guide technical and career growth, supporting their progress through regular meetings. - Recognize and celebrate achievements, offer competitive compensation, and reward successful projects or innovative solutions. - Empower engineers by giving them ownership of projects and opportunities to lead initiatives aligned with their expertise. - Foster a collaborative, inclusive culture that promotes knowledge sharing and cross-team collaboration, encouraging creativity and problem solving. - Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and set joint goals to support continuous career development. In summary, hiring ML developers is just the starting point. Organizations should prioritize professional development, mentoring, recognition, and a positive work culture to retain them. Effective retention strategies nurture ML engineers’ skills and support the long-term success and innovation of data-driven projects. As ML engineers continue shaping the future of technology, investing in their growth secures an organization’s future. Featured Image Credit: Provided by the Author.

Wannan makala na bayyana yadda za a ƙirƙira da amfani da waɗannan dabarun don tallafa ci gaban aiki da gamsuwar injiniyoyin ML, tare da haskaka muhimmancinsu ga kamfani. Masu ML sune ginshikin amfani da ƙarfin koyon na'ura ga kamfanoni. Suna ƙirƙira da kula da samfuran ML da ke rikida bayanai zuwa fahimta mai amfani, wanda ke kawo yanke shawara mafi kyau, inganta aiki, faranta ran kwastomomi, da kirkira a fannoni daban-daban. Injiniyoyin ML suna da ƙwarewa ta musamman a lissafi, kididdiga, shirin kwamfuta, da ilimin fannin su. Suna gina bututun ML, zaɓar manhajoji masu dacewa, inganta samfura, da tabbatar da cewa tsarin yana da ƙarfi da aiki. Hanyoyin da suka samar na taimaka wa kamfanoni yin gasa a kasuwa mai canzawa sosai. Daukar injiniyoyin ML abu ne mai muhimmanci, amma riƙe su na da nasu ƙalubale. Tunda koyon na'ura fage ne mai saurin sauyi, ci gaba da koyo da haɓaka ilimi suna da tasiri sosai. Injiniyoyin ML suna son warware sabbin matsaloli da aiki kan manyan ayyuka. Don riƙe su, kamfani ya kamata ya mayar da hankali kan ci gaban aiki da samar da muhallin ci gaba da kirkira. Idan ba a yin haka, kamfanoni na fuskantar haɗarin rasa injiniyoyin su zuwa masu fafatawa da ke ba da damar bunkasa. Ci gaban aiki na da matuƙar muhimmanci ga riƙe injiniyoyin ML, waɗanda ke da sha'awar magance matsaloli da zama a gaba-gaba a fasaha. Kamfanoni su: - Fitar da matakan ci gaban aiki, suna bayyana matsayin injiniya mai bincike, masanin bayanai, ko mai tsara AI, da irin ƙwarewa ko matakan da ake buƙata. - Zuba jari a koyo mai dorewa ta hanyar tallafawa shiga taruka, horo, karatu ta yanar gizo, da samar da kayan karatu, tare da ƙarfafa zuwa karin karatu. - Haɗa matasa da gogaggun injiniyoyi don ra'ayi da shawarwari game da aiki, da tallafa musu wajen ci gaba da koyon aiki. - Gane da murnar nasarori, bayar da lada da albashi mai inganci ga ayyuka masu nagarta ko mafita masu kyau. - Ba da dama ga injiniyoyin ML su riƙe aikinsu a hannu da jagorantar ayyukan da suka fi ƙwarewa a kai. - Gina ƙungiya mai haɗin kai da bambance-bambancen ra'ayi don inganta musayar ilimi da kirkira. - Yin bita na aiki akai-akai, ba da tambihai masu amfani da saita burin ci gaba. A takaice, ɗaukar injiniyoyin ML kawai fara ne. Kamfanoni su fifita ci gaban aiki, taimakawa, jinjinawa, da gina yanayi mai kyau don riƙe su. Kyakkyawan dabara tana taimakawa injiniyoyin ML gina ƙwarewar su da taimakawa nasara da kirkira a ayyukan kamfani. Europe is bracing for its second winter under the shadow of the Ukraine war and after Russia reduced gas supplies, causing last year's energy prices to skyrocket and doubling household bills. In response, the EU Commission unveiled a suite of reforms this March to boost renewables, shield consumers, and enhance industrial competitiveness.

Central to the EU's energy debate is whether to include nuclear power in contracts for difference (CFDs)—mechanisms that assure stable prices for electricity generators and stimulate renewable investments. France, which operates 56 nuclear reactors, advocates for nuclear energy’s inclusion, hoping to leverage its affordable nuclear power. Germany fears this would favor French industry and wants CFDs limited to new projects only.

These opposing views are at the fore as French and German leaders hold talks ahead of a pivotal European energy ministers’ meeting set for 17 October in Luxembourg. President Macron has pledged to control electricity pricing in France and across the EU and even hinted at returning to a national energy pricing model. Despite tensions, Macron says he’s optimistic about reaching consensus with Germany.

France’s allies in this dispute include Hungary, the Czech Republic, and Poland, while Germany’s position is supported by Austria, Luxembourg, Belgium, and Italy. These rifts reflect greater divisions over grid expansion and the future of EU electricity markets: Germany champions extensive grid upgrades to import energy, while France favors national energy independence and using nuclear for clean hydrogen, a step Germany resists.

Intensifying these talks is the United States’ Inflation Reduction Act, which is spurring a surge in green technology investment in America. French Energy Minister Agnès Pannier-Runacher stresses that Europe needs a decisive response within weeks to match the US’s aggressive approach.

Schools educating students who have been permanently excluded from mainstream education are under increasing pressure due to rising exclusion rates. In Surrey, permanent exclusions rose by 81%, from 59 in 2018-19 to 107 in 2021-22. The head of three Pupil Referral Units (PRUs)—institutions that support excluded and suspended pupils—said demand for their services has increased since the pandemic. The government maintains that suspensions and permanent exclusions should be used where necessary.

Amy Smith, director of education at the Inclusive Education Trust, says that the need for these services is at an all-time high. She notes there is inadequate support for young people, especially those with challenging behaviour.

One parent, Jodie, explained that her 10-year-old son is now taught at Wey Valley College in Guildford after being expelled from his primary school, with a combination of hormones, ADHD, and age affecting his behaviour. She described the expulsion as heartbreaking, but said her son’s experience at the PRU has been “ten times better,” thanks to smaller classes and shorter lessons that are better suited for him.

A 14-year-old PRU student said that the teachers understand and support him, which was lacking in mainstream schools. He now feels welcomed and hopeful for his future.

Smith, who is also vice president of PRUsAP (an organization representing PRUs and alternative provision providers), pointed out a shortage of places. She highlighted the need for national discussions on commissioning and supporting mainstream schools, emphasizing that these improvements depend on funding.

A spokesperson for the Department for Education said that suspensions and permanent exclusions could be justified to ensure safe and calm learning environments. The government’s SEND and Alternative Provision improvement plan presents a national vision for alternative provision, working with mainstream schools to provide early intervention and reduce unnecessary exclusions. The government has committed £2.6 billion to create thousands of new places for children with special educational needs and disabilities.

article_content: Two NHS nurses and a healthcare worker were dismissed after sharing inappropriate content about patients and posting unprofessional photographs of themselves while on duty. The staff members—Julie Dyde and Rachel Keys from Calderdale and Huddersfield NHS Trust, and Caroline Luxford-Noyes from Maidstone and Tunbridge Wells NHS Trust—posted tweets containing crude jokes about patients and described being hungover at work. One nurse uploaded a photo of herself wearing hospital incontinence pads over her uniform, while another commented about access to hospital medication. The tweets included insensitive remarks about patients' medical conditions and personal habits, which were visible to thousands of followers. Photographs showed staff posing in uniforms, trying on medical supplies, and making light of their responsibilities. Both Trusts conducted investigations and concluded that the actions of the three staff members violated professional standards and the organization's social media policy. As a result, all three were dismissed. NHS Trust officials expressed their disappointment and emphasized their commitment to high standards of patient care.

article_content: The Rolling Stones have returned with their latest album, Hackney Diamonds, delighting fans and critics alike. Launched to widespread acclaim, the album achieved significant commercial success globally. In the United States, Hackney Diamonds debuted at No. 3 on this week's Billboard 200, a chart that tracks the most-consumed albums each week. This milestone extends The Rolling Stones' record as the act with the most top 10 albums on the Billboard 200, now totaling 38. Their closest competitor, Barbra Streisand, has 34 top 10 albums, while The Beatles and Frank Sinatra each have 32. Hackney Diamonds opened with 101,000 equivalent album units in its first week, including 94,000 in pure album sales. The album's debut trails only Blink-182’s new release, One More Time, at No. 1, and Drake’s For All The Dogs, which ranked second. Despite not capturing the No. 1 spot, Hackney Diamonds stands out as a major commercial and critical success for The Rolling Stones.

Politics in Nigeria is often portrayed as a call to service, but in practice, it is widely regarded as a means for personal enrichment. Fiercely contested elections demonstrate the ‘winner-takes-all’ mentality, leaving losing candidates with nothing regardless of how much they invested.

Nigerian officials, both elected and appointed, enjoy substantial state-sponsored privileges such as luxury vehicles, official residences with domestic staff, and state-funded medical care for themselves and their families. Spending details for high-profile figures—including former President Muhammadu Buhari’s overseas medical trips and healthcare for Ondo State Governor Oluwarotimi Akeredolu—are often undisclosed.

Recently, Funsho Doherty, the 2023 Lagos Action Democratic Congress governorship candidate, wrote an open letter to Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu questioning public procurement. Highlights included N440.75 million for a bullet-proof Lexus LX 600, N2.02 billion for office supplies, N7.48 million for liquid fragrance in the governor’s office, N152 million for water supply at the Oba of Lagos’s residence, N581 million for renovating a church, and N400 million for charter plane expenses. Further, generous allocations for consultancy services and events were mentioned, totaling billions of naira. Additional reports cited N73.1 million spent on President Tinubu’s portrait and N44.8 million on vegetation clearing.

Other states have similar patterns. Oyo State reported N43.5 million spent on 55 fire extinguishers, and Benue State Governor Hyacinth Alia allocated more than N2 billion for official vehicles, with over N40 billion in questionable expenses over five months. Former Lagos Governor Babatunde Fashola once spent N78.3 million on a website upgrade and N139 million on two boreholes, according to reports.

Nigeria faces significant public debt: by June 2023, Lagos reportedly owed N996 billion in domestic debt and $1.26 billion in external debt, representing a large share of Nigeria’s subnational debt. Overall public debt reached N87.38 trillion by mid-2023, a 75% increase from the previous quarter.

Extravagant government spending continues, including N5 billion for a presidential yacht, billions for renovations of official residences, vehicle purchases, and office complexes. The National Assembly budgeted over N40 billion for new cars and nearly N70 billion for complex renovations.

At the same time, approximately 133 million Nigerians live in multidimensional poverty, with youth unemployment near 40%. Many states provide lifetime pensions to ex-governors and deputies. This ongoing disconnect between high government spending and public hardship has led to increased public skepticism about the purpose of politics in Nigeria and underlined the urgent need to reduce the cost of governance.

Ana yawan kiran siyasa a Najeriya a matsayin aikin hidima ga jama’a, amma a gaskiya, mutane da dama na ganin ta a matsayin hanyar tara dukiya. Zaɓukan siyasa a Najeriya suna da tsananin gogayya inda duk wanda bai lashe ba ke rasa komai, ko da da nawa ya kashe.

Shugabannin gwamnati na jin daɗin motocin alfarma, gidajen gwamnati da ma’aikata, da kuma kula da lafiyar su da iyalansu a kan kuɗin gwamnati. Sau da yawa ba a bayyana irin kuɗin da aka kashe wajen kula da lafiyar manyan shugabanni irin su tsohon Shugaban Kasa Muhammadu Buhari da kuma Gwamnan Ondo Oluwarotimi Akeredolu ba.

Kwanan nan, Funsho Doherty, ɗan takarar gwamna a jam’iyyar ADC a Legas na 2023, ya rubuta wasika budaddiya ga Gwamna Babajide Sanwo-Olu yana tambaya game da sayayyar gwamnati. Wasikar ta nuna an kashe N440.75m kan Lexus mai ƙyamar harbi, N2.02bn kan kayan ofis, N7.48m kan turare a ofishin gwamna, N152m don dawo da ruwa gidan Oba na Legas, N581m don gyara coci, da N400m kan haya jirgin sama. Hakanan, wasu shawarwari da taruka sun cin kudade masu yawa, har biliyoyin naira. Daily Trust ta ruwaito an kashe N73.1m kan hoto na Tinubu da N44.8m don cire ciyawa a Epe.

Haka ma a wasu jihohi. Oyo ta kashe N43.5m kan extinguishers 55, Gwamna Benue Hyacinth Alia ya ware fiye da N2bn don motocin gwamnati, inda jimillar kashe kudin da ake cece-kuce akai a cikin wata biyar ya kai N40bn. Tsohon gwamnan Legas Babatunde Fashola ya taba kashe N78.3m wajen sabunta shafin yanar sadarwa, da N139m kan rijiyoyi, inji rahotanni.

Najeriya na ci gaba da tatsar bashi: Zuwa karshen Yuni 2023, Legas ya ke da bashin cikin gida N996bn da $1.26bn na bashi daga waje. Bashi gaba daya ya kai N87.38tn, karuwar kashi 75% cikin wata uku.

Jabrin kashe kudaden gwamnati yana ci gaba, ciki har da N5bn don jirgin ruwa na shugaban kasa, biliyoyin naira don gyaran gidajen gwamnati, motoci, da manyan gine-gine. Majalisar dokoki ta tanadi sama da N40bn don motoci da kusan N70bn ga gyaran majalisa.

A gefe guda, kusan mutane miliyan 133 na rayuwa cikin talauci, da rashin aikin yi ga matasa ya kai kusan kashi arba’in. Jihohi da dama suna biyan tsofaffin gwamna da mataimakansu fansho har shekaru masu yawa. Wannan rata tsakanin irin kashe kudin gwamnati da wahalar talakawa ya sa mutane sun rage ganin alheri a siyasa a Najeriya, kuma yana nuna bukatar rage nauyin kashe-kashen gwamnati.

article_content: MoveOn.org, one of the largest liberal grassroots organizations in the United States with 8 million members, is preparing to launch a $1 million campaign to persuade Senator Elizabeth Warren to run for president in 2016. Although Senator Warren has consistently stated she is not running, many liberal activists remain hopeful she will change her mind. The campaign will be presented to MoveOn members for a vote, and due to Warren's popularity among progressives, approval is widely expected. MoveOn's plan includes opening offices and hiring staff in the key early states of Iowa and New Hampshire, and organizing a national volunteer network in case Warren decides to enter the race. If the campaign is approved, MoveOn will also produce advertisements and media highlighting Warren's advocacy for the middle class and her vision for the country's future. Ilya Sheyman, executive director of MoveOn.org Political Action, emphasized that strong candidates are essential for the Democratic debate and expressed readiness to show Warren she has widespread support. Despite ongoing excitement, Warren’s press secretary, Lacey J. Rose, reiterated that the Senator is not running for president. Historically, some candidates have changed their stance about running, so activists remain persistent. Anna Galland, the executive director of MoveOn.org Civic Action, described this effort as an opportunity for members to inspire Warren. Some observers view MoveOn's move as both support for Warren and a challenge to Hillary Clinton, the leading Democratic contender who hasn’t always resonated with liberal activists. While national polls, such as a July CNN/ORC International survey, indicate that most liberals support Clinton, Warren is significantly more popular among members of liberal groups. A November Democracy for America poll showed Warren garnering 42% support among its members, ahead of Bernie Sanders and Clinton. Democracy for America is also considering joining the effort to draft Warren. Charles Chamberlain, DFA’s executive director, released a statement emphasizing the importance of Warren’s voice in the 2016 Democratic debate, despite reservations from political consultants.

Ko da yake Sanata Warren ta sha nanatawa ba za ta tsaya takara ba, 'yan gurguzu da dama na fatan ta canza ra'ayi. Za a gabatar da shirin kamfen din ga mambobin MoveOn domin kada kuri'a, kuma saboda farin jinin Warren a wajen masu ra'ayin gurguzu, ana sa ran za a amince. Tsarin MoveOn na hada bude ofisoshi da daukar ma'aikata a jahohin Iowa da New Hampshire, da kuma samar da cibiyar masu sa kai na kasa baki daya idan Warren ta yanke shawarar tsayawa takara. Idan an amince da kamfen din, MoveOn za ta fara fitar da tallace-tallace da kayan yada labarai da ke nuna yadda Warren ke kare matsakaitan mutane da burinta na makomar kasar. Ilya Sheyman, darakta mai kula da MoveOn.org Political Action, ya ce muhimmanci ne a samu 'yan takara masu karfi a dandalin jam’iyyar Dimokradiyya, kuma suna shirye su tabbatar da Warren na da goyon baya. Duk da wannan sabon shiri, mai magana da yawun Warren, Lacey J. Rose, ta jaddada cewa Sanatar ba za ta tsaya takara ba. A tarihi, wasu 'yan takara sun sauya matsayinsu kan tsayawa takara, dalilin da ya sa masu kamfen suka ci gaba da dagewa. Anna Galland, daraktar MoveOn.org Civic Action, ta bayyana wannan yunkuri a matsayin dama ga mambobi su shawarci Warren kamar yadda ita ta zaburar da su. Wasu na kallon wannan yunkuri a matsayin goyon baya ga Warren da kuma kalubale ga Hillary Clinton, wadda ke kan gaba a jerin 'yan takarar Dimokradiyya amma ba ta samu karbuwa daga 'yan gurguzu duka ba. Alkaluman jin ra'ayi na kasa, irin su na CNN/ORC International na watan Yuli, sun nuna cewa mafi yawan 'yan ra’ayin gurguzu na goyon bayan Clinton; sai dai Warren ta fi dacewa a tsakanin mambobin kungiyoyin gurguzu. A wata kuri’ar Democracy for America da aka gudanar a watan Nuwamba, Warren ta samu kashi 42% na goyon bayan mambobi, fiye da Bernie Sanders da Clinton. Kungiyar Democracy for America ma na la’akarin shiga cikin shirin neman Warren ta tsaya takara. Charles Chamberlain, darakta na DFA, ya fitar da sanarwa yana bayyana muhimmancin sauraron muryar Warren a muhawarar shugaban kasa ta 2016, duk da shakku daga masu ba da shawara na siyasa.

article_content: At the Collegiate Institute for Math and Science in the Bronx, Principal Shadia Alvarez used an unusual method to motivate her students—she announced that the senior prom would be canceled unless every senior worked hard to graduate. This followed a period when teachers observed students’ grades starting to slip, and wanted to encourage greater academic effort. This policy sparked a mix of anger and concern among the senior class. Although a few students doubted the principal’s seriousness, most responded by boosting their efforts. Principal Alvarez later clarified that her goal was to see students trying their best, saying prom would only be canceled if there was no effort from the class. The approach turned out to be effective. Students’ grades improved, motivation rebounded, and a new announcement eventually confirmed that prom was back on. Seniors such as Jose Abreu said the scare tactic encouraged them to focus more, and many now acknowledge that it helped them get back on track before graduation. The school is outperforming other schools in the city, projected to reach a 90% graduation rate—well above the typical New York City average of 66%. For seniors, prom represents an important milestone, and the possibility of its cancellation drove students to work harder. Student Lala-Marie Perez noted that the wake-up call made them realize they could achieve more, and now they’re excited to celebrate both their academic and personal accomplishments at prom.
