Wannan matakin ya biyo bayan lura da malamai sun ga cewa sakamakon ɗalibai na ƙasa, don haka ana bukatar ƙarfafa su su fi himma. Wannan sanarwar ta haifar da ruɗani da damuwa a tsakanin ‘yan aji na ƙarshe. Duk da cewa wasu ɗalibai sun zaci shugabar ba za ta aiwatar da barazanar ba, mafi yawansu sun ƙara himma sosai. Shugabar Alvarez ta ba da tabbaci daga baya cewa manufarta ita ce ganin kowa na ƙoƙari, kuma za a soke prom ne kawai idan babu ƙoƙari gaba ɗaya daga ɗalibai. Dabarar ta samu nasara. Sakamako ya tashi, ɗalibai sun ƙara sa’a, kuma daga bisani an fitar da wata sabuwar sanarwa cewa an dawo da prom. Wasu irin su Jose Abreu sun bayyana cewa wannan gargadi ne ya dawo da su kan hanya, kuma da dama sun gamsu cewa hakan ya taimaka musu kafin kammala makaranta. Makarantar ta na gudanarwa fiye da sauran makarantu a yankin, ana hasashen za ta kai kashi 90% na yawan masu kammala karatu – sama da matsakaitan kashi 66% na birnin New York. Ga ‘yan aji na ƙarshe, biki na prom babbar dama ce, kuma barazanar rasa yin sa ya zaburar da su su ƙara aiki tukuru. Casey Sanders, while hunting near his Chattahoochee Hills, Georgia home last week, experienced his most unexpected encounter yet. As he tracked deer in the woods, a shout caught his attention. Sanders soon found a disoriented, naked young man stranded by a creek. Wary, Sanders announced that he was armed and began recording the event for his own protection.

Sanders quickly learned the man had attended TomorrowWorld, a massive electronic music festival staged nearby, which had ended four days prior. The festival had drawn headliners such as Tiesto, Avicii, David Guetta, and Skrillex to perform for around 120,000 attendees on an expansive 500-acre venue from September 26 to 28.

Still clearly shaken and confused, the man claimed he had been attacked, drugged, and abandoned in the woods by three men after leaving the festival. According to Sanders’ video, the man alleged, "Three guys beat me up, dragged me somewhere, took my clothes, and left me out here." He explained that he survived for days by staying close to a creek for water.

From a distance, Sanders questioned the man, who could only recall being from Atlanta—about an hour away—but could not remember his address. The man, whose name was not revealed, pleaded not to contact law enforcement. After a few moments, Sanders stopped filming and focused on helping him.

Later, Sanders explained online that he had spent an hour assisting the man out of the forest. Using Sanders’ phone, the man called someone to come pick him up from a main road. Sanders wrote that while he had been cautious at first, he ultimately ensured the man’s safety. The stranded individual's identity still remains publicly unknown, and it is not clear if he was reported missing after the festival ended.

TomorrowWorld, inspired by the Belgian music festival Tomorrowland, is recognized as one of the United States’ largest 21-plus music festivals. The 2014 event in Chattahoochee Hills featured eight stages and enormous crowds, cementing its place among major global music gatherings.
translated_content:
A makon da ya wuce, wani mai farauta mai suna Casey Sanders yana cikin dajin kusa da gidansa a Chattahoochee Hills, Georgia, sai ya gamu da abun da bai taɓa fuskanta ba. Yana binciken namun daji ne lokacin da ya ji an yi ihu, ya kuma gani wani matashi tsirara — yana rikice a bakin kogi. Sanders cikin shakku da kula da kare kansa, ya sanar da matashin cewa yana da bindiga sannan ya fara daukar bidiyo.

Da sauri Sanders ya gano cewa matashin ya kasance a bikin waka na TomorrowWorld da aka shirya a kusa da wajen, wanda aka kammala kwanaki hudu baya. Wannan babbar bukukuwa ta gayyato manyan mawaka irin su Tiesto, Avicii, David Guetta da Skrillex, inda fiye da mutane 120,000 suka halarta a fili mai girman eka 500 daga 26 zuwa 28 ga Satumba.

Matashin, cikin firgici da rudani, ya ce wasu mutane uku sun kai masa hari a bayan bikin, suka doketa, suka cire masa kaya, suka raba shi da kayan sa, suka bar shi a cikin daji bayan sun masa wani abu (wani mugun abu ko kwaya). Ya bayyana a cikin bidiyon Sanders: "Mutane uku sun doketa, suka ja ni wuri mai nisa, suka cire min kaya, suka bar ni a nan." Ya ce ya rayu ne ta hanyar zama bakin kogi don samun ruwa har kwana da yawa.

Daga nesa, Sanders ya tambayi matashin inda ya fito da ko yana da adireshi, amma bai iya tuna komai ba sai dai cewa daga Atlanta ne — tafiyar awa daya daga wurin. Ya roki Sanders kada ya kira 'yan sanda. Bayan 'yan mintuna, Sanders ya kashe daukar bidiyon don mayar da hankali wajen taimako.

Bayan haka, Sanders ya bayyana a shafin sada zumunta cewa ya dauki kusan sa’a guda yana taimaka wa matashin fita daga daji. Matashin ya iya tuno lambar waya, ya kira wanda zai zo daukarsa daga babban hanya ta amfani da wayar Sanders. Sanders ya kara da cewa ko da yana kama da mai tsoron kanka a farko, daga bisani ya tabbatar da mutumin ya samu lafiya. Ba a san ko wanene matashin ba, kuma babu tabbacin an bayyana shi a matsayin wanda ya bata bayan bikin.

TomorrowWorld, wanda aka samo asali daga bikin Belgium na Tomorrowland, shine daya daga manyan bukukuwa na kiɗa ga masu shekaru 21 da sama a Amurka. A 2014, ya taka gwagwarmaya da manya-manyan mawakan duniya a Chattahoochee Hills, inda dimbin mutane suka halarta, yana kuma kara baje kolinsa a jerin manyan bukukuwa na kiɗa a duniya.

article_content:
HBO's 'Succession,' crafted by Jesse Armstrong, stands out as a sharply satirical look at the power struggles inside the Roy family, who are all vying to control the vast Waystar RoyCo media empire. While fan-favorite episodes like ‘All the Bells Say’ and ‘Connor’s Wedding’ get most of the spotlight, several underrated installments quietly shape the show’s heart—revealing character depth and propelling the story forward.

Take 'Mass in Time of War': Logan Roy, the authoritative patriarch, is at his weakest while stuck in Sarajevo. His children gather at Rava’s apartment, considering a revolt. Kendall tries to rally them to his side, but the group’s resolve crumbles easily—a gesture like their father sending donuts is all it takes to reignite old fears and loyalties, leaving the siblings hesitant to act.

‘The Summer Palace,’ the second season’s opener, shows Kendall wrestling with guilt following a tragic incident. His failed attempt at a corporate takeover sets the stage for Logan swiftly reclaiming dominance, underscoring the family’s persistent power struggles.

In ‘Vaulter,’ the focus turns to online journalism as Roman and Kendall assess a startup that Waystar swallowed up. They ultimately decide to shut it down, laying bare harsh truths about media acquisitions and the fragility of workers’ rights.

Episodes such as ‘Rehearsal’ and ‘Austerlitz’ allow viewers a window into the Roy siblings’ traumatic upbringing. Whether it’s Shiv and Kendall seeking an apology for Logan’s harsh parenting or the siblings participating in therapy at Connor’s ranch, these stories reveal how their painful pasts linger beneath their wealthy exteriors. Roman’s tendency to return to his father, despite the turmoil, also illustrates the deep, unresolved loyalty within the family.

As the show moves to the ‘What It Takes’ episode, the Roys wield their influence at a political summit, aiming to pick a president who will keep Waystar on top. This chapter highlights the real-world parallels of elite families shaping political landscapes behind closed doors.

Though the show’s buzzy dramatic peaks drive much of the conversation around ‘Succession,’ its quieter, often overlooked episodes are essential, shining a spotlight on the Roys' emotional wounds, their Machiavellian business moves, and the steep price of their relentless quests for power.
translated_content:
Shirin HBO mai suna 'Succession' wanda Jesse Armstrong ya kirkira, yana nuna rikicin dangi Roy cikin nishadi da barkwanci yayin da kowa ke kokarin karbe Waystar RoyCo, babban kamfanin labarai da nishadi. Duk da cewa shahararrun bangarori kamar ‘All the Bells Say’ da ‘Connor’s Wedding’ sun jawo hankalin masu kallo, akwai wasu bangarorin da ba a fiye kula da su ba wadanda ke kara zurfin labarin.

Misali, a ‘Mass in Time of War’, uba Logan Roy ya raunana a Sarajevo, yayansa kuma na shirin kifar da shi daga gidan Rava. Kendall ya bukaci su hada kai, amma karfinsu ya ragu bayan da Logan ya aiko musu da donuts, wanda ya tsorata da ruɗar da su, sai suka ja da baya.

A farkon zangon biyu, ‘The Summer Palace,’ Kendall yana cikin kuka da damuwa bayan wani hadari. Rashin nasararsa wajen juyin mulki ya sa Logan ya koma mulki, ya kuma nuna yadda rigima ke ci gaba.

A ‘Vaulter’, an mayar da hankali kan kafar labarai ta yanar gizo yayin da Roman da Kendall suka tantance wani dan karamin kamfani da Waystar ya mallaka. A ƙarshe sun rufe kamfanin, suna nuna ukuba da matsin da irin wadannan ma’aikata ke fuskanta.

Shafuka kamar ‘Rehearsal’ da ‘Austerlitz’ sun ba mu damar fahimtar raunin yayansu. Ko Shiv da Kendall na neman afuwa daga Logan ko zamansu a gonar Connor, wannan ya nuna irin radadin da suke ciki. Roman kuwa har yanzu yana dawowa kusa da mahaifinsa duk da wahala.

A ‘What It Takes,’ dangin Roy sun shiga taron siyasa, suna kokarin zaben shugaban da zai kare muradinsu a Waystar. Wannan bangare ya fito da irin tasirin manyan dangi a siyasa ba tare da an san da hakan ba.

Ko da yake masu kallo sun fi maida hankali kan manyan abubuwan ban mamaki, wadannan bangarori masu nutsuwa suna da muhimmanci, suna fahimtar halin dangi Roy, dabararsu ta kasuwanci da irin wahalar samun iko.
post_content: If you think Succession is just about explosive drama, think again! Some of the show's overlooked episodes quietly serve up family tension, industry takedowns, & political chess moves. It's not always about the Roys fighting—sometimes it's about why they can't let go. #Succession #HiddenGems
translated_post: Idan ka yi tunanin 'Succession' rigima ce kawai, da ka sake tunani! Wasu bangarorin shirin sun fi gano sirrin dangi, rudanin kasuwanci da siyasa. Ba ko yaushe ake fada ba—wani lokaci tsoron barin ikonne ke damunsu. #Succession #LabariMaiZurfi

article_content: Renowned Dutch DJ Armin van Buuren believes artificial intelligence still falls short in capturing the emotional depth that makes music special. Buuren will soon visit India for the 17th Sunburn Arena tour, performing in Bengaluru on October 5, Mumbai on October 6, Kolkata on October 7, and New Delhi. Known for hits such as 'On & On,' 'Blah Blah Blah,' and 'This Is What It Feels Like,' he expressed excitement about playing to Indian audiences and praised the incredible energy he experienced during his recent set at Tomorrowland. Buuren also enjoys Indian cuisine, often seeking out new restaurants when he visits. Although he doesn’t currently listen to Indian music, he’s impressed by the amount of talent in the country and is eager to explore it more. He attributes electronic dance music’s popularity to its constant evolution, which keeps the genre lively for fans. He also recommends Brian Eno’s ambient music, and maintains that while AI can build basic musical pieces, genuine artistry comes from the human heart.
translated_content: Shahararren DJ ɗan Netherlands, Armin van Buuren, ya bayyana cewa fasahar kere-kere ta AI har yanzu ba ta iya kawo zurfin motsin zuciya da ke sa kiɗa ya bambanta ba. Buuren zai ziyarci Indiya don Sunburn Arena karo na 17, inda zai yi wasa a Bengaluru (5 Oktoba), Mumbai (6 Oktoba), Kolkata (7 Oktoba), da New Delhi. Sananne ne da waƙoƙi irin su 'On & On,' 'Blah Blah Blah,' da 'This Is What It Feels Like', kuma ya nuna farin ciki da dawowa tsakanin masoyansa na Indiya, yana yabawa ƙwazo da nishadin da ya gani a bukin Tomorrowland da ya buga kwanan nan. Buuren ya bayyana yadda yake jin daɗin cin abincin Indiya, inda yakan zabi cin a sabbin gidan abinci duk lokacin da ya zuwa kasar. article_content: If Steffon Armitage successfully moves to Bath, both the RFU and coach Stuart Lancaster deserve credit for facilitating this step. Such a move signals that, during this World Cup year, England is determined to pursue victory without leaving any stone unturned. By ensuring every top player is available, the team aims to avoid future regrets if results fall short. Armitage could join England's World Cup squad upon signing with Bath, as the current RFU policy—enforced by Lancaster—excludes players based overseas. It was concerning that Armitage could have been unavailable for England, and might even have played against them with France. Although becoming a starting player will be challenging, Armitage’s high caliber warrants his selection in the squad, adding important competition. Strong internal rivalry elevates performance across the team and requires coaches and selectors to make tough decisions. England’s back row is particularly competitive, with captain Chris Robshaw able to fill multiple roles, and Armitage offering versatility in both the openside and No 8 positions, as he has done for Toulon. Armitage has shown remarkable development while playing for Toulon, where he was named European Cup player of the season. Having started at London Irish, he now seeks a return to the England team. Should Armitage’s transfer be completed promptly, he should be added directly to the senior England squad and begin participating in autumn internationals right away, without delay. If Sam Burgess were available, the same approach would apply—direct and immediate integration. A long-term consideration persists: allowing foreign-based players may create new precedents, but Armitage’s overseas success argues for a flexible approach. Toulon's impact on his growth illustrates the benefits of international experience. Reintegrating Armitage may bring challenges, yet his motivation to vie for a World Cup spot demonstrates the drive needed for England to field its strongest possible team.

article_content:
Joe Hart, Manchester City's goalkeeper, has made it clear that his team intends to fight hard to retain their Premier League crown as they face Liverpool this Sunday. After a disappointing loss to Barcelona in the Champions League, Hart reassures that morale within the squad remains high. With Chelsea leading the table, but busy with the Capital One Cup final, City can close a two-point gap with a win over Liverpool.

Hart, already the winner of two titles with City, is still eager for further success and says the squad is motivated, strong, and full of quality. He notes that while Chelsea is currently favored, the league remains unpredictable. Hart points out the team's collective hunger and spirit: “We’ve proved people wrong before, and we believe in doing it again. Our determination is real, and our belief in one another is strong.”

He speaks openly about dealing with criticism, including losing his starting spot to Willie Caballero earlier in the season, but remains committed to helping the team. Hart also stands by his manager, Manuel Pellegrini, praising his leadership, and believes that both players and manager are determined to achieve more success for the club. Facing the pressure is, according to Hart, simply part of being at a top club like Manchester City.

Chelsea na saman tebur amma suna wasa a gasar Capital One Cup, don haka Manchester City na da damar rage tazarar maki idan suka doke Liverpool.

Hart, wanda ya riga ya lashe ƙofuna biyu tare da City, har yanzu yana da kwarin gwiwar samun ƙarin nasara tare da ‘yan uwansa. Ya yarda da cewa Chelsea na da karfi, amma gasar ta Premier League cike take da sauyi. Hart ya kuma bayyana yadda yake karbar suka da irin matsin lambar da ya fuskanta, har ya rasa matsayinsa ga Willie Caballero a wani lokaci, amma ya ce yana mayar da hankali ga muradinsa na taimakon kungiyar. Ya yaba da kocin su Manuel Pellegrini, yana mai cewa jagorancinsa yana kara musu kwarin gwiwa da burin samun karin nasara. Hart ya jaddada cewa matsin lamba wani bangare ne na kasancewa dan wasa a babbar kungiya kamar Manchester City.

article_content: Footy personality Sam Newman is under scrutiny for defending commentator Brian Taylor after Taylor called Geelong player Harry Taylor a 'big poofter' on air. Newman, who has been involved in several controversial incidents throughout his career, reportedly made his remarks during the 25th anniversary celebrations of The AFL Footy Show, which he hosts. Taylor's comment sparked widespread backlash and calls for his dismissal on social media. However, Newman described the incident as 'harmless.' Newman downplayed the homophobic nature of Brian Taylor's comment about Harry Taylor on Sydney Confidential, saying, 'I know we’ve moved on and I’ve had a lot of those incidents and it’s not acceptable, I understand that, but let’s not become too over the top. There are plenty of other things that people say on different networks and shows that are far worse, but Brian’s a big fish and they like to harpoon him.' Newman has a history of controversial remarks, including pretending to smoke a bong on live TV and calling a Malaysian man a 'monkey.' He also made an alleged homophobic comment in May, criticizing openly gay NFL player Michael Sam for kissing his boyfriend after being drafted to the St Louis Rams, saying, 'It was an annoying, gratuitous act. Kissing your boyfriend ... No heterosexuals do that when they’re drafted.' Meanwhile, radio station 3AW has recommended that Taylor undergo 'quite severe counselling,' although he is expected to return to radio next week. Taylor apologized during the halftime break of the TV coverage and also apologized personally to Harry Taylor. The controversial comment was made while Channel 7’s Saturday Night Footy panel showed footage of Harry Taylor being chaired from the field after his 150th game, during which he made an unusual wave to the crowd. Taylor, a popular player, was celebrating this milestone. Brian Taylor, a former Richmond and Collingwood full-forward, is known for critiquing players who celebrate what he considers 'minor' milestones. Sam Newman maintained his support for Taylor, saying he was a 'big fish and they like to harpoon him.'

article_content:
Over the weekend, professional athletes continued to voice their protest against the grand jury decisions in the Eric Garner and Michael Brown cases by displaying messages on their clothing and shoes. St. Louis Rams wide receiver Kenny Britt honored slain Black teens, including Trayvon Martin and Michael Brown, by writing their names on his game-day shoes Sunday, a gesture he has made before via messages on his wrists. Britt's actions have contributed to a growing trend of athlete activism, as more sports figures demonstrate solidarity with victims of what many consider an unjust legal system.

Many athletes wore 'I Can't Breathe' slogans in reference to Eric Garner's last words before his death in a police chokehold—a case in which a grand jury chose not to indict the officer involved. Among those participating, Chicago Bulls guard Derrick Rose wore a T-shirt with the slogan during warmups, Cleveland Browns cornerback Johnson Bademosi and Detroit Lions running back Reggie Bush warmed up in shirts with the same message, and St. Louis Rams lineman Davin Joseph displayed it on his cleats.

The movement has gained momentum as teams and players use their public platforms to raise awareness about racial injustice and police violence, notably highlighted during a Rams game in which multiple players, including Britt, raised their arms in a gesture referencing the events in Ferguson, Missouri, before kickoff.

Kenny Britt na St. Louis Rams ya girmama matasa bakaken fata da aka kashe, ciki har da Trayvon Martin da Michael Brown, ta rubuta sunayensu a kan takalman wasan da ya saka a ranar Lahadi—abin da ya taba yi a baya ta rubuce-rubuce a kan wuyoyinsa. Abin da Britt ya yi ya kara habaka sabuwar al’adar gwagwarmayar ‘yan wasa, yayin da karin fitattun ‘yan wasa ke nuna goyon baya ga wadanda ake ganin sun fuskanci rashin adalci daga tsarin shari’a.

Wasu daga cikin ‘yan wasan sun saka riga mai dauke da sako mai cewa “I Can’t Breathe” domin tunawa da kalmar karshe ta Eric Garner kafin rasuwarsa a hannun jami’in ‘yan sanda—inda grand jury ta ki gurfanar da jami’in. Daga cikin wadanda suka halarta akwai Derrick Rose na Chicago Bulls wanda ya saka riga da wannan sako a lokacin zafafa jiki, Johnson Bademosi na Cleveland Browns da Reggie Bush na Detroit Lions—duk suna sanye da riga mai irin wannan sako, sannan Davin Joseph na St. Louis Rams ya rubuta sakon a kan takalmansa.

Gwagwarmayar na kara fadada ne yayin da kungiyoyi da ‘yan wasa ke amfani da damarsu wajen jawo hankalin jama’a kan matsalolin rashin adalci da cin zarafin launin fata, musamman lokacin da ‘yan wasan Rams da dama, ciki har da Britt, suka daga hannunsu a matsayin nuni da abin da ya faru a Ferguson, Missouri kafin fara wasan.

article_content: Ann Cooper is on a determined campaign to change how children eat in schools, stating, 'We're harming our kids with food.' She hopes her work transforming school lunch programs will leave a lasting legacy. Cooper cites U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention statistics: half of all Hispanic and African-American children born in 2000, and one-third of Caucasian children, are projected to develop diabetes in their lifetimes—many before finishing college. She attributes this largely to current eating habits, saying it's preventable. A self-proclaimed 'renegade lunch lady' and chef, Cooper pushes back against fast-food and junk-food companies, whom she says profit at the expense of children's health. 'They're making money off our children's health and their future,' she says. Previously a celebrity chef at high-end resorts, cruise ships, hotel chains, and film festivals, Cooper has won several awards and serves on various culinary boards. Despite her success, she wanted to reach more than just the wealthy elite. Cooper and her peers often volunteered their culinary skills to support causes, but she felt food's impermanence left her impact limited. Writing her first book, 'A Woman's Place Is In the Kitchen,' led her to connect with influential women in food advocacy, like Alice Waters and Nora Pouillon. These associations shifted her perspective on food, leading her to write a second book, 'Bitter Harvest,' about food sourcing and politics. Later, she accepted a position at the Ross School in East Hampton, New York, seeing it as a way to impact future generations. Now, as director of nutrition services in Berkeley, California, Cooper has changed the district's lunch program from using 90% frozen, reheated food to 90% fresh meals. Fruit and salads are now available daily. She also integrates healthy eating education into classrooms and oversees cooking and gardening classes, serving students at 17 locations with her team. Cooper has developed a 'meal wheel' to help children nationwide make healthier food choices and hopes her website, Lunch Lessons, will serve as a national model. 'There's only one of me. I can't cover the whole country,' she says, expressing the desire for broader public support and policy focus on children's nutrition. Fran Fifis contributed to this report from CNN's Boston bureau.
translated_content: Ann Cooper ta dauki tsayin daka wajen ganin an canza yadda yara ke cin abinci a makarantu, tana cewa, 'Muna cutar da yarinyanmu da abinci.' Tana fatan aikin da take yi na sauya shirye-shiryen cin abinci a makarantu zai bar tarihi mai kyau. Cooper ta kawo alkaluman Cibiyar Kula da Cututtuka ta Amurka (CDC): rabin yara Hispanik da bakaken fata da aka haifa a 2000, da kashi daya cikin uku na fararen fata, ana hasashen za su kamu da ciwon suga a rayuwarsu, da yawa kafin su gama makarantar gaba da sakandare. Ta alakanta hakan da irin abincin da ake ci yanzu, tana mai cewa yana iya wucewa ba tare da samuwa ba. Cooper, wacce ta bayyana kanta a matsayin 'renegate lunch lady' kuma chef, tana kalubalantar kamfanonin abinci mai sauri da na junk-food da take cewa suna cin riba cikin lafiyar yara. 'Suna samun kudi ne daga lafiyar yarinyanmu da makomarsu,' inji ta. A baya Cooper ta taba zama sananniyar chef a otal-otal masu tsada, jiragen ruwa, manyan gidajen cin abinci, da bukukuwa na fina-finai. Ta samu lambobin yabo da dama kuma tana aiki a kwamitocin girki daban-daban. Duk da nasarorin da ta samu, ta fi son ta taimaka wa jama'a masu yawa ba wai masu kudi kadai ba. Cooper da abokanta sukan tallafa da kwarewarsu ta girki don aikin alheri, amma ta dauka cewa kwanakin abinci ba su cika da tasiri ba. Rubuta littafinta na farko, 'A Woman's Place Is In the Kitchen,' ya sa ta haɗu da wasu mata masu tasiri a fannin kiwon lafiya irin su Alice Waters da Nora Pouillon. Wadannan dangantaka sun canza yadda take kallon harkar abinci, inda har ta rubuta littafi na biyu, 'Bitter Harvest,' game da samuwar abinci da siyasar harkar. Daga bisani ta amince da aiki a Ross School dake East Hampton, New York, ganin hakan zai taimaka wa manyan yara masu tasowa. Yanzu haka Cooper ita ce shugabar sashen abinci mai gina jiki a makarantu na Berkeley, California, inda ta rage amfani da danyen abinci mai daskarewa zuwa 90% abinci sabo. Ana samun 'ya'yan itatuwa da salad kullum yanzu. Haka kuma tana koyar da ilimin cin abinci mai kyau a ajin, tana jagorantar darusan girki da noma, tana hidima wa dalibai a wurare 17 tare da tawagarta. Cooper ta kirkiro da 'meal wheel' don taimakawa yara a fadin kasar su fahimci yadda zasu ci abinci mai kyau, tana fatan shafinta na yanar gizo, Lunch Lessons, zai zama abin koyi ga kasa baki daya. 'Ni kadai ce ba zan iya rufe duk kasar ba,' inji ta, tana nuna fatan samun taimako da mahimmancin mayar da hankali kan lafiyar yara ta fuskar gwamnati. Fran Fifis ta taimaka wajen wannan rahoto daga CNN ofishin Boston.

article_content: During its 'Sustainable with Google' event on October 10, Google unveiled several new projects aimed at addressing climate change on a global scale. This includes expanding Project Green Light, which uses AI to optimize traffic signals. By timing traffic lights more efficiently, the project lets more vehicles pass through successive intersections without stopping, reducing unnecessary acceleration and braking. Early results from 12 cities show a 30% reduction in stops and a 10% decrease in emissions at optimized intersections, impacting around 30 million car journeys each month. Google intends to roll out this solution to more cities soon. Google Maps now offers fuel-efficient routing in India and Indonesia, while in France, the app will soon highlight walking and public transit directions in addition to driving, encouraging more sustainable travel options. Google hopes these features will help more than a billion people worldwide make greener transportation choices. In the energy sector, Google is providing enhanced information on renewable heating and cooling when people search for home solutions. Utility companies, like those in Chile using Project Tapestry, also gain access to new AI-based grid planning tools which help manage the transition from fossil fuels to clean energy despite weather uncertainties. Google is also developing resources to boost communities’ climate resilience. Flood Hub, the company’s flood forecasting platform, now serves the U.S. and Canada, offering advance alerts to over 12 million residents. With the U.S. Forest Service, Google created a state-of-the-art AI system to model wildfire spread, representing the first such leap in technology in decades. Efforts like tree canopy and cool roof mapping are expanding to thousands of urban areas to mitigate heat. Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai underscored Google's ongoing commitment to innovating for a carbon-free future, highlighting the urgent need for accessible climate technology to drive meaningful reductions in global emissions.

Daga ciki akwai faɗaɗa Project Green Light, wanda ke amfani da AI don inganta tsarin fitilun titi. Wannan yana taimaka wa motoci su rika wucewa tituna da dama ba tare da tsayawa ba, don rage dumama injina da hayaƙin da suke fitarwa. Rahotannin farko daga birane 12 sun nuna raguwar tsayawa har kashi 30% da raguwar hayaƙi har kashi 10% a inda aka aiwatar, wanda hakan ke shafar tafiye-tafiye miliyan 30 a wata. Google na shirin faɗaɗa wannan hanya zuwa ƙarin birane a duniya nan gaba kadan. Google Maps yanzu tana ba da sabon zaɓi mai rage amfani da man fetur a ƙasashen India da Indonesia, sannan za a ƙara gabatar da hanyoyin tafiya a ƙafa da na sufuri jama'a a Faransa, domin ganin mutane sun zabi matakai masu kare muhalli. Burin Google shi ne wannan sauyi ya taimaka wa mutane fiye da biliyan daya a duk duniya su zabi hanyoyin tafiye-tafiye masu kyau ga muhalli. A fannin makamashi, Google na samar da ƙarin bayani ga masu neman hanyoyin dumi ko sanyaya gida na makamashi sabuntawa. Kamfanonin wutar lantarki kamar na Chile dake amfani da Project Tapestry suna da kayan aikin AI don saukaka shiryawa da tafiya daga amfani da makamashi mai gurbata kasa zuwa wanda ba shi da illa, komai yanayin tashin hankali na yanayi. Hakanan, Google na taimaka wa al'umma su yaki matsalolin tasirinta — kamar fadada shirin Flood Hub yanzu zuwa Amurka da Canada, tana taimaka wa sama da mutane miliyan 12 da hasashen lokaci kafin ambaliya. Hade da Hukumar Kula da Gandun Daji ta Amurka, Google ta ƙirƙiro sabon tsarin AI don hango yaduwar gobara wanda ya fi kowane nau’i na baya tarin shekaru. An fadada shirin kididdigar bishiyu da tantance rufin gidaje masu rage zafi zuwa dubban birane domin rage matsalar zafi a gari. Shugaban Alphabet, Sundar Pichai, ya jaddada cewa Google za ta ci gaba da ƙirƙirar sabbin fasahohi domin taimaka wa mutane da kungiyoyi rage hayaƙin carbon. article_content: The TrekDesk is a desk designed to fit over a treadmill, allowing users to walk at a slow pace while working. Health guidelines recommend walking 10,000 steps daily to help maintain a healthy weight and reduce risks of heart disease and cancer, but busy schedules make this difficult for many people. An American company has introduced the TrekDesk as a potential solution, enabling individuals to exercise while working. The height-adjustable workstation is intended to help users get regular physical activity, reduce stress, prevent disease, and strengthen muscles. According to the company, working at the TrekDesk could help users reach 10,000 steps in about three hours. The manufacturer also claims that using the desk can boost mood and productivity, referencing studies suggesting that walking while working improves concentration and reduces fatigue. The desk, priced at around £300, fits most treadmills and measures 72 by 34 inches. It includes a manuscript holder for reading and two cup holders. The manufacturer notes that movement on the TrekDesk is not vigorous enough to cause sweating. Recent research found that sitting for extended periods can more than double the risk of developing diabetes, heart disease, or dying prematurely. These risks are elevated even for those who exercise at other times. Professor Stuart Biddle from the University of Loughborough, a contributor to the study published in Diabetologia, suggests office workers should try to stand or move more during the workday. Steve Bordley, CEO of TrekDesk, notes that the product is designed for people who are confined to desk work. He highlights studies supporting the benefits of moving more throughout the day, linking increased activity to better health, productivity, and life satisfaction.

article_content: Whether you love baseball or board games, Harry Potter or heavy metal, Ning offers an online network tailored for you. According to CEO Gina Bianchini, Ning connects people around shared passions. Launched two years ago, the fast-growing, free website lets members build custom social networking platforms focused on their interests. While Facebook and MySpace primarily help people stay in touch with friends and family, Ning gathers users based on common interests. The site hosts a variety of networks, from hip-hop music fans and video gaming moms to teens obsessed with the Twilight franchise. Other popular Ning communities bring together people for political and social causes, like Pickens' Plan, which advocates for wind energy. As of January, Ning attracted 4.7 million unique visitors and surpassed 1 million created social networks—about a fifth of which are considered active. In March, the platform introduced features such as a real-time activity feed, allowing users to see instant updates about what others are doing, similar to Twitter. CNN recently spoke with Gina Bianchini, a Silicon Valley native and former Goldman Sachs analyst, about Ning and the evolution of social networking. CNN: Where did the idea for Ning originate? Bianchini: We began with a simple idea—what if people could create their own social experiences around their unique interests? We built Ning to be customizable and individual for every user. The most powerful ideas are often the simplest. CNN: What is Ning's mission? Bianchini: Our mission is to help people organize and connect around their passions. CNN: Were you inspired by other websites? Bianchini: We were inspired by early web companies like Craigslist and eBay, which focused on connecting people. The Internet offers a unique way for people to connect that traditional media like TV or newspapers cannot match. CNN: Did you expect this approach to be so successful? Bianchini: Social interaction is what people naturally seek online. The rapid growth of social networking shows that clearly. CNN: What are some notable networks on Ning? Bianchini: We currently have around 200,000 active networks covering tens of thousands of interests. These include 'This is 50,' a hip-hop themed community; the 'Pickens' Plan,' organizing over 200,000 people around wind energy; a rapidly growing Indian cricket network; and a Twilight saga network for teens. Interests range widely, from hip-hop to government policy. CNN: To what do you attribute Ning’s growth? Bianchini: Ning’s popularity comes from people’s uniqueness and their desire to express their interests and identity in a community setting. CNN: What distinguishes Ning from other social platforms? Bianchini: Ning enables users to create new social networks based on their passions, connecting people who share those interests. While Facebook connects you with people you already know and Twitter is great for news, Ning is about meeting new people with similar interests. CNN: How can organizations use Ning? Bianchini: Bringing people together for a cause has great potential for fundraising and volunteer organization. CNN: How does Ning generate revenue? Bianchini: Users can pay to add features such as custom domains. The free service is ad-supported, with ads tailored to each network. CNN: What’s your view on the future of social networking? Bianchini: Niche social networking sites are definitely in demand. As people get comfortable with platforms like Facebook and Twitter, they'll seek networks for more specific groups or interests. CNN: What are your future goals for Ning? Bianchini: We’re focused on optimizing our service for people seeking new connections with those who share their interests. Our rapid growth demonstrates increasing demand for these communities.
translated_content: Ko kana son wasan kwallon baseball ko wasan allo, Harry Potter ko kiɗan heavy metal, Ning na da dandalin yanar gizo da ya dace da kai. Shugabar kamfanin Ning, Gina Bianchini, ta ce shafin nasu yana haɗa mutane masu irin abubuwan sha'awa. Shafin, wanda aka ƙaddamar shekaru biyu da suka wuce kuma ke girma da sauri, yana ba da damar gina dandalin sada zumunta na musamman bisa abubuwan da kake so. Yayin da Facebook da MySpace ke taimakawa mutane su ci gaba da hulɗa da abokai da dangi, Ning na haɗa masu amfani bisa sha'awa ɗaya. Shafin yana da nau'ikan dandalai iri-iri—daga masoya kiɗan hip-hop da iyaye mata masu sha'awar wasannin bidiyo zuwa matasa masu sha'awar littafin Twilight. Wasu dandalin Ning na haɗa mutane don Manufofin siyasa da zamantakewa, kamar Pickens' Plan wadda ke goyon bayan samar da makamashin iska. A watan Janairu, Ning ya samu maziyarta na musamman miliyan 4.7 kuma ya haura dandalin miliyan guda da aka kirkira—kimanin kashi (1/5) daga cikinsu ne ke aiki sosai. A watan Maris, shafin ya ƙara sabbin fasali irin su labaran zamani da ke nuna abin da sauran masu amfani ke yi a lokaci-lokaci, kamar na Twitter. CNN ta tattauna da Gina Bianchini, 'yar asalin Silicon Valley kuma tsohuwar ma'aikaciyar Goldman Sachs, kan Ning da cigaban dandalin sada zumunta. CNN: Daga ina aka samo ra'ayin Ning? Bianchini: Mun fara da sauƙin ra'ayi—me zai hana mutane su ƙirƙiri damar zamantakewa bisa abin da suka fi so? Mun gina Ning mai sauƙin daidaitawa da ke ba kowane mutum matsayi na musamman. Mafi ƙarfafa ra’ayoyi galibi sukan zama masu sauƙi. CNN: Mene ne burin Ning? Bianchini: Manufarmu ita ce taimakawa mutane su tsara kansu da haɗuwa bisa abin da suke sha'awa. CNN: Shin akwai wasu shafuka da suka ba ku sha'awa? Bianchini: Mun samu sha'awa daga kamfanonin farko na yanar gizo irinsu Craigslist da eBay, waɗanda suka mayar da hankali kan haɗin kai. Intanet ta fi kowane dandali samar da haɗin kai tsakanin mutane—abinda ba za ka samu a TV ko jaridu ba. CNN: Kun yi tsammanin wannan hanyar zata yi nasara sosai haka? Bianchini: Yin zamantakewa abu ne da mutane ke sha'awa sosai a intanet. Girman sauri na dandalin sada zumunta ya tabbatar da hakan. CNN: Waɗanne daga cikin dandalin Ning ne ke shahara? Bianchini: Muna da kimanin dandali 200,000 masu aiki a fannoni da dama. Wadanda suka shahara sun haɗa da 'This is 50' (dandalin hip-hop); 'Pickens’ Plan' (yankin siyasar makamashin iska da mutane 200,000 suke ciki); wani dandali na wasan cricket na Indiya da ya samu mabiya da yawa cikin ƴan makonni; da kuma na Twilight ga matasa. Sha'awoyi sun bambanta daga kiɗan hip-hop zuwa tattaunawar manufofi. CNN: Menene kuke gani ya sa Ning ke karɓuwa sosai? Bianchini: Saboda mutane na da irin nasu salon da sha’awa da suke son bayyana kansu cikin al'umma. CNN: Me ya bambanta Ning da sauran dandalai? Bianchini: Ning yana ba da damar ƙirƙiro sabbin dandalin sada zumunta bisa sha'awa, yana haɗa mutane masu irin wannan ra'ayi. Facebook na haɗa masu amfani da waɗanda suka sani, Twitter na bada labarai a lokaci guda. Ning kuwa, yana taimakawa mutane su haɗu da sababbin abokai masu abin da suka fi so. CNN: Ta yaya kungiyoyi za su iya amfani da Ning? Bianchini: Idan mutane sun haɗu don dalili guda, akwai damar samun kuɗi da samar da masu sa kai. CNN: Ta yaya Ning ke samun riba? Bianchini: Idan ana so a ƙara fasali irinsu sunan domain, dole a biya a la carte. Amma sabis na kyauta na dauke da tallace-tallace masu dacewa da kowanne dandali. CNN: Me kike gani game da makomar dandalin sada zumunta? Bianchini: Dandalan na musamman suna ku arziki sosai. Yayin da mutane ke sake sabawa da Facebook da Twitter, za su nemi dandalan da suka fi dacewa da ƙungiyarsu ko sha’awa. CNN: Me Ning ke fatan cimmawa a gaba? Bianchini: Mun himmatu wajen inganta sabis ga wadanda ke son haɗuwa da sababbin mutane masu irin sha’awarsu. Girmar da muke gani na nuna bukata da sha'awa na kai.

article_content: On Tuesday, about 70 conservative activists gathered outside the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) headquarters in Washington, DC, for a noon Tea Party protest. They held signs, chanted slogans, and listened to speakers who criticized what they described as unconstitutional treatment by federal tax authorities. Lisa Miller, founder of Tea Party WDC, told reporters, 'Big government is the problem.' She emphasized the need for the government to release all documents showing who ordered increased scrutiny of Tea Party groups, when it occurred, and what President Obama knew about it. Miller’s group organized the rally—one of dozens held nationwide—to highlight what they described as harassment and intimidation by the federal government. The largest event reportedly drew around 250 protesters in Cincinnati, where the IRS office processes nonprofit tax-exempt status applications. The IRS has admitted that some conservative groups were unfairly singled out for additional scrutiny based on their names and political leanings. Protesters displayed a variety of homemade signs, some with pointed political messages. Tea Party activists held President Obama accountable for these 'abuses,' asserting that his administration's tax officials unfairly targeted conservative organizations for their political beliefs. Organizers in Washington led chants of 'Big government! Big problem!' Andrew Langer, president of the Institute for Liberty, addressed the crowd through a megaphone, emphasizing, 'People have rights. Government has power. And when those powers are abused, the people will ultimately reclaim them.' The protest drew participants from several states, including a group of elderly Floridians showing their support for free speech. One anonymous protester wore a mask to symbolize intimidation, and his sign read, 'Don’t audit me, Bro!' After the demonstration, Langer expressed skepticism about President Obama’s claim that he only learned of the IRS’s actions from news reports on May 10, after an Inspector General's report became public. Langer suggested accountability should start at the top and questioned whether the President was either complicit or uninformed. A protester in Revolutionary War attire waved a historical 'Appeal to Heaven' flag, referencing a symbol from the American Revolution and political thought. Department of Homeland Security police monitored the event to maintain order. Other prominent figures mentioned included Jay Carney, the White House spokesperson, and Ron Kirby, a protester from Alexandria, Virginia, who questioned the President’s awareness of events within his administration. Miller stopped short of calling for more firings at the IRS, stating, 'The problem, no matter who is in these jobs, is big government.' Some participants criticized federal spending and the Affordable Care Act, and called for limitations on government and IRS power. Former Americans for Prosperity vice president Phil Kerpen argued that many IRS employees involved should be held accountable but emphasized the importance of reducing IRS authority. Sarah Hall Ingram, former head of the IRS’s tax-exempt division and now overseeing parts of the Affordable Care Act, was also a focus for protesters, who questioned her past bonuses and continued role within the agency. Many attendees expressed support for civil liberties and free speech, sometimes using sarcasm to comment on the police presence and government oversight during the protest. The coordinated demonstrations reflected widespread concern among Tea Party groups over the perceived targeting of conservative organizations by federal officials.

Sun rike takardun sakonni, suna rera taken zanga-zanga, tare da sauraron jawaban da suka soki abin da suka kira tauye musu hakki daga ma’aikatan haraji na gwamnati. Lisa Miller, mai kafa Tea Party WDC, ta shaida wa manema labarai cewa, “Babban gwamnati ce matsala.” Ta bukaci a saki dukkan takardu da ke bayyana wanda ya umarci binciken musamman kan kungiyoyin Tea Party, lokacin da aka yi hakan, da abin da Shugaba Obama ya sani da lamarin. Jama’a dake shirya zanga-zangar sun rera taken “Babban gwamnati! Babban matsala!” Andrew Langer, shugaban Institute for Liberty, ya ce wa taron ta na’urar kara: “Mutane suna da hakki. Gwamnati da iko. Idan aka ci zarafin wannan iko, mutane za su kwato shi.” An samu mahalarta daga wurare daban-daban, ciki har da tsofaffi daga Florida da suka zo goyon bayan 'yancin magana. Langer ya ce a fara ne daga manyan mutane, yana tambaya ko shugaban ya da hannu ko ba a gaya masa ba. Wani mai zanga-zanga yana sanye da kayan yakin juyin juya hali ya daga tutar 'Appeal to Heaven', wata alama daga zamanin juyin-juya hali na Amurka. ‘Yan sanda na bangaren tsaro na cikin gida sun kasance wurin don tabbatar da doka. Wasu wadanda aka ambata sun hada da Jay Carney, kakakin White House, da Ron Kirby daga Alexandria, Virginia, wanda ya tambayi sanin shugaban game da abinda ke faruwa a gwamnati. Miller ta ce ba dole ne a kori karin ma’aikatan IRS ba, inda ta kara da cewa: “Matsalar nan, komai wanda ke gurbin, babban gwamnati ce.” Wasu sun soki kashe kudin gwamnati da shirin Affordable Care Act, suna rokonsu da a rage karfin gwamnati da na IRS. Phil Kerpen, tsohon mataimakin shugaban Americans for Prosperity, ya ce a dauki mataki kan ma’aikatan IRS, amma ya fi mayar da hankali kan rage ikon hukumar. Sarah Hall Ingram, tsohuwar shugabar IRS mai kula da kungiyoyi marasa riba da yanzu ke aiki a cikin shirin Affordable Care Act, ta fuskanci suka daga masu zanga-zanga kan lambar yabo da ci gaba da aiki da aka ba ta. Mafi yawan mahalarta sun nuna goyon baya ga 'yancin magana. Wasu sun yi barkwanci game da tsauraran matakan tsaro da kulawar gwamnati. Zanga-zangar na nuna damuwar kungiyoyin Tea Party game da yadda aka bi su saboda fahimtar siyasa.

article_content: MILAN — Italy announced on Wednesday that it will temporarily suspend its open-border agreement with neighboring Slovenia, citing heightened terrorism concerns in Europe linked to ongoing violence in the Middle East. The government, led by Premier Giorgia Meloni, said that authorities in the Friuli-Venezia Giulia region identified 16,000 people who have crossed into Italy illegally from Slovenia this year. This border is a key stop on the Balkan migrant route into Western Europe. Additionally, Italy has received 140,000 migrants by sea so far this year, an 85% increase compared to 2022. The Interior Ministry’s anti-terrorism committee is currently examining the situation, stating that strengthening border controls is necessary. Italy will reinstate border checks starting October 21 for a period of 10 days. Both Italy and Slovenia are part of the 27-country Schengen Area, the world’s largest free-travel zone.

Gwamnatin da Firayim Minista Giorgia Meloni ke jagoranta ta bayyana cewa hukumomi a yankin Friuli-Venezia Giulia sun gano mutane 16,000 da suka ketaro Italiya ba bisa ka’ida ba ta kan iyakar Slovenia a bana. Wannan iyaka muhimmin wuri ne a hanyar Balkan da bakin haure ke bi zuwa yammacin Turai. Haka kuma, Italiya ta karbi bakin haure 140,000 ta teku a bana, karin kashi 85% idan aka kwatanta da shekarar 2022. Kwamitin yaki da ta’addanci na Ma’aikatar Harkokin Cikin Gida na nazarin halin, yana mai cewa samun karin tsaron iyaka ya zama wajibi. Za a dawo da binciken iyaka daga ranar 21 ga Oktoba na tsawon kwanaki 10. Italiya da Slovenia na cikin kasashe 27 da ke cikin yankin Schengen, mafi girman yankin tafiye-tafiye cikin ‘yanci a duniya.

article_content: The House of Representatives has completed the screening and confirmation of the presidential nominees for the Board and Management of the Niger Delta Development Commission (NDDC). The exercise took place on Thursday before an ad-hoc committee assigned the task. President Bola Tinubu had formally requested the House to ratify the appointments of the NDDC Chairman and Governing Board, in line with Section 2(2) of the Niger Delta Development Commission (Establishment etc.) Act. On August 29, President Tinubu nominated Mr. Chiedu Ebie as board chairman, alongside 16 others for various roles. During the screening, the Chairman of the House Committee on NDDC, Erhiatake Ibori-Suenu, encouraged the nominees to prove themselves worthy of the trust placed in them by the President. She emphasized the need for visionary leaders with integrity at this critical time to fulfill the commission's mandate and improve the lives of people in the Niger Delta. Both Mr. Chiedu Ebie and Dr. Samuel Ogbuku (the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer designate) presented their professional backgrounds and vision for the commission. The Deputy Minority Leader, Ali Isa, moved a motion for the nominees to be confirmed, noting that the Senate had previously conducted a similar screening and that some of the appointees are former parliamentarians. The motion was seconded by Deputy Leader Abdullahi Ibrahim Halims and adopted unanimously. Following this, the National Assembly is expected to promptly send its resolution to the Presidency, fulfilling Section 2(2)(a) of the NDDC Act, which requires both Senate and House confirmation for these appointments. Confirmed as members of the Board and Management are: Mr. Chiedu Ebie (Chairman, Delta State); Dr. Samuel Ogbuku (Managing Director/CEO, Bayelsa); Mr. Boma Iyaye (Executive Director, Finance & Admin, Rivers); Mr. Victor Antai (Executive Director, Projects, Akwa Ibom); Otito Atikase (Executive Director, Corporate Services, Ondo); Dimaro Denyanbofa (State Representative, Bayelsa); Mr. Abasi Nkono (State Representative, Akwa Ibom); Monday Igbuya (State Representative, Delta); Tony Okocha (State Representative, Rivers); Patrick Aisowieren (State Representative, Edo); Mr. Kyrian Uchegbu (State Representative, Imo); Victor Akinjo (State Representative, Ondo); Dimgba Eruba (State Representative, Abia); Orok Otu Duke (State Representative, Cross River); Nick Wende (Zonal Representative, North Central); Namdas Abdulrazak (Zonal Representative, North East); Dr. Ibrahim Abdullahi Gobir (Zonal Representative, North West). House Leader Prof. Julius Inhovbere tasked the appointees with steering the commission to fairness and justice across all communities, reminding them to respect the constitution and act with integrity. He underscored that Nigerians expect results, and the board members owe a duty to everyone to perform well.

article_content: At White Post Farm in Farnsfield, Nottinghamshire, Jemima the goat has given birth to four kids—a rare event since goats usually have twins. The playful young goats have been named Harry, Ron, Neville, and Hermione after the beloved Harry Potter characters, reflecting their mischievous behavior that has brought them local fame. The birth took place just before 11am on Sunday, October 6, 2013. Farm manager Anthony Moore, 32, recounted how surprised the staff was when Jemima, who is five years old, delivered a fourth kid. While triplets occasionally occur, this is the farm’s first set of quadruplets. "We’ve had triplets before, but never quads," Moore explained, noting their excitement when they realized another kid was coming. "Everyone is doing well—the kids are full of energy, hopping around and playing." Inspired by the kids’ playful natures, the staff chose names from Harry Potter. Jemima and her four kids, along with their five-year-old father Dave, will stay together at White Post Farm and are quickly becoming star attractions among visitors. Jemima, Dave, and two other pregnant female goats arrived at the farm a few weeks earlier. While Jemima appeared larger than the other goats, the staff didn’t expect quadruplets. Her delivery was smooth, requiring no help, and she’s proven to be a devoted mother. All four youngsters are healthy and similar in size. The family is housed in a large barn to accommodate the many guests eager to see the newest members of the farm.

An sanya wa ‘ya’yan suna Harry, Ron, Neville, da Hermione saboda yanda suke da kawaici da wasa, lamarin da ya sa suka zama sanannun a wajen gonar. An haife su ne kafin karfe 11 na safe a ranar Lahadi, 6 ga Oktoba, 2013. Manajan gonar, Anthony Moore, mai shekaru 32, ya bayyana yadda ma’aikatan gonar suka yi ta mamaki yayin da Jemima, mai shekaru biyar, ta haifi ’ya’ya hudu. Duk da cewa sau da yawa akwai haihuwar uku, wannan shi ne karo na farko da gonar ta fuskanci hudu. “Mun taba samun uku a baya, amma hudu ba mu taba gani ba,” in ji Moore, yana nuna yadda suka ji dadin ganin wata akuya ta sake fitowa. “Dukkansu suna cikin koshin lafiya—‘ya’yan suna da kuzari, suna yawo suna wasa.” Saboda irin wasa da kawaicin ‘yan akuyan, aka sanya musu sunaye daga haruffan shahararren fim din Harry Potter. Jemima da ’ya’yan nata hudu tare da mahaifinsu Dave, wanda shima yana da shekaru biyar, za su ci gaba da zama tare a gonar kuma suna samun farin jini daga bakuncin baƙi. Jemima, Dave da wasu akuyoyi biyu masu ciki sun iso gonar ne wasu makonni da suka wuce. Ko da yake ma’aikatan gonar sun lura Jemima ta fi sauran mata girma, ba su zata za ta iya haifar hudu ba. Haihuwar ta tafi lafiya ba tare da wata matsala ba, kuma Jemima ta nuna kulawa a matsayin uwa. Dukkan yara hudun suna cikin koshin lafiya kuma suna daidai girma. An tanadi babban ruga a gare su domin karbar baƙin da ke sha’awar ganin sabon dangin gonar.

article_content: Childbirth, traditionally a private event, is increasingly being shared publicly on social media. Recently, Sara Williams, wife of Twitter CEO Evan Williams, live-tweeted her labor from the hospital, mixing humor with honest updates for her many followers. This signals a trend where future parents use platforms like Twitter to document everything from pregnancy to childbirth. Williams updated about each stage of her labor—her water breaking, hospital arrival, contractions, and opting for an epidural. Her husband later announced their healthy son's birth online. Sara's candid posts provided both drama and amusement, with supporters saying her openness helps other parents understand the process, while critics argue such sharing is too personal. Williams is not alone in this approach. Terra Carmichael of the San Francisco Bay Area tweeted through her third childbirth to keep loved ones informed and found it helped her cope. In New York, Kyle Monson live-tweeted for his wife using code words to protect their privacy, announcing their daughter Ada’s birth so friends and family could share the joy remotely. Many parents turn to social media to include friends and family in special moments, but some, like psychologist Dr. Renana Brooks, feel real-time online sharing can diminish the intimate nature of childbirth. Experts such as Debora Robertson agree that it can assist anxious expectant parents but question just how much should be revealed publicly. Other platforms like Facebook, YouTube, and tools such as the Kickbee—which tweets when a baby kicks—also connect parents online. While these resources create online communities, professionals like Dina Freeman advise that important health issues should still be discussed with doctors. Ultimately, the growing impulse to share childbirth online reflects technology’s evolving role in life’s most meaningful moments. After his wife gave birth, Evan Williams received a wave of congratulatory messages from friends like Twitter co-founder Biz Stone, underlining how digital platforms can foster connection.

Bayan matarsa ta haihu, Evan Williams ya karɓi sakonnin taya murna daga abokai ciki har da Biz Stone, yana nuna irin yadda dandalin sada zumunta ke hada mutane.

Venture capital is experiencing a transformation, with profitability now taking center stage. Not long ago, startups concentrated on securing large funding rounds, often sidelining profit as they pursued fast growth and unicorn valuations. However, after numerous startups used up their investments without becoming financially sustainable, venture capitalists have changed course. Their current priority is backing startups that outline a clear path to profitability.

This new approach means investors seek out companies built on reliable and adaptable revenue streams, healthy profit margins, and robust business models. Entrepreneurs now need to demonstrate the ability not just to expand quickly, but also to sustain that growth while generating financial returns. Practically, this involves careful cash flow management, prudent spending, and fostering customer loyalty for long-term value.

Profitability now represents more than just short-term gains—it signals resilience and the ability to survive market fluctuations. Startups achieving this are reinvesting in marketing, customer service, and ongoing product development, all in pursuit of steady, lasting value. By centering their strategies around profit, these businesses are gaining more interest from investors who value both expansion and enduring stability. Ultimately, demonstrating profitability is now essential for startups seeking meaningful growth and the support of top-tier investors.

The U.S. Department of Justice is investigating allegations of misconduct by three Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) employees in Colombia, separate from the recent Secret Service scandal involving prostitutes in Cartagena. Officials stated that the investigation began after the Secret Service provided information, and the DEA is fully cooperating by making its employees available for interviews with the Justice Department's Office of Inspector General (OIG).

According to CBS News, three DEA agents are under investigation for allegedly hiring prostitutes in Cartagena. Justice Department spokesperson Jay Lerner confirmed that the OIG is examining potential misconduct by DEA personnel not associated with the Secret Service incident.

The OIG is coordinating with the Department of Homeland Security’s inspector general, the State Department’s Diplomatic Security Service, and the Secret Service. The DEA, which enforces U.S. controlled-substance laws, maintains a permanent presence in Colombia and has stated it will take appropriate personnel action if the investigation warrants it.

In the earlier Secret Service incident, investigators spoke with Dania Londono Suarez, a Colombian woman who stated that a payment dispute led to the April 12 event becoming public. She claimed to have agreed to provide services for $800, but received only $50 from the agent, prompting her to inform authorities and triggering a larger investigation.

More than a dozen members of the Secret Service and U.S. military were implicated. Several Secret Service officers, including supervisors, were dismissed. The agency is reportedly revoking one employee’s security clearance, and three others have been cleared of serious wrongdoing. Prostitution is legal in Colombia.

article_content: The Goa government has announced several initiatives to promote the state as a leading spiritual destination. Efforts include creating spiritual circuits, developing temple trails, increasing flights to key tier 2 cities, constructing a monument to honor Lord Parshuram, encouraging local festivals, and launching marketing campaigns that showcase Goa’s cultural history. Tourism department officials noted that Goa is often seen primarily as a 'sun, sand, sea' destination. The government is working to shift this perception by encouraging visitors to explore Goa 'beyond the beaches.' In May, the governments of Goa and Uttarakhand signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to encourage tourism, with a special focus on spiritual, wellness, and eco-tourism circuits. As part of the initiative, a direct flight between Goa and Dehradun was introduced. 'Goa is known as Dakshin Kashi. To bridge the travel gap between Uttarkashi and Dakshinkashi, our first step is to improve connectivity by launching direct flights to tier 2 tourist destinations such as Uttarakhand, Nagpur, Guwahati, Nashik, Amritsar, Kashi, and Varanasi. This will help attract more tourists to Goa and foster cultural exchange,' said Goa Tourism Minister Rohan Khaunte. Khaunte added that the department would soon announce plans for spiritual tourism, including temple trails and initiatives to promote yoga, wellness, and eco-tourism. The state has also signed an MoU with Temple Connect to promote spiritual tourism. Later this month, a one-day conclave will be held, inviting social media influencers and tourism stakeholders to collaborate on developing spiritual experiences and circuits, officials said. The state is also making an effort to highlight local festivals to showcase Goa’s cultural heritage and alter the perception of Goa as only a party destination. 'Recently, we have celebrated traditional Goan festivals such as Sao Joao, Chikhal Khalo, and Bomderas. For the upcoming Shiv Jayanti festival, we plan to organize celebrations in six cities across the state. These festivals must be promoted and their histories documented—so that future generations recognize Chattrapati Shivaji Maharaj’s contributions to resisting Portuguese rule,' Khaunte said. Another initiative, still in its early stages, proposes constructing an iconic 'Bow and Arrow' structure in North Goa’s Mandrem to honor Lord Parshuram's legacy. A tourism department official explained, 'According to legend, Lord Parshuram shot an arrow into the Arabian Sea, creating Goa. Land for the monument has been identified near rock formations on Mandrem beach, but the plan is still in the early planning phase.'

Shirye-shiryen sun hada da kafa zagayen ruhaniya, tsara hanyoyin ziyarar haikali, ƙara jiragen sama zuwa manyan biranen yawon bude ido na mataki na biyu, gina gagarumin gumaka don girmama Lord Parshuram, ƙarfafa bukukuwan al’adu, da kaddamar da kamfe don nuna tarihin al’adun Goa. Jami’an sashen yawon bude ido sun bayyana cewa akasari ana kallon Goa ne a matsayin wurin hutu na ‘rana, yashi, da teku’. Gwamnati na kokari wajen sauya wannan tunani ta hanyar karfafa maziyarta su binciki Goa ‘fiye da rairayin bakin teku’. A watan Mayu, gwamnatocin Goa da Uttarakhand sun sanya hannu kan yarjejeniya don bunkasa yawon bude ido, inda aka mayar da hankali akai-akai kan zagaye ruhaniya, jin dadin jiki, da yawon bude ido mai motsa muhalli. A karkashin wannan shiri, an bude jirgin kai tsaye tsakanin Goa da Dehradun. ‘Goa ana kiranta Dakshin Kashi. Don hada kai tsakanin Uttarkashi da Dakshinkashi, matakin farko shine inganta hanyoyin jiragen kai tsaye zuwa manyan biranen mataki na biyu kamar Uttarakhand, Nagpur, Guwahati, Nashik, Amritsar, Kashi, da Varanasi. Wannan zai taimaka fadada yawon bude ido da musayar al’adu a Goa’, in ji Ministan Yawon Bude Ido na Goa, Rohan Khaunte. Khaunte ya kara da cewa nan ba da jimawa ba za a sanar da sabon shirin bunkasa yawon ruhaniya, wanda zai kunshi hanyoyin tafiya zuwa haikalai da kokarin bunkasa yoga, jin dadin jiki da yawon bude ido mai kula da muhalli. An kuma kulla yarjejeniya da Temple Connect don karfafa yawon bude ido na ruhaniya. A karshen wannan watan, za a gudanar da taron rana daya, inda masu tasiri a kafafen sada zumunta da masu ruwa da tsaki a bangaren yawon bude ido za su halarta domin kokarin hadin guiwa wajen bunkasa wadannan abubuwan sha’awa na ruhaniya. Har ila yau, jihar na kokari wajen haskaka bukukuwan gargajiya don nuna al’adun Goa da kuma sauya ra’ayin cewa jihar ta fi komai bukukuwan dare. ‘Kwanan nan, mun gudanar da bukukuwan gargajiya kamar Sao Joao, Chikhal Khalo da Bomderas. Don bikin Shiv Jayanti mai zuwa, muna shirin gudanar da bukukuwan a birane shida. Dole ne a bunkasa wadannan bukukuwan da kuma tabbatar da tarihin su—domin matasa su fahimci gagarumar rawar da Chattrapati Shivaji Maharaj ya taka wajen tsayin daka da Turawan Portuguese’, in ji Khaunte. A wani sabon salo, an kaddamar da shiri na gina wata fitacciyar ‘Kibiya da Baka’ a Mandrem, arewacin Goa, don bayyana tarihin Lord Parshuram. Jami’in sashen yawon bude ido ya ce, ‘A cewar tatsuniya, Lord Parshuram ya harba kibiya zuwa Tekun Arabia har aka kafa jihar Goa. An riga an ware fili a bakin dutsen Mandrem, amma har yanzu shirin yana farko ne.'

article_content: Authorities in Pennsylvania continue their extensive search for Eric Frein, a 31-year-old man accused of killing state trooper Bryon Dickson and wounding trooper Alex Douglass. Investigators believe the attacks were the result of years of careful planning; Frein reportedly researched ways to evade capture and survive in the wilderness. Before fleeing, he is thought to have destroyed his own computer’s hard drive to obscure evidence. Hundreds of officers—including local police and federal agents—have scoured the derelict, 400-room Inn at Buck Hill Falls, given Frein’s familiarity with the property. Despite a thorough 10-12 hour search, they found nothing indicating his presence. Lt. Col. George Bivens of the Pennsylvania State Police has stated that Frein may possess a radio to monitor law enforcement movements and is possibly using booby traps in wooded areas. Investigators looked into the possibility that the attacks were motivated by an alleged affair involving trooper Douglass and Frein’s sister-in-law, Melissa, but found no supporting evidence. Police recovered bomb-making materials in Frein’s parents’ home and discovered soiled diapers and distinctive Serbian cigarettes in the search area, items which suggest survivalist tactics and a readiness for extended evasion. Frein, identified as a survivalist who may hold resentment towards law enforcement, remains at large after evading police for over two weeks. He previously visited Buck Hill Falls when it operated as a resort. His family, including Melissa and his brother Michael, have aided the investigation through interviews. Authorities have repeatedly shifted the search perimeter in response to new clues. While there is little reason to believe Frein poses a threat to civilians, police remain cautious due to the risks toward officers. The search has disrupted local life, with residents occasionally displaced during operations. Law enforcement officials remain determined and assert that Frein will ultimately be found, encouraging residents to stay alert as the search continues until his capture is secured.

Masu bincike sun ce wannan harin yana zuwa ne bayan shiryawa na wasu shekaru, inda rahotanni suka nuna Frein yana nazarin hanyoyin kaucewa kama da yadda ake rayuwa a daji. Kafin ya tsere, ana zargin ya lalata kwamfutarsa domin boye shaidu. 'Yan sanda da jami'an gwamnati na tarayya da yawa sun duba otel mai dakuna 400 da aka bari a Buck Hill Falls tun da Frein yana da masaniya da wurin. Duk da binciken da suka yi na tsawon sa'o'i 10 zuwa 12, basu samu wani alamar kasancewarsa ba. Lt. Col. George Bivens na 'yan sandan Pennsylvania ya ce Frein na iya samun radio don sauraron labaran 'yan sanda, kuma yana iya saka tarkuna a dazuka. Hukuma ta binciki jita-jitar cewa harin yana da alaƙa da wata sabani ta soyayya tsakanin Alex Douglass da surukar Frein, Melissa, amma babu shaidar hakan. 'Yan sanda sun sami kayan hada bam a gidan iyayen Frein tare da pampers masu datti da sigarin Serbia a wuraren bincike; abubuwan da ke nuna shi na amfani da dabarun tsira yana kuma shiryawa boyewa na dogon lokaci. Frein, wanda aka bayyana a matsayin ɗan gwanin rayuwar daji da ake zato yana da rashin jituwa da jami'an tsaro, bai shiga hannu ba har yanzu bayan fiye da sati biyu. Ya taba ziyartar otel din Buck Hill Falls a da. Iyalin Frein, ciki har da Melissa da dan uwansa Michael, sun taimaka wajen bincike. Jami'an tsaro sun ci gaba da canza yankin bincike bisa ga sabbin bayanai da suke samu. Duk da babu hujjar cewa Frein zai kai wa jama'a hari, jami'ai na ci gaba da shiri saboda hadari gare su. Wannan bincike ya janyo hargitsi ga mazauna yankin, inda wasu suka fuskanci ficewa daga gidajensu na dan lokaci. Jami'ai na nuna kwarin gwiwa cewa nan gaba za a samu kamo Frein, suna kuma jan hankalin jama'a su kasance masu lura har saukar wannan matsala.

article_content: Three days after Shiv Sena (UBT) Worli MLA Aaditya Thackeray forcibly opened a section of the Delisle Road bridge, the BMC installed streetlights along the carriageway on Sunday. Civic officials indicated that the bridge may be officially opened after Tuesday this week. Last week's high-profile incident involved a forced inauguration of the bridge, a closure within hours, a letter from Thackeray to the governor highlighting several pending infrastructure and social projects, and an FIR. The BMC stated that the crucial Lower Parel connector could not be reopened fully as lighting was still under testing. "Most of the work has been completed and we want to open the bridge fully for motorists' convenience," an official said on Sunday. The formal opening is likely to include ruling party members and guardian ministers Deepak Kesarkar and Mangal Prabhat Lodha, particularly after the recent controversy. Some citizens questioned why political interests appeared to outweigh public benefit. Since its closure in July 2018, the missing connector has caused significant inconvenience for residents and office-goers in the area. Worli resident and advocate Dhanpal Solanki Jain said, "It's unfortunate that politics is being played over taking credit. The welfare of Mumbaikars should be the priority. People have struggled to access schools, colleges, hospitals, offices, markets, and even visit friends or relatives, as they had to take a major detour between Lower Parel and Parel." Byculla resident Imran Abbas Sayyed noted that the bridge's reopening had been repeatedly delayed. "The bridge was supposed to open before this year's monsoon. If it's ready, the BMC should finish the remaining work and open it—painting, for example, can be done at night when traffic is low." Civic officials cited several reasons for the delays, including the need for concrete curing, a shortage of steel supplies for about 15 days, and a water tanker strike earlier this year.
translated_content: Kwana uku bayan dan majalisar Worli na Shiv Sena (UBT), Aaditya Thackeray, ya bude wani sashin gada ta Delisle Road da karfi, BMC ta saka fitilun titi a kan gadar ranar Lahadi. Jami’an hukumar sun ce ana iya bude gadar ta hukuma bayan Talata wannan mako. A makon da ya gabata, an samu bude gada da karfi, rufewa cikin sa’o’i, wasikar Aaditya Thackeray zuwa gwamna kan wasu muhimman ayyukan gine-gine da na al’umma, da kuma shigar da korafi ga ‘yan sanda. BMC ta bayyana cewa hanyar Lower Parel ba a bude ta gaba daya ba saboda ana gwajin hasken fitilu. "Yawancin ayyukan sun kusa kammalawa kuma muna son bude gadar gaba daya don saukin masu mota," in ji wani jami’i ranar Lahadi. Za a iya samun ‘yan siyasa daga jam’iyyar mai mulki da ministocin Deepak Kesarkar da Mangal Prabhat Lodha a wajen bude gadar ta hukuma, musamman ganin abin da ya faru kwanan nan. Wasu daga cikin mazaunan sun tambayi dalilin da yasa siyasa ke gabata da muhimmanci fiye da jin dadin jama’a. Tun da aka rufe gadar a watan Yulin 2018, rashin hanyar ya janyo wa al’umma da masu aiki a yankin matsala. Dhanpal Solanki Jain, mazaunin Worli kuma lauya, ya ce, “Abin takaici ne ana siyasa ne kawai don samun yabo. Jin dadin al’ummar Mumbai ya kamata ya zama fifiko. Mutane suna wahala wajen zuwa makarantu, asibitoci, kasuwanni, ofisoshi da ziyarar ‘yan uwa don sai sun bi hanya mai nisa daga Lower Parel zuwa Parel.” Imran Abbas Sayyed na Byculla, ya ce an dade ana jinkirta bude gadar. “An ce za a bude kafin damina bana. Idan gadar ta shirya, BMC ta kammala sauran karamin aiki kuma a budeta; irin na zanen hanya za a iya yi da dare idan motoci sun ragu.” Jami’an BMC sun ce dalilan jinkiri sun hada da bukatar bushewar siminti, karancin karafa na kwanaki 15 da yajin aikin masu tankar ruwa a farkon shekara.

article_content: On Wednesday night, Lindsay Lohan became involved in an altercation with Florida psychic Tiffany Eve Mitchell at a Manhattan nightclub, resulting in Lohan’s arrest. Max George of The Wanted was also present at the club but seemed unconcerned by the incident or the subsequent attention. Following a performance with his band at Madison Square Garden, Max was seen smiling, mingling with fans, and posing for photos. The Wanted had been opening for Justin Bieber for a second consecutive night in New York. Max, dressed casually, greeted several enthusiastic fans outside his hotel. After the concert, Lohan and a friend joined The Wanted band members Jay McGuiness and Tom Parker at the club. A dispute reportedly occurred near their group, involving Lohan, a heavily intoxicated Max George, Tiffany Eve Mitchell, and Mitchell’s husband. Details about The Wanted’s involvement in the incident remain unclear. According to police, Mitchell accused Lohan of striking her on the left side of her face, causing swelling and pain. Although an ambulance was called, Mitchell declined medical treatment. Lohan was later identified as the attacker and arrested by police after the group left the club. Lohan was led away in handcuffs. She repeatedly denied the accusations, stating, 'Oh my God! I didn't touch anyone!' and 'Are you kidding me?' She was taken to Manhattan’s 10th Precinct Station House, charged with misdemeanor assault, and issued a desk appearance ticket requiring her to appear in court on January 7. Later that day, Lohan’s legal troubles deepened as California prosecutors filed new charges related to a June car crash on the Pacific Coast Highway. She is accused of obstructing and lying to police, as well as reckless driving, after allegedly driving her Porsche into a dump truck and then lying about being the passenger. At the time of the crash, Lohan was on probation, making the situation more serious. Meanwhile, Max George, who recently ended his engagement with actress Michelle Keegan, appeared to be enjoying his time, interacting playfully with fans and showing no signs of being concerned about the surrounding controversies.

article_content: Since arriving at Manchester United earlier this summer, manager Louis van Gaal has introduced his favored 3-5-2 formation. In United's penalty shootout win against Inter Milan—Van Gaal’s third match in charge—Chris Smalling, Phil Jones, and Jonny Evans operated as the defensive trio. Nonetheless, many United supporters are unconvinced these three can form the foundation of a title-winning defense, especially after losing veteran leaders Rio Ferdinand and Nemanja Vidic this summer. As the new setup develops during the club's preseason tour in America, Van Gaal is expected to pursue defensive reinforcements before the transfer window closes. Building on his track record of guiding defenders like Ron Vlaar, Daley Blind, and Bruno Martins Indi at the World Cup, where his Dutch team went unbeaten during regular play, he’s considering several candidates for Manchester United’s backline. If reinforcements are brought in, here are six defenders rumoured to be on United’s radar: - Thomas Vermaelen (Arsenal, £12m): At 28, the Belgian offers options at both centre-back and left-back, aligning well with Van Gaal’s tactical plans. - Mats Hummels (Borussia Dortmund, £30m): Though his father has publicly ruled out a move, United could still make an approach. Hummels brings composure and commitment, though he lacks great pace. - Daley Blind (Ajax, £17m): Known for his positional flexibility and ball distribution, Blind can play as a left-back, wing-back, or in midfield. - Joel Veltman (Ajax, £18m): This emerging centre-back, already on Van Gaal’s World Cup roster, is monitored by leading European clubs. - Joao Miranda (Atletico Madrid, £25m): At 29, Miranda offers experience, with both Chelsea and Barcelona expressing interest—though his age affects his market value. - Raphael Varane (Real Madrid, £35m): Young, tall, and athletic, Varane is seen as a future star in European defense, attracting considerable interest from top clubs.
translated_content: Tun daga hawansa shugabancin Manchester United a farkon wannan bazara, kocin Louis van Gaal ya bullo da tsarin 3-5-2 da yake so. A wasansu da Inter Milan a gasar bugun fanareti—wanda ke zama wasansa na uku da United—Chris Smalling, Phil Jones da Jonny Evans suka jagoranci tsaron. Duk da haka, da yawa daga magoya bayan United na ganin cewa wannan ukun ba za su iya zama garkuwa mai ƙarfi ba, musamman bayan tafiyar Rio Ferdinand da Nemanja Vidic a wannan kakar. Yayin da sabon tsarin ke bunkasa yayin horon kakar bazara a Amurka, ana sa ran Van Gaal zai kara zakulo ‘yan tsaro kafin kasuwar canja ‘yan wasa ta kare. Bayan yadda ya horar da masu tsaro irin su Ron Vlaar, Daley Blind da Bruno Martins Indi a gasar cin kofin duniya wadda Holland ta kammala ba tare da sha kashi a lokaci na yau da kullum ba, yana duban kara ƙwararrun ‘yan tsaro ga United. Idan za a kawo karin ‘yan tsaro ga United, ga wasu daga cikin wadanda ake dangantawa da su: - Thomas Vermaelen (Arsenal, £12m): Dan Belgium mai shekara 28 na iya taka leda a tsakiya ko gefen bayan hagu, abin da ya dace da tsarin Van Gaal. - Mats Hummels (Borussia Dortmund, £30m): Kodayake mahaifinsa ya ce ba zai koma United ba, kulob din na iya kokarin daukarsa. Hummels yana da hali mai kyau da jajircewa, amma ba shi da sauri sosai. - Daley Blind (Ajax, £17m): Mashahurin dan wasa ne mai iya tsayawa a wurare da dama da kwarewa wajen rabon kwallo, yana iya bugawa a baya, wing-back ko a tsakiya. - Joel Veltman (Ajax, £18m): Matashi mai kwazo wanda ya riga ya shiga cikin ‘yan wasannin Van Gaal a cin kofin duniya kuma manyan kungiyoyin Turai na bibiyarsa. - Joao Miranda (Atletico Madrid, £25m): Miranda mai shekara 29 ya tara kwarewa, yayin Chelsea da Barcelona ke nema—kele shekarunsa na rage masa daraja. - Raphael Varane (Real Madrid, £35m): Dan wasa matashi, mai tsawo da kuzari, ana ganin Varane zai zama daya daga cikin manyan ‘yan tsaro a Turai, kuma kungiyoyi masu tasowa na bibiyarsa.
