article_content: Marilyn Jean Hartman, age 62, a well-known serial airline stowaway, was arrested Monday at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) after successfully boarding a flight without a ticket. Hartman slipped past Transportation Security Administration (TSA) officers at Mineta San Jose International Airport and boarded a Southwest Airlines flight to Los Angeles. Her presence went unnoticed until after landing at LAX, when the crew counted passengers continuing to Phoenix. Hartman was removed from the plane and charged with trespassing by the Los Angeles Police Department. Hartman has become somewhat of a figure of interest in the Bay Area due to her repeated attempts to travel without a ticket, particularly at San Francisco International Airport. In her first attempt, on February 15, she boarded a plane to Hawaii by sneaking through TSA security, but was discovered when the ticketed passenger arrived. She claimed at that time that she had cancer—a claim that has not been confirmed—and said she wanted to go somewhere warm. A GoFundMe page created by San Franciscans has raised nearly $1,300 to help send her on a legal trip to Hawaii. San Jose Mercury News reported that Hartman evaded TSA agents by blending with a family being screened. She had tried and failed three earlier times before getting through security. Inside the terminal, she attempted to board a number of flights before successfully boarding the Southwest flight. The airline does not assign seats, which may have allowed her to avoid detection until arrival. Authorities say Hartman suffers from a major mental illness and has stated that she feels safer in airports than in her San Francisco apartment. After several arrests, prosecutors considered pursuing mental health treatment rather than criminal charges. Despite numerous warnings not to return to airports without a ticket, she has continued to be arrested for trespassing, even in airport food courts. This was the second major security lapse at Mineta San Jose International Airport this year. In April, a 15-year-old boy managed to survive a flight to Hawaii after stowing away in a plane's wheel well.
translated_content: Marilyn Jean Hartman, mai shekaru 62, sananniya a matsayin wadda ke shiga jirgin sama ba tare da tikiti ba, an kama ta a Filin Jirgin Sama na Los Angeles (LAX) ranar Litinin bayan ta hau jirgi ba tare da tikiti ba. Hartman ta wuce jami’an tsaro na TSA a Filin Jirgin Sama na Mineta San Jose sannan ta hau jirgi na Southwest Airlines zuwa Los Angeles. Ba a gane kasancewarta a cikin jirgin ba har sai bayan jirgin ya sauka a LAX, lokacin da ma’aikatan jirgin suka kirga fasinjojin da za su ci gaba da tafiya zuwa Phoenix. An fitar da Hartman daga cikin jirgin kuma rundunar ‘yan sandan Los Angeles ta tuhume ta da shiga wurin da ba a yarda ba. Hartman ta shahara musamman a yankin Bay Area saboda yawan yunkurinta na shiga jirgi ba tare da tikiti ba, musamman a Filin Jirgin Sama na San Francisco. A kokarinta na farko a ranar 15 ga Fabrairu, ta shiga jirgin zuwa Hawaii ta boye wa jami’an tsaro na TSA, amma aka gano ta lokacin da wanda ke da tikitin ya iso. Ta shaida wa ‘yan sanda a lokacin cewa tana da cutar daji—ikirkirarin da ba a tabbatar ba—kuma tana so ta tafi wurin da yake dumi. ‘Yan yankin San Francisco sun bude GoFundMe don taimaka mata ta tafi hutun doka zuwa Hawaii, inda aka tara kusan dala 1,300. San Jose Mercury News ta ruwaito cewa Hartman ta kauce wa jami’an TSA ne lokacin da wata iyali ke tsallaka. Ta gwada sau uku kafin ta samu ta wuce. Bayan ta shiga terminal din, ta yi kokarin hawar jirage da dama kafin ta samu shiga jirgin Southwest. Wannan jirgin baya tsai da kujeru, dalilin da ya sa ba a gano ta ba har sai sun sauka. Hukumomi sun ce Hartman na fama da matsalar kwakwalwa mai tsanani kuma ta ce tana fi jin lafiya a filin jirgin fiye da gidanta a San Francisco. Bayan kama ta sau da yawa, masu gabatar da kara sun nemi a mayar da ita dakin kula da masu tabin hankali maimakon gurfanar da ita gaban kotu. Duk da gargadi sau da dama kada ta sake komawa filin jirgi ba tare da tikiti ba, an ci gaba da kama ta har da kasancewa a cikin kantin abinci. Wannan ne karo na biyu da aka samu matsalar tsaro a Filin Jirgin Sama na Mineta San Jose a wannan shekarar. A watan Afrilu, wani yaro ‘dan shekara 15 ya ketare shinge, ya shiga cikin bututun jirgi, sannan ya tsira bayan suka sauka Hawaii.

article_content: Andrea Pirlo had a crucial influence on the game—not through scoring, but with his creative movement, including a clever dummy that set up Claudio Marchisio's goal for Italy. This moment energized the Italian fans in Manaus and launched a thrilling World Cup encounter between teams known for defense. Despite their reputation, both sides played an attacking game. Pirlo directed Italy’s play, using his skillful passing and awareness to create opportunities, particularly down the right side where Matteo Darmian and Antonio Candreva stood out. Early in the match, Pirlo calmly settled into his role, controlling possession and tempo from deep. Just before the break, his feint deceived Daniel Sturridge and enabled the opening goal by Marchisio. England’s midfield, featuring Jordan Henderson and Jack Wilshere, tried to track and disrupt Pirlo, but he consistently found ways to influence the game with composure and accurate distribution, especially with long passes to the wings. With captain Gianluigi Buffon out, Pirlo took the armband and led Italy’s attack with trademark poise. England’s various attempts to neutralize him were ineffective, and Italy nearly won a penalty when Pirlo’s chip struck Glen Johnson’s arm. Pirlo demonstrated his enduring class, controlling games with vision and technical ability. With his international retirement nearing, this match was a fitting display of his mastery. Italy ultimately secured the win, largely shaped by Pirlo’s leadership in midfield, while England’s players will analyze how to counter such talent going forward.
translated_content: Andrea Pirlo ya fito fili a wasa, ba wai da kwallo ba amma da dabara da motsi, ciki har da wata kaifin dabara da ya bude wa Claudio Marchisio damar jefa kwallo ga Italiya. Wannan ya faranta ran magoya bayan Italiya a Manaus, tare da kaddamar da wata doguwar gwabza mai kayatarwa a gasar cin kofin duniya tsakanin kungiyoyin da aka san su da kokarin kare gida. Duk da irin kokarinsu wajen kare raga, duka kungiyoyin sun fito da wasanni masu sauri da kai hare-hare. Pirlo ne ya jagoranci wasannin Italiya da tsantsar basira da gani, musamman gefen dama inda Matteo Darmian da Antonio Candreva suka taka rawa sosai. Daga farko, Pirlo ya fara da natsuwa yana jan ragamar wasa daga baya. Kafin tafiya hutun rabin lokaci, dabara tasa ta ruɗe Daniel Sturridge wanda ya haifar da kwallon farko da Marchisio ya ci. ‘Yan tsakiyar Ingila irin su Jordan Henderson da Jack Wilshere sun kokarta su takaita tasirin Pirlo, amma a koyaushe yana da kwanciyar hankali da fasaha wajen wuce musu, musamman da dogayen canjin wurin da yake yi. Da Gianluigi Buffon ba ya cikin wasa, Pirlo ya jagoranci Italiya a matsayin kyaftin, yana jan ragamar hare-hare da sanin makamar aiki. Duk kokarin Ingila na takaita tasirinsa bai haifar da da mai ido ba, harta kusa da Italiya ta samu bugun fanareti yayin da kwallon Pirlo ta bugu da hannun Glen Johnson. Pirlo ya nuna kwarewarsa ta musamman, yana gudanar da wasan da tsari da basira. Tun da shirin ritayarsa daga wasannin kasa-da-kasa ya gabato, wannan wasa ya bayyana karsashensa na musamman. A karshe, Italiya ta samu nasara sakamakon tasirin Pirlo a tsakiyar wasa, kuma ‘yan Ingila zas su duba hanyoyin da za su iya shawo kan irin wannan kwarewa a nan gaba.

article_content: Chinese contemporary artist Zhu Tian has designed a distinctive pair of high heels called 'Babe', which feature human hair embedded in their construction. The shoes are flesh-colored, have pointed toes, and stand on tall, spiked heels, with hair strands meticulously implanted into a silica gel base. Created as an art piece rather than practical footwear, 'Babe' is intended to challenge perceptions about the sexualization of women’s shoes. Zhu Tian personally inserted each hair by hand, then assembled and exhibited the heels in China. The unusual footwear, standing four inches high, has generated strong reactions, with many observers unsettled or even repulsed by their unconventional look. Design-focused sites like Designboom suggest the piece invites reflection on the relationship between fashion, attractiveness, and sexuality, while some fashion commentators describe the shoes as bizarre or unsettling.
translated_content: Zanen zamani daga kasar Sin, Zhu Tian, ta ƙirƙiri wani irin takalmin tsini na musamman mai suna 'Babe', inda aka fito da gashin mutum a cikin zane. Takalman suna da launin fata, suna da yatsun tsini da tsawo mai yawa, gashinsu an sha da su cikin gelatin silica da ƙwarewa. Ba don amfani a wajen tafiya aka kirkiri takalman ba, amma a matsayin aikin fasaha don tada tattaunawa game da yadda ake hada batun jima’i da takalman mata. Zhu Tian da kanta ta dasa kowanne gashi da hannu kafin haɗa waɗannan takalma, sannan ta nuna su a wani baje kolin fasaha a kasar Sin. Wadannan takalman masu tsayin inci hudu sun yi dab da jawo cece-kuce mai tsanani; da dama daga cikin masu dubawa sun ji takalman sun ban tsoro ko damuwa. Shafukan zane irin su Designboom sun bayyana aikin a matsayin mai kiran tunani game da alakar dake tsakanin k’ayatarwa, tufafi, da yanda ake kallon sha’awa; wasu daga masana k’ayatarwar sun kwatanta takalman a matsayin abubuwan mamaki ko masu tayar da hankali.

article_content: The reward for information leading to an arrest in the shooting death of a Seattle police officer has risen to $85,000. Richard O'Neill, head of the Seattle Police Guild, said the city is on edge and citizens are worried about safety while the shooter has not been found. Police are working tirelessly to track down those who killed Officer Timothy Brenton and wounded trainee Brit Sweeney. The attack occurred Saturday night while Brenton, 39, was reviewing a traffic stop in a parked patrol car with Sweeney. Another vehicle pulled alongside and opened fire, killing Brenton and injuring Sweeney. Despite being grazed by a bullet, Sweeney was able to call for help and report her partner’s death through sobs. Chief John Diaz stated her uniform and vest were damaged by the shot. Assistant Chief Jim Pugel said Sweeney fired back, but it's unclear if she hit the suspects’ car. Officials characterized the act as an 'assassination,' noting there had been no threats made against Brenton prior to the attack. The suspect's vehicle is described as a light-colored compact car, possibly white, light blue, or silver. Police are reviewing dash camera footage but have not yet found the vehicle. Seattle Mayor Greg Nickels condemned the shooting as 'cold-blooded,' noting it's the first intentional killing of a Seattle officer since 1994. Authorities promised to relentlessly seek justice. Crime Stoppers has raised the reward, and Deputy Chief Nick Metz shared a letter from Brenton’s family thanking the community for its support. Brenton, a nine-year veteran, leaves behind a wife and two children, as well as family members who served in the Seattle police.
translated_content: An kara ladan neman bayanai zuwa $85,000 ga duk wanda zai taimaka wajen kama wanda ya kashe jami’in ‘yan sanda a Seattle. Shugaban kungiyar ‘yan sanda ta Seattle, Richard O’Neill, ya bayyana damuwar yan gari game da tsaro matukar da wanda ya aikata hakan bai kama ba. ‘Yan sanda na kokarin gano wanda ya kashe Timothy Brenton da raunata dalibar horo Brit Sweeney. Abu ya faru ne daren Asabar, inda Brenton mai shekara 39 ke duba bayanai da Sweeney a cikin motar su har wani mota ta zo ta harbe su, ta kashe Brenton tare da raunata Sweeney. Duk da samun rauni, Sweeney ta kira taimako cikin kuka, tana bayyana cewa abokin aikinta ya rasu. Shugaban ‘yan sanda John Diaz ya ce harbin ya huda rigar aiki da garkuwarta. Mataimakin shugaban ‘yan sanda Jim Pugel ya ce Sweeney ta mayar da martani da harbi, amma ba a tabbatar ko harbin ya shafi motar su ba. Jami’an tsaro sun kira wannan a matsayin 'kisan gilla', suna mai cewa babu barazana da aka taba yi wa Brenton kafin harin. Motar da ake zargi tana da launin fari, shudi ko azurfa kuma karama ce. Ana duba bidiyon dashcam na motoci amma ba a gano motar su ba tukuna. Magajin garin Seattle, Greg Nickels, ya yi Allah-wadai da harin tare da cewa wannan kisan shi ne mafi muni tun 1994 ga jami’an ‘yan sanda a garin. Hukuma ta sha alwashi za ta tabbatar an hukunta wadanda ke da hannu. Crime Stoppers sun kara ladan neman bayani, inda Mataimakin Sufeto Nick Metz ya karanta wasiƙar iyalan Brenton suna godiya da jajantawa jama’a. Brenton, mai shekaru tara a aikin ‘yan sanda, ya bar mata, ‘ya’ya biyu, da kuma dangin da su ma sun yi aikin ‘yan sanda a Seattle.

article_content: Toyin Bamidele, a Higher National Diploma student at Federal Polytechnic, Offa, Kwara State, was reportedly murdered by unidentified individuals. Mrs. Oyinloye said the polytechnic’s management is cooperating with security agencies to investigate the killing and seek justice for Toyin. She further noted that such violence is rare in their school community and was strongly condemned by the management. Details about the circumstances of Toyin’s death remain unknown as investigations continue. The school has extended heartfelt condolences to her family, friends, and the Food Technology Department. The management urged anyone with relevant information to reach out to the authorities. Attempts to contact Mr. Victor Olaiya, the Kwara State Commissioner of Police, for a statement were unsuccessful at the time this report was filed.

article_content:
MOSCOW — Russian nationalist Igor Girkin, currently in custody awaiting trial for allegedly inciting extremism, has announced his intention to run for president in the March 2024 election. Girkin's supporters relayed this message, citing a letter from prison. Known by his alias Igor Strelkov, Girkin has frequently warned that Russia risks revolution or even civil war if President Vladimir Putin’s military leaders do not handle the war in Ukraine more effectively.

A former Federal Security Service (FSB) officer, Girkin played a role in Russia’s 2014 annexation of Crimea and the coordination of pro-Russian militias in eastern Ukraine. Before his arrest, Girkin had declared plans to enter politics. “A systemic crisis is developing in Russia—some might say we are already in crisis—while social tensions rise,” Girkin told Reuters in May. “We are on the verge of very serious internal changes with potentially catastrophic consequences.”

At a gathering, Oleg Nelzin, co-chairman of a Russian movement supporting Strelkov, read Girkin’s letter calling on his supporters to begin efforts to nominate him for the March election. During the event, an image of Girkin, 52, with the slogan ‘Our president — Igor Ivanovich Strelkov — 2024’ was projected on a screen as Nelzin spoke. Applause followed, and a video of the event was shared on Telegram by Girkin’s supporters.

Girkin’s backers confirmed to Reuters that he had requested to be put forward as a candidate. Since he has not been convicted, they note he could theoretically participate in the election. Girkin denies the charges against him.

Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov, in an interview published Friday, expressed hopes that Vladimir Putin would run in the March election, which could extend Putin’s presidency to at least 2030.

Russia has recently cracked down on nationalist critics—those advocating a tougher stance in Ukraine, including martial law and national mobilization—especially after Wagner chief Yevgeny Prigozhin’s failed mutiny in June. Prigozhin was killed in a plane crash in August, with the cause still unclear. Girkin, who has also served in Chechnya and Moldova, was arrested in July.

A monarchist, Girkin authored a dissertation on the ‘White Russians’ who opposed the ‘Red’ Bolsheviks after the 1917 revolution. He is among the most prominent nationalists to criticize Russia’s conduct of the Ukraine war, framing it as an existential battle against a hostile West. While he described the 1991 Soviet Union collapse as ‘positive,’ he attacks the post-Soviet Russian elite as corrupt and serving Western interests.

In May, Girkin stated that “Putin is currently the only legitimate figure in the Russian Federation,” despite his criticisms. By August, he argued he would make a better president than Putin, calling the Kremlin leader ‘too kind’ and ‘too trusting’ of security and military officials.

Last year, a Dutch court convicted Girkin in absentia of murder for his role in the 2014 downing of Malaysia Airlines Flight MH17 over eastern Ukraine, killing all 298 passengers and crew. Girkin denies involvement.
translated_content:
MOSKO — Dan kishin ƙasa na Rasha, Igor Girkin, wanda ke tsare yana jiran shari’a bisa zargin tayar da tarzoma, ya bayyana burinsa na tsayawa takarar shugaban ƙasa a zaɓen watan Maris 2024. Magoya bayansa ne suka sanar da hakan, suna ambaton wata wasiƙa daga kurkuku. Da aka fi sani da sunan Igor Strelkov, Girkin ya sha gargadi cewa Rasha na fuskantar hatsarin juyin juya hali ko ma yaƙin basasa idan manyan hafsoshin yaƙin shugaban ƙasa Vladimir Putin ba su tafiyar da yaƙin Ukraine yadda ya dace ba.

Tsohon jami’in hukumar tsaron cikin gida (FSB), Girkin ya taka rawa wajen mamaye yankin Crimea a 2014 da kuma haɗa dakarun goyon bayan Rasha a gabashin Ukraine. Kafin a kama shi, Girkin ya bayyana aniyarsa na shiga siyasa. “Matsala mai tsanani na kunno kai a Rasha—ko dai mu ce mun shiga matsala tuni—yayin da tashin hankali ke karuwa a al’umma,” in ji Girkin ga Reuters a watan Mayu. “Muna dab da shiga manyan canje-canje a cikin gida masu hatsari matuƙa.”

A wani taro, Oleg Nelzin, daya daga cikin shugabannin kungiyar magoya bayan Strelkov, ya karanta wasiƙar Girkin inda ya bukaci a fara kokarin samun damar tsayar da shi takara a zaɓen watan Maris. A lokacin taron, an nuna hoton Girkin mai shekara 52 tare da taken ‘Shugabanmu — Igor Ivanovich Strelkov — 2024’ a allo yayin da Nelzin ke jawabi. An tafa, sannan magoya bayan Girkin suka wallafa bidiyon a Telegram.

Magoya bayan Girkin sun tabbatar wa Reuters cewa ya bukaci a tsayar da shi dan takara. Saboda ba a yanke masa hukunci ba tukuna, suna ganin yana iya shiga zaɓe a ka’ida. Girkin ya musanta zarge-zargen da ake masa.

Kakakin Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, cikin wata hira da aka wallafa a ranar Juma'a, ya bayyana fatan cewa Vladimir Putin zai sake tsayawa takara a zaɓen Maris, lamarin da zai iya sa Putin ci gaba da mulki har zuwa 2030.

A baya-bayan nan, hukumomin Rasha sun tsananta mataki kan masu kishin ƙasa da ke sukar yadda ake tafiyar da yaƙin Ukraine, ciki har da kiran a kafa dokar-yaki da tara jama'a, musamman bayan yunƙurin juyin mulki da shugaban Wagner, Yevgeny Prigozhin, ya kasa yin nasara a watan Yuni. Prigozhin ya mutu cikin hatsarin jirgin sama a watan Agusta, har yanzu ba a san musabbabin lamarin ba. Girkin, wanda ya taɓa aiki a Chechnya da Moldova ma, an kama shi a watan Yuli.

Girkin masoyin masarauta ne; ya rubuta kundin digiri kan ‘Yan Fari’ da suka yi wa ‘Yan Ja’ (Bolsheviks) yaki bayan juyin juya hali na 1917. Daga cikin shahararrun masu kishin ƙasa da ke sukar yadda ake tafiyar da yaƙin Ukraine ne, yana daukar yaƙin a matsayin yaki da daular Yamma. Kodayake ya bayyana rugujewar Tarayyar Soviet a 1991 a matsayin abu mai kyau, ya na zargin shugabannin Rasha bayan Soviet da cin hanci tare da aiki wa Yamma don raunana Rasha.

A watan Mayu, Girkin ya ce, “Putin shi ne kawai shugaban da ke da sahihanci a Rasha a yanzu,” duk da suka da yake masa. A watan Agusta ya ce zai fi Putin shugabanci, yana kiran shugaban Kremlin ‘mai kirki’ da kuma ‘mai yawan yarda’ da manyan hafsoshin tsaro da soji.

A bara kotun Holland ta yanke wa Girkin hukuncin kisa a waje dangane da rawar da ya taka a harbo jirgin Malaysia Airlines MH17 a gabashin Ukraine a 2014, wanda ya halaka mutane 298 baki ɗaya. Girkin ya musanta hannu a lamarin.

article_content: A retired South Korean intelligence officer says the world has been using the wrong name for North Korean leader Kim Jong Un’s daughter, The Korea Times reports. Choe Su Yong, who served in South Korea’s National Intelligence Service for 20 years, stated that although Kim’s daughter is widely known as Kim Ju Ae, her real name is likely Kim Eun Ju. Choe explained that the mistake originated from former NBA star Dennis Rodman, who has visited North Korea multiple times and claims to be friends with Kim. According to Choe, during one visit, Rodman misunderstood Kim’s introduction of his daughter. Kim reportedly used the Korean phrase 'jeo-ae,' meaning 'that girl,' but Rodman seems to have mistaken it as her name. Choe cited North Korean sources for this information. In 2013, Rodman told The Guardian that the girl’s name was Ju Ae, saying he visited North Korea and held her as a baby. A representative for Rodman did not respond to Business Insider’s request for comment. Kim introduced his daughter to the public in November 2022, sparking speculation about her potential role in the regime and possible succession. South Korean officials and intelligence services continue to refer to her as 'Kim Ju Ae,' and she is frequently featured in North Korean state media. The girl, believed to be 11 years old, is thought to be one of at least three children of Kim Jong Un. However, Choe claims Kim has four children, again citing sources in North Korea. Choe retired from intelligence services in 2010 and did not share specific details about his sources, citing safety concerns. Details about Kim’s family remain secret due to strict privacy maintained by North Korean authorities, making independent confirmation difficult. One report from Radio Free Asia stated that North Korean officials ordered girls named 'Ju Ae' to change their names due to the leader’s daughter. South Korea’s Unification Ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment from Business Insider.
translated_content: Wani tsohon jami’in leken asiri daga Koriya ta Kudu ya bayyana cewa an dade ana amfani da sunan da ba daidai ba ga ‘yar shugaban Koriya ta Arewa, Kim Jong Un, kamar yadda jaridar The Korea Times ta ruwaito. Choe Su Yong, wanda ya yi aiki a hukumar leken asiri ta kasa a Koriya ta Kudu tsawon shekaru 20, ya ce ko da yake ana kiranta da Kim Ju Ae, mai yuwuwa sunanta na gaskiya Kim Eun Ju ne. Choe ya ce wannan kuskure ya samo asali ne daga tsohon tauraron NBA Dennis Rodman, wanda ya ziyarci Koriya ta Arewa sau da dama tare da dangantaka da Kim. A cewar Choe, a daya daga cikin ziyarar, Rodman ya fahimta ba daidai ba lokacin da Kim ya gabatar da ‘yarsa. Kim ya yi amfani da kalmar Koriya 'jeo-ae' wato 'wancan yarinyar', amma Rodman ya dauka sunanta kenan. Choe ya ce ya samo wannan labari daga tushe a Koriya ta Arewa. A 2013, Rodman ya shaidawa The Guardian cewa sunan yarinyar Ju Ae ne, inda ya ziyarci Koriya ta Arewa kuma ya rungumi yarinyar tun tana jaririya. Wakili daga bangaren Rodman bai amsa tambayar da Business Insider ta aika nan take ba. An fara bayyana ‘yar Kim ga jama’a a watan Nuwamba 2022, lamarin da ya haifar da jita-jitar cewa tana iya taka rawa ko samun matsayi a mulkinsa. Hukumomin Koriya ta Kudu da na leken asiri har yanzu suna kiran ta da 'Kim Ju Ae', kuma ana ganinta a kafafen yada labarai na Koriya ta Arewa. Ana zaton yarinyar mai shekaru 11, daya ce daga cikin akalla ‘ya’ya uku na Kim Jong Un. Sai dai Choe na cewa Kim yana da ‘ya’ya hudu, inda ya dogara da tushe daga Koriya ta Arewa. Choe ya yi ritaya daga aikin leken asiri tun 2010, baya bayyana cikakkun bayanan tushe dinsa saboda tsaro. Bayanai game da dangin Kim na da wahalar samuwa saboda sirri da ake kiyayewa a Koriya ta Arewa. Rahoton Radio Free Asia ya ce hukumomin Koriya ta Arewa sun umurci ‘yan mata masu suna 'Ju Ae' su sauya sunayensu saboda ‘yar shugaban kasar. article_content: Southampton is set to demand that Tottenham Hotspur include either Andros Townsend or Harry Kane in any potential deal for Jay Rodriguez. Spurs manager Mauricio Pochettino is interested in signing Rodriguez in January to strengthen his team’s attack, which has recently struggled. Rodriguez, an England international, has not played since April due to a significant knee injury. Despite his absence, Southampton wants to keep him at St Mary’s and has offered him an improved five-year contract. However, with only 18 months left on his current deal and no agreement yet reached, doubts remain about his long-term future at the club. Southampton is aware that Rodriguez could leave for free in just over a year if he does not sign a new contract. As a result, Spurs are expected to test Southampton’s resolve when the transfer window opens in January. Manager Ronald Koeman is clear: Townsend or Kane must be part of any transfer for Rodriguez. Sources suggest Pochettino is unwilling to part with Harry Kane due to limited attacking options but could allow Townsend to leave. Kane, Spurs’ top scorer with nine goals across all competitions this season, has had limited playing time in the Premier League, raising questions about his position in the team. Townsend is reportedly among the players Tottenham may release in January. Koeman was previously interested in Townsend during the summer and has been impressed with Kane’s form. If Tottenham renews their interest in midfielder Morgan Schneiderlin, Southampton will insist on similar terms—demanding that either Townsend or Kane be included in any potential deal.

article_content: George Osborne, the UK Chancellor, signaled that government spending reductions would need to remain in place until at least 2019, extending current austerity measures for four more years. Speaking to the BBC, Osborne described these savings as essential for economic security and future job growth, stressing that cuts to certain welfare benefits for working-age adults are part of this effort. He argued that these tough choices are worthwhile for the nation's long-term stability. Osborne’s comments surfaced amid growing disagreements within the coalition government about the direction of economic policy. His Liberal Democrat colleague, Danny Alexander, suggested that the Conservatives were acting out of pre-election anxiety and accused them of wanting to reduce the state unnecessarily. Labour Party representatives also criticized Osborne, with commentator Stefan Stern comparing his stance to that of former Chancellor Lord Lamont, who once described unemployment as a 'price worth paying' to control inflation. Prime Minister David Cameron defended the Conservative approach, claiming that the Liberal Democrats were inconsistent in their positions. Meanwhile, Alexander accused the Conservatives of policies that would cause the public undue hardship. Liberal Democrat leader Nick Clegg argued that Conservative proposals to cut spending while offering tax reductions were unrealistic. Despite public disputes, some government sources believe the coalition partners are deliberately emphasizing their differences before the general election, both to mobilize their supporters and to overshadow Labour’s economic messages. Both parties are still considering the potential for another coalition, even while publicly debating policy. Osborne maintained that the Conservatives represent stability and competence compared to what he described as 'chaos' from their rivals, warning that alternative approaches would result in higher taxes, increased borrowing, and a return to economic instability. He also suggested that keeping public sector wage restraints would minimize job losses. Within the Conservative Party, some MPs, such as Peter Bone, have advocated ending the coalition and governing as a minority, especially if an early election is possible. Others, like Nadine Dorries, expect another coalition scenario after the next election, predicting the Conservatives will not secure a majority large enough to govern alone. Opposition voices, particularly from Labour, claim Osborne has failed to meet his economic promises or improve living standards. The ongoing debates underscore deep differences on how best to achieve fiscal responsibility and support public services in the UK.

Da yake hira da BBC, Osborne ya ce wadannan matakan na rage kudi suna da matukar muhimmanci don tsaron tattalin arziki da samar da guraben ayyuka a nan gaba, inda ya nuna cewa yanke wasu tallafin jin kai ga masu aiki ya zama dole. Danny Alexander daga Liberal Democrat ya zargi Conservatives da yin hakan ne saboda damuwar zabe, tare da zargin su da kakaba matsin lamba fiye da kima ga gwamnati. Wakilan Labour suma sun soki Osborne, inda Stefan Stern ya kwatanta matsayin sa da na tsohon Akanta Lord Lamont wanda ya taba cewa rashin aikin yi yana da amfani idan zai daidaita hauhawar farashi. Firayim Minista David Cameron ya kare tsarin Conservative, yana zargin Liberal Democrats da rashin tabbas. Duk da haka, suna har yanzu nazarin yiyuwar ci gaba da hadaka, koda suna jayayya a bainar jama’a. Osborne ya nace jam’iyyarsa ta Conservative tana nuna kwarewa da tsaro idan aka gwada da 'rudani' na sauran jam’iyyu, yana cewa shawarwarin 'yan adawa za su haifar da karin haraji, ciyo bashi da dawowar matsalolin tattalin arziki. Wasu irinsu Nadine Dorries sun fi ganin za a sake samun hadakar gwamnati bayan zaben gaba, saboda ba za su samu rinjayen da za su kafa mulkin kai tsaye ba. Wakilan adawa, musamman Labour, na zargin Osborne da gazawa wajen cika alkawuran tattalin arziki da inganta rayuwar mutane. Har yanzu batun ya nuna babbar banbanci kan yadda za a tafiyar da kudi da kuma inganta ayyuka a Birtaniya.

article_content: Crowds gathered to honor the memory of Adam Johnson, a 29-year-old Nottingham Panthers ice hockey player who died after suffering a neck injury during a match. The tragic incident occurred on October 28, when Johnson was struck by the skate of Sheffield Steelers player Matt Petgrave. He was transported to the hospital but was pronounced dead soon after. Mourners and fans assembled at Nottingham’s Motorpoint Arena to pay tribute to Johnson. The Panthers described the incident as a 'freak accident.' Players, staff, and fans signed books of condolence on the carpeted ice, followed by a two-minute silence in Johnson's honor. Local mental health charities were present at the arena to support those impacted by the tragedy. Fan Michelle Hallam shared that she was attending the game with her son and his friends for their first Panthers experience when the incident occurred. She recounted ensuring the children were shielded from witnessing the distressing scene. Hallam later returned with her son to lay flowers and view the tributes, noting that they were both visibly affected by the event. Sheffield Steelers fan Ronnie Woolley described it as a 'really hard week,' remarking on the collective grief among fans from both teams. Woolley returned to the arena to pay his respects, emphasizing the unity within the ice hockey community. Adam Johnson’s aunt, Kari Johnson, told Minnesota’s KSTP-TV that Adam had planned to propose to his partner, Ryan Wolfe. An inquest into Johnson's death was opened and adjourned on Friday; Wolfe formally identified him. The Nottingham Panthers, with the permission of Johnson's family, launched a fundraising page supporting charitable activities in his hometown of Hibbing, Minnesota. The appeal has raised over £45,000. Johnson’s funeral is scheduled to take place in Minnesota on Sunday, according to an obituary on Dougherty Funeral Home’s website, which praised his quiet confidence and caring nature. South Yorkshire Police have started an investigation into the incident, which is expected to take time.

Ensuring that artificial intelligence benefits everyone is a key focus for President Biden, whose recent Executive Order introduces new safeguards around AI development. This order aims to increase AI safety and security, protect privacy, encourage fairness, boost innovation, and support healthy competition, particularly for small businesses and entrepreneurs. The government is providing technical help and resources to level the playing field for these smaller entities, giving them an advantage to create and market their own AI solutions. 

To address the risk of algorithmic bias, the order requires federal agencies to work together to prevent discrimination in AI-driven decisions related to things like hiring or contract awards. Training and guidance will help make sure AI systems don't reinforce inequality. 

On cybersecurity, the order establishes programs to use AI for detecting and resolving vulnerabilities in key software, improving protections for businesses and organizations. 

The administration emphasizes the need for collaboration across government, private industry, and civil society to ensure responsible AI development. This Executive Order is seen as a first step, with further actions expected to help guide the future of AI in a fair and secure manner.

article_content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has spotlighted the escalating threats posed by deepfake technology and the key role artificial intelligence plays in fueling misinformation. This issue gained new urgency after a deepfake video featuring popular Indian actress Rashmika Mandanna went viral. For many young women who rely on social media for news, these developments are particularly troubling. The concept of deepfakes, which entered public discussion following fake videos of Bollywood celebrities, far exceeds past image editing tools like Photoshop. With AI, it’s now possible to fabricate highly realistic images and videos, significantly increasing privacy risks and misinformation. The surge in AI-generated celebrity videos has prompted debates over whether public conversations on AI focus too heavily on sensational incidents instead of essential topics like privacy, cybersecurity, or the positive roles of AI, such as early detection of breast cancer. It is especially disheartening that mainstream attention to the dangers of AI arose through a viral video targeting a female actor, amplifying the ongoing problem of sensationalism and objectification in media, which often impacts women the most. A WIRED article cites research from Deeptrace, an AI security firm, reporting that by September 2019 there were 15,000 deepfake videos online, 96 percent of them being pornographic. This exposes severe issues of cyberviolence and online harassment, disproportionately harming women, leading to psychological trauma and discouraging their participation online. The rapid pace of AI advancements highlights the global necessity for ethical norms, privacy safeguards, and stronger oversight. While Prime Minister Modi has publicly called for greater awareness, it’s also crucial for mainstream media to cover these topics responsibly and avoid sensationalism when reporting on synthetic media. Even as policy reforms are developed, it remains vital for individuals to critique and carefully evaluate online content, push back against misinformation, and defend the foundations of our digital community. Heightened vigilance and skepticism are our best tools against the fast-moving spread of falsehoods that threaten online truth. The writer is an enthusiast working between women’s health and artificial intelligence, committed to advancing sound technology policy.

Wannan matsala ta kara kamari ne bayan wani bidiyo na deepfake da ya shafi shahararriyar jarumar Indiya, Rashmika Mandanna, ya karade kafafen sada zumunta. Ga matasa mata da ke amfani da kafafen sada zumunta don samun labarai, wannan sabon salo yana kara fargaba. Kalmar deepfake ta fara shahara bayan bullar bidiyoyin bogi na ‘yan fim na Bollywood. Saboda AI, abin ya zarce gyaran hoto na Photoshop, domin yanzu za a iya kirkirar hotuna da bidiyoyi masu kama da gaske amma ba su da tushe, wanda hakan ke kara tsananta matsalar karya sirri da yada labaran karya. Yawaitar bidiyoyin da aka kirkira ta hanyar AI da ke nuna fitattun jaruman Indiya ya fito da tambaya: ko tattaunawa game da AI ta fi karkata ga abubuwan ban sha’awa fiye da hankali ga batutuwan kariyar sirri, tsaron bayanai, ko kuma amfani mai kyau na AI irin su gano cutar nono tun da wuri. Abin takaicin, wannan hankalin da ake baiwa fasahar AI ya fito ne ta dalilin bidiyo ta deepfake da ta shafi mace, lamarin da ya nunar da yadda kafafen yada labarai ke kokarin kokarta kan batun kasaita da cin zarafin mata. A cewar jaridar WIRED da binciken kamfanin tsaro na AI, Deeptrace, a watan Satumba 2019 an gano bidiyoyi 15,000 na deepfake a yanar gizo, inda kaso 96 cikin dari na wadannan bidiyoyin batsa ne. Wannan ya jaddada matsalar cin zarafi da barazana ga mata a intanet, wanda ke haddasa damuwa tare da takaita shirin matan shiga duniyar dijital. Saurin ci gaban AI yana kara tabbatar da bukatar dokoki, kariyar sirri, da kulawa mai kyau a duniya baki daya. Kiran Firayim Minista Modi na samar da wayar da kai yana da muhimmanci, amma kafafen watsa labarai ma na da rawar gani wajen bayar da labari cikin gaskiya da kaucewa ban tsoro game da synthetic media. Faɗakarwa da shakku su ne makamin yakar karya da tafiyar da gaskiya a duniyar sada zumunta. Marubuci na aiki tsakanin fannin lafiyar mata da fasahar wucin gadi, kuma yana da kishin samar da ingantattun manufofin fasaha.

article_content: Marilyn Jean Hartman, described by authorities as a serial stowaway, was re-arrested at Los Angeles International Airport on Thursday, just a day after pleading no contest to stowing away on a flight. Airport police reported that Hartman spent about an hour moving through LAX's passenger terminals before her arrest. She did not possess a ticket or boarding pass, nor did officers see her attempt to purchase one. Airport Police Chief Patrick Gannon stated that flyers with Hartman's photo were distributed ahead of her release from prior custody. Earlier in the week, authorities said the 62-year-old managed to get through security at Mineta San Jose International Airport and boarded a Southwest Airlines flight to LAX without a ticket. She was arrested upon arrival at LAX. On Wednesday, Hartman pleaded no contest to a misdemeanor charge of stowing away, according to CNN affiliate KTLA. She received a sentence of two years probation and three days in jail, was credited for time served, and subsequently released. Outside the courthouse, Hartman refused to detail her method for breaching airport security, saying, “I don’t think it’s wise to say how I got through. I don’t want to help the enemy.” She also stated that she wants to fly legally and acknowledged that her actions were wrong and not something she wants to repeat. Authorities note that Hartman has repeatedly tried to board flights without a ticket, notably to Hawaii from San Francisco International Airport. Earlier this year, she received probation and was ordered to stay away from that airport. Reporting by CNN's Chelsea J. Carter and Randi Kaye.

article_content: Honduras has elected Porfirio Lobo Sosa as its new president, but the legitimacy of the election is disputed. The vote took place under interim President Roberto Micheletti, who assumed power after a June 28 coup ousted President Jose Manuel Zelaya. Many countries had warned they would not recognize the election unless Zelaya was restored. The United States, Colombia, and Costa Rica have stated they will recognize Lobo, while Argentina, Brazil, and Spain refuse. Zelaya, who called for a boycott, also said he would not recognize the results. The US government is urging Honduras to resolve the political crisis, including a congressional vote on restoring Zelaya, as outlined in a US-brokered agreement. Officials repeated that the election alone is insufficient to resolve the crisis. The Supreme Electoral Tribunal has not officially confirmed results, but early counts indicate Lobo, representing the National Party, defeated Liberal Party candidate Elvin Santos. Both Zelaya and Micheletti belong to the Liberal Party, whose split may have affected Santos's campaign. Lobo has pledged to unite the nation and is open to meeting with Zelaya. Since secretly returning to Honduras in September, Zelaya has been staying at the Brazilian Embassy in Tegucigalpa. Analysts believe Lobo might create a unity government and offer Zelaya amnesty to end Honduras’s isolation. Lobo narrowly lost to Zelaya in 2005 but now says he is committed to action and national reconciliation. Other candidates included Bernard Martinez (Innovation and Unity Party-Social-Democracy), Felicito Avila (Christian Democrat Party), and Cesar Ham (Democratic Unification Party). Carlos Reyes withdrew in November. The United States praised voter turnout, calling it an important step in addressing the crisis. Still, the United Nations, Organization of American States, and European Union had previously condemned the coup and demanded Zelaya’s return. A congressional vote about Zelaya’s reinstatement is expected soon, following a Supreme Court ruling that Zelaya must first face charges stemming from an attempt to hold a referendum on ending presidential term limits. The coup occurred the day this vote was scheduled. Micheletti, who temporarily stepped down to distance himself from the election, plans to resume office. He praised the peaceful turnout. Despite fears, election day was calm, with over 35,000 police and soldiers deployed. Amnesty International called on authorities to disclose details about detainees from election weekend. Porfirio Lobo Sosa is set to be sworn in as president on January 27.
translated_content: Honduras ta zabi Porfirio Lobo Sosa a matsayin sabon shugaban kasa, amma tambayar sahihancin zaben tana ci gaba da janyo muhawara. An gudanar da zaben ne karkashin shugabancin rikon kwarya Roberto Micheletti, wanda ya hau mulki bayan juyin mulki na 28 ga Yuni da ya kifar da shugaban kasa Jose Manuel Zelaya. Kasashe da dama sun yi gargadi cewa ba za su amince da zaben ba sai an dawo da Zelaya. Amurka, Colombia da Costa Rica sun nuna za su amince da Lobo, yayin da Argentina, Brazil da Spain suka ki amincewa. Zelaya, wanda ya bukaci a kaurace wa zaben, ya ce shi ma ba zai amince da sakamakon ba. Gwamnatin Amurka na matsa lamba ga Honduras don warware rikicin siyasa, ciki har da zaben majalisa kan dawo da Zelaya, kamar yadda wata yarjejeniyar Amurka ta tanada. Jami’ai sun jaddada cewa zabe kawai ba zai iya warware matsalar ba. Hukumar Kula da Zabe ba ta fitar da sakamako na hukuma ba tukuna, amma kirga na farko ya nuna cewa Lobo daga jam’iyyar National Party ya kayar da Elvin Santos na jam’iyyar Liberal Party. Duk Zelaya da Micheletti ’yan jam’iyyar Liberal ne, kuma rabuwar kawunansu na iya shafar takarar Santos. Lobo ya sha alwashin hada kan kasa kuma yana bayyana cewa zai iya haduwa da Zelaya. Tun daga dawowar sirri da Zelaya ya yi Honduras a watan Satumba, ya ke zaune a ofishin jakadancin Brazil a Tegucigalpa. Masana na cewa Lobo zai iya kafa gwamnati hadaka da bayar da afuwa ga Zelaya don kawo karshen sakawa Honduras baya. Lobo ya sha kaye da Zelaya a 2005, amma yanzu yana dagewa kan hada kan kasa. Sauran ’yan takara sun hada da Bernard Martinez (Innovation and Unity Party-Social Democracy), Felicito Avila (Christian Democrat Party) da Cesar Ham (Democratic Unification Party). Carlos Reyes ya janye daga takara a watan Nuwamba. Amurka ta yabawa yawan fitowar masu zabe, tana ganinsa muhimmin mataki wajen warware rikicin. Sai dai Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Kungiyar Kasashen Amurka da Tarayyar Turai sun soki juyin mulkin tare da neman a koma da Zelaya. Ana sa ran majalisa za ta kada kuri’a kan dawo da Zelaya baya jimawa, bayan kotun kolin kasar ta ce dole ne Zelaya ya fara fuskantar tuhuma kan yunkurin gudanar da kuri’ar jin ra’ayi kan wa’adin shugabanci. Juyin mulkin ya faru a ranar da aka tsara wannan zaben na jin ra’ayi. Micheletti, wanda ya sauka na dan lokaci domin ya nesanta kansa daga zaben, yana shirin komawa ofis. Ya yabawa lumana a ranar zabe. Duk da fargaba, ranar zaben ta gudana lafiya, inda ’yan sanda da sojoji sama da 35,000 suka tsarawa kasa duka. Kungiyar Amnesty International ta bukaci hukumomi su bayyana sunaye da bayanai kan wadanda aka tsare a karshen makon zaben. An tsara rantsar da Porfirio Lobo Sosa a matsayin shugaban kasa ranar 27 ga Janairu.

article_content: Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas has, for the first time, recused himself from a case connected to the January 6, 2021 attack on the U.S. Capitol. His decision involved an appeal by John Eastman, a former Trump attorney and one-time law clerk to Thomas, who sought to block his former employer from handing over emails to the now-dissolved January 6 Congressional committee. Eastman is currently facing criminal charges in Georgia related to attempts to overturn the 2020 presidential election. Like other justices, Thomas did not provide a reason for his recusal from the Monday case. Notably, he had previously faced calls to step aside from January 6 and 2020 election matters, due in part to his wife, Virginia "Ginny" Thomas's, public support for efforts to overturn the election results. Earlier this year, Thomas was the sole justice to support former President Trump’s bid to keep White House documents away from the January 6 committee and chose not to recuse himself then. Recent ProPublica reports have alleged a pattern of ethical misconduct by Thomas, including accepting and failing to disclose luxury vacations from GOP donor Harlan Crow. A Bloomberg Law analysis noted that Thomas recuses himself less frequently than his peers on the Supreme Court. Scott Lemieux, a constitutional law expert at the University of Washington, suggested the recent increased scrutiny may have played a role in Thomas’ decision. 'The fact that he didn't recuse himself in previous cases involving the 2020 election makes it hard to imagine these recent stories aren't playing a role here,' Lemieux told Insider. The Supreme Court declined to review Eastman’s appeal, which Lemieux described as having little legal merit since the committee had already obtained and published the contested emails. The court provided no explanation beyond recording Thomas's recusal. Lemieux suggested the move may have been symbolic, allowing Thomas to address criticism without significantly impacting the case’s outcome. Supreme Court justices are expected to recuse themselves when a conflict of interest arises, but as Lemieux noted, the system lacks mechanisms to enforce such recusal decisions. Regardless of his reasoning, Lemieux said Thomas's recusal in the Eastman appeal was the right decision, adding, 'The justices have to be convinced that if they do unethical things, it will hurt the legitimacy of the Supreme Court.'
translated_content: Alkalin Kotun Koli Clarence Thomas ya cire kansa daga wani shari’a da ta shafi harin da aka kai Majalisar Dokoki a ranar 6 ga Janairu, 2021, karon farko. Wannan matakin ya shafi koken John Eastman, tsohon lauya na Trump kuma wanda ya taba yin aiki a matsayin hadimin shari’a ga Thomas, wanda ke kokarin hana tsohon maigidansa mika wasu sakonnin imel ga kwamiti na 6 ga Janairu wanda aka rusa. Yanzu haka Eastman yana fuskantar tuhumar aikata laifuka a jihar Georgia dangane da kokarin dakile zaben shugaban kasa na 2020. Kamar yadda sauran alkalai ke yi, Thomas bai bayyana dalilinsa na janye kansa daga shari’ar ranar Litinin ba. Abin lura, an taba nemansa ya janye kansa daga shari’o’i da suka shafi 6 ga Janairu da batun zaben 2020, musamman saboda matarsa, Virginia "Ginny" Thomas, ta nuna goyon baya ga kokarin rushe sakamakon zaben. Farkon wannan shekarar, Thomas ne kadai ya mara wa Trump baya, yana goyon bayan kin mika wasu takardun fadar White House ga kwamiti, kuma bai cire kansa ba a wancan lokacin. Rahotannin ProPublica kwanan nan sun zargi Thomas da cin gajiyar wasu fa’idodi ba tare da bayyana su ba, kamar shakatawa na alfarma daga mai taimako ga jam’iyyar Republican, Harlan Crow. Nazarin Bloomberg Law ya nuna Thomas ba ya janye kansa daga shari’o’in kotu fiye da sauran abokan aikinsa. Scott Lemieux, kwararre a tsarin dokar kundin tsarin mulki daga Jami’ar Washington, ya yi nuni da cewa samun wani matsin lamba daga kafafen yada labarai a baya-bayan nan ka iya sa Thomas ya yanke wannan hukunci. 'Idan ya ki cire kansa daga shari’o’i da suka shafi zaben 2020 da farko, sai dai in ba wai wadannan sabbin labaran sun taka rawa ba,' in ji Lemieux ga Insider. Kotun Koli ta ki amincewa da koken Eastman, wanda Lemieux ya bayyana da cewa ba shi da wani dogon tushe a doka domin kwamiti ya riga ya samu kuma ya wallafa sakonnin imel din da ake takaddama da su. Kotun ba ta bayar da wata karin bayani ba sai dai ambaton cewa Thomas ya janye kansa. Lemieux ya ce yiwuwar wannan matsayi na Thomas ya kasance tamkar alamar amsa korafe-korafen da ba zai shafi sakamakon shari’ar ba. Ana sa ran alkalai su cire kansu daga shari’o’in da ke da rashin jin dadi ko banbanci, amma kamar yadda Lemieux ya ce, babu wata doka da ke tilasta hakan a tsarin kotun. Ko menene dalilinsa, Lemieux ya ce janye kan Thomas a karar Eastman ya dace, yana mai cewa: 'Dole ne alkalai su gane cewa idan suka aikata ba daidai ba, hakan zai iya zubar wa kotun mutunci.'

Salvador Orozco, 48, was recently arrested in Hawaii on suspicion of involvement in a rape that happened in Gateshead, England, in 1990. Orozco was found at a residence in the Kahului area of Hawaii, where authorities apprehended him last Thursday under a UK extradition warrant. 

The incident under investigation dates back to May 17, 1990, when a 20-year-old woman was attacked as she walked home from work on Askew Road, Gateshead. The attacker dragged her into a secluded yard and assaulted her.

After allegedly fleeing the UK, Orozco was able to avoid law enforcement for over twenty years, living undetected in parts of America before settling in Hawaii. 

UK authorities, working with the US Justice Department and the British Embassy, have collaborated to facilitate the arrest and are now waiting for Orozco's extradition to Britain for questioning.

A Home Office official confirmed, 'Salvador Orozco was arrested on February 7 in Hawaii on a UK extradition warrant for alleged sexual offences from 1990. The extradition process is currently in the hands of US authorities.' 

Northumbria Police have also confirmed that their investigation into the 1990 crime is still ongoing and that they have been informed of Orozco's arrest.

article_content: For decades, researchers and organizations have tried to estimate the number of gay, lesbian, and bisexual people in the United States, but concrete figures were elusive. For the first time, the decennial U.S. Census has reported counts of same-sex partners and spouses, regardless of state marriage laws. Recent census data show more people openly identifying as gay and living in more locations. Headlines reflect national trends: New Jersey has seen a sharp rise in gay couples. South Carolina reports changing family structures, and Iowa has seen a 77% increase in same-sex households. Provincetown, Massachusetts, is labeled 'America's Gayest City.' Since June, the U.S. Census Bureau has released state data, including how many children are raised in same-sex parent households. National numbers are expected in November. Demographer Gary Gates from UCLA Law School's Williams Institute reports about a 50% increase in same-sex couples since 2000, with some of the largest gains in conservative regions. Gates attributes the rise to increased acceptance and willingness to report, not a sudden increase in couples. States like Vermont, Massachusetts, California, Oregon, and Delaware, which allow same-sex unions or marriage, show higher proportions of same-sex couples. Additionally, places like Provincetown, Wilton Manors (Florida), and Rehoboth Beach (Delaware) serve as popular destinations for LGBT communities and show high concentrations. Gates notes that baby boomers were among the first visible LGBT generations, and many are now retiring in these communities. Despite more adoptions, the proportion of same-sex couples raising children has remained steady since 2000. Gates suggests fewer are raising children from previous heterosexual relationships as people come out earlier and are less likely to have children before coming out. Advocates argue accurate counts help develop policies relating to same-sex marriage or partner benefits. Brian Moulton of the Human Rights Campaign says knowing community numbers helps assess economic impacts and rights denial, especially regarding federal law. However, some say the census falls short by not directly asking if respondents are lesbian, gay, bisexual, or transgender. The census only reflects same-sex couples living together, omitting many within the LGBT community. Richard Socarides, president of Equality Matters, says any data is better than none for research, but comprehensive counts are still lacking. He notes that while heterosexual people are not identified explicitly, their rights are not as contested. Researchers estimate over 8 million U.S. adults identify as lesbian, gay, or bisexual, and approximately 700,000 as transgender. A 2011 study suggested almost 9 million Americans identify as LGBT. The Williams Institute found about 50,000 legally married same-sex couples and 85,000 in civil unions or domestic partnerships in various states. The census's recognition of same-sex couples is significant for advocacy. Before the census included these counts, nonprofits like United Way of Broward County, Florida, conducted local surveys to assess LGBT community needs, including questions about demographics, social issues, and support systems.
translated_content: Shekaru da dama, masu bincike da kungiyoyi sun yi ƙoƙarin ƙididdige adadin masu jima'i iri ɗaya (gay, lesbian, da bisexual) a Amurka, amma adadi tabbatattu ba su bayyana ba. A karon farko, binciken ƙididdiga na shekara goma (census) ya fitar da bayanan ma'aurata masu jinsi iri ɗaya ko abokan rayuwa, ko da a jihohinsu ba a amince da auren jinsi ɗaya ba. Sabbin bayanai sun nuna yawan mutane da ke bayyana kansu a fili a matsayin gay kuma suna zaune a wurare daban-daban. Rahotanni sun nuna abubuwan da ke faruwa a ƙasa baki ɗaya: New Jersey ta samu karuwar ma'auratan gay. South Carolina na cewa tsarin iyali yana canzawa, kuma Iowa ta ga karuwar kashi 77% na gidajen jinsi ɗaya. Provincetown, Massachusetts, ana kiranta 'Birni mafi yawan gay a Amurka.' Tun watan Yuni, hukumar ƙididdiga ta Amurka tana sakin bayanan jihohi, ciki har da yawan yara dake rayuwa a cikin iyayen jinsi ɗaya. Ana sa ran adadin ƙasa gaba ɗaya za su fito a watan Nuwamba. Masani Gary Gates daga Williams Institute na UCLA Law School ya ce akwai ƙaruwa kimanin kashi 50% na ma'auratan jinsi iri ɗaya tun 2000, musamman a wurare masu ra'ayin mazan jiya. Gates ya ce wannan ƙaruwa ta samo asali ne daga karɓar al'umma da mutane sun fi yarda su bayyana kansu, ba wai ma'aurata sun ƙaru ba kwatsam. Jihohi irin su Vermont, Massachusetts, California, Oregon, da Delaware, waɗanda ke yarda da auren jinsi ɗaya ko haɗin zamantakewa, suna da yawan ma'auratan jinsi ɗaya. Haka nan, wurare kamar Provincetown, Wilton Manors (Florida), da Rehoboth Beach (Delaware) wurare ne da LGBT ke da yawa. Gates ya ce baby boomers su ne suka fara bayyana kansu a fili kuma yanzu da dama suna yin ritaya a irin waɗannan wuraren. Duk da karuwar ɗaukar yara (adoption), kawo yanzu adadin ma'auratan jinsi ɗaya da ke rainon yara bai ƙaru sosai ba tun 2000. Gates ya danganta hakan da raguwar wadanda ke da yara daga tsohuwar dangantaka ta jinsi daban, saboda yanzu ana fitowa fili da wuri kuma mutane ba su da yara kafin hakan. Masu kare hakkin LGBT suna cewa sahihan ƙididdiga na taimakawa wajen tsara manufofi kan auren jinsi ɗaya ko wasu fa'idodi. Brian Moulton na Human Rights Campaign ya ce sanin adadin jama'a zai taimaka fahimtar tasirin tattalin arziki da yadda rashin hakki ke shafar wasu, musamman a matakin dokar tarayya. Sai dai wasu na ganin binciken ƙididdigar bai isa ba saboda ba'a tambayi mutane kai tsaye ko su lesbian, gay, bisexual, ko transgender ba. Kawai waɗanda ke zaune tare a matsayin ma'aurata ko abokan zama ne aka ƙidaya, wanda hakan ya bar da yawa daga cikin LGBT a waje. Richard Socarides, shugaban Equality Matters, ya ce kowanne irin bayanan ƙididdiga ya fi babu komai ga bincike, amma har yanzu akwai gibi. Ya ce ko da ba a bayyana masu jima'i daban kai tsaye ba, hakkinsu ba sa cikin muhawara sosai kamar na LGBT. Bincike ya nuna cewa fiye da mutane miliyan 8 a Amurka suna bayyana kansu a matsayin lesbian, gay, ko bisexual, sannan kusan mutane 700,000 suna transgender. Bincike a 2011 ya nuna kusan Amurkawa miliyan 9 na bayyana kansu LGBT. Williams Institute ya ƙiyasta sama da ma'auratan jinsi ɗaya 50,000 sun yi aure a wasu jihohi, sannan 85,000 na da haɗin zamantakewa ko partnership a wasu jihohi. Amincewar census da lissafa ma'auratan jinsi ɗaya babban ci gaba ne ga masu kare hakki. Kafin haka, kungiyoyi irin su United Way na Broward County, Florida, sun fitar da nasu bincike don gano bukatun al'ummar LGBT, ciki har da tambayoyin al'umma, matsaloli, da goyon bayan juna.

article_content: Marshall B. Grossman, a formidable and widely respected Los Angeles attorney known for representing high-profile figures such as Steven Spielberg, Clint Eastwood, J.K. Rowling, and Netflix, has passed away at age 84. The Daily Journal reported his death but did not specify the cause. Over his distinguished 55-year career, Grossman advocated for clients like Mariah Carey, Tommy Hilfiger, Dr. Dre, Larry King, Grupo Televisa, Apple Computer, Cirque du Soleil, Blockbuster, and many others in a broad range of legal matters. He made history by litigating California’s first successful consumer class action, one of his earliest cases after graduating from USC Law School in 1964. Among other notable cases, Grossman represented Billy Bush following the release of the infamous ‘Access Hollywood’ tape in 2016 and secured a $55 million judgment for TV personality Erin Andrews, who was secretly filmed in her hotel room. Born on March 24, 1939, in Omaha, Nebraska, Grossman moved to Los Angeles as a child and followed in his father’s footsteps, who became director of the Hollywood USO. He co-founded The Association of Business Trial Lawyers in 1973, held various positions at Los Angeles law firms, and achieved the role of managing partner at Alschuler Grossman after joining in 1995. Despite a challenging merger with Stein & Kahan in 1999, which ended in 2007, Grossman later joined Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe and retired as a partner. Grossman’s high-profile cases included representing Netflix in a patent-infringement lawsuit and Blockbuster in a class action; he also won a judgment helping Agudas Chasidei Chabad recover religious texts seized during the Bolshevik Revolution and testified before a House subcommittee on land use disputes. Active in the legal community, Grossman served on the board of the Beverly Hills Bar Association and as President of the BHBA Barristers. He was consistently recognized with honors, such as inclusion in Los Angeles Business Journal’s list of the 500 most influential people (2017), the Century City Bar Association’s Litigator of the Year (2010), multiple appearances in The Best Lawyers in America, and top rankings by Chambers Global, Chambers USA, and the Daily Journal’s Top 100 Most Influential Lawyers in California. Grossman is survived by his wife, Marlene, their daughter and son, and several grandchildren.
translated_content: Marshall B. Grossman, fitaccen lauyan Los Angeles mai ƙarfi kuma mai daraja, wanda aka san shi da kare shahararrun mutane kamar su Steven Spielberg, Clint Eastwood, J.K. Rowling, da Netflix, ya rasu yana da shekaru 84. Jaridar Daily Journal ta ruwaito mutuwarsa ba tare da fadin dalili ba. A cikin shekaru 55 da ya shafe yana aiki, Grossman ya wakilci mutane da kamfanoni masu suna da dama irin su Mariah Carey, Tommy Hilfiger, Dr. Dre, Larry King, Grupo Televisa, Apple Computer, Cirque du Soleil, Blockbuster da sauran su a fannoni daban-daban na shari'a. Grossman ya kafa tarihi wajen gabatar da shari'ar 'consumer class action' ta farko da ta ci nasara a California, daya daga cikin shari'o'insa na farko bayan ya kammala karatu daga makarantar koyon lauya ta USC a 1964. Daga cikin shari'o'in sa na musamman, ya wakilci Billy Bush bayan bullar bidiyon ‘Access Hollywood’ a 2016 sannan ya samu wa jigon talabijin Erin Andrews hukuncin dala miliyan 55 bayan an dauke ta hoton tsiraici a dakin otel ba tare da izini ba. An haifi Grossman a ranar 24 ga Maris, 1939 a Omaha, Nebraska. Ya koma Los Angeles yana yaro bayan mahaifinsa ya zama darektan Hollywood USO. A 1973, Grossman ya kafa kungiyar Association of Business Trial Lawyers, sannan ya rike mukamai daban-daban a kamfanonin lauyoyi na LA har ya zama babban shugaba a Alschuler Grossman tun bayan shiga a 1995. Bayan hadewar kamfanin lauya da Stein & Kahan a 1999 wanda ba ta dore ba, Grossman daga bisani ya shiga Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe inda ya yi ritaya a matsayin abokin aiki. Grossman ya yi shari'o'i da dama masu tasiri ciki har da kare Netflix cikin shari'ar hakkokin kirkira da Blockbuster a cikin shari'ar 'class action'. Ya kuma taimaka wa Agudas Chasidei Chabad wajen dawo da littattafan addini da aka kwace lokacin juyin juya halin Bolshevik, da kuma shaida wa kwamitin Majalisar Dattawa game da rikicin amfani da filaye. A matsayin mai aiki sosai a masarautar lauya, Grossman ya kasance memba a hukumar Beverly Hills Bar Association da shugaban BHBA Barristers. An jinjinawa kokarinsa ta hanyar sanya shi cikin jerin ‘mutane 500 mafi tasiri’ na Los Angeles Business Journal (2017), Litigator of the Year na Century City Bar Association (2010), jerin The Best Lawyers in America, da kuma samun matsayi mafi tsoka a Chambers Global, Chambers USA, da Daily Journal Top 100 Most Influential Lawyers in California. article_content: On Sunday, residents of Igbomotoru in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area, Bayelsa State, organized a peaceful demonstration after military gunboats arrived in their coastal community. The protest, which involved youths, elders, women, and local leaders, was shared online. According to the protesters, the military operation was allegedly initiated by Joshua Maciver, the All Progressives Congress (APC) deputy governorship candidate from the recent state election. Protesters allege Maciver leveraged Tantita Security Services Limited, a security firm, to sow unrest in the area and is attempting to install Friday Jonathan, a candidate previously rejected by locals, as paramount ruler. The community has vowed to resist imposed leadership. A man, identifying himself as the community’s deputy paramount ruler, described Igbomotoru as previously peaceful and urged both federal and state governments to investigate the actions of Tantita and Maciver. He further claimed there were plans to bring in a leader from another town. In addition, an elderly woman speaking in Izon warned against bringing trouble to the community and underscored their determination to oppose any outsider being imposed as ruler. Lucky Okodeh, caretaker chairman for Southern Ijaw, voiced similar concerns. He condemned Tantita Security Services’ conduct, pointing to a September incident in which its operatives allegedly invaded neighboring Okpotuwari, causing chaos and destruction. Okodeh reported intervening to restore calm and called for a thorough investigation into the company’s actions, directing security agencies to safeguard the region. Attempts to contact Maciver for comment were unsuccessful. A spokesperson promised to provide Maciver’s response but had not done so at the time of reporting. Likewise, calls to a Tantita official were not returned.

Masu zanga-zangar—matasa, dattawa, mata da shugabannin al'umma—sun wallafa bidiyo a yanar gizo suna cewa harin sojojin an yi shi ne da bukatar Joshua Maciver, mataimakin dan takarar gwamna na jam’iyyar APC a zaben kwanan nan. Masu zanga-zangar sun zargi Maciver da amfani da kamfanin Tantita Security Services Limited wajen haddasa tashin hankali a wasu yankuna, da kokarin dora Friday Jonathan wanda ba a so ya zama sarkin kauyen. Al'umma ta sha alwashin ba za ta lamunci a dora musu shugaba da karfi ba. Wani da ya yi magana a matsayin mataimakin sarkin kauyen ya bayyana cewa kauyen tun da fari yana cikin kwanciyar hankali, ya kuma bukaci gwamnati ta tarayya da ta jiha su binciki ayyukan Tantita da Maciver. Ya kuma yi ikirarin cewa akwai shirin kai wani daga wani yanki don nada shi a matsayin sarkin Igbomotoru. Haka wata tsohuwa mai magana da harshen Izon ta gargadi masu neman tada husuma a cikin gari, inda ta kara da cewa ba za su yadda a dorawa kauyen shugaba daga waje ba. Shugaban kwamitin rikon kwarya na Southern Ijaw, Lucky Okodeh, shima ya yi korafi iri daya. Ya ce Tantita Security Services sun ci doka, inda ya kawo misalin wani abu da ya faru a watan Satumba lokacin da jami'an Tantita suka kai farmaki ga kauyen Okpotuwari, wanda ya haddasa rikici da asarar dukiya. Okodeh ya ce ya sa baki aka dawo da zaman lafiya tare da kiran da a gudanar da bincike sosai kan Tantita, yana kuma rokon jami'an tsaro su tabbatar da tsaro a yankin. An yi kokarin samun martanin Maciver amma lamarin bai yuwu ba, yayin da wani kakakinsa ya ce zai tattaro martanin amma bai aiko ba har zuwa lokacin hada rahoton. Hakanan duk kira zuwa ga kakakin Tantita ba a samu amsa ba.

article_content: Think dressing up is just for kids? Not anymore. Cosplay, which stands for 'costume play', has become a worldwide phenomenon, and a newly released book titled 'Cosplay World' captures this vibrant scene through hundreds of photographs of adults dressed as their favorite characters. Starting as a niche activity in Japan, cosplay has flourished globally thanks to the power of the internet. The book showcases creative costumes, like a futuristic Wonder Woman ensemble complete with chrome cuffs and a metallic belt, and detailed portrayals of characters such as Daenerys Targaryen from Game of Thrones. 'Cosplay World' traces the evolution of costume play from its origin nearly a century ago, highlighting its growth into a popular form of art and self-expression. The book is packed with vivid images showing fans transforming into iconic characters from anime, movies, games, and comics. Stunning photography reveals elaborate outfits made with advanced materials and crafted props. Costumes range from superheroes like Superman and Captain America, to fantasy and game-inspired figures such as Empress Himiko and Maleficent. Beyond dress-up, cosplay has developed rich communities, its own media, shops, events, and a strong presence in the digital era. The book also features interviews with leading cosplayers, skilled photographers, and talented prop makers — including Yaya Han, Crystal Graziano, Spiral Cats, and others — offering a deep dive into the subculture’s dynamic world. Co-authored by Brian Ashcraft, a Japan-based journalist, and Luke Plunkett, an Australian writer, ‘Cosplay World’ delivers both a celebration and thoughtful exploration of the global cosplay phenomenon. The book is available now from Prestel for £19.99.

Cosplay, wanda ke nufin 'costume play', yanzu ya zama abin shahara a duniya baki daya, kuma sabon littafin ‘Cosplay World’ ya tara hotunan daruruwan manyan da ke shigar jaruman da suka fi so. Wannan al’ada ta fara ne a matsayin ƙaramar sha’awa a Japan, yanzu cosplay ya bazu ko’ina a duniya ta hanyar intanet. Littafin yana bayani kan kayan sawa na zamani, kamar wata sabuwar rigar Wonder Woman da aka kawata da cuff na chrome da bel na ƙarfe, da kuma ɗaukar fasalin jarumai irinsu Daenerys Targaryen daga Game of Thrones. ‘Cosplay World’ yana bin tarihin cosplay tun sama da shekara dari, yana bada haske kan yadda ya zama fasaha kuma wata hanya ce na bayyana kanka. Littafin ya cika da hotunan masoya da suke canzawa zuwa shahararrun jaruman fina-finai, anime, wasanni da littattafai. Hotuna masu ban sha’awa sun nuna kaya da aka kera da sabbin fasahohi da kayan zamani. Suna hada da jarumai kamar Superman da Captain America, da kuma fitattun ‘yan wasa kamar Empress Himiko da Maleficent. Fiye da saka kaya, cosplay ya haifar da al’ummomi, mujallu, shaguna, taruka da kuma manyan kafafen sadarwa a zamanin dijital. Littafin ya haɗa zantuka da fitattun masu cosplay, ƙwararrun masu daukar hoto, da kuma wadanda ke kera kayan wasa — irinsu Yaya Han, Crystal Graziano, Spiral Cats da sauransu — yana ba da cikakkiyar fahimta a cikin wannan al’ada mai armashi. Marubutan littafin su ne Brian Ashcraft, ɗan jarida daga Japan, da Luke Plunkett, marubuci daga Ostraliya. ‘Cosplay World’ na da nufin murna da kimantawa ga wannan mashahurin al’ada. Ana iya samun littafin yanzu daga Prestel kan £19.99.

article_content: The Ogun State Government reaffirmed its commitment to leveraging Information and Communication Technology (ICT) to further empower citizens, promote entrepreneurship, and curb brain drain. Dayo Abiodun, Special Adviser on ICT to Governor Dapo Abiodun, made this known during an Abuja event on Thursday, where the state was recognized as the second runner-up for the 'Most Digitally Compliant State' at the 2023 Digital Nigeria Award by the National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA). Abiodun stated that the administration remains dedicated to equipping citizens—especially the youth—with up-to-date skills in cybersecurity, data analysis, and web design, ensuring relevance in the global tech landscape. He urged interested individuals to enroll in the ongoing '3 million Technical Talent' training program organized by NITDA. Attributing the accolade to Governor Dapo Abiodun's digital initiatives, the Special Adviser emphasized that the state government is investing significantly in a variety of training opportunities for residents. He said, 'This recognition is a testament to the remarkable progress we have made in digital transformation and compliance with evolving digital standards under Governor Prince Dapo Abiodun’s leadership.' Abiodun assured that the administration will continue to promote digital skills that empower citizens to become self-reliant and access global job opportunities while residing in Nigeria.

Dayo Abiodun, mai ba Gwamna Dapo Abiodun shawara kan ICT, ya bayyana haka a wani taro a Abuja, inda aka karrama jihar a matsayi na uku wajen 'Jihar da tafi bin matakan dijital' a gasar 2023 Digital Nigeria Award da Hukumar Ci Gaban Fasahar Sadarwa ta Kasa (NITDA) ta shirya. article_content: China and the United States traded accusations over the weekend regarding an incident in the disputed South China Sea. China's military announced it had driven away a US warship, while the US Navy maintained its vessel was conducting a routine freedom of navigation operation. According to the Chinese People's Liberation Army Southern Theatre Command, Chinese naval and air forces tracked, monitored, and warned away the US destroyer. The US Navy, however, stated that the USS Hopper was asserting navigational rights near the Paracel Islands, in accordance with international law. China claims nearly the entire South China Sea, through which more than $3 trillion in annual trade passes, overlapping with territorial claims by the Philippines, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Brunei. The Permanent Court of Arbitration ruled in 2016 that China's claims have no legal basis. On Saturday, the Philippines and Australia began their first joint sea and air patrols in the South China Sea. This came days after Beijing accused Manila of involving foreign forces in patrols, referencing joint Philippine-US military operations. Following the incident, China stated that this proves the United States is a 'security risk creator' in the South China Sea. Lieutenant Kristina Weidemann, deputy spokesperson for the US 7th Fleet, commented that the United States challenges excessive maritime claims around the world. She added that 'unlawful and sweeping maritime claims in the South China Sea pose a serious threat to the freedom of the seas.' Earlier this month, the US and China held discussions on maritime issues, including tensions in the South China Sea. The US State Department reported concerns about 'dangerous and unlawful' Chinese actions during these talks.

article_content:
The Niger State Police Command has taken Ahmed Aliyu, a resident of Zaria in Kaduna State, into custody for allegedly stealing two horses from a farm. Reports indicate that Aliyu had been visiting the farm in Chekungi village, near Bida, frequently, claiming his visits were for horse grooming and racing activities. On the evening of October 3, 2023, two female horses went missing from a stable where about five horses were kept. The farm owner, noticing Aliyu’s recent activity, suspected him and filed a report with the police on October 4. 

Police arrested Aliyu shortly afterwards. During interrogation, he admitted he had moved the horses to a nearby bush and then hired a driver for N100,000 to help transport them to Kaduna. The driver reportedly dropped the horses at Mararaban-Jos in Kaduna State, and arrangements were made for another vehicle to bring them back to Bida. According to Police Public Relations Officer Wasiu Abiodun, the suspect remains in police custody as the investigation continues.

Mai gonar, bayan ya lura da shigowar Ahmed a kwanan nan, ya zarge shi, ya kai rahoto ga 'yan sanda ranar 4 ga Oktoba.

'Yan sanda sun banka wa Ahmed Aliyu cikin hanzari. A lokacin bincike, ya amsa cewa ya boye dawakin a daji sannan ya dauki direba a kan Naira 100,000 dan kai su Kaduna. article_content: Building on the commercial success of Dr Organic's Snail Gel face and body cream, the company is launching additional products featuring snail slime, specifically from Helix Aspersa Muller, as a primary ingredient. The manufacturer claims these products can visibly reduce the signs of ageing, with some users purportedly appearing up to six years younger after four weeks, although these results are based on company reports and not independent studies. The expanded range, supported by a £600,000 marketing campaign, will be promoted by singer and model Louise Redknapp and is reportedly favored by celebrities like Katie Holmes and Ashley Roberts. These products are available exclusively at Holland & Barrett. Snail slime used in the products contains proteins, antioxidants, and hyaluronic acid, which are believed to remove dead skin cells, reduce inflammation, and help the skin retain moisture. The supposed skincare benefits were first noted by Chilean snail farmers who found their skin healed rapidly and without scarring when handling snails. According to Dr Organic's marketing director Martin Lightowlers, the snail slime is ethically harvested from specialist farms designed to support snail populations. The snails are encouraged to mate using natural plant hormones, and their secretions are gently collected as they move across glass plates, then processed into cosmetic ingredients. The original gel is priced at £19.99 for a 50ml jar, and new offerings include an eye serum, face mask, face cream, and hand and nail elixir. Alongside snail slime, the products incorporate natural extracts like aloe vera and jojoba, valued for their anti-ageing qualities. A new ingredient, proteolea, has been added to enhance these effects. Marketing efforts also aim to address consumer skepticism, as highlighted by branding expert Kate Waddell, who notes that convincing prospective users will require strong reassurance and authentic reviews.

Kamfanin yana ikirarin cewa kayayyakin na iya rage alamun tsufa a fili, inda wasu masu amfani suke iya kallon kamar sun karanci shekaru shida a cikin makonni hudu, amma wannan sakamakon yana bisa rahoton kamfanin, ba hujjar bincike mai zaman kansa ba. Sabbin kayayyakin, da kamfen din talla na £600,000 ke tallatawa, za a fito da su ta hannun mawakiya/kuma samfurta Louise Redknapp, sannan ana rade-radin fitattun mutane kamar Katie Holmes da Ashley Roberts suna amfani da su. Kayayyakin za a iya samu ne kawai a shagunan Holland & Barrett. Danko na kurkuku da ke cikin kayayyakin na dauke da sinadaran protein, antioxidants, da hyaluronic acid, wadanda ake tsammanin suna taimakawa wajen cire matattun kwayoyin fata, rage kumburi, da kuma taimakawa fata ta riƙe danshi. Amfanin hakan ya fara bayyana ne daga manoman kurkuku a Chile da suka lura fatar hannunsu na warke da sauri ba tare da tabo ba yayin sarrafa kurkuku. A cewar Daraktan Tallan Dr Organic, Martin Lightowlers, ana samun dankon kurkuku ne cikin kulawa a gonakin musamman don yawaita kurkuku. Ana karfafa kurkuku yin aure ta hanyar amfani da sinadaran tsirrai, kuma ana tattara danko lokacin da su ka ratsa faranti na gilashi, daga bisani a sarrafa shi zuwa kayan kwalliya. Gel na asali yana farashin £19.99 don kwalba 50ml, kuma sabbin kayayyakin sun hada da eye serum, face mask, face cream, da hand and nail elixir. Baya ga dankon kurkuku, an hada kayayyakin da sinadaran halitta irin su aloe vera da jojoba wadanda aka sani suna taimakawa wajen dakile tsufa. An kuma kara sinadari mai suna proteolea don ƙarfafa tasirin anti-ageing. article_content: In an unusual incident in Begusarai, Bihar, a man named Ajay Kumar allowed his wife, Kajal, to marry her lover, Raj Kumar Thakur. Ajay and Kajal had been married since 2018 and have two children together. Kajal maintained a close relationship with Raj, which began before her marriage to Ajay and continued afterwards. When Ajay discovered the ongoing affair, he decided to arrange Kajal and Raj’s marriage at a village temple. He stated, "There was no point in continuing with her as she had been in a relationship with Thakur. Arranging their marriage protected her from my family’s anger and gave her the freedom she wanted." Ajay chose to take responsibility for the couple’s two children, so that Kajal would not face difficulties with her new partner. The local village sarpanch, Ram Sahar Sahni, mentioned that since the decision was made within the family, the villagers accepted it without objection. The incident took place on Tuesday in Dahia village, Begusarai district, Bihar.

Shirya aurensu ya kareta daga fushin iyalina kuma ya bata 'yancin da take so." Ajay ya yanke shawarar daukar nauyin yaran biyu, domin Kajal ta samu saukin rayuwa tare da sabon mijinta.
