article_content: England's disappointing performance at the Cricket World Cup has caused shock at home, signaling the end of a remarkable era, according to former captain Nasser Hussain. After a heavy defeat by Sri Lanka on Thursday, the defending champions now sit ninth out of ten in the standings and have little chance of reaching the semi-finals. England have lost four of their five matches, including a loss to Afghanistan, and now face the in-form Indian team on Sunday. This is a stark contrast to 2019, when Eoin Morgan's England won the World Cup in a memorable final against New Zealand, prompting significant reflection now. "We are talking about some of the greatest players in our white-ball history, but this has simply become too much for some of them," Hussain told Sky Sports. "I wouldn't have changed the side before this tournament, but I would definitely consider changes now because it feels like the end of an era. That doesn't diminish what this England team has achieved. While it's easy to be negative and say 'replace them all,' they've given us six or seven years of brilliant white-ball cricket." Questions are now being raised about England's preparation for the tournament and whether the lack of 50-over matches for key players has affected their ability to retain the title. Ben Stokes has not played a 50-over match in England since 2014, and captain Jos Buttler—whose role is under scrutiny—has not played one since 2016. However, Hussain argues that blaming the amount of T20 cricket being played instead of the 50-over format is not valid. "People praise these players when they win two World Cups, but when things go wrong, some blame the structure of English cricket," he said. "I've heard people say the Hundred or the Blast, or the lack of 50-over matches, is responsible. These are just excuses."

article_content: Brendan Rodgers described Raheem Sterling as a quick learner after the England winger showcased the benefits of recent shooting practice. Sterling displayed composure as he scored the only goal in Liverpool’s 1-0 win at Turf Moor against Burnley, rounding goalkeeper Tom Heaton before calmly placing the ball into an empty net. Two weeks earlier at Old Trafford, Sterling had missed several chances, but since then, the 20-year-old has scored in each of his last three appearances. Rodgers explained that Sterling has been undergoing intensive training at Melwood to improve his finishing. Rodgers said, “It showed what a great learner he is. He’s now finding himself in more of those goalscoring situations due to his pace, and he’s been working with the coaches on finishing from both sides. He displayed great composure and a strong ability to learn by beating the keeper and finishing well. His drive to improve has been vital in earning us three points.” Burnley were the stronger team in the first half, but when asked if Liverpool were lucky to win, Rodgers disagreed, highlighting his team’s character and resilience. “There weren’t many chances, but we took the one clear opportunity we had and deserved the win based on our mentality,” he said. Burnley manager Sean Dyche felt his side deserved more, stating, “We had our pocket picked today. I don’t recall Tom Heaton making too many saves, and our defense was alert. Liverpool have a talented squad, and it was always going to be a challenge.” In other news, Simon Mignolet will return as Liverpool’s goalkeeper on Monday after Brad Jones was forced off early through injury during the match, with Danny Ward named as backup. article_content: Crypto-focused bank Silvergate Capital announced on Wednesday that it has fully repaid all remaining deposit liabilities after deciding earlier this year to wind down operations. According to its statement, Silvergate now holds less than $10,000 in assets. In March, Silvergate said it would voluntarily liquidate after suffering major losses following the dramatic collapse of crypto exchange FTX. 'Silvergate continues to focus on implementing the bank’s liquidation,' the company said Wednesday. Based in California, Silvergate was once a popular bank for the crypto industry, but reported a $1 billion quarterly loss prior to winding down. After the FTX scandal spooked investors, over $8 billion in deposits were withdrawn. The wider cryptocurrency market lost more than a trillion dollars in value in 2022 as concerns over economic instability grew and interest rates rose. In other news, India’s IPO market is experiencing a boom. Three out of four recent IPOs—Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, and Gandhar Oil Refinery—were fully subscribed within hours of opening. IndiGo, India’s largest airline, is reportedly planning to introduce a premium class of seats, hot meals, and a loyalty programme by the end of 2024 to attract more business travelers and compete with Air India. Meanwhile, creditors in India have withdrawn 26,518 insolvency cases involving defaults amounting to as much as ₹9.33 lakh crore before applications were admitted since the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code took effect. SAP has unveiled a new enterprise platform on the Metaverse, aimed at accelerating cloud adoption among Indian firms. The interactive ‘cloud on wheels’ platform lets customers experience SAP’s full range of offerings to improve business outcomes.

article_content: The Federal Government of Nigeria is preparing to enforce a new policy to automatically deduct 40% from the Internally Generated Revenue (IGR) of partially-funded federal universities, starting November 2023. This initiative was outlined in a letter dated October 17, 2023, signed by the Accountant-General of the Federation, Mrs. Oluwatoyin Madein, and supported by the Director of Revenue and Investment, Felix Ore-ofe Ogundairo. It follows the Finance Circular referenced FMFBNP/OTHERS/IGR/CRF/12/2021, released in December 2021. Senior officials from the Academic Staff Union of Universities (ASUU) and the Committee of Vice-Chancellors of Nigerian Universities (CVCNU) have strongly opposed this decision, calling it detrimental to the country’s university system. ASUU President, Prof. Emmanuel Osodeke, stated that universities mainly rely on subsidized fees paid by students for basic services—such as ID cards, accommodation, and laboratory supplies—rather than generating significant revenue or profit. Prof. Osodeke criticized the deduction of 40% from these student charges, highlighting that universities are not designed to generate profits for the government. He voiced fears that the policy would hinder essential educational services, and urged parents, students, and the wider public to call for its reversal. According to Prof. Yakubu Ochefu, CVCNU Secretary-General, the deduction rate from university funds was increased from 25% to 40%. He explained that most of the income classified as IGR comes from user charges, not actual surplus, and warned that this heightened deduction would add to existing financial deficits and undermine university operations. Ochefu also appealed to the government to clarify the definition of IGR for universities. Both ASUU and the CVCNU have announced plans for dialogue with relevant government bodies. They insist that, if the policy is to remain, the government must guarantee full funding for universities to prevent further harm to the quality of higher education in Nigeria.
translated_content: Gwamnatin Tarayyar Najeriya tana shirin aiwatar da sabon tsari na cire kashi 40% daga kudaden da Jami’o’in Tarayya ke samarwa da kansu (IGR) masu samun tallafi, tun daga watan Nuwamba 2023. Wannan umarni yana cikin wasika mai kwanan watan 17 ga Oktoba, 2023, wadda Accountant-General na Tarayya, Mrs. Oluwatoyin Madein, ta sanya wa hannu, tare da taimakon Darektan Kudade da Zuba Jari, Felix Ore-ofe Ogundairo. Wannan na biyo bayan takardar zartarwa ta FMFBNP/OTHERS/IGR/CRF/12/2021 da aka fitar a Disamba 2021. Shugabannin Kungiyar Malaman Jami’o’i (ASUU) da Kungiyar Shugabannin Jami’o’in Najeriya (CVCNU) sun yi matukar sukar wannan mataki, suna kira da cewa yana cutar da tsarin jami’o’i na kasa. Shugaban ASUU, Farfesa Emmanuel Osodeke, ya nuna cewa yawancin kudaden jami’o’i na fitowa ne daga kudin da dalibai ke biya don ayyuka irin su katin shaida, masauki, da kayan gwaje-gwaje—ba ribar kasuwanci ba. Farfesa Osodeke ya soki cire kashi 40% daga wadannan kudaden, yana jaddada cewa jami’o’i ba wurin tara ribar gwamnati bane. Ya bayyana damuwa cewa wannan mataki zai rage ayyukan da ake bukata a fannin ilimi, sannan ya roki iyaye, dalibai, da al’umma su nemi gwamnati ta janye wannan mataki. Shima Farfesa Yakubu Ochefu, Sakatare Janar na CVCNU, ya bayyana cewa an k’ara kaso daga 25% zuwa 40% na kudaden jami’o’i da gwamnati ke karba. Ya ce mafi yawan kudaden da ake kiran IGR a jami’o’i kudin ayyuka ne da dalibai ke biya, ba kudin da ake samu saboda wuce gona da iri ba, kuma ya gargadi cewa karin kaso zai kara dagula matsalar kudi. Ochefu ya bukaci gwamnati ta fayyace menene a zahiri ake nufi da IGR a jami’o’i. ASUU da CVCNU sun bayyana cewa za su yi shawarwari da hukumomin gwamnati. Sun dage cewa idan za a ci gaba da wannan tsari, gwamnati ya kamata ta tabbatar da cikakken tallafi ga jami’o’i don kare ingancin ilimi a kasar.

article_content: Dr. Florian Rabitz, chief researcher at Kaunas University of Technology (KTU) in Lithuania, states that global efforts to prevent ecological collapse have not been very successful. Rabitz is the author of 'Transformative Novel Technologies and Global Environmental Governance,' a new book published by Cambridge University Press. Issues such as greenhouse gas emissions, species extinction, ecosystem degradation, and chemical pollution continue to threaten Earth's future. Despite many international agreements and summits, significant progress remains elusive, according to Dr. Rabitz. In his book, Dr. Rabitz explores how advanced new technologies intersect with global environmental challenges. He examines how international institutions respond—or sometimes fail to respond—to high-impact and often controversial technologies. "Some of these proposed solutions are more intrusive than others. While they might advance environmental sustainability, they could also create new problems for both the environment and society. Transformative novel technologies remain largely unrealized: whether their benefits materialize and their risks are avoided depends significantly on having proper governance mechanisms," Dr. Rabitz explains. One chapter focuses on biotechnology's potential role in protecting nature. Invasive alien species—non-native organisms that disrupt the ecosystems they enter, often due to human activity—are a major factor in ongoing biodiversity loss. Scientific and policy organizations worldwide are trying to address this urgent issue. "The UN admits that target 15.8 of the Sustainable Development Goals, which aimed to significantly reduce the impact of biological invasions by 2020, has not yet been met," says Dr. Rabitz. He further explains that researchers are developing biotechnological countermeasures, such as gene drive systems, designed to control invasive species through ecosystem-wide genetic modifications. However, these technologies present significant risks and challenges that require careful consideration and international cooperation. Gene drive systems, in particular, have become the subject of attention from global institutions like the Convention on Biological Diversity and the World Health Organization. Dr. Rabitz contends that transformative technologies—such as those proposed to address climate change by altering planetary reflectivity—require robust international governance. Yet, such solutions remain out of reach. "My book shows that, despite the existence of many international institutions that could address these technological challenges, effective responses are rare. This is partly because these technologies are unique and unprecedented, leading to gaps in international governance," he notes. This issue extends into other fields as well, such as Artificial Intelligence, where global regulation falls behind the pace of political, economic, and social changes. "We may not agree on the best approach to transformative technologies—whether to restrict, ban, or encourage their responsible use. However, without proper international governance, these important technological developments will inevitably cause problems in the future," says Dr. Rabitz.
translated_content: Dr. Florian Rabitz, babban mai bincike a Jami'ar Kimiyya ta Fasaha ta Kaunas (KTU) a Lithuania, ya bayyana cewa kokarin duniya na kauce wa rugujewar muhalli bai yi nasara sosai ba. Rabitz ne ya rubuta littafin 'Transformative Novel Technologies and Global Environmental Governance,' saban littafi da Cambridge University Press ta buga. Batutuwa kamar hayakin da ke dumama yanayi, bacewar jinsunan dabbobi da tsirrai, lalacewar muhalli, da gurbatar sinadarai suna ci gaba da barazana ga rayuwar duniya. Koda yake an yi yarjejeniyoyi da tarurruka masu yawa na kasa da kasa, babban ci gaba bai samu ba, a cewar Dr. Rabitz. A littafinsa, Dr. Rabitz ya duba yadda sabbin fasahohi ke da tasiri a kan matsalolin muhalli na duniya. Ya bayyana yadda kungiyoyin kasa da kasa ke amsa (ko rashin amsa) ga sabbin fasahohi masu matukar tasiri da rikici. "Wasu daga cikin wadannan hanyoyin magance matsaloli sun fi shafar rayuwa fiye da wasu. Ko suna taimakawa dorewar muhalli, suna iya haifar da sabbin matsaloli ga yanayi da al'umma. Sabbin fasahohi masu canji har yanzu ba a tabbatar da yanda za a amfana da su ba: ko za a amfana da su ko a kauce wa illolinsu, yana dogara ne da samun ingantaccen tsarin shugabanci," in ji Dr. Rabitz. Wani babi na littafin ya mayar da hankali kan rawar da fasahar kimiyyar halittu za ta taka wajen kare jinsin halittu. Halittu masu mamaye daga waje—wadanda ba na asali ba kuma ke lalata muhalli da suka shiga saboda aikin bil adama—na daya daga cikin abubuwan dake haddasa bacewar jinsin halittu. Masana da kungiyoyin manufofi a duniya na kokarin shawo kan wannan gagarumin matsala. "Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta amince cewa burin 15.8 cikin Tsarin Ci gaba Mai Dorewa, da ke nufi rage tasirin mamayar halittu daga waje zuwa shekarar 2020, bai cika ba tukuna," in ji Dr. Rabitz. Ya kara da cewa masana suna binciken hanyoyin fasaha kamar 'gene drive', domin shawo kan halittun waje ta hanyar sauya tsarin kwayoyin halitta a cikin muhallinsu. Sai dai, wadannan fasahohi suna tattare da babban hadari da kalubale da ke bukatar shiri da hadin kan kasa da kasa. Gene drive ta janyo hankalin kungiyoyin duniya masu muhimmanci kamar Convention on Biological Diversity da Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya. Dr. Rabitz ya bayyana cewa sabbin fasahohi masu canji—irinsu wadanda ake son amfani da su wajen sauya reflectivity na duniya don yaki da sauyin yanayi—na bukatar tsari mai karfi na shugabanci na kasa da kasa. Sai dai har yanzu ba a cimma hakan ba. "Littafina ya nuna cewa kodayake kungiyoyin kasa da kasa da dama na da damar kula da irin wadannan fasahohi, amsar da ta dace ba kasafai ake samu ba. Wannan saboda rashin misaltuwa da sababbin dabi'un fasahohin, wanda ke barin giibi a tsarin shugabanci," in ji shi. Wannan matsala ta shafi sauran fannonin kimiyya, misali Artificial Intelligence, inda doka ta kasa biyo bayan saurin ci gaban rayuwa, tattalin arziki da siyasa. article_content: Mississippi state senator Chris McDaniel is taking his case to the state Supreme Court after a judge dismissed his attempt to challenge the outcome of the June 24 Republican Senate runoff. The case was thrown out because McDaniel filed his complaint 41 days after the election—well past the 20-day window allowed by law. McDaniel, who has the backing of Tea Party and anti-establishment Republicans, narrowly finished ahead of longtime senator Thad Cochran in the initial June 3 primary, but neither candidate got more than half the votes, prompting a runoff. In the runoff, Cochran won by a little more than 7,000 votes, a result bolstered by support from African-American voters who traditionally vote Democratic. McDaniel alleges that some voters improperly participated in both the Democratic and Republican primaries, contesting the validity of the runoff. On the other hand, Cochran credits his years of building relationships across communities for his victory. With the general election coming up, Cochran is seen as the overwhelming favorite to win a seventh Senate term.

article_content: McDonald's Israel's announcement of free meals for the Israeli military has sparked backlash from franchises in Arab countries. In the late 1990s, Pulitzer Prize-winning commentator Thomas Friedman famously claimed that two countries with McDonald’s outlets had never gone to war. However, as fighting continues between Israel and Hamas, the iconic American fast food chain is facing internal divisions. McDonald's franchises across the Middle East have taken opposing sides, with branches in Muslim countries disavowing McDonald's Israel's decision to provide free meals to the Israeli military. Franchises in Saudi Arabia, Oman, Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates, Jordan, Egypt, Bahrain, and Turkey have distanced themselves from their Israeli counterpart, collectively pledging more than $3 million to support Palestinians under bombardment in Gaza. McDonald's Oman, which pledged $100,000 towards humanitarian relief in Gaza, posted on X (formerly Twitter): 'Let us all combine our efforts and support the community in Gaza with everything we can. We ask God Almighty to protect our beloved country and all Arab and Muslim countries from all the evil and hate.' Since announcing its support for the Israeli army, McDonald's Israel has set its Instagram account to private after facing backlash from consumers in Arab and Muslim countries. Although McDonald's is one of the most iconic American brands, most of its restaurants worldwide are locally owned and operated. McDonald's headquarters in Chicago did not respond to Al Jazeera’s request for comment. This situation highlights the complex geopolitical dynamics that global brands must navigate as they are often expected to take positions on social and political issues. The controversy has also revived discussion of the so-called Golden Arches theory of conflict prevention, popularized by Friedman in his 1999 book 'The Lexus and The Olive Tree.' The theory—that countries wealthy enough to support major chains like McDonald's do not go to war—has been widely discredited by conflicts such as the 1998–99 Kosovo War and Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. McDonald's does not operate any restaurants in Gaza or the occupied West Bank, but Israel has clashed with Hezbollah fighters in neighboring Lebanon, which does have McDonald's outlets. Paul Musgrave, an associate professor of political science at the University of Massachusetts Amherst, told Al Jazeera: 'We're in a post-Golden Arches theory of conflict prevention world now. Even though Russia and Ukraine both had McDonald's in 2022, they still went to war. Now, conflicts within the McDonald's empire mirror the real stresses and passions of the region.' McDonald's is not the first global brand involved in controversy over its stance on the Israel-Palestine conflict. For example, Unilever faced criticism for not disclosing that its ice cream subsidiary, Ben & Jerry’s, decided to boycott Israeli-occupied territory in the West Bank and East Jerusalem in 2021. Spanish retailer Zara faced boycotts after the chairman of its Israeli franchise hosted a campaign event for far-right minister Itamar Ben-Gvir. Japanese retailer MUJI was criticized in 2021 for endorsing cotton grown in China’s Xinjiang region, where human rights activists allege forced labor of ethnic minority Muslims. Musgrave added that, 'the idea that capitalism and trade would quiet nationalism and other fervors has been shown to have limits. Having different McDonald's franchises take opposing rhetorical sides is another example of how politics permeates everything.'

A shekarun 1990, Thomas Friedman, mai lambar yabo ta Pulitzer, ya fadi cewa ba a taɓa ganin ƙasashen da ke da McDonald’s sun yi yaƙi da juna ba. Rassan McDonald’s a Gabas ta Tsakiya sun nesanta kansu daga shawarar McDonald’s Israel na tallafawa sojojin Isra’ila da abinci kyauta. Rikicin ya kuma farfado da mahawara kan ka’idar Golden Arches, wacce Friedman ya fitar a littafinsa na 1999 'The Lexus and The Olive Tree,' wato ra’ayin cewa kasashe masu McDonald’s ba su yin yaki. MUJI daga Japan ma ta fuskanci suka a 2021 bisa goyon baya ga audugar Xinjiang inda ake zargin tilasta Musulmi aiki. Musgrave ya kara da cewa, 'tunani na cewa kasuwanci da ciniki zai hana rikice-rikicen kungiyar kasa ko kishin kasa ya nuna rashi. Reshe-reshen McDonald’s suna kan sides daban-daban alama ce na yadda siyasa take shafar kowa a yau.'

article_content: Starting Friday, Amsterdam will offer heroin testing kits to tourists, following several tragedies where visitors died after accidentally consuming heroin they thought was cocaine. Reports from Het Parool confirm these kits will be sold for two euros in 30 smart shops and by official street teams. Warning signs have been set up throughout Amsterdam, especially in major tourist areas such as the Red Light District, to alert visitors about the dangers of purchasing drugs on the street. The move comes in response to the deaths of three British tourists—aged 20, 21, and 22—who all died after using what they believed was cocaine but turned out to be 'white heroin.' In addition, at least 17 other tourists have needed emergency medical attention after similar incidents. Authorities warn that 'white heroin' closely resembles cocaine and can cause severe health problems, including respiratory failure. Mayor Eberhard van der Laan supports the sale of these kits in legal smart shops, clarifying, however, that the kits are not a guaranteed safeguard. Information will be provided to users warning them the tests cannot ensure complete safety. Although cannabis is legally available in certain coffee shops, hard drugs such as heroin remain illegal in the Netherlands. ‘White heroin’ is said to be more potent and more expensive than the more common brown heroin, with roots tracing back to Southeast Asia. To address the ongoing risk, Amsterdam is intensifying efforts to inform and protect tourists, promoting both public awareness campaigns and the distribution of heroin testing kits.

An jibge allunan gargaɗi a wurare da dama a cikin Amsterdam, musamman kusa da wuraren shahararrun da yawon bude ido ke zuwa kamar Red Light District, don sa wa baƙi su kula da hatsarin sayen kwayoyi daga tituna. Domin rage haɗari, birnin Amsterdam na kokari sosai wajen wayar da kai ga baƙin da ke ziyara, ta hanyar tallata gargaɗi da rabon kayan gwajin heroin.

article_content: Google continues to enhance Bard by rolling out new updates and features. The latest improvements focus on making the AI chatbot better at summarizing emails and displaying images in shared conversations. According to Google's official Bard updates blog, users who use the Workspace extension can now ask Bard to summarize multiple emails at once. This provides a quick overview of your messages without needing to manually check your whole inbox. Google stated, 'We are making a small step to improve quality and make the Workspace Extension more useful by summarizing more of your emails. Sometimes you just need an update, so we’re making Bard better at finding the latest emails.' The integration allows Bard and Gmail to work together to summarize several emails simultaneously, helping users quickly identify important messages while saving time. Another update allows images to be visible in shared Bard conversations. Previously, only text was shown when sharing, but now images included in prompts will also be displayed. Since Bard's public launch in February, it has received several enhancements, such as improved math abilities, more precise location responses, and the ability to show images in its answers. These latest features aim to make managing your inbox less stressful and further establish Bard as a valuable AI tool.

article_content: A Wendy's restaurant in Lovejoy, Georgia, has terminated an employee after a customer discovered a half-smoked marijuana cigarette in her cheeseburger. The employee, Amy Seiber, 32, admitted to police that she accidentally left the joint inside the burger after smoking part of it during her shift. Customer Shalon Travis, 39, purchased a single cheeseburger combo at around 10:30 p.m. on November 1 from the drive-through at the 11121 Tara Boulevard Wendy's. Upon returning home, Travis detected an unusual odor and, upon inspecting the burger, found the partially smoked joint on top of the pickle. Travis experienced symptoms similar to food poisoning and was taken to the hospital. According to reports, Seiber confessed to her mistake when police arrived and was arrested for possession of less than an ounce of marijuana. Wendy's management responded by immediately dismissing Seiber and offering to cover Travis' medical bills. The company also issued Travis a $50 gift certificate and stated, 'Obviously the employee broke the rules and did not follow proper food handling steps... We are deeply sorry that this incident occurred.' Seiber was released from Clayton County Jail after posting bond.

article_content: Google is quickly rolling out the next beta for its upcoming quarterly update. According to an official Reddit post, Android 14 QPR1 Beta 2 is now available for several Pixel devices, including the Pixel 5a through Pixel 7a, as well as the Pixel Fold and Pixel Tablet, with build number U1B2.230922.006. The company has notified enrolled testers of potential issues with this test OS version, such as possible battery drain, performance slowdowns, and stability problems. Google’s changelog details fixes but also notes a few unresolved issues: swapping SIM cards may disrupt cellular connectivity, and the battery percentage indicator might briefly show 0% before correcting itself. QPR1 Beta 2 introduces an updated settings page, allowing enrolled Pixel users to see if their operating system, mainline version, and Pixel system apps are current, as noted by Mishaal Rahman on Telegram. Google advises that OTA updates can take up to 24 hours to arrive, though users can manually check for the beta update in Settings > System > System updates. Eligibility and enrollment can be checked on the Android beta page. Android 14 was launched just yesterday, together with Google’s new products: the Pixel 8 series and Pixel Watch 2. Since beta testing began in September and with this second beta, Google is on track for the quarterly Android release coming in December. The Pixel 7a is Google’s latest compact phone, featuring a 6.1-inch display, 64MP main camera, powerful Tensor G2 chip, and five years of updates. Its refreshed design aligns with the larger Pixel 7 series while maintaining strong performance.

The German Aerospace Center is developing the SpaceLiner, a groundbreaking hypersonic passenger craft that could transport up to 50 people at speeds reaching 24 times the speed of sound. Designed to drastically cut travel times, the SpaceLiner could make the journey from London to Sydney in just 90 minutes. According to project coordinator Martin Sippel, private funding may be secured within the next ten years, with the goal of launching the vehicle around 2050.

The SpaceLiner would use a two-stage system. A rocket booster would carry the vehicle to about 50 miles above Earth into the upper atmosphere, after which the orbiter would glide at hypersonic speed, without entering outer space. Its propulsion would rely on liquid hydrogen and oxygen, producing water vapor as the only emission.

Other possible routes, such as London to New York, could be completed in just over an hour. Tickets, however, are expected to cost several hundred thousand dollars. Sippel suggests that, if demand grows, a fleet of SpaceLiners could offer up to 15 flights per day.

Major challenges include protecting the craft from the extreme heat generated during hypersonic travel and managing sonic booms, which may necessitate remote launch sites and carefully planned flight routes to avoid residential areas. The reusable booster is designed to detach and return to Earth, where it could be retrieved mid-air by another aircraft and towed to a landing strip.

The SpaceLiner’s aerodynamic shape will have to endure extreme temperatures, with engineers working on advanced cooling and shielding systems for safety. European Union research like FAST20XX and private spaceflight developments such as those by Virgin Galactic are also guiding the SpaceLiner’s design. 

Overcoming these obstacles could revolutionize global travel and make ultra-fast flights a reality.

Cibiyar Fasaha ta Jamus tana kan aiki da SpaceLiner, jirgin sama mai matsanancin sauri da zai dauki fasinjoji har 50, yana iya kai sau 24 na saurin sauti. Wannan na'ura za ta taimaka rage lokacin tafiya sosai—daga London zuwa Sydney cikin mintuna 90. Shugaban aikin, Martin Sippel, ya ce ana iya samun jarin masu zaman kansu cikin shekara goma masu zuwa, da burin fara amfani da jirgin nan da 2050.

SpaceLiner za ta kunshi matakai biyu: roka zai tura ta zuwa kusan mil 50 a sama, inda za ta ci gaba da shawagi cikin sauri a saman duniyar, ba tare da kaiwa sararin samaniya na gaskiya ba. Za ta yi amfani da fetur na hydrogen da oxygen, kuma abinda take fidda shine tururin ruwa.

Za'ayi hanyar London zuwa New York cikin kusan awa daya. Amma farashin kujera zai kasance mai tsada sosai—har dubunnan daloli. Idan mutane da dama sun nuna sha'awa, Sippel na ganin ana iya gudanar da jiragen har sau 15 a rana.

Babban kalubale sun hada da kariya daga zafi mai tsanani saboda gudun tafiya, da kuma tsaida karar sonic boom, don haka dole a tasa jirgi daga wurare masu nisa da jama'a da tsara hanyoyin tafiya iya kyau. Booster din zai dawo bayan ya cire kansa da jirgi, sannan wani jirgi zai kama shi a sama ya ja shi zuwa sauka.

Fasalin jirgin za a tabbatar yana da karfi jure zafin tafiya, da kokarin fasahar sanyaya da kariya daga zafi. Binciken EU kamar FAST20XX da ci gaban kamfanonin masu zaman kansu irin su Virgin Galactic suna taimakawa inganta aikin.

Da an shawo kan wadannan kalubale, SpaceLiner na iya canza tafiya a duniya da kawo jirgin sama mai azama ga kowa.

article_content: US Secretary of State Antony Blinken and Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin are traveling to New Delhi for talks with Indian Foreign Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar and Defense Minister Rajnath Singh. Called the '2+2 Dialogue' and established in 2018, these meetings aim to deepen defense ties and align Indo-Pacific strategies. The top priorities for this round are security challenges in the Indo-Pacific and managing concerns about China, rather than the conflicts in Gaza or Ukraine. Officials are set to discuss enhancing joint military projects, including co-developing fighter jet engines, drones, and expanding semiconductor manufacturing in India. Despite ongoing diplomatic tensions with Canada after the killing of a Sikh separatist leader, officials say the controversy will not affect these talks. The US continues to support the investigation while moving forward with building a closer strategic partnership with India. These talks are part of the ongoing engagement following Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Washington and President Joe Biden's trip to India for the G20 summit. The context also includes expectations for Biden’s upcoming meetings, notably with Chinese President Xi Jinping at the APEC summit and a possible visit to India in January. Policy experts highlight significant progress in US-India defense cooperation, particularly in technology sharing and co-production. India also maintains strong ties with Israel and Russia while increasing economic engagement with Middle Eastern nations. According to analysts, this dialogue is focused more on regional issues in Asia, like elections in Bangladesh, developments in Myanmar, the pro-China leadership in the Maldives, and potential instability in Sri Lanka and Nepal, rather than global conflicts or the India-Canada diplomatic row.

Wadannan taruka na '2+2 Dialogue' da aka fara tun 2018, na nufin zurfafa hadin gwiwa a fannin tsaro da daidaita dabarun yankin Indo-Pacific. Babban abin da za a tattauna a wannan taro shine kalubalen tsaro a yankin Indo-Pacific da dabarun tinkarar matsalolin da suka shafi China, maimakon rikicin Gaza ko Ukraine. Za a mayar da hankali kan hadin gwiwar kere-kere a bangaren soji, ciki har da samar da injinan jiragen yaki, drones da habaka sarrafa microchip a Indiya. Duk da sabanin diflomasiyya tsakanin Indiya da Kanada bayan kisan wani jagoran Sikh, jami’ai sun ce hakan ba zai shafi wannan tattaunawa ba. Amurka na goyon bayan binciken lamarin tare da fadada zumunci da Indiya. Wannan taron ya biyo bayan ziyarar Firaministan Indiya Narendra Modi zuwa Washington da ta Shugaba Joe Biden zuwa Indiya a taron G20. Har ila yau, ana sa ran Biden zai gana da shugaban China Xi Jinping a taron APEC da kuma yiwuwar dawowa Indiya a watan Janairu. Masana harkokin siyasa sun jaddada cewa an samu gagarumin ci gaba a hadin gwiwar tsaron Amurka da Indiya, musamman a musayar fasaha da hada-hadar kayan soji. Indiya na da kyakkyawar dangantaka da Isra’ila da Rasha tare da habaka ciniki da kasashen Gabas ta Tsakiya. Masana sun ce tattaunawar yanzu ta fi karkata zuwa batutuwan yankin Asiya, irin su zaben Bangladesh, lamarin Myanmar, sabuwar gwamnatin da ke kusanci da China a Maldives, da yiwuwar rikice-rikice a Sri Lanka da Nepal, maimakon matsalolin Gaza, Ukraine ko rikicin Indiya da Kanada.

Last year, Vanessa Thiemann discovered a lump near her nipple during a sleepless night. Despite having cancer only in one breast and no family history, the 42-year-old single mother decided to have both breasts removed to ease her constant worry about future cancer. Her case reflects a growing trend in the United States—more women with early-stage breast cancer are choosing double mastectomies, even when only one breast is affected.

Research shows a sharp rise in such surgeries: between 1998 and 2003, double mastectomies increased by 150%, according to Dr. Kelly Hunt of MD Anderson Cancer Center. By 2012, more than 14% of their breast cancer patients were opting for preventive removal of the healthy breast. A similar increase was seen at Memorial Sloan-Kettering, where rates went from 6.7% in 1997 to 24% in 2005.

Many factors fuel this shift. Widespread genetic testing for BRCA mutations has empowered women, particularly in the U.S., to pursue preventive mastectomy. Dr. Steven Narod found over 36% of American women with BRCA mutations undergo this surgery, much more than in other countries. However, studies show most American women who remove both breasts after a cancer diagnosis do not have a clear medical reason, suggesting anxiety and desire for control are strong motivators.

Improvements in breast reconstruction also influence decisions. Modern surgical options now use body fat or safer implants to create natural-looking results, making recovery easier and boosting confidence post-surgery.

‘Pink ribbon’ breast cancer awareness is now a major part of American culture, providing abundant information and support. Many high-risk but cancer-free women seek preventative mastectomies, often coming to consultations with specific procedures in mind, shaped by online resources and social media. Some doctors actively engage with patients online to help inform their decisions.

Dr. Deanna Attai, who treated Thiemann, says her job is to support her patients’ choices and ensure they are well informed—even if the surgery isn’t strictly necessary. As Thiemann puts it, she wanted to do everything possible to be there for her children.
translated_content:
Shekarar da ta gabata, Vanessa Thiemann ta gano wata karamar kumbura kusa da nononta yayin da take kwance ba barci. Ko da ya ke tana da ciwon daji a nono daya ne kuma ba ta da tarihi a danginsu, uwa mai yara biyu nan ta yanke shawarar cire nonuwanta duka don rage tsoron sake samun ciwon a gaba. Wannan al’amari na Vanessa yana nuna yadda yawancin mata a Amurka ke zabar cire nonuwa biyu ko da ciwon ya tsaya a guda daya kacal.

Bincike ya tabbatar da karuwar wannan nau’in tiyata da kashi 150% daga 1998 zuwa 2003, kamar yadda Dr. Kelly Hunt daga MD Anderson Cancer Center ya nuna. Zuwa 2012, sama da kashi 14% na marasa lafiya a cibiyarsu sun zaɓi cire nonon da ba ya da ciwo domin kariya. Memorial Sloan-Kettering ma sun samu irin haka inda adadi ya haura daga 6.7% a 1997 zuwa 24% a 2005.

Yin gwajin kwayar BRCA yana daga cikin abubuwan dake jawo hakan, musamman a Amurka, inda sama da kashi 36% na mata masu wannan kwayar ke yanke wannan shawara, fiye da sauran kasashe. Duk da haka, bincike ya nuna cewa mafi yawan mata da ke cire nonuwa biyun ba sa da cikakken dalilin lafiya; tsoro da damuwa ne suke tura su hakan.

Sabbin dabaru wajen sake gina nono suna sa iyawar likitoci kara inganta sakamakon bayan tiyata. Suna amfani da kitson jiki ko na’urorin dasawa masu aminci don samar da nono mai kama da na halitta, wanda ke taimakawa murmurewa cikin sauki da taimakawa mace ta ji dadin jikinta.

Wayar da kai da tallafin masu fama da ciwon nono ta yadu kwarai a Amurka, inda dabaru da bayanai daga yanar gizo ke bukatar mata su yanke shawarwari da kansu. Wasu likitoci ma kan gudanar da tattaunawa a yanar gizo don shawarwa kai tsaye tare da marasa lafiya.

Dr. Deanna Attai, wadda ke kula da Thiemann, ta ce aikin ta shi ne bayar da bayanai kuma ta goyi bayan zabin marasa lafiya—ko tiyatar ba ta zama dole ba. Thiemann ta ce ta zabi wannan mataki ne don ta tsawaita rayuwarta tare da ’ya’yanta.

article_content: Pat Summitt, the winningest major college basketball coach in history, said Friday that stepping down as head coach of the Tennessee women's basketball team was entirely her decision following her diagnosis with early-onset Alzheimer's disease. This statement came a day after she submitted an affidavit indicating she had felt pressured to leave. Summitt said, 'It was completely my decision to step down from my role as Head Coach of women's basketball at the University of Tennessee. As I stated at my April press conference, I loved serving as Head Coach for 38 years. But after consulting with my son, doctors, lawyer, and close friends, I decided the time had come for a new chapter.' In April, Summitt announced her retirement from coaching, eight months after her diagnosis became public. 'I did not then, and do not now, feel that I was forced out by the University,' Summitt said. 'Anyone who knows me understands that any such effort would have met with resistance. If my affidavit caused any confusion about this, I want to clear that up.' In her affidavit, Summitt recalled a March meeting with athletics director Dave Hart, during which she was told she would no longer be coach after 38 seasons. She wrote that she had wished to make that decision herself and found the experience hurtful. The affidavit was part of a lawsuit filed by Debby Jennings, a former media relations director for women's sports, who claimed age and gender discrimination and retaliation. Margie Nichols, vice chancellor for communications at the University of Tennessee, also issued a statement Friday, calling Summitt a legend and emphasizing the university's respect for her. Nichols reaffirmed that Summitt's departure was her choice. Nichols added that the university would address other claims in Jennings's lawsuit through the legal process. Summitt, who led the Lady Vols to eight national championships and achieved a record 1,098 wins, continues to mentor Tennessee players and assist with recruiting as head coach emeritus through April 2013.
translated_content: Pat Summitt, wadda ta fi kowa girma wajen nasara a tarihin kwallon kwando na manyan makarantun gaba da sakandare a Amurka, ta bayyana a ranar Juma'a cewa ita kadai ta yanke shawarar barin aikin kociyar mata ta Jami'ar Tennessee bayan gano tana dauke da cutar amai-na-mahaukaciya (Alzheimer's). Wannan bayani nata ya zo ne bayan wata takardar shaida da ta gabatar kwana daya da ya gabata, inda Summitt ta bayyana cewa ta ji kamar an matsa mata ta hakura daga kujerar. Summitt ta ce, 'Ni da kaina na yanke shawara na ajiye aikin kociyar mata ta Jami'ar Tennessee. Kamar yadda na fada a dandalin manema labarai a watan Afrilu, na yi matukar farin ciki da kasancewa kociya tsawon shekaru 38. Amma bayan shawara da ɗana, likitoci, lauya da abokai na kusa, na ga ya dace in daga kafa in bude sabon shafi.' A watan Afrilu, Summitt ta sanar da yin ritaya daga aikin kociya, watanni takwas bayan ta bayyana ciwon da ke damunta. 'Ba a ranar nan ko yanzu na taba ji cewa jami'a ta tilasta min barin aiki ba,' in ji Summitt. 'Kowane mai sani na zai fahimta cewa basa iya matsa min. Idan takardar shaidata ta haifar da rudani a kan wannan, ina son in bayyanawa.' A cikin takardar shaidar, Summitt ta tuna wani zama da daraktan wasanni Dave Hart a watan Maris, inda aka shaida mata cewa ba za ta ci gaba da zama kociya bayan shekaru 38 ba. Ta rubuta cewa tana fatan yanke wannan hukunci da kanta kuma lamarin ya bata rai. Wannan takardar shaida tana cikin karar da Debby Jennings, tsohuwar shugabar hulda da jama'a ta wasannin mata, ta shigar tana zargin wariya saboda shekaru da jinsi da kuma ramuwar gayya. Margie Nichols, mataimakiyar shugaban jami'a mai kula da sadarwa a Jami'ar Tennessee, ta kuma fitar da wata sanarwa a ranar Juma'a tana bayyana Summitt a matsayin gwarzo kuma ta bayyana yadda jami'ar ke girmama ta. Nichols ta tabbatar cewa yanke shawara daga Summitt da kanta ya fito. Nichols ta kara jaddada cewa jami'ar za ta amsa sauran zarge-zarge a cikin karar Jennings ta hanyar shari'a. Summitt, wadda ta jagoranci Lady Vols zuwa lashe kofuna takwas na kasa tare da nasara 1,098 mafi yawa a tarihin kwallon kwando na manyan makarantu, har yanzu tana ba da shawarwari ga 'yan wasan Tennessee da taimakawa wajen dauko sabbin 'yan wasa a matsayin coach emeritus har zuwa Afrilu 2013.

article_content: Lionel Messi is aiming to revive his form while representing Argentina at the 2014 World Cup, following a challenging season with Barcelona. Messi, the world's highest-paid footballer, has faced criticism in the past for not matching his club performance on the international stage, but he is now optimistic, according to ESPN. Speaking to reporters at Ezeiza airport, the 26-year-old acknowledged this season was not his best—Barcelona lost the La Liga title to Atletico Madrid on the final day and generally appeared a shadow of their former dominant team. "I have arrived with the national team and I am flipping the switch. Often, I would play well at Barcelona but not so well for Argentina. This time, I hope it's the reverse," Messi said. He expressed hope that playing with his friends on the Argentina squad would lead to a different outcome. The four-time Ballon d'Or winner admitted that Barcelona as a team struggled throughout the season, which also saw them eliminated from the Champions League by Atletico Madrid. "It wasn't one of my best years," he said. "I would have liked a different end to the season, but it was a struggle for the whole team." Recently, Messi signed a new contract with Barcelona, reportedly worth £16.3 million per year, solidifying his status as the highest-paid footballer. He reaffirmed his attachment to Barcelona, saying, "Barcelona is my home, but if the day comes when they don't want me, I will go. But my home will always be Barcelona." Messi is Barcelona's all-time leading goalscorer, with 354 goals in 425 appearances. At the World Cup in Brazil, Argentina will compete against Bosnia, Iran, and Nigeria in the group stage.

Yayin hira da 'yan jarida a tashar jirgin sama ta Ezeiza, Messi mai shekaru 26 ya bayyana cewa wannan kakar ba ta fi yawa ba – Barcelona ta rasa kambin La Liga a hannun Atletico Madrid a ranar karshe kuma gaba daya kungiyar bata kai irin matsayin da ta saba ba. "Na iso da tawagar kasa kuma zan canja yanayi. Sau da dama ina yin kyau a Barcelona amma ba haka a Argentina ba. Yanzu, muna fatan akasin haka zai faru," in ji Messi. Messi shi ne gwarzon jefa kwallo a tarihin Barcelona, da kwallaye 354 a wasanni 425. A gasar cin kofin duniya a Brazil, Argentina za ta kara da Bosnia, Iran da Nigeria a rukuni na farko.

A recent agreement between the United States and China will increase the number of 3D, IMAX, and similar enhanced-format movies allowed to be released in China. Previously, China limited foreign films to 20 per year, mainly from the United States. The new deal, announced during meetings between U.S. Vice President Joe Biden and Chinese Vice President Xi Jinping, adds 14 more slots for IMAX or 3D films annually. Foreign film studios will now also be allowed to receive up to 25% of Chinese box office revenues, an increase from the prior 13-17% range. A White House statement claimed the arrangement will support thousands of American film industry jobs and provide Chinese audiences with greater access to high-quality international movies. The Motion Picture Association of America estimates 2.2 million U.S. jobs depend on the film and television industries.

IMAX, with 217 theatres currently open or planned in China, praised the decision and expressed commitment to featuring Chinese films in its U.S. venues. They reported box office sales of $55 million in the first quarter of the year, up from $38 million a year earlier—boosted mainly by 'Mission: Impossible — Ghost Protocol,' which accounted for nearly half those earnings. The Chinese film 'Flying Swords of Dragon Gate' was also among top performers, earning $3.7 million. Last year, Chinese box office revenue exceeded $2.1 billion, much of which came from 3D films, according to the White House.

The agreement addresses longstanding trade disputes following a 2009 World Trade Organization ruling, which found that China’s regulations on importing and distributing foreign films and entertainment products violated its WTO commitments. Despite China's efforts to curb piracy, illegal distribution remains a challenge, partly due to limited access for Hollywood films in China.

Allen Wan, head of production at Hong Kong-based Salon Films Group, welcomed the agreement, saying it allows Chinese audiences to legally access more American films and opens additional opportunities for cooperation between Chinese and U.S. companies.

'Flowers of War,' directed by Zhang Yimou and starring Christian Bale, was the most expensive production in China to date, costing $100 million, but failed to generate significant revenue in the U.S. In its peak week, it screened in only six U.S. locations with an average gross of $550, and its overall total was just $213,792 after four weeks.

Coinciding with the U.S.–China film deal, DreamWorks Animation announced the creation of 'Oriental DreamWorks,' a joint venture with China Media Capital and two other Chinese companies to develop family entertainment, live events, theme parks, games, and consumer products. The venture will begin with $330 million in funding, with Chinese partners holding a 55% majority stake and DreamWorks Animation owning about 45%. One of the first projects will be 'Kung Fu Panda 3.' DreamWorks' original 'Kung Fu Panda' was the top animated film in China in 2008, and its sequel earned $95 million last year, second only to 'Transformers 3,' with $170 million at the Chinese box office.

article_content: A California mother is suffering a double loss after thieves stole her baby boy's ashes from her home. Raynesha Williams reported that burglars broke into her Stockton home, near West and Hammer Lanes, on Wednesday and took the urn containing her son Zachary Toliver's ashes. Williams described the ordeal as 'like losing a child all over again.' She found her doors and windows wide open when she returned home, and noticed the urn, kept in a blue velvet box with her son's initials, was missing. The burglars emptied her home, leaving only a small pile of clothes. Williams told Fox40 that Zachary was stillborn and shared she has endured five miscarriages in the past five years, including another earlier that week. "It's been a hard couple of years," Williams said. She appealed for the urn's return, noting its only value is sentimental. "It's metal and not worth anything except to me." Stockton Police Officer Joseph Silva asked the public to help find the urn and urged the burglars to return it. 'A burglary is traumatic, but losing something as meaningful as a child's ashes is devastating,' Silva said.
translated_content: Wata uwa daga California ta sake fuskantar babban rashi bayan wasu barayi sun sace gawayen jaririnta daga gidanta. Raynesha Williams ta bayyana cewa barayi sun kutsa gidanta dake Stockton, kusa da titunan West da Hammer, ranar Laraba, inda suka sace kwalbar da ke dauke da gawayen danta, Zachary Toliver. Williams ta ce abin da ya faru ya ji mata kamar ta sake rasa danta karo na biyu. Ta ce ta dawo gida ta tarar da kofar gida da tagogi a bude, kuma kwalbar, wacce aka adana a cikin akwatin kadara mai launin shuɗi da haruffan sunan Zachary, ta bace. Barayin sun kwashe yawancin abubuwan gida, sai kadan daga tufafi suka bari. Williams ta shaida wa Fox40 cewa Zachary an haife shi ba rai, kuma ta ce ta sha fama da zubewar ciki sau biyar a cikin shekaru biyar da suka wuce, ciki har da daya a wannan makon. "Shekarun baya sun yi matukar wahala," in ji Williams. Ta roki a dawo mata da kwalbar, tana mai cewa ita kadai ke da darajarta. "Kwalbar ƙarfe ce, babu wani kudi ko amfani sai ni kaɗai ke da daraja gareta." Jami'in 'yan sanda na Stockton, Joseph Silva, ya roki jama'a da su taimaka wajen neman kwalbar kuma ya bukaci barayin da su dawo da ita. 'Fashin gida na da ciwo, amma rasa abu kamar gawayen jaririnki abin ciwo ne sosai,' in ji Silva.

article_content: Tottenham striker Emmanuel Adebayor has criticized Yaya Toure and his Ivory Coast teammates for prioritizing individual accolades over teamwork. Adebayor was candid in his assessment of a squad filled with Premier League stars such as Kolo Toure, Cheick Tiote, Wilfried Bony, and former stars Didier Drogba and Gervinho. "I never trust them. They are a country that will always let you down," Adebayor stated in an interview with Ghana SoccerNet. He argued that, despite having top talents—including Didier Drogba, whom he called the best striker in Europe, and Yaya Toure, the best midfielder—the team has failed to win major tournaments like the Africa Cup of Nations. Adebayor questioned their ability to work collectively, remarking, "Are they going to be collective enough? I don’t know. I am not Ivorian. They enjoy themselves, but when it’s time to work, they forget their job." He identified Nigeria as Africa’s best hope at international tournaments due to their organization and focus, while saying Ghana’s team relies too much on Asamoah Gyan. Ivory Coast has not won the Africa Cup of Nations since 1992, despite having many star players. Continuing his criticism, Adebayor added, "There’s no togetherness. Everyone wants to be the hero. People want to be remembered for what they did individually, not for what was achieved as a team. That’s what’s hurting Ivory Coast."
translated_content: Dan wasan gaba na Tottenham, Emmanuel Adebayor, ya soki Yaya Toure da sauran 'yan wasan Ivory Coast saboda fifita kai a kan aiki tare. Adebayor ya bayyana ra'ayinsa game da tawagar da ke dauke da taurarin Premier League kamar Kolo Toure, Cheick Tiote, Wilfried Bony, da tsoffin taurari Didier Drogba da Gervinho. "Ba na amincewa da su. Kasar da kullum za ta ba ka kunya," in ji Adebayor a hirar da ya yi da Ghana SoccerNet. Ya ce duk da suna da fitattun 'yan wasa—ciki har da Didier Drogba wanda ya kira mafi kyawun dan wasan gaba a Turai, da Yaya Toure mafi kyawun dan tsakiya—tawagar bata iya lashe manyan gasar kamar Africa Cup of Nations ba. Adebayor ya tambayi ikon su na aiki tare, yana cewa, "Za su iya zama masu haɗin kai? Ban sani ba. Ni ba Ivorian ba ne. Su kan more kansu, amma idan lokaci ya yi na aiki, sukan manta da aikinsu." Ya ce Najeriya ce ke da mafi kyawun fata a gasar duniya saboda tsari da mayar da hankali, sannan ya ce Ghana ta dogara da Asamoah Gyan fiye da kima. Ivory Coast ba ta dade da lashe Africa Cup of Nations tun 1992 ba, duk da yawa da ingancin 'yan wasanta. A ci gaba da suka, Adebayor ya kara da cewa, "Babu haɗin kai. Kowa na so ya zama jarumi. Kowanensu na son a tuna da abin da ya yi da kansa, ba abin da aka cimma a matsayin ƙungiya ba. Wannan ne matsalar Ivory Coast."

article_content: China is steadily expanding its influence in Central America through substantial infrastructure investments and the development of diplomatic ties. A notable example is the newly inaugurated, state-of-the-art library in San Salvador, financed by a $54 million grant from China. President Nayib Bukele, alongside the Chinese ambassador, unveiled the seven-story facility, which features advanced digital and technological amenities and houses 360,000 books. In Nicaragua, Laureano Ortega, son of President Daniel Ortega, recently received 250 Chinese-made buses and expressed gratitude for what he described as a 'special relationship' with Beijing, which he believes is helping lift the country out of poverty. Experts observe that the shifting political dynamics in Central America are distancing the region from the United States. For example, since Costa Rica switched diplomatic recognition from Taiwan to China in 2007, multiple countries, including Panama, El Salvador, Nicaragua, and recently Honduras, have established formal ties with Beijing. Now, only Guatemala and Belize in Central America still recognize Taiwan, which China claims as part of its territory. These diplomatic developments go hand-in-hand with major economic initiatives. Nicaragua recently ratified a free-trade agreement with China, while El Salvador and Honduras are negotiating their own deals. However, trade remains imbalanced. For instance, Costa Rica imports $3.35 billion in Chinese goods but exports only $400 million to China; similar disparities exist for El Salvador and Nicaragua. Despite these economies' relatively small commercial significance to China, their strategic locations along key trade routes—including the Panama Canal—make them important. China is involved in infrastructure projects ranging from port construction in Panama to major technology and public works initiatives across the region. In El Salvador, plans include a 50,000-seat stadium and a new shipping wharf. Chinese technology firms, notably telecommunications giant Huawei, are also planning 5G networks and other digital projects. However, concerns have been raised, especially by the United States, about potential debt risks tied to Chinese financing. While leaders like Honduran Minister Rodolfo Pastor argue that long-standing US influence has not spurred development, others warn about the dangers of accumulating debt. Overall, the response in Central America is mixed: some see Chinese partnerships as a path to modernization and growth, while critics caution about dependency and unfavorable economic terms.
translated_content: Kasancewar China tana ƙara tasirinta a Amurka ta Tsakiya ta hanyar zuba jari a manyan ayyukan more rayuwa da kuma haɓaka alaƙar diflomasiyya. Misali, an buɗe sabon ɗakin karatu na zamani a San Salvador wanda China ta dauki nauyin gina shi da dala miliyan 54. Shugaba Nayib Bukele tare da jakadan China sun bayyana wannan katafaren bene mai hawa bakwai da ke ɗauke da fasahohin zamani da littattafai 360,000. A Nijaraguwa, Laureano Ortega, ɗan shugaban ƙasa Daniel Ortega, ya karɓi sabbin motocin bas 250 daga China, kuma ya nuna godiya kan abin da ya kira da 'alaƙar musamman' da Beijing, yana mai cewa hakan na taimaka wa ƙasa fita daga talauci. Masana sun lura cewa canjin siyasa a Amurka ta Tsakiya na ƙara nisantar da yankin daga Amurka. Tun bayan da Costa Rica ta sauya alaƙar diflomasiyya daga Taiwan zuwa China a 2007, wasu ƙasashe da dama sun bi sahu, ciki har da Panama, El Salvador, Nijaraguwa, da kwanan nan Honduras. Yanzu dai, sai Guatemala da Belize kawai ke da alaƙa da Taiwan, wacce China ke ikirarin cewa tana karkashinta. Wadannan sauye-sauye na diflomasiyya suna tare da manyan tsare-tsaren tattalin arziki. Nijaraguwa ta amince da yarjejeniyar ciniki da China, sai El Salvador da Honduras suma suna tattaunawa. Amma dai kasuwancin ba daidaito bane; misali, Costa Rica tana shigowa da kayan China na dala biliyan 3.35 amma tana fitar da kaya na dala miliyan 400 kacal; irin wannan rata na wanzuwa a El Salvador da Nijaraguwa. Duk da cewa tattalin arzikin waɗannan ƙasashen ba su da muhimmanci sosai ga China, amma wurinsu a manyan hanyoyin ciniki kamar tashar jiragen ruwa ta Panama na da matuƙar tasiri. China na aiki a kan ayyukan more rayuwa da dam-dam a yankin, daga gina tashar jiragen ruwa a Panama zuwa ayyukan fasahar zamani da na jama'a. A El Salvador, China za ta gina filin kwallon kafa mai kujeru 50,000 da wani sabon tashar jirgin ruwa. Kamfanonin fasahar China, musamman Huawei, na shirin samar da fasahar intanet ta 5G da wasu ayyukan zamani. Sai dai akwai damuwa, musamman daga Amurka, kan yiwuwar hatsarin basusuka daga jarin China. Yayinda wasu shugabannin yankin, irin su Ministan Honduras Rodolfo Pastor, ke cewa tasirin Amurka bai kawo ci gaba ba, wasu kuma na nuna fargaba game da girman bashin da zai iya taruwa. Gaba ɗaya, martani a Amurka ta Tsakiya ya kasu gida biyu: wasu na ganin haɗin gwiwa da China hanya ce ta zamani da ci gaba, wasu kuma na nuna damuwa game da dogaro da kuma rashin daidaito a yarjejeniyoyin tattalin arziki.

article_content: The Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam has reopened its doors following a 10-year, $489 million renovation. The grand reopening ceremony was conducted by Queen Beatrix of the Netherlands, marking one of her final official acts before her impending abdication. The museum will now welcome visitors every day of the year. Thousands attended the opening, eager to revisit treasured works such as Rembrandt's 'Night Watch,' Vermeer's 'Milkmaid,' and Frans Hals' 'Merry Drinker,' or to discover new additions like the Yves Saint Laurent 'Mondrian' dress, a 16th-century sculpture of 'Mater Dolorosa,' and a 1917 warplane. Rijksmuseum director Wim Pijbes described the occasion as 'the start of a new era,' explaining that while much has changed, 'The Night Watch' remains the centerpiece of the museum. The renovation introduced chronological displays that combine paintings and historical objects to provide context, as curator Pieter Roelofs noted. This approach aims to 'tell the story of Dutch history and culture.' Director of collections Taco Dibbets remarked that visitors are 'transported into another world – the world of Rembrandt, Vermeer, and Mondrian.' The restoration brought back the museum's original entrance, with its opulent stained glass and wall murals, while also substantially modernizing many gallery spaces. Spanish architects Cruz y Ortiz opened up the courtyards to create a spacious, light-filled atrium. Interior architect Jean-Michel Wilmotte removed unnecessary design elements to focus attention on the art, mounting key works on minimalist gray walls and placing artifacts in clear glass cases only when needed. Advanced LED lighting illuminates the collection. While technology is used behind the scenes, there are no video or computer screens in the galleries. 'We believe the works of art should speak for themselves,' said Dibbits. Visitors intrigued by technology can access the museum's features online via smartphones or tablets. During reconstruction, highlights from the collection were exhibited in an annex or lent out to international exhibitions in cities such as Los Angeles, Vancouver, São Paulo, and Sendai following the 2011 Japanese earthquake.
translated_content: Gidan adana kayan tarihi na Rijksmuseum a Amsterdam ya sake bude bayan shekaru goma na gyara da suka kai dala miliyan 489. Sarauniyar Beatrix ta Netherlands ce ta jagoranci bude taron, wanda shi ne daya daga cikin ayyukanta na karshe kafin ta sauka daga mulki. Za a rika karbar baki a gidan kayan tarihi kullum daga yanzu. Dubban mutane sun halarci bude taron, suna sha’awar ganin fitattun kayayyaki kamar ‘Night Watch’ na Rembrandt, ‘Milkmaid’ na Vermeer, da ‘Merry Drinker’ na Frans Hals, ko kuma gano sabbin abubuwa irin su Yves Saint Laurent ‘Mondrian’ rigar, wani sassaken ‘Mater Dolorosa’ daga karni na 16, da jirgin yaki na shekarar 1917. Daraktan Rijksmuseum, Wim Pijbes, ya bayyana wannan lokaci a matsayin ‘farkon sabon zamani’, inda ya kara da cewa duk da an canza komai, ‘Night Watch’ tana nan a matsayin ginshikin gidan kayan tarihin. Gyaran ya kawo tsarin nuna kayan tarihi da zane-zane bisa ga tsari na lokaci-lokaci don a bayyana cikakken tarihi kamar yadda kuratan Pieter Roelofs ya bayyana. Wannan tsari yana da nufin ‘bayyana labarin tarihinku da al’adunku na Holland’. Taco Dibbets, daraktan kayan tarihi ya ce, baƙi suna shiga duniyar Rembrandt, Vermeer, da Mondrian ne. Gyara da aka yi ya mayar da tsohon kofar shiga tare da fitilolin gilashi masu kyau da fentin bangon da ke cikin gidan, sai kuma sabbin azuzuwan zamani masu fadi da haske da ‘yan Spain Cruz y Ortiz suka tsara. Jean-Michel Wilmotte, mai tsara cikin gida, ya cire duk wani abu da zai shagaltar da hankali domin a mayar da hankali ga zane-zane, an rataya wasu manyan kayayyaki a bangon launin toka sannan an saka wasu kayan tarihi a cikin kwalaben gilashi idan ya zama dole. An kuma samar da fitilun zamani na LED don haskaka tarin kayan tarihi. Ko da yake ana amfani da fasaha a bayan fage, babu allunan bidiyo ko kwamfuta a dakunan kallon kayan tarihin. ‘Muna so kayan zane su bayyana kansu’, in ji Dibbits. Wadanda ke sha'awar fasaha za su iya ziyartar shafin gidan tarihi ta wayar hannu ko kwamfutar hannu. A lokacin gyara, an nuna wasu muhimman kayayyaki a wani dakin ajiya, kuma wasu an tura su baje koli a kasashen waje kamar Los Angeles, Vancouver, São Paulo da Sendai bayan girgizar kasa a Japan a 2011.

article_content:
Just four days after the SAG-AFTRA strike ended, Netflix hosted Hollywood’s first major post-strike premiere on Sunday night for Season 6 of its royal drama, The Crown. The event took place at the Regency Village Theatre in Westwood, Los Angeles, attracting prominent stars and highlighting an important step in the film and TV industry’s rebound. 

Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos, who was instrumental in brokering the agreements that ended the strikes, attended the premiere. “It’s a thrill,” Sarandos told Deadline, noting that this was his first industry event in months. He expressed happiness about resuming work with actors and writers after the long shutdown.

Sarandos described a sense of relief following intense negotiations alongside Disney CEO Bob Iger, Warner Bros. Discovery CEO David Zaslav, and NBCUniversal Studio Group Chairman Donna Langley. With 86% approval from the SAG-AFTRA national board, the deal now awaits union member ratification. Productions are quickly gearing up to get back on track. “I hope the members approve. It’s up to them now,” Sarandos commented.

The celebration included cast members Elizabeth Debicki, Jonathan Pryce, Khalid Abdala, Luther Ford (Prince Harry), and Ed McVey (Prince William). Sarandos and Netflix Chief Content Officer Bela Bajaria mingled with the stars, took photos, and admired costumes from the upcoming season. After months of subdued premieres due to the strike, this lively event signaled a promising restart for Hollywood.
translated_content:
Kwana hudu bayan kawo karshen yajin aikin SAG-AFTRA, Netflix ta shirya babban bikin gabatar da fim na farko a Hollywood bayan yajin aikin – don kakar 6 na The Crown a ranar Lahadi. An gudanar da taron a Regency Village Theatre dake Westwood, Los Angeles, inda manyan taurari suka halarta kuma hakan alama ce ta farfadowar masana’antar fim da talabijin.

Shugaban Netflix, Ted Sarandos, wanda ya taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen cimma yarjejeniyar kawo karshen yajin aikin, ya halarci taron. “Abin birgewa ne,” inji Sarandos ga Deadline, yana murna da samun damar dawowa aiki tare da ‘yan wasan kwaikwayo da marubuta bayan dogon hutun yajin aikin.

Sarandos ya bayyana jin dadi bayan muhawarar da aka yi da Bob Iger na Disney, David Zaslav na Warner Bros. Discovery, da Donna Langley na NBCUniversal Studio Group. Hukumar gudanarwar SAG-AFTRA ta amince da yarjejeniyar da kashi 86%, yanzu ana jiran mambobin kungiyar su tabbatar. Fina-finai da shirye-shiryen talabijin sun fara kokarin dawowa bakin aiki. “Ina fatan mambobi za su amince. Yanzu komai yana hannunsu,” in ji Sarandos.

Bikin ya samu halartar ‘yan wasan kwaikwayo kamar Elizabeth Debicki, Jonathan Pryce, Khalid Abdala, Luther Ford (Prince Harry), da Ed McVey (Prince William). Sarandos tare da Bela Bajaria, babban jami’in kula da abun ciki na Netflix, sun yi hoto da taurari kuma sun duba kayan ado na sabon kakar. Wannan biki mai kayatarwa, bayan watanni na shiru saboda yajin aikin, na nuni da sabon fata a Hollywood.

article_content: Thomas Kramer, a Miami-based German former real estate investor famous for his yachts, luxury cars, and extravagant parties, says he has spent nearly all of his $90 million fortune. According to a legal deposition connected to an unpaid $108 million judgment from 2007, Kramer now claims to have just $300,000 left, spending roughly $50,000 per month. Kramer, 56, reports having no current job or income, and says he has made efforts to cut costs, including selling his boats and valuable artwork and reducing his staff's working hours. Despite these claims, Kramer continues to attend high-profile events and travel internationally. In 2013, he attended the Golden Globes, visited Universal Studios, traveled to cities such as Tokyo, Seoul, Hong Kong, Bangkok, and Vietnam, hosted a birthday party in Las Vegas, attended the Cannes Film Festival, Elton John's White Tie and Tiara Summer Ball in England, and went to several weddings in different countries. In the deposition, Kramer says he owns two homes in South Beach worth up to $55 million. After selling his Range Rover to a friend, who still allows him to use it, he claims his only other transport is a bicycle his brother bought him at Costco for $149. According to the Miami Herald, Kramer also spent several weeks in Doha, Qatar, staying at Prince Ali Qatar's palace, and in Saint-Tropez at the home of a friend, Christian Jagodzinski. He says he once owned 20 properties among the most expensive real estate in the U.S., but business setbacks and the 2007 judgment led to his financial decline. Kramer states he funds his current lifestyle with a $3.3 million inheritance from his father, received in 2012, and says this accounted for $2 million in expenditures last year. When additional cash is required, he contacts Noman, a banker in Dubai, to have money wired to him. Kramer reports having $3.8 million in unpaid bills, including $1.8 million in real estate taxes. He sometimes earns money by renting the backyard of one of his homes for photo shoots and charity events. He suggests that when his remaining money is exhausted, he will likely declare bankruptcy, but says he will rely on his friends and family for support. MailOnline reached out to Kramer for comment, but he has not responded. His attorney also declined to comment.
translated_content: Thomas Kramer, tsohon dan kasuwa dan asalin Jamus da ke zaune a Miami, wanda aka fi sani da jiragen ruwansa, motoci masu tsada, da matsatsin shagulgulan alfarma, ya ce ya kashe kusa da dukiyar sa ta dalar Amurka miliyan 90. Bisa bayanin shari'a da ke da alaka da bashin da bai biya ba na dala miliyan 108 tun 2007, Kramer yanzu yana cewa ya rage masa kimanin dala 300,000, kuma yana kashewa kusan dala 50,000 a wata. Kramer, dan shekara 56, ya bayyana cewa ba shi da aiki ko wata hanya ta samun kudin shiga yanzu, kuma yana ce ya ɗauki matakai don rage kashe kudinsa, ciki har da sayar da jiragen ruwansa da zane-zanen sa masu tsada, da kuma rage kwanakin aiki na ma'aikatansa. Duk da wannan ikirarin, Kramer na ci gaba da halartar manyan taruka da kuma yin shakatawa a kasashe daban-daban. A 2013, ya halarci Golden Globes, ya kai ziyarar Universal Studios, ya je biranen Tokyo, Seoul, Hong Kong, Bangkok da Vietnam, ya shirya bikin haihuwarsa a Las Vegas, ya halarci Cannes Film Festival, da bikin Elton John's White Tie and Tiara Summer Ball a Ingila, da kuma manyan bukuwan aure a kasashe daban-daban. A cikin bayanin shari'a, Kramer ya ce yana da gidaje biyu a South Beach da darajarsu ta kai har zuwa dala miliyan 55. Bayan ya sayar da Range Rover dinsa ga abokinsa wanda har yanzu yana barin shi yin amfani da ita, ya ce kekin da dan uwansa ya saya masa a Costco kan dala 149 ne kawai abin hawan sa yanzu. A cewar Miami Herald, Kramer ya kuma kwashe wasu makonni a Doha, Qatar, inda ya sauka a fadar Prince Ali Qatar, da kuma a Saint-Tropez gidan abokinsa, Christian Jagodzinski. Ya ce a wani lokaci yana da gidaje 20 da suka fi tsada a Amurka, amma matsalolin kasuwanci da hukuncin kotu na 2007 sun sa dukiyarsa ta ragu sosai. Kramer ya bayyana cewa yana ci gaba da tafiyar da rayuwarsa ta alfarma ne da gadar dala miliyan 3.3 da ya samu daga mahaifinsa a 2012, inda ya ce bara kadai ya kashe dala miliyan 2 daga wannan kudi. Idan ya bukaci karin kudi, yana kira Noman, wani bankan dake Dubai, don a aika masa da kudi. Kramer ya ce yana da bashi har dala miliyan 3.8 da bai biya ba, ciki har da harajin kadara na dala miliyan 1.8. Wani lokaci yana samun kudi ta hanyar haya da bayan gidan daya daga cikin gidajensa don daukar hotuna ko tarukan sadaka. Ya ce idan kudin da ke hannunsa sun kare, zai iya bayyana fatarar kudi a kotu, amma zai dogara da abokansa da danginsa don taimako. MailOnline ta tuntubi Kramer don karin bayani, amma bai bada amsa ba. Lauyansa shi ma ya ki yin tsokaci.

article_content: The Boston Celtics bounced back from a surprise defeat to the Charlotte Hornets by edging out the Milwaukee Bucks 119-116 in Wednesday’s NBA Eastern Conference clash. Boston started strong with a 10-0 run and maintained control throughout the contest at TD Garden. Jaylen Brown led the team with 26 points, Jayson Tatum tallied 23 points, 11 rebounds, and four assists, while Kristaps Porzingis contributed 21. Seven Celtics players reached double figures, helping Boston preserve their unbeaten 12-3 home record. Jayson Tatum told ESPN after the game: 'It was a total team effort. We regrouped after our last loss and stayed composed when they made a run.' In Los Angeles, the Dallas Mavericks narrowly topped the Lakers 104-101. The Lakers clawed back from a 20-point deficit led by LeBron James’s 16 points in the fourth quarter and briefly took the lead. Kyrie Irving hit a crucial three-pointer to put Dallas ahead, then added two clutch free throws to secure the win. Irving finished with 28 points and Luka Doncic had 30. James ended with 26 points but missed a last-second three. Elsewhere, the Phoenix Suns defeated the Golden State Warriors 123-115 in a game marked by Chris Paul’s ejection for arguing with a referee. Kevin Durant paced Phoenix with 32 points, Devin Booker added 25. Klay Thompson led Golden State with 23 points, hitting six threes. Orlando Magic continued their impressive play, upsetting the NBA champion Denver Nuggets 124-119. Franz Wagner and Paolo Banchero combined for 50 points during a decisive fourth-quarter surge. Nikola Jokic recorded a triple-double with 30 points, 13 rebounds, and 12 assists. The Minnesota Timberwolves prevailed over the Philadelphia 76ers, 112-99. Anthony Edwards scored 31, and Karl-Anthony Towns contributed 23 points and 11 boards. In Atlanta, Trae Young poured in 43 points to lead the Hawks to a 147-145 overtime win against the Brooklyn Nets, who were led by a career-high 45 points from Mikal Bridges. In San Antonio, Kawhi Leonard scored 26 as the Clippers beat the Spurs 109-102. Rookie Victor Wembanyama led the Spurs with 22 points. During the game, Spurs coach Gregg Popovich used the mic to ask fans not to boo Leonard, calling for more sportsmanship.

Celtics sun fara da tashi 10-0, suna rike da damar har zuwa ƙarshe a TD Garden. Jaylen Brown ya ci maki 26, Jayson Tatum ya samu maki 23 tare da rebounds 11 da assists 4, Kristaps Porzingis ya taimaka da maki 21. Yan Celtics guda bakwai sun ci maki fiye da goma, hakan ya ba su damar kare bajintarsu a gida inda suka samu nasara 12-3. Jayson Tatum ya shaida wa ESPN bayan wasan: "Munga aiki tare a matsayin ƙungiya. Mun dawo da karfi bayan rashin nasara kuma muka zauna lafiya lokacin da abokan hamayya suka tashi." A Los Angeles, Dallas Mavericks sun lallasa Lakers da ci 104-101. Lakers sun dawo daga tazarar maki 20, inda LeBron James ya ci maki 16 a quarter na karshe har suka dan gabatar. Kyrie Irving ya ci muhimmiyar 'three-pointer' don mayar da Dallas gaba, sannan ya kara biyu daga bugun daga waje don rufe wasan. Irving ya samu maki 28, Luka Doncic 30; James ya tsaya da maki 26 amma ya rasa dunkulallen na ƙarshe. A wani wurin, Phoenix Suns sun doke Golden State Warriors 123-115, inda aka kori Chris Paul saboda cece-kuce da alkalin wasa. Kevin Durant ya ja ragamar Suns da maki 32, Devin Booker ya kara 25. A bangaren Golden State, Klay Thompson ya fi kowa maki da 23, ciki har da 'three-pointers' shida. Orlando Magic sun cigaba da bajinta, suka fitar da NBA champion Denver Nuggets da ci 124-119. Franz Wagner da Paolo Banchero sun hade maki 50 a kashi na karshe. Nikola Jokic ya samu triple-double da maki 30, rebounds 13 da assists 12. Minnesota Timberwolves sun kayar da Philadelphia 76ers da ci 112-99. Anthony Edwards ya cin maki 31, Karl-Anthony Towns yana da 23 da rebounds 11. A Atlanta, Trae Young ya ci maki 43, ya taimaka Hawks lashe Nets 147-145 a karin lokaci, duk da bajintar Mikal Bridges da ya ci maki mafi girma a tarihin sa – 45. A San Antonio, Kawhi Leonard ya zura maki 26 yayin Clippers suka doke Spurs 109-102. Victor Wembanyama, tauraro mai tasowa, ya cin wa Spurs maki 22. Yayin wasan, kocin Spurs Gregg Popovich ya yi kira ga magoya bayan su daina yi wa Leonard ihu, yana nema da a nuna mutunci da kyawawan halaye.

article_content: The Industrial Training Fund (ITF) in Abeokuta has completed the training and equipping of 165 individuals from Ogun State as part of the National Industrial Skills Development Programme, with participants chosen from all three senatorial districts. The training focused on practical vocations such as tailoring, solar installation, hair and beauty services, shoe and bag crafting, and P.O.P. installation. Of these beneficiaries, 120 were trained directly by ITF while 45 received training through a collaboration with Nigerian Breweries Plc. During a ceremony in Abeokuta, ITF Area Manager Mrs. Bolanle Ajibade encouraged the graduates to use their new skills not only to improve their own lives but to support Nigeria's economic growth. She cautioned them against selling the equipment provided, reminding them to value the training they received and prove the effectiveness of the program. Representing Nigerian Breweries, Corporate Affairs Manager Mr. John Denjuma highlighted that acquiring skills is a powerful way to reduce unemployment and pressed trainees to leverage these opportunities to create wealth, contributing to national productivity and development. He also reiterated Nigerian Breweries' ongoing commitment to youth empowerment and giving back to the community. Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Industry, Trade and Investment, Mr. Olu Ola Aikulola, urged the new graduates not to underestimate their beginnings and to show diligence in applying their new skills. In a similar vein, Mr. Waheed Adesina from the Ministry of Information and Strategy, via Mrs. Toluwalope Layade Kowo, praised ITF's consistent partnership with the government and encouraged the participants to use their expertise to generate wealth, ultimately benefiting Ogun State's economy. Speaking for the beneficiaries, Mr. Olaomo Akeem, who completed the P.O.P. installation training, expressed gratitude to both ITF and Nigerian Breweries, promising that he and fellow graduates would use their new skills to pursue entrepreneurship and create jobs for others.
translated_content: Hukumar Horas da Masana'antu (ITF) na ofishin yankin Abeokuta ta kammala horas da kuma bai wa mutane 165 ‘yan asalin Jihar Ogun kayan aiki, a karkashin shirin National Industrial Skills Development Programme, inda aka zabi mahalarta daga daukacin mazabu ukun da ke jihar. An horar da su a sana’o’in hannu kamar dinki, girka hasken rana, gyaran gashi da kyau, hada takalma da jaka, da kuma girka P.O.P. Daga cikin wadanda aka koyar, 120 ne ITF ta horar kai tsaye, 45 kuma ta hanyar hadin gwiwa da kamfanin Nigerian Breweries Plc. A lokacin bikin kammala horon a Abeokuta, shugabar ofishin yankin ITF, Mrs. Bolanle Ajibade, ta bukaci sabbin wadanda aka horar da su su yi amfani da kwarewarsu ba kawai don inganta rayuwarsu ba, har ma da taimakawa ci gaban tattalin arzikin Najeriya. Ta gargade su kada su sayar da kayan da aka ba su, ta kuma ja hankalinsu su girmama horon da suka samu, su nuna irin amfaninsa. A madadin kamfanin Nigerian Breweries, Manajan Hulda da Jama’a, Mr. John Denjuma, ya ce koyon sana’o’i hanya ce mai amfani wajen ta da hankali kan rage rashin aikin yi, ya kuma karfafawa mahalarta su yi amfani da wannan dama wajen neman arziki da taimakawa ci gaban kasa. Ya jaddada cewa kamfaninsu zai ci gaba da tallafawa matasa da inganta al’umma. Sakataren dindindin na Ma’aikatar Masana’antu, Kasuwanci da Zuba Jari, Mr. Olu Ola Aikulola, ya shawarci sabbin masu kwarewa da kada su raina karancin farawa, su kuma yi aiki tukuru da sabuwar kwarewar. Haka zalika, Mr. Waheed Adesina na Ma’aikatar Bayanai da Dabaru, ta hannun Mrs. Toluwalope Layade Kowo, ya yaba wa ITF bisa hada kai da gwamnati, ya kuma bukaci mahalarta su yi amfani da iliminsu don tabbatar da cigaban tattalin arziki a Ogun. Da yake jawabi a madadin sauran mahalarta, Mr. Olaomo Akeem wanda ya samu horo kan girka P.O.P., ya gode wa ITF da Nigerian Breweries, tare da alkawarin su da abokan horarsa za su yi amfani da sabbin kwarewar da suka samu wajen zama masu samar da ayyuka ga wasu.

article_content: Jose Riga has been appointed as the new Blackpool manager, with the club officially confirming a deal for the Belgian to take charge. The 56-year-old previously managed Charlton Athletic for two months before leaving at the end of last season. Riga succeeds Paul Ince at Bloomfield Road, following a period without a permanent manager. He held discussions with chairman Karl Oyston two weeks ago, resulting in a one-year rolling contract. Riga earned praise for helping Charlton Athletic remain in the Championship during his brief tenure and also has coaching experience with Standard Liege and AC Milan. Former Leeds boss Brian McDermott and Doncaster's Brian Flynn were also considered for the role. Under caretaker Barry Ferguson, Blackpool narrowly avoided relegation to League One last season. The team currently has only six players under contract, and Riga is preparing a list of potential new signings for the upcoming pre-season. Upon his appointment, Riga said: 'I had a good discussion with the chairman, and we reached an agreement. I am ready for the big challenge. With the support of the chairman and fans, I’m confident we can succeed.'
