Riga ya maye gurbin Paul Ince a Bloomfield Road, bayan wani lokaci ba tare da koci na dindindin ba. Ya tattauna da shugaban ƙungiyar, Karl Oyston, kimanin makonni biyu da suka gabata, wanda ya kai ga yarjejeniyar shekara guda mai ci gaba. Riga ya samu yabo saboda taimaka wa Charlton Athletic tsira a Championship da kuma kwarewar koyarwa a Standard Liege da AC Milan. Tsohon kocin Leeds, Brian McDermott, da na Doncaster, Brian Flynn, suma sun kasance cikin wadanda aka duba don aikin. A ƙarƙashin Barry Ferguson, Blackpool ta kubuta da ƙyar daga sauka zuwa League One bara. Yanzu haka ƙungiyar na da 'yan wasa shida kawai masu kwangila, kuma Riga na shirin kawo sababbin 'yan wasa kafin lokacin pre-season. Lokacin da aka naɗa shi, Riga ya ce: 'Na yi tattaunawa mai kyau da shugaban, kuma mun cimma matsaya. Na shirya tsaf don wannan ƙalubalen. Tare da goyon bayan shugaban da magoya baya, na yi imani za mu yi nasara.'

article_content: Lifetime is turning Stephen King’s chilling novella 'Big Driver' into a made-for-TV movie starring Maria Bello. The cast also includes Olympia Dukakis, Grammy-nominated rock musician Joan Jett, and Will Harris from 'Sky High.' This production represents the first time Stephen King has worked with Lifetime. 'Big Driver' first appeared in King’s 2010 collection 'Full Dark, No Stars.' The plot follows Tess Thorne, a crime novelist who, after her car breaks down in rural New England, is assaulted by a would-be rescuer. She survives the attack and returns home, fixated on getting revenge. Dukakis will play the role of Doreen, with Jett as Betsy Neal. The film is set to premiere in the fall. More information can be found at EW.com.

'Big Driver' ya fara fitowa a cikin littafin tarin na Stephen King mai suna 'Full Dark, No Stars' a shekarar 2010. Labarin na biye da Tess Thorne, marubuciya mai rubuta labaran laifi, wadda ta samu matsala a kan hanya a daren New England, sannan wani da ya zo taimakonta ya ci zarafinta. Bayan ta tsira, ta koma gida cike da kishin ramawa. Dukakis za ta buga matsayin Doreen, yayin da Jett za ta buga matsayin Betsy Neal. Za a nuna fim din a lokacin kaka. article_content: TikTok, a major video-sharing platform, is preparing for a legal battle after being hit with a €345 million ($363 million) data privacy fine and a compliance order from EU regulators. The penalties stem from concerns about the protection of personal data belonging to teenage users. Owned by ByteDance Ltd., TikTok is challenging the fine, having lodged an appeal with the European Union’s General Court. The company is also contesting a local order from its lead data regulator in Ireland, which calls for the removal of any “deceptive or manipulative” practices that could threaten user privacy. The €345 million fine followed a comprehensive investigation into TikTok’s child safeguarding policies. Known worldwide for its viral videos and more than 1 billion users, TikTok, alongside other social media platforms such as Meta and X (formerly Twitter), is facing scrutiny from EU regulators. The European Union has also issued warning letters to these platforms, urging swift action against disinformation. The Irish Data Protection Commission imposed the fine after finding that TikTok failed to adequately protect minors from unnecessary data processing and lacked transparency during the period from July 2020 to December 2020. The company’s practices violated GDPR rules designed to safeguard users aged 13 to 17. Because the breach had wider implications across Europe, the European Data Protection Board, made up of regulators from 30 European countries, had to approve the final decision. As TikTok plans to appeal the fine and the compliance order, it has declined to make further comments. Both the European Data Protection Board and the Irish data watchdog have also chosen not to comment on the ongoing legal proceedings. The panel has expressed particular concern that TikTok encourages minors to create public accounts and makes their content publicly accessible by default, raising additional privacy concerns.

Wadannan tara da oda sun samo asali ne daga damuwa kan kariyar bayanan sirri na matasan masu amfani. Mallakar ByteDance Ltd., TikTok na kalubalantar wannan hukunci ta hanyar daukaka kara zuwa Kotun Gaba ta Tarayyar Turai. Tara €345 miliyan ta biyo bayan cikakken bincike ne game da yadda TikTok ke tsare yara. Ayyukan kamfanin sun saba wa dokokin GDPR da aka kafa domin kariyar yara masu shekaru 13 zuwa 17. Saboda wannan keta doka na da tasiri a duk Turai, Hukumar Kula da Bayanai ta Tarayyar Turai wacce ke da wakilai daga kasashe 30, ta amince da hukuncin karshe. Yayin da TikTok ke shirin daukaka kara kan tara da odar bin doka, kamfanin bai fitar da karin bayani ba. Haka ma hukumomin kula da bayanai na EU da Ireland sun ki yin tsokaci kan shari'ar da ke gudana. article_content: Colin Jost and Michael Che had a busy week on Saturday Night Live’s 'Weekend Update,' making jokes about politics and pop culture. A prominent story was media and tech companies pulling their advertising from X (formerly Twitter) after ads appeared next to antisemitic posts. Jost joked, 'Which is a huge relief because I was definitely worried about where this was going to end up,' as a thumbs-up image appeared on the screen. Later, Jost made fun of Rupert Murdoch stepping down as CEO of Fox News' parent company and News Corp, saying Murdoch handed over the job to his son, calling him 'Darth Murdoch' in reference to Star Wars’ Darth Vader. The Sex and the City spinoff 'And Just Like That' was also mentioned. Jost talked about a woman in Europe who keyed several parked cars and blamed menopause, joking, 'Incidentally, ‘Feeling Menopausal’ was also the working title of And Just Like That.' President Joe Biden got a few jabs as well. Jost referenced a video of Biden calling China's President Xi a dictator while Secretary of State Antony Blinken looked uncomfortable: 'That’s the same face I make when my uncle starts a story by mentioning the race of the waitress.' Jost continued, 'It’s actually the same face I made when I first heard Biden say this about LL Cool J,' referring to a clip where Biden mispronounced the rapper’s name and commented on his physique. 'Weekend Update' with Colin Jost and Michael Che can be watched in the segment above.

Jost ya ce, 'Wannan dai babban sauki ne tunda na fara damuwa yadda abubuwan nan za su kare,' yayin da hotonsa yana daga yatsa ya bayyana a allon. An kuma kawo shirin 'And Just Like That,' inda Jost ya bada labarin wata mata daga Turai da ta fasa motoci ta kuma dora laifi kan menopause, inda ya yi dariya da cewa, 'A zahiri, “Feeling Menopausal” shi ne sunan na farko da aka ba shirin And Just Like That.' article_content: BRUSSELS — Ukraine, Moldova, and Georgia received encouraging news on Wednesday regarding their efforts to join the European Union. However, Balkan countries, which have waited even longer for membership in the world’s largest trading bloc, appear to be facing further delays. In a series of reports about prospective member states, the EU’s executive branch recommended that Ukraine should be allowed to begin accession talks after it addresses remaining issues. The European Commission commended Ukraine, which has been resisting a full-scale Russian invasion since February 24, 2022, for its institutional strength and determination. Nevertheless, the Commission stated that negotiations should start only after further progress on reducing corruption, curbing lobbying, and removing restrictions that could prevent national minorities from studying and reading in their own languages. Moldova—a neighbor of Ukraine that has also faced pressure from Russia—received a similar message. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen noted that Moldova faces ongoing destabilization, but recognized significant reforms. Moldova's accession talks depend on further advances in justice and anti-corruption measures. Georgia was informed that it could be formally named as an EU candidate if it addresses gaps, especially regarding corruption and election deficiencies. However, this does not guarantee immediate accession talks, as further reforms are needed. These recommendations, presented in annual progress reports, primarily serve as technical advice for the EU’s 27 member states to assess how well candidate countries align with EU standards. EU leaders are expected to decide whether to endorse the recommendations during a summit in Brussels on December 14-15, but unanimous agreement is not guaranteed. For instance, Hungary and Slovakia remain skeptical about Ukraine’s membership bid. Russia’s war in Ukraine has motivated the EU to consider expansion, potentially admitting new members as early as 2030. For the past two decades, the hope of joining the EU has driven pro-democratic reforms in many aspiring countries. However, Balkan states—Albania, Bosnia, Montenegro, Serbia, and Kosovo—have grown frustrated with what they perceive as slow progress and unmet promises. Some, like Bosnia, remain hampered by internal divisions that complicate reform, and the Commission said membership talks should start only after further progress. The report highlighted ongoing justice system and rights concerns in Bosnia’s Serb region. Serbia and Kosovo continue to refuse normalization of their relationship, which leaves them last in the EU’s accession process. Following recent cross-border violence in northern Kosovo, their leaders remain unwilling to even meet. Just before these recommendations were released, von der Leyen visited the Balkans to encourage economic reforms with a €6 billion ($6.4 billion) support package. A senior EU official, speaking anonymously, observed that some Balkan countries still expect to be the EU's main priority, but overlook Ukraine's rising importance. The official said Ukraine is showing enthusiasm and commitment currently lacking in the Balkans, as reflected in the Commission's enlargement reports. Meanwhile, Turkey's EU accession remains stalled. Although talks started in 2005, they have stalled in recent years. The Commission found serious shortcomings in Turkey’s democratic institutions, noting ongoing backsliding, declining human rights standards, and no significant progress against corruption.
translated_content: BRUSSELS — Ukraine, Moldova, da Georgia sun samu labari mai dadi a ranar Laraba dangane da kokarinsu na shiga kungiyar Tarayyar Turai (EU). Amma kasashen yankin Balkans, wadanda suka dade suna jiran zama membobin babbar kungiyar kasuwanci ta duniya, yanzu suna fuskantar wasu tsaiko. A cikin rahotannin da ke duba kasashen da ke son zama mambobin EU, rukunin zartarwa na EU ya bayar da shawarar a fara tattaunawa da Ukraine bayan ta cike ka’idojin da suka rage. Hukumar Tarayyar Turai ta yabawa Ukraine, wadda ke fuskantar mamayar Rasha tun 24 ga Fabrairu, 2022, saboda karfin kafuwarta da tsayin daka. Sai dai, hukumar ta ce dole ne tattaunawar shiga EU ta Ukraine ta tsaya har sai an kara kokari wajen yaki da cin hanci, rage tasirin masu ruwa da tsaki, da cire shingayen da zai hana kabilu karatu da karantawa da yaren su. Moldova makwabcinta—wadda ita ma ke fuskantar barazanar Rasha—ta samu irin wannan sako. Shugabar Hukumar Tarayyar Turai, Ursula von der Leyen, ta ce Moldova na fuskantar hare-haren tayar da hankali, amma ta amince akwai canje-canje masu kyau. Moldova za ta ci gaba da shirin tafiya idan ta samo ci gaba a fannin shari’a da yakar cin hanci. Georgia kuwa, an shaida mata za a iya sakata cikin jerin ‘yan takarar EU idan ta gyara bangaren cin hanci da na zabe, ko da hakan bai tabbatar da fara tattaunawa kai tsaye ba. Wadannan shawarwari na cikin rahoton cigaba na shekara, suna zama shawarwarin fasaha ga kasashen EU guda 27 wajen lura da daidaituwar sabbin kasashe da ka’idodin EU. Shugabannin EU za su yanke hukunci ko za su amince da wadannan shawarwari a taron Disamba 14-15 a Brussels, amma ba tabbacin amincewa gaba daya ba. Sun hada da Hungary da Slovakia, wadanda ke nuna shakku kan burin Ukraine. Yakin Rasha da Ukraine ya sa EU ke duba yin fadi, da yiwuwar karbar sababbin mambobi nan da 2030. Shekaru 20 da suka wuce, burin shiga EU ya zamo ginshikin cigaban dimokradiyya ga wadanda ke sha’awar zama memba. Amma kasashen Balkans — Albania, Bosnia, Montenegro, Serbia, da Kosovo — sun gaji da jinkiri da rashin cika alkawurra. Wasu kamar Bosnia na fama da takaddama a ciki wanda ke kawo cikas, inda EU tace tattaunawa sai an yabo cigaba. Rahoton ya jaddada matsalolin shari’a da hakkin dan Adam a bangaren Bosnia na Serb. Serbia da Kosovo sun ki sulhu da junansu don samun ci gaba da shiga EU. Bayan tashin hankali a arewacin Kosovo, shugabanninsu ma ba sa haduwa. Kafin fitar da wadannan shawarwari, von der Leyen ta zagaya Balkans domin karfafa tattalin arziki da euro biliyan 6 (€6.4 biliyan Dala). Wani manyan jami’in EU da ya nemi a boye sunansa ya ce wasu kasashen Balkans har yanzu na ganin kansu da muhimmanci a idon EU, suna manta da yadda abubuwa suka sake canzawa zuwa ga Ukraine. Jami’in ya ce Ukraine na nuna himma, kwazo da azama da ba mu gani a Balkans, kamar yadda rahoton ci gaba na EU ya nuna. A daya bangaren, burin Turkiyya na shiga EU har yanzu yana fuskantar cikas. article_content: The Bundesliga's new season kicked off on Saturday, bringing promising starts for teams that struggled last year. Stuttgart began their campaign with a 3-0 victory over Schalke at the Mercedes Benz Arena. Brazilian striker Cacau scored first with a header in the 37th minute, followed by Austrian forward Martin Harnik, who doubled the lead 11 minutes into the second half. Japanese striker Shinji Okazaki finished the scoring with a strike near the end, handing last season’s Champions League semi-finalists a decisive defeat. Hanover 96 also had a positive start, defeating Hoffenheim 2-1. Former German international Jan Schlaudraff opened the scoring with a free-kick after 15 minutes. Hoffenheim responded quickly, equalizing three minutes later when Bosnia and Herzegovina midfielder Sejad Salihovic converted a penalty. Hanover regained the lead after being awarded their own penalty, which Norwegian striker Mohammed Abdellaoue converted into the winning goal. Werder Bremen earned a 2-0 win over Kaiserslautern thanks to two second-half goals by Swedish striker Markus Rosenberg. Wolfsburg, Bundesliga champions in 2009 but 15th last season, also claimed three points with a 3-0 win at Cologne. Former German striker Patrick Helmes scored twice, and Marcel Schaefer added another goal. Newly-promoted Augsburg managed a 2-2 draw at home to Freiburg by scoring twice in the second half through Sascha Mölders. Last season's second division champions, Hertha Berlin, suffered a 1-0 home defeat to Nuremberg, with Czech striker Tomas Pekhart securing the win ten minutes from time. Bayern Munich will open their league campaign on Sunday at home against Borussia Moenchengladbach, while last season’s runners-up, Bayer Leverkusen, are set to play away at Mainz.

Dan wasan Brazil Cacau ya fara jefa kwallo da kai a minti na 37, sai dan wasan Ostiriya Martin Harnik ya kara ta biyu mintuna 11 da shigowar rabin na biyu. Dan wasan Japan Shinji Okazaki ya kammala kwallaye da wata kwallo a karshen wasa, wanda ya sa kungiyoyin da suka kai matakin kusa da karshe na Champions League bara suka sha kashi. Hanover 96 ma sun fara kakar da kyau, inda suka doke Hoffenheim da ci 2-1. Tsohon dan wasan Jamus Jan Schlaudraff ya fara da bugun tazara minti 15 da fara wasa. Bayan haka, Hoffenheim sun dawo cikin wasa da sauri, inda dan wasan Bosnia da Herzegovina Sejad Salihovic ya jefa kwallo ta bugun daga kai sai mai tsaron raga, bayan mintuna uku. Wolfsburg, wadanda suka lashe Bundesliga a 2009 amma suka gama a matsayi na 15 bara, suma sun lashe maki uku da wata nasara 3-0 a kan Cologne. Patrick Helmes, tsohon dan wasan Jamus, ya jefa kwallaye biyu, sannan Marcel Schaefer ya kara daya. Zakaran rukunin kasa bara, Hertha Berlin, sun sha kashi a gida da ci 1-0 a hannun Nuremberg, inda dan kasar Czech Tomas Pekhart ya ci kwallon da ta basu nasara minti goma kafin a tashi daga wasa. article_content: Financial markets typically experience shifting regimes or states, with each environment differing significantly from the others. While various models have aimed to capture these regime dynamics, many struggle to perform well when tested on unfamiliar (out-of-sample) data. In a study published in The Journal of Finance and Data Science, a team of US-based researchers developed a novel method to model market regime dynamics and construct portfolios, demonstrating significant out-of-sample performance compared to benchmarks. "To define market states, we used efficient frontiers—trade-off curves constructed when optimizing portfolios to maximize expected return and minimize volatility," explained Nolan Alexander, the study's first and corresponding author. "These efficient frontiers can be described by three coefficients, forming the basis of our market states." The researchers modeled state transitions using a Markov process, where the probability of moving to a new state depends on historical transition frequencies. "To develop a portfolio using this Markov model, we computed portfolio-optimized weights for each state based only on data from that state," said Alexander. "These weights are then aggregated and weighted by the probability of transitioning to each state." Alexander added, "Our proposed model is more interpretable than standard regime-shifting Hidden Markov Models (HMMs), which often lack interpretability due to hidden states." In an illustrative example, the model uses two states, five months of data, and four assets. If the last observed state is State 2, the probability of transitioning to State 1 is 1/3, and to State 2 is 2/3. Each state's tangency portfolio is calculated from its own data, and the final portfolio aggregates these, weighted by transition probabilities: 1/3 and 2/3 respectively. (Credit: Nolan Alexander et al.) Since the proposed model uses observable states, it is now possible to analyze the model's intermediate components to understand how final portfolio weights are determined. "We found that, across multiple universes, there exist several bull market states, but one is much more likely to transition to a bear market than the others," said Alexander. "Additionally, for universes partitioning the US stock market, bearish states are more likely to recur than to transition to any other, a recurrence property not present in the Developed Markets universe."
translated_content: Kasuwannin kudi a mafi yawan lokaci kan sauya yanayi ko matakai, inda kowanne mataki ke da bambanci sosai da wani. Ko da yake akwai nau’ikan samfurori da aka ƙirƙira don gano waɗannan matakan, da dama daga cikinsu ba sa yin aiki yadda ya kamata tare da bayanan da ba su saba da su ba. A wani bincike da aka wallafa a mujallar The Journal of Finance and Data Science, wata ƙungiyar masu bincike daga Amurka sun ƙirƙiri wata sabuwar hanya don nazarin canjin yanayin kasuwa da kuma gina jakunkuna masu zuba jari, inda aka ga ta fi sauran samfurori aiki a sabbin bayanai. "Domin fassara matakan kasuwa, mun yi amfani da efficient frontiers—wadanda ake amfani da su wajen tsara jakunkunan zuba jari domin samun riba mafi yawa da kuma rage haɗari," in ji Nolan Alexander, shugaban binciken. "Wadannan efficient frontiers na kunshe da coefficients guda uku, wanda muke amfani da su a matsayin asali don ayyana matakan kasuwa." Masu binciken sun tsara yadda matakai ke sauyawa ta amfani da Markov process, wadda ke amfani da tarihin canjawa don lissafa yuwuwar sake faruwa. "Don gina jakar zuba jari ta amfani da wannan tsarin Markov, mun lissafa nauyin kowane jari ga kowanne mataki bisa bayanai daga matakin kawai," in ji Alexander. "Bayan hakan sai a tattara nauyin kowanne kuma a daidaita da yuwuwar sauya zuwa matakin." Alexander ya ce, "Sabuwar samfurarmu ta fi saukin fahimta fiye da Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) na yau da kullum, wanda suka fi ɓoyewa." A misali, samfurin na amfani da matakai biyu, bayanan watanni biyar, da hajar jari hudu. Idan mataki na ƙarshe shine Mataki na 2, yuwuwar sauyawa zuwa Mataki na 1 shine 1/3, zuwa Mataki na 2 shine 2/3. Ana lissafa tangency portfolios na kowanne mataki daga bayanan matakin, sai a haɗa su tare da yakinin canji tsakanin matakai: 1/3 da 2/3. (Tushen hoto: Nolan Alexander da abokan aiki.) Tunda wannan samfurin yana amfani da matakan da ake iya gani a fili, abu ne mai sauki a bincika yadda abubuwa ke gudana don fahimtar yadda aka ƙayyade nauyin ƙarshe. "Mun gano cewa, a kasuwanni da dama, akwai bull market states fiye da ɗaya, amma ɗaya daga ciki shi ne ya fi saukin canzawa zuwa bear market," in ji Alexander. "Haka zalika, a kasuwannin da suka raba US stock market, idan an shiga mataki mai matsin lamba (bearish), sau da yawa ana komawa wannan mataki fiye da sauyawa zuwa wani mataki—inda hakan ba ya faruwa a kasuwar Developed Markets."

article_content: Pippa Middleton, although not widely regarded as a business expert, has demonstrated notable business skill over the last year. According to Companies House, she earned nearly £250,000 as the sole director and shareholder of PXM Enterprises Limited. In its inaugural year, PXM Enterprises reported assets of £229,241, with about £211,521 of that in cash. This achievement positions Pippa as the most financially successful among the Middleton siblings, outpacing her brother James, whose ventures have faced difficulties. James’s companies, Nice Cakes Ltd and Nice Wine Ltd, both ceased operations with assets totaling only £20 at closure. From the company’s inception in May 2013 until the end of May the following year, Pippa’s enterprise outstripped her brother’s earnings by approximately £229,221. While the company is officially listed under 'Other publishing activities'—perhaps alluding to her book 'Celebrate!'—her main sources of income seem to be a variety of writing and editorial roles, including columns for Waitrose Kitchen and Vanity Fair, and editorial duties for the Party Times, her parents’ web magazine. After settling debts of £115,000, Pippa’s company retained a profit of £115,192. Her success closely mirrors that of her mother, Carole Middleton, who is known for her own business achievements. James, meanwhile, now concentrates on Boomf, a personalized marshmallow venture yet to file accounts, and continues to operate The Cake Kit Company, serving primarily business clients. Despite initial skepticism about her business capabilities, Pippa has surpassed her brother’s business outcomes and follows in her mother’s entrepreneurial footsteps. The family, including Pippa, James, the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge, and Prince George, recently celebrated Carole’s 60th birthday together in Mustique.

article_content: A senior judge has ruled that schools cannot be expected to eliminate all risks for students, highlighting that children's tendency to play can make accidents unavoidable. The judgement came after nine-year-old Lewis Pierce, who injured his thumb during a playground game with his brother at St Andrew's School in Nuthurst, initially received more than £3,000 in compensation for his injury. Lewis cut his hand after hitting a newly installed water fountain while reacting to his brother spraying him with water. Although the original trial found the local council negligent, the Court of Appeal, led by Lady Justice Sharp, overturned this, emphasizing that requiring schools to be entirely hazard-free would be unrealistic. The court noted that the water fountain was not particularly sharp and that Lewis’s injury resulted from an unforeseen reaction. The family had argued the school failed to assess risks before setting up the fountain, but the council pointed out that similar fountains exist across England and Wales without issues. The judge warned that a compensation ruling could have led schools to cover every edge to avoid liability. The council praised the decision as practical, and while Lewis’s family defended their lawsuit, they now face court costs for both hearings.

Wannan hukuncin ya biyo bayan wani yaro mai shekara tara, Lewis Pierce, wanda ya sami rauni a yatsansa lokacin wasa da ɗan uwansa a filin wasa na makarantar St Andrew's da ke Nuthurst, inda aka ba shi diyyar fiye da £3,000 tun da farko. Iyalan sun zargi makarantar da rashin duba haɗari kafin saka rijiyar, amma hukumar ta nuna irin wannan rijiyar akwai su a makarantu da dama a Ingila da Wales ba tare da matsala ba. article_content: Over the past two years, the BBC has spent more than £2 million moving staff and guests between London, Manchester, and Salford, despite plans to hire more employees near its new Salford base at MediaCity. The organization covered the cost of at least 24,000 train rides and over 500 flights between these cities. Of the total expenditures, over £1.8 million went towards train fares and almost £77,000 was allocated to flights, with the funding coming from taxpayer money. Since last May, thousands of staff members have relocated to the North West as part of the move to Salford, often splitting work between original and new offices. This led to a nearly 30% increase in travel costs from 2009-10 to 2010-11, attested by Freedom of Information records. From May to December last year, monthly travel spending frequently exceeded £100,000. The BBC spent over £640,000 on train journeys to Manchester, more than £45,000 on flights, and upwards of £160,000 on taxis. Noteworthy trips included a £1,502 flight from Dubai and numerous taxi rides with fares in the hundreds. The relocation effort has meant that employees are typically expected to travel by rail unless flights are considerably more affordable or quicker. The BBC also provides shuttle buses for journeys between sites and covers late-night or early-morning commutes within a set radius. Increased transparency follows prior criticism of the BBC’s spending habits, including a former director-general’s costly flight. Senior staff expenses are now regularly published, and the National Audit Office will later assess whether moving the headquarters was cost-effective. BBC Breakfast is now based in Salford, with permanent presenters like Bill Turnbull and Susanna Reid eligible for full relocation packages. Meanwhile, freelance hosts, such as Louise Minchin and Charlie Stayt, would bear moving expenses themselves. So far, about 46% of BBC Breakfast staff have transferred, alongside more than 2,200 staff from other BBC divisions.

Masu aikin kwangila irinsu Louise Minchin da Charlie Stayt su ne za su biya nasu. Yanzu haka, kimanin kashi 46 cikin dari na ma’aikatan BBC Breakfast sun koma Salford tare da fiye da ma’aikata 2,200 daga sassa daban-daban na BBC.

article_content: Teachers have long experienced lower pay compared to workers in other professions, and this wage gap grew wider in 2022, according to a recent report. Economist Sylvia Allegretto, from the Center for Economic and Policy Research and the Economic Policy Institute, examined how public school teachers' salaries compare to those of college graduates working in other fields. The analysis, drawn from the Census Bureau's Current Population Survey, included full-time workers aged 18 to 64 with at least a bachelor's degree. The report found that the pay gap—adjusted for education, experience, and demographic characteristics—has steadily worsened. In 2022, teachers earned 26.4% less than similarly qualified college graduates in other fields, the largest gap ever recorded. While teachers typically receive a higher share of their total compensation as benefits, such as healthcare and retirement plans, this only partially offsets the wage disadvantage. The total compensation penalty for teachers was 10.2% in 2019 (with a 9% benefits advantage and a 19.2% wage penalty). This penalty grew to 14.2% in 2021 and 17% in 2022. Beyond pay, teachers often use their own money to buy classroom supplies. The challenges faced by teachers extend beyond compensation. According to Allegretto, increasing stress from curriculum disputes, COVID-19 policies, and rising incidents of school violence further impact teachers’ well-being. These issues contribute to teacher turnover. A 2022 McKinsey survey of over 1,800 educators found that 31% planning to leave cited well-being concerns, while nearly half pointed to compensation as a reason. Former teacher Mahala Kuehne shared with Insider that she earned around $55,000 by her fifth year, often working 9- or 10-hour days, and felt undercompensated. She noted an unspoken expectation that teachers should accept lower pay because teaching is viewed as a passion, not just a job. The report suggests that teacher compensation and well-being deserve more attention to ensure the sustainability and quality of public education.
translated_content: Malaman makaranta sun dade suna fuskantar karancin albashi idan aka kwatanta da ma’aikata a wasu fannoni, kuma gibin wannan albashi ya kara fadada a shekarar 2022, kamar yadda wani rahoto na baya-bayan nan ya nuna. Masani tattalin arziki, Sylvia Allegretto daga Cibiyar Binciken Tattalin Arziki da Siyasa tare da Institute Policy na Tattalin Arziki, ta gudanar da bincike kan yadda albashin malamai na makarantun gwamnati ke kwatanta da na wadanda suka kammala jami’a da ke aiki a wasu sassa. Binciken ya samo bayanai ne daga binciken Census Bureau na Amurka, wanda ya hada ma’aikata cikakku masu shekaru daga 18 zuwa 64 da akalla digirin farko. Rahoton ya nuna cewa gibin albashi—da aka daidaita bisa ilimi, kwarewa, da al’amuran al’umma—yana kara tsananta. A shekarar 2022, malamai sun samu kashi 26.4 cikin 100 kasa da sauran ma’aikatan da suka yi karatu daya da su, wanda shi ne mafi girma da aka taba samu. Kodayake, malamai na samun kaso mafi yawa na albashinsu ta hanyar fa’idodi kamar kiwon lafiya da tsarin ritaya, hakan bai kai ga rufe gibin albashi ba gaba daya. Hukuncin tarin fa’ida ga malamai ya kasance kashi 10.2 cikin 100 a 2019 (fa’idar fa’ida ta 9% da hukuncin albashi na 19.2%). Wannan hukunci ya karu zuwa 14.2% a 2021 da 17% a 2022. Ban da albashi, malamai da dama na kashe kudadensu wajen sayen kayan aiki don aji. Kalubalen da malamai ke fuskanta sun fi na kudi kadai. A cewar Allegretto, karin damuwa daga rigingimu kan manhaja, dokokin COVID-19, da karuwar tashin hankali a makarantu suna kara shafar jin dadin malamai. Wadannan matsaloli na sa malamai su bar aiki. Wani bincike na McKinsey daga 2022 da ya tattauna da malamai sama da 1,800 ya nuna cewa kashi 31% daga cikin wadanda ke shirin barin aikin sun ambaci damuwar lafiyar kwakwalwa, kusan rabinsu kuma sun ambaci rashin gamsuwa da albashi. Tsohuwar malama Mahala Kuehne ta fada wa Insider cewa ta samu kusan $55,000 zuwa shekararta ta biyar, tana aiki har sa’o’i 9 zuwa 10 a rana, tana kuma jin ana biyan ta kasa da ya dace. Ta bayyana cewa akwai wani ra’ayi cewa bai kamata malami ya koka ba saboda aikin koyarwa ana kallonsa a matsayin aikin sha’awa ne ba aikin samun kudi kawai ba. Rahoton ya nuna cewa ya zama dole a duba albashi da jin dadin malamai idan ana so a kiyaye inganci da dorewar ilimi a makarantun gwamnati.

article_content: Democrats in Congress currently hold minority status. This means they cannot call for a vote to elect or remove the Speaker of the House; that responsibility lies with the majority party, the Republicans (GOP). Recently, the GOP removed their own Speaker, Kevin McCarthy, after Representative Matt Gaetz, a Republican, led a motion to vacate the position.  Despite this, some Republicans have assigned blame to Democrats for not supporting a GOP nominee for Speaker who had pledged not to compromise with them. Representative Austin Scott (R-GA) stated that Democrats played a crucial role in ousting McCarthy, emphasizing that 208 out of the total votes to remove the Speaker came from Democrats, while only eight Republicans supported the move.  In an exchange with CNN's Brianna Keilar, Scott insisted that Democrats' votes were decisive. Keilar, however, countered by highlighting that the House majority is responsible for electing the Speaker, not the minority. She pressed Scott on the GOP's responsibility in the matter, noting that while Democrats provided most of the votes to remove McCarthy, it was the Republicans’ internal disagreements and small number of dissenters that ultimately led to his removal.  This exchange underscores ongoing partisan disagreements and the complicated dynamics within the House regarding the selection and removal of its Speaker.

article_content: Martti Ahtisaari, former president of Finland, diplomat, teacher, and global peace broker who was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2008 for his work to resolve international conflicts, has died at the age of 86. Current Finnish President Sauli Niinistö called Ahtisaari 'a Finn with a big heart.' Niinistö added, 'He believed in people, education, and goodness. He worked tirelessly for peace and life, even for those living far away and under very different circumstances. For him, human dignity was inviolable.' Niinistö's remarks were delivered in a Monday television speech that replaced regular programming on Yle, Finland's public broadcaster. Ahtisaari served as Finland's president for one term from 1994 to 2000. The foundation he established after leaving office to prevent and resolve violent conflicts said it was 'deeply saddened by the loss of its founder and chair of the board.' In 2021, it was announced that Ahtisaari had advanced Alzheimer's disease. His death was confirmed on Monday morning. Among his achievements, Ahtisaari helped negotiate peace accords related to Serbia's withdrawal from Kosovo in the late 1990s, Namibia’s bid for independence in the 1980s, and autonomy for Aceh province in Indonesia in 2005. He also participated in the Northern Ireland peace process in the late 1990s, monitoring the disarmament process of the IRA. When the Norwegian Nobel Peace Committee awarded him the Nobel Peace Prize in October 2008, they cited his 'important efforts, on several continents and over more than three decades, to resolve international conflicts.' Born on June 23, 1937, in the eastern town of Viipuri—now part of Russia—Ahtisaari worked as a primary school teacher before joining Finland’s Foreign Ministry in 1965. He spent about 20 years abroad, first as Finland's ambassador to Tanzania, Zambia, and Somalia, and later as its top diplomat at the United Nations in New York. He later joined the UN, initially at its New York headquarters before heading the UN operation that oversaw Namibia’s independence in 1990. Ahtisaari became deeply involved in supporting Namibian independence during his diplomatic service in Africa in the 1970s. He was appointed special representative to Namibia by UN Secretary-General Kurt Waldheim in 1978 and is widely credited with helping guide the nation to independence as head of UN peacekeeping forces in the late 1980s. The Namibian government made him an honorary citizen in recognition of his efforts. After returning to Finland in 1991, Ahtisaari served as foreign ministry secretary of state before being elected president in 1994, becoming the first Finnish head of state chosen by direct election rather than an electoral college. As a political outsider who had spent many years abroad, he was seen as bringing fresh perspectives to Finnish politics. Ahtisaari was a strong supporter of the European Union and NATO, organizations Finland joined in 1995 and 2023, respectively. A major highlight of his presidency came in 1999 when, alongside Russia’s Balkans envoy Viktor Chernomyrdin, he brokered an end to fighting in Kosovo. He also hosted Russian President Boris Yeltsin and U.S. President Bill Clinton at a US-Russia summit in Helsinki in March 1997. As president, Ahtisaari traveled internationally more than any of his predecessors. Domestically, he was sometimes seen as impatient with media criticism and was more comfortable in international settings. He declined to seek a second term in the January 2000 presidential election, saying he wanted to focus on running Finland's presidency of the European Union, which the country held for the first time in 1999. After his presidency, Ahtisaari was offered several international roles, including with the UN refugee agency, but chose to establish his own office in Helsinki, dedicated to mediation in international crises. In May 2017, Ahtisaari stepped down as chairman of the Crisis Management Initiative, which he founded in 2000 to help resolve global conflicts, but continued to serve as an adviser to the organization. Ahtisaari is survived by his wife Eeva and their adult son. He will be given a state funeral, with the date to be announced later.
translated_content: Martti Ahtisaari, tsohon shugaban kasar Finland, ɗan diflomasiyya, malami, kuma mai kokari wajen samar da zaman lafiya a duniya wanda ya samu lambar yabo ta Nobel Peace Prize a shekarar 2008 saboda kokarinsa wajen shawo kan rikice-rikicen kasa da kasa, ya rasu yana da shekaru 86. Shugaban Finland na yanzu, Sauli Niinistö, ya bayyana Ahtisaari a matsayin 'Bafinniya mai zuciya mai girma.' Niinistö ya ce, 'Ya yi imani da mutane, ilimi da nagarta. Ya yi aiki tukuru don zaman lafiya da rayuwa, har ma ga wadanda ke nesa kuma suna rayuwa a yanayi daban-daban. A gare shi, mutunci na dan Adam ba za a tauye ba.' Niinistö ya gabatar da wannan jawabi a wani shirin talabijin ranar Litinin wanda ya maye gurbin shirye-shiryen yau da kullum a tashar Yle, gidan talabijin na kasar Finland. Ahtisaari ya zama shugaban kasar Finland na tsawon wa'adi daya daga 1994 zuwa 2000. Kungiyar da ya kafa bayan shiga murabus daga shugabanci don hana da shawo kan tashe-tashen hankula tana nuna alhinin rashin wanda ya kafa ta kuma shugaban kwamitin ta. A shekarar 2021, an sanar da cewa Ahtisaari na fama da ciwon mantuwa na Alzheimer mai tsanani. An tabbatar da rasuwarsa da safiyar Litinin. Daga cikin manyan nasarorinsa, Ahtisaari ya taimaka wajen cimma yarjejeniyar zaman lafiya da ta shafi janyewar Serbia daga yankin Kosovo a ƙarshen shekarun 1990, yunkurin samun 'yancin kai na Namibia a shekarun 1980, da samun 'yanci ga yankin Aceh a kasar Indonesia a 2005. Haka kuma, ya taka rawa a tsarin zaman lafiya a Northern Ireland a shekaru 1990, inda yake sa ido kan matakan mika makamai na kungiyar IRA. Lokacin da kwamitin Nobel Peace na Norway ya ba shi lambar yabo a watan Oktoban 2008, sun bayyana 'kokarin da ya yi, a nahiyoyi da dama sama da shekaru talatin, wajen warware rikice-rikicen kasa da kasa.' An haifi Ahtisaari a ranar 23 ga Yuni, 1937, a garin Viipuri—yanzu a Rasha—inda ya fara aiki a matsayin malamin makaranta kafin ya shiga aikin diflomasiyya a ma'aikatar harkokin wajen Finland a 1965. Ya kwashe kusan shekaru 20 a kasashen waje, da fari a matsayin jakadan Finland a kasashen Tanzaniya, Zambia da Somalia, sannan kuma ya zama babban jami'i a Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a birnin New York. Daga baya ya shiga aikin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya kai tsaye, inda ya fara aiki a hedkwatar su a New York, kafin daga bisani ya jagoranci aikin da ya ba Namibia 'yancin kai a shekarar 1990. Ahtisaari ya shafe lokaci sosai yana kokari wajen shirya 'yan Namibiya domin samun 'yanci a lokacin aikinsa a nahiyar Afrika cikin shekarun 1970. An nada shi wakili na musamman zuwa Namibia daga Sakataran Janar na MDD, Kurt Waldheim, a shekarar 1978, kuma ana yabonsa a matsayin wanda ya tallafa sosai ga 'yancin kasar a matsayin shugaban rundunar kiyaye zaman lafiya ta MDD a karshen shekarun 1980. Gwamnatin Namibia ta ba shi dan girmamawa a kasar. Bayan dawowarsa Finland a 1991, Ahtisaari ya zama sakataren ma’aikatar harkokin wajen kafin a zabe shi shugaban kasa a 1994, yana mai zama shugaban kasa na farko a tarihin kusar da aka zaba kai tsaye maimakon ta hanyar wani kwamitin zabe. Saboda ya dade yana zama a kasashen waje, an dauke shi a matsayin sabuwar fuska a siyasar Finland. Ahtisaari mai goyon bayan kungiyar Tarayyar Turai (EU) da kungiyar tsaro ta NATO, wacce Finland ta shiga a shekarar 1995 da kuma 2023. Babban abin lura a mulkinsa shi ne huldarsa da mika wuya a Kosovo a 1999 tare da dan majalisar Balkans na Rasha Viktor Chernomyrdin, inda suka kawo karshen fada. Haka kuma, ya karbi bakuncin Shugaban Rasha Boris Yeltsin da Shugaban Amurka Bill Clinton a taron kolin Amurka da Rasha a birnin Helsinki a watan Maris 1997. A matsayin shugaban kasa, Ahtisaari ya fi kowane wanda ya riga shi yawan tafiya wajen huldar kasa da kasa. A cikin gida, wasu lokuta yana jin rashin jin dadin wasu daga bakin yan jarida, kuma yafi jin dadin aiki a matakin kasa da kasa. Ya ƙi tsayawa takara don wa’adi na biyu a zaben shugaban kasa na Janairu 2000, yana mai cewa zai fi mayar da hankali kan jagorancin Finland na shugabancin kungiyar Tarayyar Turai, wanda kasar ta samu a karon farko a 1999. Bayan ya gama mulki, Ahtisaari ya samu tayin mukamai na kasa da kasa, ciki har da na hukumar 'yan gudun hijira ta MDD, amma ya zabi bude ofishinsa a Helsinki wanda ke mai da hankali kan sasanci a matsalolin duniya. A watan Mayu 2017, Ahtisaari ya ajiye matsayin shugaban Crisis Management Initiative, wanda ya kafa a shekara ta 2000 domin taimakawa wajen warware rikice-rikicen duniya, amma ya ci gaba da zama mai ba da shawara ga kungiyar. Ahtisaari ya bar matarsa Eeva da dan su guda daya. Za a yi masa jana’iza ta girmamawa daga gwamnati, kwanan wata za a bayyana daga baya.

article_content: Tottenham Hotspur striker Emmanuel Adebayor has publicly denied accusations that he forced his mother out of his house in Africa over allegations of witchcraft. In an interview with Ghanaian radio station Peace FM, Adebayor addressed statements made by his sister, Maggie, who claimed the footballer had not provided financial support to their mother and had not seen her in over a year. Their mother is reportedly selling items like polythene bags and padlocks to support herself. Adebayor stated, 'I never sacked my mum from the house. She decided to leave on her own.' He explained the situation further, saying, 'How am I going to be in touch with my mum if my mum is the one telling everyone that my work will not go forward? I will just be on my side and do my thing.' He urged people to 'stop doing Juju'—a term for spiritual practices involving spells in West Africa—against him, and asked to be left alone. Adebayor also mentioned, 'I bought a $1.2 million house in East Legon for the one talking and calling herself my sister. Can you imagine that sister went to rent the house without my knowledge?' It remains unclear at whom his message about stopping Juju was directed. Adebayor, who earns £101,000 per week and has scored two goals in 12 games this season, is hoping to focus on football as Tottenham faces Hull this weekend. The full interview can be found at Peacefmonline.com.

An ruwaito mahaifiyarsu na sayar da kaya kamar buhunan roba da makulli don samun na kai wa baka. Adebayor ya ce, 'Ban taba korar mahaifiyata daga gida ba. Ita ce ta bar gidan da kanta.' Ya sake bayyana cewa, 'Ta yaya zan rika mu’amala da mahaifiyata ina ga ita ce ke gaya wa kowa cewa aiki na ba zai samu ci gaba ba? Saboda haka, zan ci gaba da rayuwata.' Ya zuwa yanzu ba a sani ba wa su wanene yake nufi da batun daina yin Juju a kansa. Adebayor, wanda ke daukar fam 101,000 a mako kuma ya ci kwallaye biyu cikin wasa 12 bana, yana fatan mayar da hankali kan kwallo yayin da Tottenham za su kara da Hull ranar karshen mako. Za a iya sauraren cikakken hirar a Peacefmonline.com.

article_content: Derek Acorah, recognized for his television psychic work, has denied reports suggesting he claimed Madeleine McCann is no longer alive. The Sun newspaper allegedly quoted Acorah as saying that Madeleine, who went missing in Portugal five years ago, is in the 'spirit world' and would soon return through reincarnation. Acorah refutes these remarks, asserting that nobody truly knows Madeleine’s fate. He has offered to travel to Portugal and utilize his psychic abilities to assist investigators, assuring that any findings would be passed to the police. Acorah claims he was misquoted and expresses that, as a sensitive person, he would not impose his beliefs on others. He also said he hopes and believes Madeleine is alive. Some have questioned why Acorah is choosing to join the search now, particularly as it coincides with his theatre tour. His credibility as a psychic was previously challenged by psychologist Dr Ciaran O'Keeffe, who alleged that Acorah faked paranormal events on a TV program. Throughout the years, Kate and Gerry McCann have maintained hope that their daughter will be found. Scotland Yard has initiated a £2 million review of the case, revisiting information—including tips from psychics—that had previously been ignored. There has been some skepticism about dedicating resources to these leads. A group of 35 officers from the Metropolitan Police is currently investigating over 100 leads as part of a renewed effort to find out what happened to Madeleine. Police have released an updated image showing what Madeleine might look like at age nine.

Acorah ya musanta wannan, yana cewa babu wanda ya san tabbas abinda ya faru da ita. Ya bayyana aniyarsa ta zuwa Portugal domin taimakawa bincike da basirarsa ta tunani, kuma zai mikawa 'yan sanda duk wani bayani da ya samu. Acorah ya ce an kuskure fassara maganarsa sannan ya jaddada cewa ba zai tilasta ra'ayinsa ga kowa ba. Har ila yau, yana nuna fatan cewa Madeleine na raye. Wasu na tambaya dalilin shiga binciken yanzu, musamman duba da cewa yana shirin wasan kwaikwayo. An taba kalubalantar sahihancinsa lokacin da Dr Ciaran O'Keeffe, masanin kwakwalwa, ya zarge shi da wawwarewa a wani shirin talabijin. Iyaye Madeleine, Kate da Gerry McCann, sun ci gaba da nuna fata cewa za a gano diyarsu. Scotland Yard ta fara sake duba binciken da kudi £2 miliyan, tana duba bayanan da suka hada har da kira daga masu tunani wadanda aka yi watsi da su da farko. Wasu na ganin ana bata lokaci da kudade wajen bin wannan hanya. Jami'an 'yan sanda 35 daga Metropolitan suna duba bayanai fiye da 100 domin gano hakikanin abin da ya faru da Madeleine. An kuma fitar da sabuwar hotonta da ke nuna yadda za ta iya bayyana tana shekara tara.

article_content: Six teenagers have been arrested in connection with the alleged gang rape of a 16-year-old girl near a Florida high school. The suspects, arrested on charges of sexual battery and false imprisonment, have been identified as Tywuan Johnson (17), Torreano Batton (18), Josea Sims (17), Deoante Stewart (17), Marquis Pierre (16), and Tobert Alexander (16). The incident occurred on Thursday between 3 p.m. and 5 p.m. in a wooded area close to Winter Springs High School. Because Batton is 18 years old, he is being held in the Seminole County Jail, while the others are in juvenile detention. The names of the juveniles were released because they are accused of felonies, according to WFTV. A spokesperson for the 18th Circuit State Attorney's Office stated that a decision had not yet been made on whether to charge the underage suspects as adults. According to police, the victim knew at least two of the boys. All the suspects are football players and students at Winter Springs High School. Five of the arrested teens are from Sanford, while Pierre is from Winter Springs. Seminole County Public Schools said it could not comment on any disciplinary actions due to student confidentiality. A statement from the school system emphasized that programs are in place to support any affected students. Winter Springs Police Chief Kevin Brunelle said that officers carefully processed evidence and conducted interviews to ensure appropriate charges were filed. No further details, including the victim's condition, have been released.

Lamarin ya faru ne ranar Alhamis tsakanin karfe 3 na rana zuwa 5 na yamma a dajin dake kusa da makarantar sakandare ta Winter Springs. Shugaban ‘yan sandan Winter Springs, Kevin Brunelle, ya ce jami’ansa sun binciki dukkan shaidu tare da tattaunawa da mutane da dama domin tabbatar da tuhumar da ta dace. Ba a fitar da wani karin bayani kan yanayin yarinyar ba har yanzu.

article_content: Veteran actor Michael Caine, celebrated for his iconic roles in movies like The Muppet Christmas Carol and Jaws: The Revenge, has confirmed he’s retiring at 90. In a BBC radio interview broadcast Saturday, Caine explained, “I always say I’ll retire, but I truly mean it this time. After leading in a movie that received fantastic reviews, I don’t think I can top this.” Caine stars alongside Glenda Jackson in 'The Great Escaper.' Jackson, who died in June shortly after filming, appears in this movie based on a true story: a World War Two veteran escapes his care home to attend D-Day anniversary events in France. Beyond acting, Caine is releasing a new novel titled 'Deadly Game.' In the book, Detective Chief Inspector Harry Taylor, who isn’t a fan of paperwork or politics but excels in cracking cases, faces a crisis when a box of radioactive material is stolen during a violent raid at a dump site in Stepney, East London—just before the police arrive. Caine also joked about his role in ‘Jaws: The Revenge,’ saying he never saw the film, but the house it built was marvelous.

Bayan fitowa a matsayin jarumi a fim din da ya samu yabo mai yawa, ban ga abinda zai fi haka ba." Caine ya fito tare da Glenda Jackson a fim din 'The Great Escaper.' Jackson, wacce ta rasu a watan Yuni bayan kammala fim din, tana cikin fim din da ya samo asali daga wani labari na gaskiya: wani tsohon soja na yakin duniya na biyu ya tsere daga gidan kulawa da tsofaffi domin halartar bikin D-Day a Faransa. Banda fim, Caine zai fito da sabon littafinsa mai suna 'Deadly Game.' Caine ya kuma yi dariya game da rawar sa a ‘Jaws: The Revenge,’ yana cewa bai taba kallo ba, amma gidan da fim din ya samar masa ya kayatar.

article_content: Recent protests in Selma, Alabama, have echoed calls for justice heard across the country. On Wednesday, about 20 demonstrators walked across the Edmund Pettus Bridge—famous in civil rights history—chanting, “Hands up! Don’t shoot!” and “I can’t breathe,” referencing the deaths of Michael Brown in Ferguson, Missouri, and Eric Garner in New York. In Selma, an additional chant, “Show the tape,” was directed at Police Chief William Riley. Protesters demanded the release of a police video from a shooting over a year ago. Ananias Shaw, 74, was killed in December after reportedly rushing an officer with a hatchet, according to police. Both Shaw and the officer were Black. Chief Riley stated the video—recorded on the officer’s lapel camera—shows the shooting was justified. A grand jury reviewed the case and declined to indict, similar to recent cases in Ferguson and New York. Activist Faya Rose Toure, inspired by the Ferguson protests, is supporting the Shaw family. Toure emphasizes that, despite Selma’s progress, issues remain. Selma, a city with over 80% African American residents, has Black leadership, including the mayor, police chief, district attorney, and majority city council. But Toure asserts that ongoing injustices exist. She highlighted the city’s civil rights legacy, referencing ‘Bloody Sunday’—when police attacked peaceful marchers at the Edmund Pettus Bridge, ultimately leading to the Voting Rights Act of 1965. A movie about Selma’s history is set for nationwide release on January 9. Toure and Shaw’s family insist that releasing the police video is essential for transparency. Shaw’s brother, Edward, believes his sibling’s death was unnecessary and wants the public to see the video. Chief Riley, however, says the family should view it first, noting, “We want the family to see it first. It’s only fair.” Arrangements have been made for Shaw’s children in Chicago to view the tape, with other family members scheduled to see it locally as well. Edward Shaw recalls rushing to the scene after the shooting, finding the area cordoned off and his brother’s body left uncovered for hours. He described Ananias as well-known in the community—a former mechanic called ‘Ambulance’ for helping others, but troubled after losing his wife and home. While Edward Shaw claims Selma police were aware of his brother’s mental health struggles and nonviolent behavior, Chief Riley insists the officer had no choice. Officers responding to a disturbance at a restaurant reportedly encountered Shaw with a hatchet, told him multiple times to drop it, but he raised it and was shot. Lt. Johnny King, a long-serving officer, said such incidents are rare in Selma. Edward Shaw questions why police pursued his brother, while Chief Riley asks why the family didn’t seek more help for Ananias, noting the long-standing behavioral issues. Riley emphasized that the tape was funded through a grant secured by State Sen. Hank Sanders, highlighting that Selma already uses lapel cameras, unlike Ferguson. Chief Riley accepts the right to protest, acknowledging problems in policing nationwide, but feels it’s wrong to compare Selma’s case directly to incidents like Ferguson. “We’re no Ferguson,” he said.

A Selma, akwai ƙarin kiran, “Ku nuna bidiyon,” da aka yi wa Kwamishinan 'Yan Sanda William Riley. Masu zanga-zangar na so a fitar da bidiyon wani harbi da ya faru fiye da shekara guda da ta wuce. An kashe Ananias Shaw, mai shekara 74, a watan Disamba bayan ya ruga wa ɗan sanda da gatari, inji 'yan sanda. Duka Shaw da ɗan sandan baki ne. Kwamishina Riley ya bayyana cewa bidiyon—wanda aka dauka daga kyamarar lapel ɗin ɗan sanda—yana nuna cewa harbin ya dace. Kotun koli ta duba lamarin kuma ta ƙi ɗaukar mataki, kamar yadda aka gani a Ferguson da New York. Mai fafutukar kare haƙƙi Faya Rose Toure, wadda zanga-zangar Ferguson ta zuga ta, na goyon bayan iyalan Shaw. Toure ta jaddada cewa duk da ci gaban Selma, akwai sauran matsaloli. Selma gari ne da kusan kashi 80% na mazauna baƙaƙe ne, kuma shugabannin gwamnati irin su, shugaban gari, kwamishinan 'yan sanda, babban lauyan ƙasa da yawancin majalisar gari duk baƙaƙe ne. Amma Toure ta ce har yanzu ana fama da rashin adalci. Ta ambaci tarihin gwagwarmayar gari, tana tuna da ‘Bloody Sunday’—lokacin da ‘yan sanda suka kai hari ga masu zanga-zangar lumana a gadar Edmund Pettus, wanda daga bisani ya kai ga dokar 'Voting Rights Act' ta 1965. An shirya fim game da tarihin Selma da za a saki a faɗin ƙasa a ranar 9 ga Janairu. Toure da iyalan Shaw na cewa fitar da bidiyon 'yansanda yana da mahimmanci don nuna gaskiya. ɗan uwan Shaw, Edward, yana ganin mutuwar ɗan uwansa ba ta da amfani, yana so jama'a su ga bidiyon. Amma Kwamishina Riley ya ce dole ne iyali su fara ganin bidiyon, yana mai cewa, “Muna so iyali su fara gani, wannan ne adalci.” An shirya yaransu da ke Chicago su ga bidiyon, da sauran ‘yan iyali nan kusa. Edward Shaw ya tuna yadda ya isa wurin bayan harbin, ya tarar an killace yankin kuma gawar ɗan uwansa tana kasa ba rufe. Ya kwatanta Ananias a matsayin wanda aka san shi a al'umma—tsohon makanikis da ake kira ‘Ambulance’ saboda yana taimaka wa jama’a, amma ya fara samun matsaloli bayan matarsa ta bar shi da kuma lokacin da gidansa ya kone. Duk da Edward Shaw na cewa ‘yansanda Selma sun san halin kwakwalwar ɗan uwansa da rashin tashin hankali, Kwamishina Riley ya dage cewa ɗan sandan bai da wani zabi. Lokacin da ‘yansanda suka amsa kiran tashin hankali a wani gidan abinci, sun sami Shaw da gatari, sun kiransa da ya ajiye, amma ya daga gatarin kuma aka harbe shi. Laftanar Johnny King, wanda ya daɗe a aiki, ya ce hakan abu ne da ba kasafai ake samu ba a Selma. Edward Shaw na tambaya me yasa ‘yansanda suka bi ɗan uwansa, yayin da Kwamishina Riley ke tambaya dalilin da yasa iyali ba su nema masa taimako ba, yana nuna matsalolin da ya daɗe yana tare da su. Riley ya ce an samu tallafin kuɗi daga Sanata Hank Sanders don sayen kyamarar lapel a Selma, wanda Ferguson ba su da su. Kwamishina Riley yana karɓar zanga-zanga, yana amincewa da akwai matsaloli a aikin ‘yansanda a ƙasa, amma yana ganin ba daidai ba ne a kwatanta lamarin Selma da na Ferguson kai tsaye. “Ba mu da alaka da Ferguson,” in ji shi.

article_content: The world of work in 2024 is approaching quickly. Are you prepared? What are the biggest HR trends to expect? While opinions may vary, several key themes are consistently top of mind for HR professionals and tech companies: 1. GenAI: Generative AI is becoming increasingly influential in HR functions. In 2024, organizations will use GenAI more thoughtfully than in 2023. While it offers efficiency and improved employee experience, there are ethical considerations and privacy concerns. For example, labor strikes among Hollywood actors and writers were partly influenced by concerns around AI usage. The resulting agreements could influence AI adoption in other industries. GenAI is streamlining talent acquisition, management tasks, and decision-making processes across HR. 2. Compensation: Compensation models are undergoing significant changes to accommodate expectations of flexibility, equity, transparency, and prompt delivery. The notion of compensation has become more dynamic, partly in response to trends like ‘quiet quitting.’ According to Gallup’s 2023 State of the Global Workplace Report, 28% of respondents would change how and when they are paid, pointing to issues such as timely payment and recognition for achievements. Employers must adopt new compensation approaches, including off-cycle and on-demand pay, to address these evolving needs. 3. Employer/Employee Relationships: Shifts in where, when, and how work is done have amplified friction in employer-employee relationships, impacting engagement, performance, and retention. For instance, a Gartner report found only 26% of organizations had full compliance with on-site attendance, and about half of employees considered their current performance unsustainable. Trust in organizations also remains an issue. Employers should prioritize transparency and improved communication. 4. HR Tech Platforms: HR technology is becoming more advanced, with platforms offering a comprehensive range of capabilities. These systems help organizations scale, manage talent effectively, offer a consistent user experience, and support regulatory compliance. AI and machine learning (ML) are vital in modern HR, handling complex issues such as remote and hybrid work arrangements. Both large enterprises and small to medium-sized businesses can benefit from robust HR platforms. 5. Skills, Learning, and Development: Skills development and learning programs are interrelated and essential for preparing employees and leaders for future demands. With digital transformation and AI, skills-based hiring and upskilling are more important than ever. However, a recent edX study found only 1 in 5 employees agreed their organization fosters a strong learning culture. Bridging this gap is crucial for engagement and performance. Additional Trends: Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) initiatives, internal mobility strategies, and the rapid evolution of HR technology remain important. The pace of change requires HR teams to maintain a strong foundation of transparency, communication, and data-driven decision-making. Ultimately, organizations should focus on transparency and communication in HR strategies, regardless of technological trends. These are best practices, not just passing trends.

Kodayake ra'ayoyi na iya bambanta, akwai wasu manyan jigogi da masu aiki a fannin HR da kamfanonin fasaha ke tattaunawa akai: 1. GenAI: Harkar fasahar Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) tana kara shiga harkokin HR. A 2024, kungiyoyi za su yi amfani da GenAI da hikima fiye da yadda aka yi a 2023. Kodayake tana kawo sauki da inganta gogewar ma'aikata, akwai matsalolin ka'ida da sirri. Misali, yajin aikin 'yan wasan kwaikwayo da marubuta a Hollywood ya faru ne bisa damuwa da amfani da AI. Yadda aka daidaita lamarin na iya shafar yadda sauran masana'antu za su yi amfani da AI. GenAI na taimakawa wajen saukaka daukar ma'aikata, gudanarwa da yanke shawara. 2. Albashi: Tsarin biyan albashi yana fuskantar sauye-sauye masu girma don dacewa da bukatun sassauci, adalci, gaskiya, da biyan albashi cikin lokaci. Sauyin biyan albashi na da nasaba da abubuwa kamar “quiet quitting”. Rahoton Gallup na 2023 ya nuna kashi 28% na wadanda aka tambaya suna son a sauya yadda da lokacin da ake biyansu, kamar samun biyan albashi a kan lokaci da ladan kokarinsu. Dole ne masu aiki su bullo da sababbin hanyoyin biyan albashi, ciki har da damar biyan albashi a kowanne lokaci, don shawo kan wadannan bukatu. 3. Dangantakar Ma’aikata da Ma’aikaci: Saboda sauye-sauye a wurin aiki da lokutan aiki, akwai karin sabani tsakanin shugabanni da ma'aikata, wanda ke shafar himma da dorewar aiki. Rahoton Gartner ya nuna kashi 26% kacal na kungiyoyi ne ke bin ka’idar dawowa ofis, kuma kusan rabin ma’aikata na ganin aikin da suke yi ba zai dore ba. Amana cikin kungiya ma na da matsala. Shugabanni su mayar da hankali wajen samar da gaskiya da kyakkyawar sadarwa. 4. Manhajojin HR: Fasahar HR na kara samun ci gaba, tare da dandali masu dauke da dama. Wadannan tsarin na taimaka wa kungiyoyi su bunkasa, su tafiyar da ma’aikata yadda ya kamata, su ba da gogewa guda da kuma cika dokar aiki. AI da ML muhimmai ne a sabon tsarin HR, suna magance matsalolin aiki daga gida ko ofis. Duk manyan kamfanoni ko kanana na amfana da wadannan dakunan HR. 5. Kwarewa, Koyo da Ci Gaban Aikin: Ci gaban kwarewa da shirye-shiryen koyo suna da muhimmanci don shiryawa ma’aikata da shugabanni ga kalubalen gaba. Saboda sauyin fasaha da AI, daukar ma’aikata bisa kwarewa kuma ya fi muhimmanci. Amma binciken edX ya nuna daya cikin biyar kawai na ma'aikata ke ganin kungiyarsu na da cikakken al’adun koyo. Dole ne a magance wannan tazara don karuwar himma da sakamako. Karin Jigo: Manufofin bambancin jinsi, adalci, hada kai, da kasancewa daya (DEIB), dabarun daukaka daga cikin gida, da saurin sauyin fasahar HR suna ci gaba da kasancewa masu muhimmanci. Saurin canji na sa HR su dage da gaskiya, sadarwa, da yin amfani da bayanai wajen yanke hukunci. A karshe, kungiyoyi su fifita gaskiya da sadarwa a cikin tsarin HR, komai sauye-sauyen fasaha. Wadannan ba kawai yanayi bane, amma kyawawan dabi’u ne masu dorewa.

article_content: The Colosseum in Rome, one of the world’s most renowned landmarks, is developing a noticeable tilt. Its southern side stands approximately 40 centimeters (16 inches) lower than the northern side. Experts have been closely monitoring the nearly 2,000-year-old monument for several months to assess if urgent repairs are needed. Authorities began investigating about a year ago after the incline was first noticed. Rossella Rea, director of the Colosseum, revealed to the Italian newspaper Corriere della Sera that officials are working with Rome's La Sapienza University and the environmental geology institute IGAG to study the phenomenon. The study is expected to conclude within a year. Additionally, tests are underway to determine whether traffic from nearby busy roads is affecting the monument’s stability. Professor Giorgio Monti, from La Sapienza’s construction technology department, warned that there could be a crack in the concrete base beneath the amphitheater, which consists of a 13-meter-thick oval slab. He suggested that, if concerns are confirmed, intervention similar to the stabilization efforts at Pisa might be necessary, though it’s too early to say what approach would be best. The Leaning Tower of Pisa, another of Italy’s famous attractions, reopened in 2001 after being closed for more than a decade while engineers worked to reduce its tilt and secure it for visitors. Restoration efforts between 1990 and 2001 decreased Pisa’s lean from 5.5 degrees to 3.99 degrees. The Colosseum, which famously hosted gladiatorial battles in the Roman era, continues to attract hundreds of thousands of visitors and remains packed with tourists.

Gefen kudancin Kolosiyum ya gangara da kimanin santimita 40 (inci 16) fiye da gefen arewa. Masana sun dade suna sa ido kan wannan tsohon gini mai shekaru kusan 2,000 don gano ko akwai bukatar gyara da gaggawa. Hukuma ta fara bincike kusan shekara guda da ta wuce bayan an lura da wannan karkata. Direktar Kolosiyum, Rossella Rea, ta bayyana wa jaridar kasar Italiya Corriere della Sera cewa jami’ai suna aiki tare da jami’ar La Sapienza dake Roma da cibiyar geology IGAG don bincika wannan al’amari. Ana sa ran za a kammala binciken cikin shekara guda. Bugu da kari, an fara gwaje-gwaje don gano ko zirga-zirgar ababen hawa daga manyan titin da ke kusa na kawo illa ga zaman lafiyar ginin. Farfeesosa Giorgio Monti daga sashen fasahar gine-gine na jami’ar La Sapienza ya gargaɗi cewa akwai yiwuwar akwai fashewar kasa a cikin tubalin siminti da ke karkashin Kolosiyum, wanda yana da kauri mita 13 kuma sifarsa zagayece. Ya ce, idan binciken ya tabbatar da matsalar, ana iya buƙatar aiwatar da irin gyaran da aka yi a Pisa, amma har yanzu ba a yanke hukunci kan matakin da ya fi dacewa ba. Ginin Leaning Tower na Pisa, wani shahararren wurin yawon bude ido a Italiya, an sake bude shi a shekarar 2001 bayan fiye da shekaru goma a rufe ana aiki don saukaka karkatarsa da tabbatar da amincinsa ga baƙi. Ayyukan gyara daga 1990 zuwa 2001 sun rage karkatar Pisa daga digiri 5.5 zuwa 3.99. article_content: A federal bankruptcy judge in Texas has denied a request by Charles D. 'Tex' Watson, an imprisoned follower of Charles Manson, to prevent Los Angeles police from obtaining decades-old tape recordings of conversations between him and his attorney. The Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) is seeking these tapes because they may offer new evidence related to unsolved murders potentially involving Manson family members, according to court filings. Watson had proposed allowing police to listen to the recordings under the supervision of a court-appointed trustee, but not to take possession of them. The judge, Chief U.S. Bankruptcy Judge Brenda T. Rhoades, declined to reconsider her previous order requiring police custody of the tapes. Judge Rhoades clarified that concerns over how the LAPD uses the tapes, or about their release to the media, fall outside bankruptcy law and should be addressed in other courts. LAPD plans to collect the tapes on Friday, according to spokesperson Cmdr. Andrew Smith. The eight-hour tapes, recorded in 1969, detail conversations between Watson and his then-attorney, Bill Boyd of McKinney, Texas. The law firm is currently a debtor in bankruptcy court. Court documents state that Watson waived attorney-client privilege for the tapes in 1976, and Boyd received partial legal fees by giving a copy of the tapes to Chaplain Raymond G. Hoekstra, who later authored the book 'Will You Die for Me: The Man Who Killed for Charles Manson Tells His Own Story.' Watson maintains there are no unsolved murders by the Manson Family and asserts the tapes contain nothing not already published in his book. Charles 'Tex' Watson, Charles Manson, Susan Atkins, Patricia Krenwinkel, and Leslie Van Houten were convicted of murder and other charges after a two-night rampage resulting in the deaths of pregnant actress Sharon Tate, Leno and Rosemary LaBianca, and others. Watson, 66, was convicted of seven counts of first-degree murder and has been denied parole 16 times. He is next eligible for parole in 2016, according to the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation. Watson says releasing the recordings could cause further distress to the victims’ families and requests that special consideration be given regarding their custody and use.

'Yan sandan Los Angeles (LAPD) na neman kaset ɗin ne saboda suna zaton za su iya samun sabbin bayanai game da kisan da ake zargin mabiyan Manson sun aikata, a cewar takardun kotu. Watson ya so kotu ta bari 'yan sanda su saurari kaset ɗin tare da sa ido, amma ba tare da su rimawa mallaka ba. Amma alkalin kotu babban, Brenda T. Rhoades, ta ƙi sauya umarnin ta da ke ba 'yan sanda daman karɓar su. Alkali Rhoades ta ce damuwar da Watson ke da ita game da yadda LAPD za ta amfani da kaset ko sakin su ga manema labarai ba ta cikin dokar bashi, za a iya shigar da irin wannan korafi a wata kotu. LAPD na shirin ɗaukar kaset ɗin ranar Jumma'a, in ji mai magana da yawun su, Cmdr. Andrew Smith. Kaset ɗin, wanda aka rikoda tun 1969, na ƙunshi tattaunawa tsakanin Watson da tsohon lauyansa Bill Boyd daga McKinney, Texas. Lauyan yanzu yana cikin shari'ar bashi. Takardun kotu sun nuna Watson ya soke kariyar da ke tsakanin lauya da abokin ciniki a 1976, kuma Boyd ya amshi wani kaso na kuɗin shari'a bayan ya bai wa limamin coci Raymond G. Hoekstra kwafin kaset ɗin. Hoekstra daga baya ya rubuta littafin 'Will You Die for Me: The Man Who Killed for Charles Manson Tells His Own Story.' Watson ya ce sakin kaset ɗin na iya jawo wa iyalai ciwo a rai, don haka yana rokon a yi la'akari ta musamman da yadda za a kula da kaset ɗin.

article_content: While men dominate the screen in AMC's acclaimed drama 'Mad Men', the women behind the show's creation play crucial roles that shape its compelling narrative. The show's largely female writing team brings authentic experiences into the portrayal of 1960s workplace dynamics. In one notable scene, Peggy Olsen—a driven copywriter—requests her own office, highlighting the challenges women faced earning respect in a male-centric environment. The exchange between Peggy and Roger Sterling, a partner at the agency, underscores the gendered expectations of the era. Robin Veith, executive story editor and one of seven female writers on the nine-person writing staff, explains that many plot points reflect the writers' own real-life experiences—not just historical fiction. For instance, scenes depicting casual sexism or women being undervalued come directly from the writers’ own careers. Maria Jacquemetton, consulting producer, shares how workplace dynamics mirrored in the show were common in her early professional life, such as being perceived through the lens of romance rather than capability. She notes these issues aren't limited to the past—similar dynamics persist today, though they are often more subtle. Despite persistent gender biases in the broader industry, the 'Mad Men' writers emphasize their own workplace is merit-based, valuing great ideas regardless of who offers them. The writing staff includes women from their twenties to their fifties, with several female department heads and directors. Show creator Matt Weiner and executive producer Scott Hornbacher focus on talent and storytelling skills when hiring. The series centers on three complex female characters: Betty Draper, a suburban housewife facing personal struggles; Joan Holloway, a determined office manager reconsidering her personal dreams; and Peggy Olsen, an ambitious career woman rising through the ranks. Writer Jacquemetton stresses that the team avoids stereotypes, instead focusing on the full complexity of each character's aspirations and experiences. Staying true to both character and historical context is key, even when it involves uncomfortable realities, such as depicting women smoking during pregnancy—a practice historically accurate but unsettling by today's standards, according to Veith. The writers' room for 'Mad Men' stands out as exceptionally diverse, contrasting with the broader television industry, where women are typically underrepresented by a ratio of 2-to-1, per a 2006 Writer’s Guild report. Jacquemetton asserts that this diversity enriches their storytelling by drawing from a broader range of life experiences. Although the team tries to set aside gender in their creative process, the influence of diverse perspectives is evident in the show's unique voice and depth. For Jacquemetton, launching a new season feels like 'birthing a baby'—a metaphor highlighting her personal investment in the series.
translated_content: Kodayake maza ke kan gaba a shirin sanannen 'Mad Men' na AMC, matan da ke bayansa suna da rawar gani wajen kashe labarin. Yawancin marubuta shirin mata ne, suna kawo kwarewarsu ta gaskiya don bayyana yanayin ofis na shekarun 1960. A wata muhimmiyar fuska, Peggy Olsen—matar da ke da kirkira—ta nemi ofis dinta, tana nuna kalubalen da mata ke fuskanta a duniyar inda maza ke da rinjaye. Tattaunawar Peggy da Roger Sterling, daya daga cikin masu kamfanin, ta bayyana yadda ake kallon mata a wancan lokaci. Robin Veith, babbar editan labari kuma daya daga cikin mata bakwai daga cikin marubuta tara, ta ce babban yanki na abubuwan labarin ya fito ne daga abubuwan da suka fada musu kai tsaye—ba wai tarihi na karya ba. Misali, yanayi na sake nuna wariya ko rashin daraja ga mata, sun faru da marubutan kansu. Maria Jacquemetton, mai tsara labari, ta bayyana yadda irin wannan yanayi ya kasance a rayuwarta ta farko, inda ba su kalli mata da muhimmanci ba sai wajen soyayya. Ta ce wadannan halaye ba na dā kadai bane—suna ci gaba har yanzu duk da ba a bayyana su sosai. Duk da nau’in wariyar jinsi da ke tsarin masana’antu, marubutan ‘Mad Men’ na tabbatar da cewa a wurinsu, kowanne ra'ayi na da daraja. Marubutan mata daga shekaru daban suke, akwai shugabannin mata da daraktoci. Matt Weiner, mai kirkira, da Scott Hornbacher, shugaban shirye-shirye, suna daukar ma'aikata ne bisa kwarewa da rawar gani a labari. Shirin yana mai da hankali kan jiga-jigan mata uku: Betty Draper, matar gida da ke fuskantar kalubale; Joan Holloway, shugabar ofis mai mafarkin samun mijin aure, da Peggy Olsen, wadda ke kokarin hawa mataki. Jacquemetton ta ce suna gujewa sanya mata cikin kalmomin jingina, suna kokarin bayyana cikakkun halayensu bisa zuciya da mafarkinsu. Tsayawa kan gaskiyar halaye da yanayin lokaci yana da muhimmanci, har da nuna abubuwan da yanzu ba su dace ba, kamar nuna mata na shan taba yayin da suke da ciki—abinda ya zama ruwan dare a lokacin, amma yanzu yana da takura, in ji Veith. Dakin marubutan 'Mad Men' ya bambanta, saboda rashin yin la'akari da jinsi, inda a wasu shirye-shirye mata ke kasa da maza sau biyu kamar yadda rahoton Writer’s Guild na 2006 ya nuna. The families of two British men, Derek Gent and Mike Holmes, both 68 and lifelong friends from Rochdale, are mourning their tragic deaths following a road accident in Thailand. While on vacation with their wives on Koh Samui island, an out-of-control pick-up truck, after colliding with another vehicle, veered off the road and struck the men as they were walking. Their wives were not with them at the time.

Gent, the former head of Oldham's trading standards, and Holmes, a father of three who worked in sales, were close companions and frequent golf partners for more than 30 years. Their children released a statement calling the loss a devastating shock that's left a significant void, and thanked the staff at Rocky’s Boutique Resort, the Thai people, and travel company Kuoni for their support.

Reports indicate the pick-up first collided with a Toyota Corolla, then swerved off the road, struck the two men, and crashed into a tea shop. The truck driver is in critical condition at a Bangkok hospital, while the Toyota driver was unharmed.

Neighbors and local officials expressed heartfelt tributes to Gent and Holmes, highlighting their positive contributions and presence in the community. Their widows, who lived close together in Rochdale, are returning to the UK with community support. The Foreign and Commonwealth Office confirmed the deaths and is assisting the families as they grieve this loss.
translated_content:
Iyalin wasu Birtaniya biyu, Derek Gent da Mike Holmes, dukkansu masu shekaru 68 kuma abokai na dogon lokaci daga Rochdale, suna cikin jimamin rasa su bayan hatsarin mota a Thailand. Yayin da suke hutu tare da matansu a tsibirin Koh Samui, wata mota kirar pick-up da ta fita daga hanya bayan ta buga wata mota, ta buge su yayin da suke tafiya. Matansu ba tare da su ba a lokacin.

Gent, tsohon shugaban hukumar kula da kasuwanci ta Oldham, da Holmes, uba ga yara uku kuma mai aikin tallace-tallace, sun kasance abokai na shekaru fiye da 30 kuma suna yawan buga golf tare. Yaran su sun fitar da sanarwa suna yaba musu tare da bayyana rasa su a matsayin babban jin zafi da ya bar gibi mai girma. Sun kuma gode wa ma’aikatan otal ɗin Rocky’s Boutique Resort, mutanen Thailand, da kamfanin balaguro Kuoni saboda taimakon da suka bayar.

Rahotanni sun nuna cewa motar pick-up din ta fara haduwa da Toyota Corolla, kafin ta kauce hanya, ta buge mutanen biyu, daga baya ta fasa wani shagon shayi. Direban motar pick-up yana kwance a asibiti a Bangkok cikin mawuyacin hali, yayin da direban Toyota bai ji rauni ba.

Makwabta da jami’an yankin sun bayyana alhini da yabo ga Gent da Holmes, suna jaddada kyautatawar su da gudummawar su ga al’umma. Matansu, wadanda ke zama kusa da juna a Rochdale, sun koma gida da goyon bayan al’umma. Ofishin Harkokin Waje na Birtaniya ya tabbatar da mutuwar su kuma yana taimakawa iyalansu a wannan lokaci na baƙin ciki.

article_content: Danny Boyle, the Oscar-winning director behind the unforgettable London 2012 Olympic opening ceremony, has shared that he refused a knighthood because he felt the accolade wasn’t just his to claim. He believed that receiving such an individual honor would diminish the contributions of the thousands involved, including the Queen herself. In an interview with Radio Times, Boyle explained, 'It’s just not me—I also thought it was wrong.' He stressed the importance of acknowledging the collaborative spirit that powered the ceremony’s success. Boyle and his creative team reached out to Buckingham Palace with a proposal for the Queen to participate in a surprise James Bond scene. They offered to use a skilled double or actor if the Queen preferred not to take part, but she agreed, leading to the evening’s standout moment. The ceremony was widely acclaimed for its creativity and quintessential British flair, featuring segments like a tribute to the NHS. Boyle is also hoping to reunite Trainspotting’s original cast—Ewan McGregor, Robert Carlyle, Jonny Lee Miller, and Ewen Bremner—for a potential sequel based on Irvine Welsh’s novel Porno. Collaborating again with screenwriter John Hodge, Boyle is excited by the idea of bringing the actors back, older and with new life stories to tell.

Ya yi imani karbar irin wannan lambar yabo na mutum daya zai rage darajar gudunmawar dubban mutane da suka taka rawa – har da Sarauniyar Ingila. A wata hira da Radio Times, Boyle ya ce, 'Ba na son hakan — kuma ina ganin ba dai-dai bane.' Ya jaddada muhimmancin ban girma da hadin kan da ya kawo nasarar bukin. Boyle da tawagarsa sun tura wata shawara zuwa Fadar Buckingham domin neman Sarauniya ta bayyana a cikin wani wasan barkwanci na James Bond. Sun ba da shawarar amfani da mai kama da Sarauniyar ko jaruma idan bata so ta shiga, amma ta amince ta fito da kanta, abinda ya kasance daga cikin abubuwan da suka fi jan hankali a daren nan. An yaba matuka da bukin saboda kirkire-kirkire da kuma irin girmama al'adun Birtaniya, ciki har da bangaren tunawa da NHS. Bugu da kari, Boyle yana fatan sake hada 'yan wasan fim din Trainspotting na asali – Ewan McGregor, Robert Carlyle, Jonny Lee Miller, da Ewen Bremner – a wani sabon fim bisa littafin Porno na Irvine Welsh. Boyle na aiki tare da marubuci John Hodge kuma yana fatan ganin dawowar duka tare da sabbin labarai bayan shekaru ashirin.
post_content: Danny Boyle said no to a knighthood after the 2012 Olympics, insisting the credit went to the whole team (even the Queen!). Plus, he’s eager to reunite the OG Trainspotting crew for a sequel. #Teamwork #Olympics #Trainspotting
