article_content: Trade expansion has often come at the expense of tropical forests, driven by increased demand from wealthy nations for products like beef and soy. This demand has contributed to significant deforestation in countries like Brazil. A former U.S. climate negotiator even noted that these market pressures unintentionally create incentives for illegal destruction of the Amazon.  Can global commerce grow without threatening crucial forests? Traditional approaches—such as sanctions, border taxes, or climate alliances—haven’t been successful, says Bård Harstad, a Stanford professor specializing in political economy. These methods typically disrupt trade and aren’t effective in preventing rainforest loss.  Harstad suggests a new strategy: contingent trade agreements (CTAs). In a CTA, trade privileges are directly tied to environmental protection. Rather than relying on vague promises or restrictive barriers, CTAs enable countries from the Global North to encourage their counterparts in the Global South to conserve tropical forests by linking free trade to measurable conservation outcomes.  This idea draws on the current situation between the European Union and Mercosur—a South American bloc including Brazil, Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay. Their pending trade deal has faced delays due to concerns over Amazon deforestation, particularly as environmental oversight weakened during Jair Bolsonaro’s presidency.  France, Germany, and the Netherlands have been hesitant to approve the agreement, citing environmental risks. Presently, additional Amazon protections are under discussion, but negotiators face a tight deadline, with ratification options narrowing by December.  Here, CTAs could be especially useful. Rather than imposing sanctions after deforestation occurs, a CTA would base trade benefits—like low tariffs—on continuous forest preservation. The EU and Brazil, for example, could agree to allow tariff-free exports if satellite data shows forest cover is stable; otherwise, tariffs would increase, making conservation more appealing.  In Harstad’s model, tariffs escalate as more deforestation happens, creating a strong incentive to maintain forests. However, these tariffs must strike a balance: they need to be substantial enough to promote conservation but not so severe that trade relationships break down. Both sides can still profit, though there’s a practical threshold for how much forest preservation is feasible through trade controls alone.  Harstad’s research indicates substantial impacts: if Brazil continues with ordinary free trade deals while Asian demand doubles, deforestation for agriculture could jump by 27%. By implementing a CTA with the EU, the increase could be limited to 14%. Coordinated U.S. and EU action could reduce it further, keeping forest loss as low as 3%.  France and the Netherlands have recently supported the idea of linking tariffs to environmental standards in trade. Harstad’s work outlines how such policies could operate in real trade agreements, arguing that trade-linked incentives are politically easier to implement than cash payments for conservation.  Harstad hopes both economists and policymakers use these findings, especially with the EU-Mercosur talks at a decisive moment. Looking ahead, he envisions expanding this approach to agreements between the U.S. and Mercosur, aligning trade with conservation objectives.
translated_content: Yawaitar cinikayya da kasashen waje yawanci yana cutar da gandun daji na yankuna masu zafi, musamman saboda karuwar bukata daga kasashe masu arziki ga kayayyaki irin su naman sa da wake. Wannan bukatar ta haifar da karuwar sare dajin da ake yi musamman a Brazil. Wani tsohon mai shiga tsakani na sauyin yanayi daga Amurka ya bayyana cewa haka na karfafa masu laifi su lalata gandun daji a Amazon ba tare da sanin gwamnati ba.  Za a iya habaka cinikayya ba tare da barazana ga gandun daji ba? Hanyoyin gargajiya irin su takunkumi ko harajin iyaka ko kungiyoyin yanayi ba su tabuka kome ba, in ji Farfesa Bård Harstad na jami’ar Stanford. Wadannan hanyoyi yawanci suna kawo cikas a cinikayya, amma ba su da inganci wajen hana sare daji.  Harstad ya zo da sabuwar hanya: yarjejeniyar cinikayya da sharadi (CTA). A irin wannan yarjejeniya, moriyar cinikayya za a hade su da kula da muhalli. Maimaikon dogaro da alkawurra marasa tushe ko katange cinikayya, CTAs na ba kasashen arewa damar karfafawa kasashen kudu gwiwa wajen kare gandun dajin su ta hanyar daura cinikin kaya ba tare da haraji ba idan aka cika sharuddan kiyaye dajin.  Wannan ra’ayi ya samo asali ne daga halin da ake ciki tsakanin Tarayyar Turai da kungiyar Mercosur—a cikin kasashen Kudancin Amurka da suka hada da Brazil, Argentina, Paraguay, da Uruguay. Wannan yarjejeniyar ta tsaya cak saboda damuwar rashin wadataccen kariya ga dajin Amazon musamman lokacin gwamnatin Jair Bolsonaro da matakan kiyaye muhalli suka raunana.  Kasashe irin su Faransa, Jamus, da Holland sun nuna shakku game da amincewa da yarjejeniyar saboda illar muhalli. A yanzu haka ana tattaunawa akan karin matakan kariya ga Amazon, amma lokaci bai yi yawa ba domin karshen tattaunawar zai zo nan kusa da watan Disamba.  CTAs za su iya zama mafita a nan. Maimaikon sanya takunkumi bayan sare daji, CTA za ta rataya moriyar cinikayya mai sauki—kamar cire haraji—da tabbacin kare dajin. Misali, idan EU da Brazil sun amince ba za a saka haraji ga kayayyakin Brazil ba muddin an tabbatar da dajin bai ragu ba ta amfani da hotunan tauraron dan adam; idan aka sami sare daji, sai a kara haraji da za ta sa kare daji yafi amfani.  A tsarin Harstad, haraji zai karu idan an kara sare daji, hakan zai sa za a fi son kiyaye dajin don samu ribar cinikayya. Amma dole a tsayar da harajin yadda ba zai yi yawa har ya yanke dangantakar cinikayya ba; haka nan, za a ci gaba da amfana amma akwai iyaka ga adadin dajin da za a kare ta wannan hanyar.  Binciken Harstad ya nuna tasiri sosai: idan Brazil ta ci gaba da yarjejeniyar cinikayya ta gargajiya yayin da bukatar Asiya ta ninka, kasar za ta iya rasa kashi 27% na dajin don noma. Amma da CTA tsakanin Brazil da EU, hakan zai ragu zuwa 14%. Idan EU da Amurka sun hada kai, asarar zai sauka zuwa kashi 3% kacal.  Faransa da Holland kwanan nan sun goyi bayan hada haraji da ka’idojin muhalli cikin yarjejeniyar kasuwanci. Harstad ya bayyana amfani da irin wannan tsarin a ainihin mu’amalar cinikayya, yana mai cewa musanyar moriyar cinikayya ya fi sauki a siyasa fiye da biyan kudi don kare gandun daji.  Harstad na fatan masana da masu yanke hukunci za su yi amfani da wadannan bayanai, musamman yanzu da ake dab da kammala tattaunawar EU-Mercosur. Bana nan gaba, Harstad na fatan ganin hakan an fadada ga yarjejeniyoyin Amurka da Mercosur domin hada cinikayya da kare muhalli.

article_content: Mamoru Samuragochi, once celebrated as the 'Japanese Beethoven' for composing acclaimed symphonies while claiming to be completely deaf for 15 years, has admitted to partially faking his hearing loss. In a handwritten apology delivered through his lawyers, Samuragochi acknowledged his wrongdoing, saying, 'I apologize from the bottom of my heart for betraying and hurting many people.' Last week, Tokyo music teacher Takashi Niigaki revealed at a press conference that he had secretly been the true composer behind Samuragochi's works for 18 years. Niigaki also doubted Samuragochi's claims of deafness, stating that their interactions were always normal and that Samuragochi provided critiques for music he had commissioned. In his written statement, Samuragochi stated that he was indeed deaf but had regained partial hearing over the last three years. 'It has recovered to an extent where I can sometimes understand words if someone speaks clearly and slowly right next to my ear, though the sound is muffled and distorted,' he explained. Samuragochi said he intends to apologize to the public in person soon. He is also willing to have his hearing medically evaluated and to give up his government-issued disability certificate if found ineligible. His letter included apologies to the victims of the tsunami—many of whom found inspiration in his most famous symphony—and to Japanese Olympic figure skater Daisuke Takahashi. Takahashi had chosen another of the ghostwritten works for his performance in Sochi, but the Japanese Skating Federation decided to use the music without acknowledging Samuragochi as the composer. 'I am deeply ashamed of living a life of lies,' Samuragochi wrote. Samuragochi had claimed to rely on perfect pitch to compose his works after losing his hearing, telling TIME magazine in 2001 that, 'if you trust your inner sense of sound, you create something that is truer... Losing my hearing was a gift from God.' While confessing to using a ghostwriter, Samuragochi claimed he contributed broad musical ideas, while Niigaki crafted the completed scores. Niigaki, however, expressed doubts that Samuragochi could even compose musical scores, and mentioned that Samuragochi threatened suicide if their arrangement was ever exposed.

A cikin wasika da ya rubuta da hannunsa, wacce lauyoyinsa suka isar, Samuragochi ya bayyana nadama, yana cewa, 'Ina ba da hakuri daga zuciyata ga duk waɗanda na cuta da na yaudara.' A makon da ya gabata, malamin kiɗa na Tokyo, Takashi Niigaki, ya bayyana a taron manema labarai cewa shi ne ya rubuta waƙoƙin Samuragochi duka tsawon shekaru 18 a boye. Niigaki ya kara rashin gaskiya kan ikirarin Samuragochi na rashin jin magana, yana cewa sun dinga magana lafiya-lafiya kuma Samuragochi na ba da ra'ayi game da kiɗan da ya umarta. A cikin bayaninsa, Samuragochi ya ce da gaske ya rasa jin magana, amma cikin shekaru uku da suka gabata ya sami dan dawowa. 'Jin na ya dan dawo ta yadda zan iya fahimtar kalmomi idan an yi magana a hankali da natsuwa kusa da kunnena, kodayake har yanzu sautin yana da nauyi da karkarwa,' in ji shi. Samuragochi ya ce zai nemi afuwar jama'a a fili nan gaba kadan. Yana kuma shirye a auna lafiyar kunne sa sannan ya mika takardar nakasa idan bai cancanta ba. Wasikar ta ƙunshi hakuri ga wadanda ambaliyar ruwan tsunami ta shafa—inda aka dauki waƙarsa a matsayin alamar juriya—da kuma ga zakaran wasan kankara na Olympics na Japan, Daisuke Takahashi. Takahashi ya zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin waƙoƙin da aka rubuta a boye domin wasansa a Sochi, amma hukumar wasan kankara ta Japan ta yanke shawarar amfani da waƙar ba tare da saka sunan Samuragochi ba. 'Ina jin kunyar rayuwar da ta cika da ƙarya,' in ji Samuragochi. Samuragochi ya ce ya dogara da bambance-bambancen sauti wajen rubuta waƙoƙinsa bayan rasa ji, inda ya shaida wa mujallar TIME a 2001 cewa, 'idan ka dogara da tunaninka na sauti, za ka ƙirƙiri abu mafi gaskiya... Rasuwar jin magana wata baiwa ce daga Allah.' Ko da yake ya amince da amfani da wanda ke rubuta masa waƙoƙi, Samuragochi ya tsaya kan cewa shi ke kawo babbar manufa, Niigaki kuma ke kammala waƙar. Sai dai Niigaki ya ce bai yarda Samuragochi zai iya rubuta waƙar kansa ba, har ya bayyana cewa Samuragochi ya taba barazanar kashe kansa idan an tona gaskiya.

article_content:
The Biden administration has said it seeks to prevent a wider regional war while maintaining strong support for Israel’s military campaign in Gaza. Despite international appeals for a ceasefire, Washington is steadfast in its backing of Israel, leading to concerns about the clarity and consequences of its policies.

President Joe Biden has pledged firm support for Israel but also warned against expanding the conflict—goals that analysts note can be at odds. Trita Parsi, executive vice president at the Quincy Institute, suggests that supporting Israel appears to be the administration’s higher priority over de-escalation.

US officials state they are challenging Israel over its operations in Gaza, including questions about long-term objectives, but the Biden administration’s own strategy is largely undefined. While the White House has denied plans for US troops in Gaza, the US has increased military presence in the region and sent advisers to assist Israel’s proposed ground operations. Ongoing clashes between Israel and Hezbollah in Lebanon, alongside attacks on US personnel by Iran-aligned groups, heighten the risk of escalation.

Analysts warn these incidents could easily grow into a broader conflict. President Biden has emphasized that the US and partners aim for a stable, more integrated Middle East, benefiting both the region and the US.

Beyond providing military aid and diplomatic support to Israel, the wider plan from the US remains unclear. Parsi notes there is no obvious strategy that would likely bring about the desired results.

The conflict began on October 7, when Hamas launched a surprise attack from Gaza, killing over 1,400 people and taking hostages. Israel responded with airstrikes, reportedly killing upwards of 6,500 Palestinians. Adam Shapiro of Democracy for the Arab World Now (DAWN) says that despite full backing for Israel, the US lacks a clearly defined objective and doubts the effectiveness of eliminating Hamas through military action.

Shapiro criticizes the open-ended nature of the mission and warns it could ultimately damage US interests. The outcome for Gaza after any ground offensive remains uncertain. President Biden opposes a renewed Israeli occupation of Gaza, which previously ended in 2005 after many years of military presence.

Brian Finucane of Crisis Group highlights that the US’s objectives seem undefined, reflecting the lack of clear Israeli goals in Gaza. He notes that even if Hamas falls, there’s no plan for what follows, and tensions between supporting Israel and avoiding a regional war persist. Finucane urges that policymakers weigh possible outcomes if escalation draws in US forces against actors like Hezbollah or Iran-aligned groups.

Following costly US wars in Afghanistan and Iraq, there is broad public and political reluctance toward new foreign interventions. Yet Finucane comments that the Hamas attack on October 7 has changed policy discussions in Washington.

University of Maryland professor Shibley Telhami argues that while neither the US nor Iran want a wider war, accidental escalation remains a real risk. He cautions against uncritical US support for Israel’s government, since that could increase chances of direct American involvement.

Parsi adds that efforts to deter Iranian involvement will likely fail if Israel is not also pressured toward restraint, which could lead to the scenario the Biden administration seeks to avoid.

For now, the US continues to support Israel’s offensive, which Amnesty International says has resulted in high civilian casualties, including entire families in Gaza. The US has dismissed calls for a ceasefire, contending that such talks would aid Hamas. Simultaneously, Washington is arranging a $14 billion aid package for Israel with significant military assistance.

Jon Hoffman at the CATO Institute suggests the Biden administration has no clear strategic aim other than hoping the conflict does not widen, warning that ongoing military aid to the region has led to harmful consequences in the past.

Shugaba Joe Biden ya bayyana goyon bayan da ba tare da sharadi ba ga Isra’ila, amma ya ja hankali kan bukatar kauce wa rikicin ya wuce Gaza — masana sun ce burin biyu na iya sabani. Trita Parsi na Quincy Institute ya bayyana cewa, goyon bayan Isra’ila ya fi daukar hankali a manufofin gwamnatin.

Jami’an Amurka sun ce suna tambayar Isra’ila tambayoyi masu muhimmanci game da burinta a rikicin Gaza, amma shirin gwamnatin Biden bai fito fili ba. Duk da Fadar White House ta musanta niyyar tura sojojin Amurka zuwa Gaza, Amurka ta karfafa gwiwa da karin dakarun soji a yankin, da kuma aikewa da kwararru don taimakawa shirin mamayar Gaza ta kasa. Harin da ke ci gaba tsakanin Isra’ila da Hezbollah a Lebanon, da kuma wadanda ke kan sojojin Amurka daga kungiyoyin dake da alaka da Iran, suna kara tayar da hankali kan yiwuwar rikicin ya fadada.

Bayan samar da tallafin soji da diflomasiyya ga Isra’ila, har yanzu ba a bayyana manufa ko tsari mai karfi daga Amurka ba. Parsi ya nuna bai ga wata hanya bayyananniya da za ta cimma sakamako mai kyau ba.

Rikicin ya fara ne ranar 7 ga Oktoba, lokacin da Hamas ta kai hari daga Gaza, wanda ya yi sanadin mutuwar mutum sama da 1,400 da kuma yin garkuwa da wasu. Isra’ila ta mayar da martani da hare-hare, wadanda ake zargin sun kashe Falasdinawa sama da 6,500. Shapiro ya soki matsayar marawa Isra’ila baya ba tare da fayyace karshe ba, yana gargadin hakan na iya cutar da Amurka. Makomar Gaza bayan yiwuwar mamayar kasa tana cikin duhu. Biden bai yarda a sake sanya sojojin Isra’ila na dindindin a Gaza ba, sabanin abin da ya faru a baya har 2005.

Brian Finucane na Crisis Group ya bayyana cewa, manufar Amurka bata fito fili ba, domin haka ne manufar Isra’ila a Gaza. Ya kara da cewa ko an cire Hamas, har yanzu ba a fayyace wadanda za su jagoranci Gaza ba, kuma akwai rikicin manufa tsakanin goyon bayan Isra’ila da kokarin hana rikicin yin zurfi a yankin. Shibley Telhami na Jami’ar Maryland ya bayyana cewa duk Amurka da Iran basu son fadada yaki amma zai iya faruwa ta kuskure. Ya ja kunne kan biyayya maras tsangwama ga gwamnatin Netanyahu, yana ganin hakan na iya jefa Amurka kai tsaye.

Parsi kuma ya ce hana Iran shiga rikicin zai gagara muddin ba a matsa lamba kan Isra’ila ta yi hakuri ba, abin da zai iya janyo abinda gwamnatin Biden ke son gujewa.

A yanzu, Amurka na ci gaba da goyon bayan hare-haren Isra’ila wanda Amnesty International ke cewa sun hallaka iyalai baki daya a Gaza. Amurka ta ki amincewa da tattauna tsagaita wuta, tana ganin hakan zai amfani Hamas. A lokaci guda, ana shirin tallafa wa Isra’ila da biliyan $14 na taimakon soja.

Jon Hoffman na CATO Institute ya bayyana cewa gwamnatin Biden bata da manufa ba sai dai fata kada rikicin ya fadada, yana gargadi cewa jefa kudi da makamai ga yankin ba lallai ya haifar da da mai ido ba.

article_content: Chevron is acquiring Hess Corp. for $53 billion in stock, marking one of the biggest deals in the energy sector this month. Major oil producers are making significant acquisitions as oil prices remain near $90 per barrel, following a sharp increase that began after Russia's invasion of Ukraine in early 2022. The higher crude prices have provided major energy companies with substantial cash, prompting them to seek new investments. This Chevron-Hess deal follows Exxon Mobil's recent announcement that it will acquire Pioneer Natural Resources for about $60 billion. Oil prices are being pushed up by factors including the ongoing war in Ukraine, production cuts from Saudi Arabia and Russia, and the conflict between Israel and Hamas—which raises the risk of broader instability in the Middle East. The U.S. Energy Information Administration notes that, while attacks on Israel have not disrupted global oil supplies, they raise the risk of potential interruptions and higher prices. Through the acquisition, Chevron will gain valuable oil assets in Guyana and shale fields in North Dakota’s Bakken Formation. Guyana, a South American country with around 791,000 people, is expected to become the world’s fourth-largest offshore oil producer, overtaking nations like Qatar, the United States, Mexico, and Norway. Global competition for oil fields in northern South America has been intense among companies such as Exxon Mobil, China’s CNOOC, and Hess. Chevron’s Chairman and CEO Mike Wirth stated that the acquisition fits the company’s strategy of delivering higher returns and lowering carbon impact. Hess is expected to boost Chevron’s production and cash flow growth over the next five years and support plans to increase dividends and share buybacks. Hess shareholders will receive 1.025 shares of Chevron for each Hess share. When including debt, Chevron values the transaction at $60 billion. Despite increased concern over climate change, especially after a summer of record temperatures, higher energy prices have encouraged more exploration, drilling, and investor returns. There has been a wave of acquisitions in the U.S. shale sector in recent years. In 2020, Chevron acquired Noble Energy for $5 billion, and ConocoPhillips bought Concho Resources for $9.7 billion. Last month, the UK approved a major oil and gas project in the North Sea, despite warnings from scientists and the United Nations against new fossil fuel developments. Chevron expects the Hess acquisition will allow the company to recommend an 8% increase in its first-quarter dividend to $1.63, subject to board approval, and raise stock buybacks by $2.5 billion to reach the top of its $20 billion annual guidance when the deal closes. Boards of both Chevron and Hess have approved the agreement after six months of negotiations. The deal is expected to close in the first half of next year, pending Hess shareholder approval. John Hess, CEO of Hess, is expected to join Chevron’s board. His family owns a significant portion of Hess. On Monday, shares of Chevron Corp., based in San Ramon, California, fell 3.7%. Shares of New York-based Hess Corp. ended the day down 1%.
translated_content: Kamfanin Chevron yana sayen Hess Corp. da darajar dala biliyan 53 cikin hannun jari, daya daga cikin manyan yarjejeniyoyi a masana’antar mai a wannan watan. Manyan kamfanonin mai suna ci gaba da sayan wasu kamfanoni yayin da farashin mai ke kusa da dala 90 kowanne ganga, tun bayan tashin gwauron zabi da farashin ya samu bayan mamayar da Rasha ta kai wa Ukraine a farkon 2022. Wannan hauhawar farashin ta sa manyan kamfanonin mai suka samu kuɗi mai yawa, suna neman yadda za su zuba jari. Wannan yarjejeniya tsakanin Chevron da Hess ta biyo bayan sanarwar Exxon Mobil cewa zai sayi Pioneer Natural Resources a kimanin dala biliyan 60. Manyan dalilan da ke tura farashin mai sama sun hada da yaki a Ukraine, rage fitar mai daga Saudi Arabia da Rasha, da rikicin Isra’ila da Hamas—wanda ke kara yuwuwar rikicin yankin Gabas ta Tsakiya ya karu. Hukumar Kiwon Lantarki ta Amurka ta ce, ko da yake hare-haren da ake kaiwa Isra’ila ba su katse samar da mai ba tukuna, suna kara hadarin matsaloli da tsadar mai. Ta wannan ciniki, Chevron za ta samu muhimmancin filayen mai a Guyana da kuma gonakin mai na shale a Bakken Formation dake North Dakota. Guyana, kasar Kudu maso Amurka mai mutane kusan 791,000, ana sa ran za ta zama ta hudu mafi girman samar da mai a teku a duniya, ta zarce kasashen Qatar, Amurka, Mexico da Norway. Kamfanoni irin su Exxon Mobil, CNOOC na China, da Hess suna fafata wa wajen samun manyan filayen mai a arewacin Kudancin Amurka. Shugaban Chevron kuma Babban Darakta, Mike Wirth, ya ce wannan hadin gwiwa tana daidai da tsarin kamfanin na samar da riba mai yawa da rage hayaƙin carbon. Hess zai karawa Chevron yawan samar da mai da bunkasar kudin shiga a shekaru biyar masu zuwa, kuma zai taimaka wajen inganta rabo ga masu hannun jari da sayen hannun jari na baya. Masu hannayen jari a Hess za su karba hannayen jari na Chevron 1.025 bisa kowane hannun jarin Hess daya. Idan aka hada da basussuka, Chevron ta bayyana kimar cinikin duka dala biliyan 60. Kodayake damuwar dumamar yanayi ta karu musamman bayan zafin bala’i lokacin bazara, hauhawar farashin makamashi ya jawo karin bincike, hako mai, da riba ga masu zuba jari. Shekarun baya sun ga yawaitar sayen kamfanonin shale a Amurka. A 2020, Chevron ta sayi Noble Energy da dala biliyan 5, inda ConocoPhillips ta sayi Concho Resources da dala biliyan 9.7. A watan da ya wuce, Birtaniya ta amince da babban aikin mai da gas a Tekun Arewa, duk da gargadin masana da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya game da kirkirar sabbin gonakin mai. Chevron na fatan wannan yarjejeniya da Hess za ta bawa kamfanin damar bada shawarar karin 8% a rabon kason farko na shekara zuwa dala $1.63, muddin hukumar ta amince, da kuma karin sayen hannayen jari har zuwa dala biliyan 2.5 don kaiwa matsakaita shirin dala biliyan 20 a shekara bayan kammala hadin. Kwamitin gudanarwar Chevron da Hess duka sun amince da yarjejeniyar bayan watanni shida na tattaunawa. Ana sa ran kammala cinikin a rabin farko na shekara mai zuwa, bayan amincewar masu hannun jari na Hess. Shugaban Hess, John Hess, ana sa ran zai shiga kwamitin Chevron kuma iyalinsa na da kaso mai tsoka a Hess. A ranar Litinin, hannayen jarin Chevron Corp. dake San Ramon, California, sun fadi da kaso 3.7%. Hannayen jarin Hess Corp. na New York sun kare da ragin 1%.

article_content: A Colorado mother, Sandy Thi Nguyen, falsely claimed her six-year-old son had cancer and used this story to raise at least $25,000 in donations, according to authorities. Nguyen pleaded guilty to child abuse and charitable fraud, The Denver Post reported, with sentencing scheduled for November. Investigators said that Nguyen convinced her son, family, and community that the child was undergoing cancer treatment since September 2012. Over a year, Aurora residents donated more than $25,000. The Arapahoe County Sheriff's Office reported Nguyen spent at least $16,000—including on a Disneyland trip for her family—and $23,000 in cash was found in her home. Nguyen admitted her son did not have cancer, and some of the funds recovered came from donations. Nguyen's story was featured in a charity race, and she allegedly posted false updates about her son's treatments online. The boy believed he was ill, underwent 'nightly chemotherapy,' and had his head shaved each morning, arrest records show. Rolling Hills school principal Darla Thompson expressed concern and sadness over the incident, emphasizing the community's support for the child victim. The child, who genuinely thought he was sick, bore no responsibility for his mother's actions.

Masu bincike sun ce Nguyen ta sa ɗanta, danginta, da al'umma sun yarda cewa yaron na samun maganin sankara tun watan Satumba 2012. Cikin shekara guda, mazauna Aurora sun tara fiye da dala 25,000. Ofishin ‘yan sanda na Arapahoe County ya ce Nguyen ta kashe akalla dala 16,000 ciki har da tafiye-tafiye zuwa Disneyland da iyalinta, kuma an gano dala 23,000 a gidanta. Nguyen ta amsa cewa ɗanta ba shi da sankara, kuma wasu kudaden da aka samo sun fito ne daga gudummawar jama’a. Labarin Nguyen da ɗanta ya fito a wata gasa ta agaji, kuma ana zargin ta da wallafa bayanan ƙarya game da jinyar ɗanta a yanar gizo. Yaron ya gaskata yana da ciwon, ana masa 'maganin chemotherapy kowacce dare', kuma mahaifiyarsa na aske masa kai kowacce safiya, kamar yadda rahoton kama ta ya nuna. article_content: Sara Ylen, a 38-year-old Michigan mother, has been accused of fraud, false pretenses, and crimes involving computer use, after investigators found no evidence of her reported cancer diagnosis. Previously, James Grissom—a local man she accused of rape—spent almost ten years in prison before being freed when doubts were raised about the alleged assault. During Ylen’s claimed battle with cancer, her community generously supported her, organizing fundraisers, providing care, and an insurance payout of nearly $100,000 for hospice treatment. Longtime friends like Carol Connell shared gifts and offered emotional support, but now feel betrayed, wondering whether Ylen’s suffering was authentic or part of a long deception. In addition to fraud charges, Ylen is also facing prosecution in a neighboring county for making a false rape allegation—allegedly even using makeup to create fake bruises. Records show she had made similar unproven claims in the past, including reports of kidnapping and rape in California, with some family members doubting her honesty. Her ex-husband and legal filings revealed a pattern of fabricated illnesses and events, with Ylen providing false information about her doctors. Psychological assessments during divorce proceedings described her as prone to deceit and seeking attention. Many former supporters now express regret and disillusionment as they come to terms with the extent of the betrayal.

article_content: A patient at Hereford County Hospital is being tested for Ebola as a precaution after recently traveling to West Africa and showing early symptoms. Public Health England maintains that the risk is low and testing is a routine safety step. The patient developed diarrhoea, one of the initial symptoms related to Ebola, leading to the temporary closure of a nearby walk-in clinic for disinfection and public safety. Officials emphasize that no Ebola cases have ever been identified in the UK. The virus spreads only through direct contact with bodily fluids from an infected person. Medical staff have been reminded to be extra vigilant with patients returning from high-risk areas, and increased testing is anticipated as a preventive measure. Health authorities are confident that existing steps protect public health. Some members of the Hereford community have expressed worry and frustration, particularly about the lack of immediate information during the clinic closure, but many appreciate the thoroughness of the response. Meanwhile, the UK government has announced a £1.34 million increase in funding for Ebola research. This decision followed pledges at the G20 summit and aims to boost programs studying rapid diagnostic tools, tracking the virus’s spread, and supporting better community engagement. With over £230 million deployed so far and teams of volunteers being trained, the UK remains a leading supporter of Ebola response efforts, particularly in Sierra Leone, Liberia, and Guinea. The outbreak in West Africa has resulted in more than 5,000 deaths and over 13,000 cases, straining local healthcare systems and interrupting critical services like child immunizations and maternal care.

article_content: School can be a daunting place for children with autism, many of whom struggle to communicate with peers and stay focused. However, one school believes it has found a solution: robot teachers. Topcliffe Primary School in Castle Vale, Birmingham, has become the first school in the UK to use humanoid robots to assist teaching pupils with autism. The school uses two knee-high robots named 'Max' and 'Ben' by the pupils, each costing around £15,000 and designed to move similarly to children. The robots can be programmed to have conversations, play games, dance, and even lead classes. Unlike human teachers, Max and Ben have blank features, no emotions, and standardized expressions and responses. Headteacher Ian Lowe explains that these characteristics make the robots easier for autistic children to relate to and understand. 'Autistic children find them less threatening and easier to engage with than adults and other children, providing a safe environment for developing communication skills,' he says. 'Children who initially struggle to make eye contact with humans begin to communicate through the robots. They are also cute and lovable, helping to capture their attention,' he adds. The mainstream state school, which also caters to children without autism, has a dedicated centre for pupils with the disability. The long-term aim is to integrate these pupils into classes with other children. The robots were donated by the University of Birmingham and robotics company Aldebaran, who are researching how such technology can aid children with disabilities. Teachers can control the robots and send messages for classroom activities by typing sentences into a computer. Libi Cooper, a five-year-old pupil, previously struggled to concentrate in lessons for more than ten minutes but can now focus for up to twenty minutes after regular sessions with the robots. Teacher Richard Garland notes improvements in her communication and social skills. 'She can interpret the robot’s body language, a skill transferable to real-life interactions,' Garland explains. 'She enjoys interacting with the robot, joins in with songs, dances, and feels comfortable with it, which has helped her remain engaged for extended periods.' Libi’s father, Colin, also has a seven-year-old autistic son, Owen, at the school. He observes significant improvements in Libi’s development over six months and credits the robot as a key part of her progress. Owen, who affectionately calls the robot 'Buzz Lightyear,' has gained confidence and become more sociable. The school has essentially acted as a research lab for two years, providing feedback to the University of Birmingham and Aldebaran to help develop new educational features for the robots. A recently developed feature allows teachers and parents to track a child’s progress by recording results from interactive games. One popular game involves animal recognition, where children identify cards when prompted by the robot. Consistent positive or constructive feedback from the robot helps build trust and reduce confusion. Ben Waterworth, the school’s Head of ICT, notes: 'We’ve seen children who were initially afraid of the robot grow to call it their “best friend.” The robot strengthens listening, mimicry, and turn-taking skills, and aids classroom management by encouraging children to listen and participate.' Dr Karen Guldberg, director of the University of Birmingham’s Autism Centre for Education and Research, emphasizes the importance of motivating and engaging autistic children, using clear language, and allowing ample time to process instructions. She considers the robot an effective tool for supporting communication and interaction in the classroom, with potential benefits for mainstream classes as well. 'When people feel safe and are motivated, they learn much better,' Guldberg concludes.

Amma wata makaranta ta samu mafita: malamai na'ura masu kama da mutum. Makarantar Firamare ta Topcliffe a Castle Vale, Birmingham, ita ce ta farko a Burtaniya da ta fara amfani da robot mai kama da mutum don taimakawa koyar da yara masu autism. Makarantar gwamnati ce, wacce ke karɓar yara da ba su da autism, amma tana da cibiyar musamman ga masu lalura. Babban burin su shine shigar da wadannan yara cikin azuzuwan sauran yara. 'Tana iya fahimta daga yanayin jikin robot, wannan kuma ƙwarewa ce da za ta ƙara mata amfani a rayuwar yau da kullum,' in ji Garland. 'Tana jin daɗin mu'amala da robot, tana anfani da waƙoƙi, rawa, da jin daɗin zama tare da shi – hakan ya taimaka wajen daidaita hankalinta na dogon lokaci.' Mahaifin Libi, Colin, yana da wani ɗa mai shekaru bakwai, Owen, mai autism, a makarantar. Ya lura da canji mai kyau cikin watanni shida, kuma yana ganin robot din ta taka muhimmiyar rawa. Owen, wanda yake kiran robot din da 'Buzz Lightyear', ya zama mai ƙarfi da yin aiki tare da sauran yara. Makarantar ta yi aiki daidai da dakin gwajin bincike na tsawon shekaru biyu, suna ba da rahoto ga Jami'ar Birmingham da Aldebaran wajen ƙirƙira sababbin fasaloli na ilimi a robot din. Wani sabon fasali yana bai wa malamai da iyaye damar bin diddigin ci gaban yaro ta hanyar sakamako da aka ajiye daga wasanni na sada zumunta. Wasanni da yara suka fi so sun haɗa da gane namun daji, inda robot zai tambayi yara su nuna katin da aka zana dabba. Daidai ko kuskure, robot din na bada amsa iri ɗaya don tallafawa yaro da rage rudani. Ben Waterworth, shugaban ICT na makarantar, ya bayyana: 'Mun ga yara wadanda da farko suna jin tsoro suna fahimta da robot har su kira shi abokinsu mafi soyuwa. Robot din yana ƙarfafa saurare, koyi, bin jere wajen wasa, da kuma taimaka wa malamai wajen daidaita aji.' Dr Karen Guldberg, daraktar Cibiyar Autism ta Jami'ar Birmingham, ta jaddada muhimmancin zaburar da yara masu autism, amfani da kalmomi masu sauki, da basu lokaci su fahimta. Ta ce robot din yana da amfani kwarai wajen tallafawa mu'amala a cikin aji, sannan zai iya amfanar da sauran aji na kowa. 'Idan mutum na jin tsaro da sha'awa, ya fi sauki wajen koyon abubuwa,' Guldberg ta ƙare.

article_content: Germany secured the World Cup after a commanding campaign, notably trouncing Brazil. However, CNN’s analytical model anticipated a different champion: Brazil. CNN’s forecast factored in FIFA world rankings going into the tournament, the annual salary for each team’s manager, and each nation’s population. Spain held the top FIFA spot while Australia ranked last among participants at 62. There was a vast gap in manager pay, with Russia’s Fabio Capello earning the most at about $11.5 million annually. At the other extreme, Mexico paid Miguel Herrera just $214,000. Population mattered too, under the assumption that more people meant a larger talent pool. The U.S. was the biggest qualified nation, followed by Brazil, Nigeria, Russia, and Japan. Bosnia-Herzegovina and Uruguay were the smallest, both under four million residents. Averaging all three measures, CNN’s model pointed to Brazil as the likely victor. Brazil, being large, highly ranked, and with a well-paid manager, was expected to win. The host country advanced out of its group but ultimately stumbled at the crucial stage, conceding 10 goals and scoring just once in their final two matches, landing a disappointing fourth. Germany actually outperformed CNN’s projections by winning the tournament (they’d been forecast as runners-up). The model also highlighted some dramatic surprises: Costa Rica, rated for 27th, finished 8th. Argentina, with less impressive metrics and a modestly paid coach, became runner-up, thanks in part to the stellar play of Messi. Meanwhile, several high-profile teams disappointed. Spain, projected for third, ended up 23rd. England was predicted to finish fifth but dropped to 26th, despite ranking 10th globally and employing one of the best-paid managers. Italy and Russia, with costly coaches, both performed significantly worse than anticipated. Another finding: Belgium and Greece appeared almost identical on paper (similar rankings, coach salaries, and populations), and both surpassed CNN’s expectations. Greece rose from an expected 18th to 13th, while Belgium vaulted from a predicted 15th to a 6th place finish. Report by Patrick Sung, Manuela Lanza, and John Sinnott.

CNN ta yi hasashenta da la’akari da matsayi a FIFA kafin gasar, albashin koci na kowace ƙasa, da kuma yawan jama’ar ƙasar. Spain ce ta fi kowa matsayi, Australia ke ƙasa a na 62. Bambanci sai dai a albashi — Fabio Capello na Rasha yana karɓar kusan $11.5m a shekara, yayin da Miguel Herrera na Mexico ke karɓar $214,000 kacal. An duba yawan jama’a tun da ƙasa mai yawa na iya zakulo ‘yan wasa fiye. Amurka ta fi kowa yawan mutane a cikin masu fafatawa, sai Brazil, Nigeria, Russia da Japan. article_content: A senior government official announced that the planned sale of the government’s stake in IDBI Bank is unlikely to conclude before March 2024. Tuhin Kanta Pandey, Secretary of the Department of Investment and Public Asset Monetisation (DIPAM), stated that while the process is underway, meeting the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) regulatory requirements remains a key step. Speaking at a Ficci event in Mumbai, Pandey explained that the complexity of the transaction, particularly in adhering to the RBI’s fit and proper norms for prospective investors, makes a completion before March improbable. Currently, the government holds more than 45% of IDBI Bank, while LIC owns 49.24%; together, they are seeking to offload a combined 60.7% stake in the bank. Pandey emphasized that achieving the government’s disinvestment target of Rs 51,000 crore this fiscal year depends on major moves like the successful sale of IDBI Bank’s majority ownership. Pandey also mentioned uncertainty surrounding other disinvestment efforts, such as the potential share sale of NMDC, from which the government expects to raise over Rs 10,000 crore. Regarding the planned sale of Shipping Corporation of India (SCI), he noted that the Maharashtra government has recently exempted the required stamp duty on an asset transfer, paving the way for the transaction. Separately, the Reserve Bank of India has tightened capital regulations for unsecured retail loans in response to rapid growth in consumer lending, instructing banks to allocate more capital and set up board-monitored oversight to manage financial risk. In other business news, the Ministry of Mines has informed Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) that any restructuring into separate business entities will require formal government approval. Meanwhile, India's cricket fast-bowler Mohammed Shami has become a hot property for brand endorsements during the ongoing ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup, reportedly commanding endorsement deals of around ₹1 crore each following his record-breaking performances.

article_content: A UK government committee has warned that the overall cost for hosting the 2012 London Olympics and Paralympic Games might rise to £11 billion ($17.2 billion), almost 20% more than earlier predictions. The British Parliament’s public accounts committee reported that nearly all of the £9.3 billion ($14.5 billion) initially allocated for the event has been spent. Committee chair Margaret Hodge MP voiced concerns about sticking to the budget, adding that when broader costs are considered, public spending on the Games and related legacy projects is already approaching £11 billion. A major source of concern is the sharp increase in security expenses. Forecasts from 2010 put security at £282 million ($442 million), but by December 2011, that figure had shot up to over £550 million ($862 million). The need for security workers has jumped from 10,000 to about 23,700. Hodge called the difference between early and current estimates 'staggering.' Questions also remain about what will happen to the Olympic stadium after the Games. The venue, which cost close to £500 million ($785 million) to build and seats 80,000, still hasn’t found a long-term tenant. A proposed deal with West Ham Football Club fell apart in October 2011. To find a new user, officials reopened bidding in December 2011, asking for submissions by March 23, 2012. The committee has also expressed skepticism about the government following through on its promise of a strong Olympic legacy, pointing out that it removed its original goal to increase sports participation by one million people by 2013. On the other hand, Minister for Sport Hugh Robertson dismissed the committee’s conclusions, saying they failed to consider the money the government could recover by selling Olympic park land. Should the committee’s judgments prove correct, the final bill for the Games could end up being nearly three times higher than the initial estimated cost of £4 billion ($6.3 billion), which was already increased to £9.3 billion in 2007. The Olympics and Paralympics will begin on July 27 and August 29, respectively.
translated_content: Wata kwamitin gwamnatin Birtaniya ta gargadi cewa kudin gudanar da Gasar Olympic da Paralympic ta London 2012 na iya kaiwa £11 biliyan ($17.2 biliyan), wanda ke nufin karin kusan kashi 20% akan hasashen farko. Kwamitin kididdiga na majalisar dokokin kasar ya ce ana kusa shanye kusan dukkan Naira £9.3 biliyan ($14.5 biliyan) da aka ware tun farko don gasar. Shugabar kwamitin, Margaret Hodge MP, ta bayyana damuwa kan iya kiyaye kasafin kudin, tana mai cewa idan aka hada da sauran kudaden da ba su cikin asusun farko, jimillar kudin da jama'a za su biya kan wasannin da ayyukan ci gaba na Gasar na dab da kai £11 biliyan. Babban abin damuwa shi ne hauhawar farashin tsaro. Hasashen 2010 ya nuna za a kashe £282 miliyan ($442 miliyan), amma zuwa Disamba 2011, wannan adadi ya haura £550 miliyan ($862 miliyan). Yawan masu tsaron da ake bukata ya karu daga 10,000 zuwa kusan 23,700. Hodge ta ce wannan bambanci da aka samu tsakanin hasashe da abin da ake fuskanta abin mamaki ne. Har yanzu akwai tambayoyi game da makomar filin wasan Olympic bayan kammala gasar. An kashe kusan £500 miliyan ($785 miliyan) wajen gina filin da ke daukar mutane 80,000, amma ba a samu wanda zai ci gaba da amfani da shi bayan gasar ba. Yarjejeniyar da aka yi da kulob din West Ham ta rushe a Oktoba 2011. Domin nemo mai amfanar filin, an bude sabon tsarin neman masu sha’awa a Disamba 2011 inda ake sa ran kammala karbar takardun gabatarwa kafin 23 ga Maris, 2012. Kwamitin ya kara bayyana shakku game da alkawuran gwamnatin na bunkasa rayuwar wasanni bayan gasar, musamman ganin an yanke hukuncin cire burin kara yawan wadanda ke shiga wasanni da milyan guda nan da 2013. A gefe guda kuwa, Ministan Wasanni Hugh Robertson ya musanta rahoton kwamitin, yana mai cewa bai la'akari da kudin da gwamnati za ta iya samu daga sayar da filin Olympic ba. Idan hasashen kwamitin ya zama gaskiya, kudin gudanar da gasar zai ninka har sau uku daga hasashen farko na £4 biliyan ($6.3 biliyan), wanda tun farko aka kara zuwa £9.3 biliyan a 2007. An shirya fara Gasar Olympic a ranar 27 ga Yuli, yayin da Paralympic za ta fara a 29 ga Agusta.

article_content: In a bar tucked away in the alleyways near Las Ramblas, named after Barcelona’s legendary youth academy La Masia, passionate Barca supporters gathered to watch football. On Friday night, fans and locals filled the venue, its walls adorned with memorabilia and posters celebrating the club’s successes over the last decade, including photos from the Champions League win at Wembley in 2011 and the Club World Cup triumph later that year in Yokohama. But on Saturday, disappointment struck at Camp Nou as Barcelona suffered a surprising 1-0 defeat to Malaga, their first home loss since November. Despite star forward Lionel Messi’s efforts, the team struggled to break down Malaga’s defense, with Juanmi’s early goal proving decisive. Luis Suarez, brought in for a significant fee from Liverpool, and Neymar both failed to make a significant impact during the match. Only weeks earlier, Barcelona seemed to have put rumors of internal conflict behind them, boasting an 11-game winning streak and high-scoring performances. Many expected an easy victory over Malaga, followed by a strong showing against Manchester City in the upcoming Champions League round of 16. Local newspapers predicted a Messi hat-trick and a return to the top of La Liga. Instead, the defeat has brought old doubts rushing back. At the final whistle, as the club hymn played over the loudspeakers and fans exited, the stadium felt subdued. The once unstoppable Barcelona looked out of sorts, lacking cohesion and creativity, and struggling to adapt to changes on and off the pitch. This latest result has fueled talk of a transitional period for the club. The dominance of Pep Guardiola’s era is fading, with icons like Xavi nearing the end of their careers. The tiki-taka style has been overtaken by the power and pace of teams like Bayern Munich and Real Madrid. Messi, while still brilliant, can’t always save the team single-handedly. The article recounts how Messi came to prominence in England by thrilling against Chelsea nine years ago, despite enduring rough treatment. Since then, Messi has remained at the center of Barcelona’s fortunes. Now, as the team faces challenges, they may depend on him more than ever to prevent further decline, especially as Manchester City sense an opportunity to capitalize on Barca’s vulnerability. Meanwhile, Manchester City enjoyed a resounding victory over Newcastle, and are preparing to face Barcelona with renewed confidence. The shift in football’s balance of power, highlighted by Cristiano Ronaldo winning another Ballon d’Or, suggests Barcelona’s era at the top is under threat.

A daren Juma’a, mashayar ta cika da mutane, bangon akwai hotuna da kaya na tunawa da nasarorin kungiyar a shekara goma da ta wuce, cikin su harda hoton gasar Champions League 2011 a Wembley da gasar Club World Cup a Yokohama. Amma a ranar Asabar, Camp Nou ta shiga jimami bayan Barcelona ta sha kashi a hannun Malaga da ci 1-0, wanda shine kashin farko a gida tun Nuwamba. Kodayake Lionel Messi ya yi iya kokarinsa, kungiyar ta kasa karya garkuwar Malaga, kuma Juanmi ya ci kwallon farko. Luis Suarez da aka dauko daga Liverpool da kuɗi mai yawa, da Neymar, duk sun kasa yin tasiri a wasan. Kwanaki baya, Barcelona ta wuce jita-jitar rikici, tana da ci 11 a jere kuma suna kwallo da yawa. An yi tsammanin cin Malaga a saukake kafin su karbi Manchester City a Champions League na gaba. Jaridun gida sun ce Messi zai ci sau uku kuma su koma kan teburin La Liga. Sai dai wannan rashin nasara ya dawo da shakku da damuwa. Da safiyar busar tashi, wakar kungiyar ta nuna tsakanin masu goyon baya, amma filin wasa ya yi shiru. Barcen da aka sani da kayatarwa yanzu ga alama tana kan matsala, rashin hadin kai, kirkira, da canje-canje sun addabi su. Wannan sakamako ya kara jaddada cewar kungiyar na cikin lokacin sauyi. Mulkin Pep Guardiola ya kusa wucewa, Xavi na gab da yin ritaya, salon tiki-taka ya ragu, yanzu Bayern Munich da Real Madrid ne ke jan zaraga. Messi har yanzu da kwarewar sa amma ba zai iya ceto kungiyar shi kadai ba. Labari ya zo da tarihin da Messi ya fara shahara a Ingila lokacin da ya burge a wasan da Chelsea shekaru tara da suka wuce, duk da kalubalen da ya fuskanta. A lokaci guda, Manchester City sun doke Newcastle da babban ci kuma za su fuskanci Barcelona da sabuwar kwarin gwuiwa. Sabon zamanin kwallon kafa, musamman bayan Cristiano Ronaldo ya sake samun Ballon d’Or, ya nuna zamanin Barcelona a sama yana karewa.

article_content: Edwin P. Wilson, a former CIA operative once accused of living extravagantly at the U.S. government's expense and maintaining multiple properties and relationships, died at age 84 in Seattle on September 10 following complications from heart valve surgery. Wilson, who was branded a traitor and convicted in the 1980s for secretly shipping arms to Libya, had his conviction overturned after serving 22 years in prison. Throughout his CIA career, Wilson established front companies abroad and posed as a wealthy American businessman, socializing with influential figures and acquiring properties in the U.S., Europe, Tripoli, Lebanon, and Mexico. His lifestyle, which included having a mistress and spending generously, attracted scrutiny. He allegedly avoided IRS investigation by claiming his income related to national security. Wilson’s legal troubles began in 1983, with a conviction for shipping 20 tons of C-4 plastic explosives to Libya in the late 1970s and early 1980s, as well as other crimes like attempted murder and criminal solicitation. He was sentenced to 52 years in prison. At his trial, Wilson claimed his actions were at the request of the CIA to build ties with the Libyan government. A federal judge overturned Wilson's conviction in 2003 after finding the government failed to correct false information about Wilson’s relationship with the CIA. Wilson was released in 2004 and moved to Edmonds, Washington, to live with his brother. While in prison, Wilson sought to prove his innocence, filing Freedom of Information Act requests for government documents. After his release, he continued efforts to clear his name and filed a civil lawsuit against several former federal prosecutors and a former CIA executive director; it was dismissed in 2007. Born May 3, 1928, in Nampa, Idaho, Wilson worked as a merchant seaman and graduated from the University of Portland in 1953 with a degree in psychology. He joined the Marines, serving in the final stages of the Korean War, and began working at the CIA in 1955. After leaving the CIA in 1971, Wilson made millions in the arms trade and owned a farm in Northern Virginia, where he hosted high-profile guests. He was arrested in 1982 after being lured from Libya, convicted of exporting firearms without proper authorization, and received sentences totaling 52 years across multiple convictions involving arms deals and conspiracy-related charges.
translated_content: Edwin P. Wilson, tsohon jami’in leken asiri na CIA da aka taba zargi da rayuwa cikin yalwa da arziki a kan kudin gwamnati tare da mallakar kadarori da dama da kuma mu’amala da mutane da yawa, ya rasu yana da shekara 84 a Seattle a ranar 10 ga Satumba bayan ya samu matsala daga aikin dashen bawon zuciya. Wilson, wanda aka kira da mai cin amana kuma aka yanke masa hukunci a shekarun 1980 saboda jigilar makamai zuwa Libya a sirrance, daga bisani an soke hukuncin bayan ya shafe shekaru 22 a gidan yari. A tsawon aikin sa na CIA, Wilson ya kafa kamfanonin bogi a kasashen waje, ya kuma fito da kansa a matsayin attajirin dan kasuwa dan Amurka, yana cudanya da manyan mutane da tara kadarori a Amurka, Turai, Tripoli, Lebanon da Mexico. Hanyarsa ta rayuwa, da suka hada da samun budurwa tare da kashe kudi, ya jawo hankalin jama’a. Ana zargin ya kauce wa binciken haraji ta hanyar bayyana kudaden sa a matsayin masu alaka da tsaro na kasa. Matsalolinsa na doka sun fara ne a 1983, inda aka yanke masa hukunci saboda jigilar nauyin C-4 na kilogram 20 zuwa Libya a karshen shekarun 1970 da farkon 1980, da kuma wasu laifuka irin su yunkurin kisan kai da kitsa laifi. An ba shi hukuncin shekaru 52 a gidan yari. A kotu, Wilson ya ce ai ya yi hakan ne a bukatar CIA don daidaita hulda da gwamnatin Libya. Alkali na tarayya ya soke hukuncin a kan Wilson a 2003 bayan gano gwamnatin ba ta gyara bayanan karya da suka shafi dangantakarsa da CIA ba. An saki Wilson a 2004 kuma ya koma Edmonds, Washington, ya tare da dan uwansa. Yayin da yake gidan yari, Wilson ya nemi tabbatar da laifi ba ya kansa, inda ya nemi takardun gwamnati ta dokar neman bayanai (Freedom of Information Act). Bayan an sako shi, ya cigaba da kokarin wanke sunansa, ya kuma shigar da kara ta farar hula a kan wasu tsoffin lauyoyin gwamnati da tsohon darektan CIA; an yi watsi da karar a 2007. An haifi Wilson a ranar 3 ga Mayu, 1928, a Nampa, Idaho. Ya fara aiki a matsayin matukin jirgin ruwa, kuma ya kammala karatu a Jami’ar Portland a 1953 da digiri a ilmin tunani. Ya shiga sojin ruwa inda ya fafata a karshen yakin Koriya, daga nan ya shiga aiki da CIA a 1955. Bayan barin CIA a 1971, Wilson ya samu miliyoyin daloli ta kasuwancin makamai, ya kuma mallaki gona a arewacin Virginia inda yake ba da tarba ga manyan baki. An kama shi a 1982 bayan an yaudare shi fita daga Libya, aka same shi da laifin fitar da makamai ba tare da izini ba, aka yanke masa hukuncin shekaru 52 duka bisa tuhumce-tuhumcen kasuwanci da makamai da kitsa laifuka.

article_content: British police are investigating after a 30-year-old man was found unconscious during the halftime break of the Premier League game between Stoke City and Blackburn Rovers. The man, an unnamed Blackburn supporter among the 1,300 fans who traveled to the Britannia Stadium, was given emergency medical care at the stadium for a head injury and cardiac arrest, then transported to the University Hospital of North Staffordshire. He died in the early hours of Sunday. A 25-year-old man remains in custody, assisting with police inquiries, according to Staffordshire Police. Both Stoke City chief executive Tony Scholes and Blackburn Rovers have expressed their condolences to the family, noting the tragic nature of the incident.

Shugaban Stoke City, Tony Scholes, da kungiyar Blackburn Rovers sun aike da sakon ta’aziyya ga iyalan marigayin, suna bayyana tashin hankalin wannan lamari.

article_content: The first official clip from the highly anticipated Star Wars: The Force Awakens will be shown in the US on Friday. However, some fans have already been tricked by well-made fake trailers online. A teaser trailer for The Force Awakens will be shown in at least 100 theaters across America, offering audiences their first look at JJ Abrams' blockbuster. Despite this, many fans believed they had already seen the trailer thanks to convincing fakes. One fake, titled 'Star Wars: The Force Awakens International Teaser Trailer', was uploaded to YouTube on Monday and has already been viewed over four million times. The video featured expertly edited Star Wars scenes and dramatic voiceovers, including logos for Disney and Abrams’ production company Bad Robot, which convinced many viewers. Comments like 'amazing' and 'incredible' appeared below the video, but some viewers soon realized it was composed of scenes from various films and computer games. One user, Rocky Severino, who is an audio engineer, pointed out that the audio quality revealed the trailer’s inauthenticity. Another fake trailer titled 'Star Wars: The Force Awakens - Black Friday Trailer 2015' used footage from the popular video game Destiny, yet also managed to deceive some viewers. Regal Cinemas announced that the real Star Wars: The Force Awakens trailer will play before every movie at nine of its locations, including Edwards Irvine Spectrum 22 & IMAX (Irvine, CA); Edwards Mira Mesa Stadium 18 IMAX & RPX (San Diego, CA); Regal Atlantic Station Stadium 18 IMAX & RPX (Atlanta, GA); Regal City North Stadium 14 IMAX & RPX (Chicago, IL); and Regal Union Square Stadium 14 (New York City, NY), among others. More locations may be added. The official trailer will reportedly last about a minute, showcasing only a few brief scenes since there hasn't been enough time to fully edit and polish all the footage. The trailer will also be available online via iTunes Trailers. Director JJ Abrams has provided some teasers from the film, including short glimpses of the Millennium Falcon and the X-Wing. The Force Awakens is set 30 years after Return of the Jedi and is being produced by Walt Disney Pictures, Lucasfilm, and Bad Robot Productions. The film will be released on December 18, 2015.

article_content: Adele is set to return to the stage at the upcoming Grammy Awards following her recovery from vocal cord surgery in November. The 23-year-old singer expressed her excitement on Twitter, noting that it has been so long since she performed, she almost forgot she was a singer. Adele had to cancel her U.S. tour last year due to persistent vocal cord issues. She underwent laser microsurgery at Massachusetts General Hospital and, after successful healing, both she and the Recording Academy have confirmed her comeback. In a press release, Adele described being asked to perform as both an honor and a thrill, as well as admitting to some nerves, since it will be her first performance in months. There was doubt earlier whether she would be ready for the awards show, but it was clear both Adele and producers hoped for her return. Adele is already a two-time Grammy winner and this year leads with six more nominations, including record and song of the year for 'Rolling In The Deep', album of the year and best pop vocal album for '21', and best pop solo performance for 'Someone Like You.' The event will also pay tribute to Glen Campbell, a five-time Grammy winner diagnosed with Alzheimer’s disease, who will give a farewell performance alongside Blake Shelton and The Band Perry. Additional performers on the night include Jason Aldean with Kelly Clarkson, Coldplay with Rihanna, and others such as Foo Fighters, Bruno Mars, Paul McCartney, Nicki Minaj, and Taylor Swift. LL COOL J will emcee the event, which will be broadcast live on CBS at 8 p.m. on Sunday, February 12. Reporting by Denise Quan, CNN.

article_content:
After losing to Australia in the World Cup final, Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Indian cricket team to offer comfort and encouragement. Video released by his office showed Modi speaking warmly with captain Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, and other players, reminding them to stay positive and highlighting that the nation supports them.

Some players were visibly emotional while others processed the defeat quietly. Modi gave a special hug to Mohammed Shami, who was the top wicket-taker in the tournament.

Team members such as Ravindra Jadeja and Shami expressed gratitude for Modi’s visit on social media, noting that his support was deeply motivating. The Prime Minister also shared a post praising their determination and performance throughout the tournament.

His gesture underscored the country's backing for its cricketers, aiming to help them recover and move forward.
translated_content:
Bayan India ta sha kaye a wasan karshe na kofin duniya da Australia, Firayim Minista Narendra Modi ya kai ziyara ga ‘yan wasan kwallon cricket na India don kwantar musu da hankali da karfafa gwiwarsu. A cikin bidiyon da ofishin Firayim Ministan ya fitar, an ga Modi yana tattaunawa da dumi da jagoran tawagar, Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli da sauran ‘yan wasa, yana tunatar da su muhimmancin kasancewa da kwarin gwiwa yayin da al’umma ke tare da su.

article_content: San Diego (CNN) -- Smartphones have blurred the lines between work and personal life. While managers appreciate smartphones for keeping employees accessible, they also bring challenges for departments responsible for data security. Experts say devices handling sensitive business information should be protected from most third-party access. Some companies now encourage employees to keep work and personal activities separate. Despite workers’ preferences, corporate information officers generally prefer that employees do not use the same device for playing games and handling important documents. This is less about lost productivity and more about the risk of malware being introduced through apps, potentially compromising emails, files, and contacts. A possible solution involves phones designed to keep work and personal data separate. AT&T, LG, and startups are introducing their own approaches. They aim to have companies install security solutions on employee devices, with most systems currently focused on Android, the most widely used smartphone platform. Android is also viewed as more vulnerable to attacks because Google does not screen apps before they are available on its app store, unlike Apple and Microsoft, and developers can embed apps deeply within Android’s system. This week, a new service called AT&T Toggle was introduced. It lets users split an Android phone into personal and work environments, easily switching between the two. According to AT&T’s Glenn Lurie, the bring-your-own-device (BYOD) trend is unavoidable, and Toggle is a natural solution. Toggle is based on technology from Enterproid, a startup funded by Google Ventures and Qualcomm, which also plans to release an iPhone version. At the CTIA enterprise conference in San Diego, Enterproid’s solution was a hot topic among security-focused executives. LG’s approach, called 'dual persona,' leverages VMware’s virtualization technology to let employees access their office desktops from anywhere. Ki Kim of LG notes that Android’s focus on consumers has made data security a challenge until now. Currently, Samsung is not pursuing a dual-persona model, but its new Stratosphere phone for Verizon Wireless, released Thursday, targets business users with enhanced security features. Ryan Bidan, Samsung’s marketing executive and former RIM (BlackBerry) employee, says this marks a new focus for Samsung, shifting from exclusively consumer-oriented products to meeting the needs of chief information officers. While this 'split personality' approach is still gaining ground, security experts see it as a promising alternative to expecting employees to carry both a BlackBerry and a personal phone. Many companies still prefer BlackBerry for its strong encryption and server-based messaging, but outages, like the one this week, can cause significant disruptions. For RIM’s competitors, now may be the ideal time to attract business customers to more reliable and secure platforms.

Masana na cewa na’urorin da ke dauke da bayanan kasuwanci yakamata a kare su daga shiga hannun wasu. Wasu kamfanoni yanzu suna karfafa ma’aikata su raba aiki da sirrinsu. Duk da ra’ayin ma’aikata, shugabannin sashen bayanai na kamfanoni na so a daina amfani da waya guda wajen nishadi da kuma hada-hadar takardun muhimmi. Ba lallai don samun cikon aiki ba, sai don kauce wa matsalar kutse daga manhajoji masu haddasa barazana ga imel, fayiloli da lambobin sadarwa. Daya dogon mafita shi ne wayoyi da ke ba da damar raba bayanan aiki da na sirri. AT&T, LG, da kamfanonin farawa na gabatar da hanyoyinsu. Burinsu shi ne su sa kamfanoni su girka tsaro a wayar ma'aikata, yawanci a Android, mafi shahara daga cikin tsarin wayar zamani. Android ana ganin yana da rauni fiye da Apple da Microsoft saboda Google ba ya duba manhajoji kafin a saka su a kasuwarsa, haka kuma masu hadawa na iya lodawa cikin tsarin sosai. A wannan makon, an bullo da AT&T Toggle, wanda ke ba da daman raba waya ta Android tsakanin aiki da sirri, tare da saukin canjawa tsakanin su. Glenn Lurie na AT&T ya ce amfani da na’ura mafi inganci wajen aiki abu ne da ba za a kauce masa ba, kuma Toggle na bayar da kwarin gwiwa. Toggle ya samo asali ne daga fasahar Enterproid, wanda Google Ventures da Qualcomm suka saka musu jari, kuma suna shirin fitar da sigar iPhone. A taron CTIA a San Diego, mafitar Enterproid ta zama jigon tattaunawa tsakanin manyan masu kula da tsaro. Dabaran LG mai suna “dual persona” na amfani da fasahar VMware don bai wa ma’aikaci damar shiga kwamfutarsa ta ofis daga ko ina. Ki Kim na LG ya ce burin Android don kasuwa na kawo cikas ga tsaron bayanai har yanzu. Yanzu, Samsung ba ta bin tsarin dual-persona ba, amma sababbin wayoyinta Stratosphere don Verizon Wireless da aka saki a ranar Alhamis, na da sabbin tsare-tsaren tsaro ga kamfanoni. Ryan Bidan, jami’in tallan Samsung kuma tsohon ma'aikacin RIM, ya ce sabon salon ne ga Samsung don saukaka wa manyan masu kula da bayanai aiki. Duk da cewa tsarin 'raba hali' a waya bai zama ruwan dare ba tukuna, masana tsaro na kallon sa a matsayin mafita fiye da wajabta ma’aikata su rike BlackBerry da wata waya ta sirri. Manyan kamfanoni har yanzu na son BlackBerry saboda karfin tsaronsu, amma matsalar rashin aiki kamar yadda ya faru a wannan makon na haddasa cikas. Ga masu takara da RIM, yanzu ne lokaci da ya dace su samu sabbin kwastomomi da ke bukatar tsaro da ingantaccen sabis.

article_content: On the 15th anniversary of the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, Indian leaders, including Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal, paid tribute to the victims. In a message posted on X (formerly Twitter), Singh wrote, "My heartfelt tributes to the victims of the 26/11 Mumbai Terror Attacks. The nation will always remember the sacrifice of those security personnel who gave their lives in the line of duty." Kejriwal, in a Hindi post on X, honored those who lost their lives and expressed respect for the bravery of security forces who sacrificed themselves to save others. Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Priyanka Chaturvedi also paid tribute, stating, "26/11. Mumbai attacked by terrorists sponsored, aided by Pakistan. India still awaits justice. Never Forget. Tributes to all our heroes who bravely fought the fight. Remembering all the lives we lost on this day." The 2008 Mumbai terror attacks resulted in the deaths of 166 people, including six Americans. The attacks were carried out by ten well-trained terrorists from Pakistan, who laid siege to multiple locations in Mumbai for over 60 hours, targeting sites such as Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Hotel Taj, Trident Hotel, and Nariman House, a Jewish centre. Calls for justice and remembrance continue on this solemn anniversary.

Kasa za ta ci gaba da tunawa da jarumtar jami’an tsaro da suka sadaukar da rayukansu." Kejriwal a sakonsa na Hindi ya nuna girmamawa ga wadanda harin ya shafa da kuma yabawa jaruman da suka ba da rayukansu don ceton wasu. ‘Yar majalisar dokoki ta Shiv Sena (UBT), Priyanka Chaturvedi, ta kuma rubuta: "26/11. Mumbai ta gamu da harin ta’addanci daga wasu da Pakistan ta tallafa musu. Har yanzu India na jiran adalci. Kada a manta. Girmamawa ga jarumanmu da suka yi gwagwarmayar kare kasa. Muna tuna wadanda muka rasa a wannan rana." Harin ta’addanci na Mumbai a 2008 ya yi sanadin mutuwar mutane 166, ciki har da Amurkawa shida. Harin ya hada da ‘yan ta’adda goma daga Pakistan, wadanda suka mamaye wurare da dama a Mumbai har na fiye da awa 60, sun kai hari wadanda suka hada da Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Hotel Taj, Trident Hotel, da Nariman House, cibiyar Yahudawa. Har yanzu ana ci gaba da kira da neman adalci da kuma tunawa da wadanda aka rasa a wannan rana.

article_content: Bright Ekwebelem, the governorship candidate of the Social Democratic Party (SDP) in the upcoming November 11 election in Imo State, has pledged to restore peace if elected. Speaking to journalists in Owerri on Monday, Ekwebelem outlined his top priorities, which include security, peace and conflict resolution, agricultural revolution, employment, and industrialization. He emphasized his commitment to rescuing the state from ongoing insecurity, noting that no economy can thrive without safety. Ekwebelem stated that an SDP-led administration would make significant investments in security, manpower training, and job creation for the state's youth. He added that his government would engage negotiators to encourage non-state actors to disarm and support the state's plans for improved security. Ekwebelem called on the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to ensure a free and fair election and prevent voter disenfranchisement, expressing confidence in an SDP victory. He urged young people to participate actively in the election and vote for the SDP, highlighting plans to improve security, agriculture, employment, tourism, industrialization, education, health, peace, and conflict resolution.

article_content: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2 is currently under production, but reports of challenging working conditions at animation studio MAPPA have sparked concerns among fans about the season’s future. While several animators have publicly shared their frustrations online, there has been no official statement confirming a hiatus or cancellation. Recent episodes have showcased impressive fight scenes, though viewers noted that some were not fully completed before broadcast. It’s anticipated that the Blu-ray release will include improvements, as the broadcasted episode reportedly reflects only 30% of the intended final version. Despite the production challenges and ongoing discussions about workplace conditions, Jujutsu Kaisen remains one of the year’s most popular anime. Fans especially praise the adaptation of the Shibuya Arc and highlight Chapter 17 as a standout episode. Much of the season’s success is attributed to the dedication of MAPPA’s animators. With six episodes remaining, many viewers look forward to further quality and storytelling advancements. For streaming, Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2 is available on Crunchyroll. article_content: Sandra McElroy, aged 45 and residing in St. Louis, was revealed as 'Witness 40' in the Ferguson case involving Michael Brown’s death. She testified before a Missouri grand jury in support of Officer Darren Wilson, stating she saw Brown charge at the officer 'like a football player.' Her trustworthiness was questioned after prosecutors and reporters uncovered her history of making false police reports, being diagnosed with bipolar disorder since her teens, and posting racist content online. McElroy also had a criminal history involving felony bad checks. She did not immediately report being a witness; instead, McElroy contacted authorities roughly four weeks after the incident, after widespread media reports. Her story closely resembled Wilson’s, but she later confessed to including information she learned from media coverage. McElroy’s explanations for being in Ferguson on the day changed multiple times. At first, she said she was visiting a classmate; later, she claimed she was there to better understand Black residents. Notes she presented from that day also contained racially insulting language. Despite all these issues, McElroy still testified to the grand jury, repeating claims that Brown had charged at Wilson. However, doubts about her presence at the scene and inconsistencies in her story led prosecutors to reject her testimony as invented and untrustworthy.

An fara shakkar gaskiyar shaidar McElroy bayan lauyoyi da masu bincike sun gano tana da tarihin bayar da bayanan ƙarya ga ’yan sanda, tana da larurar kwakwalwa tun tana yarinya, kuma tana wallafa kalaman wariya akan kafafen sada zumunta. Sannan tana da laifi kan takardun kudi na bogi. Ba ta yi hanzarin gaya wa ’yan sanda cewar ta ga lamarin ba; sai bayan makonni huɗu bayan faruwar shi, bayan ta karanta rahotanni da dama akan lamarin. Labarinta ya dace da na Wilson, amma daga baya ta yarda ta ƙara bayanan da ta samu daga yanar gizo. Hanyarta ta bayyana dalilin kasancewa a Ferguson tana sauyawa. Da farko, ta ce tana son ziyartar abokiyar makaranta, daga baya kuma ta ce tana kokarin fahimtar al’ummar bakar fata. Bayaninta a buga da kalaman wariya a cikin takardu da ta ce ta rubuta ranar. Duk da wadannan matsalolin, McElroy ta ci gaba da ba da shaida a kotu, tana nacewa Brown ya caji jami’in. Amma rashin tabbas game da kasancewarta wurin da rashin daidaito a labarinta ya sa lauyoyi suka watsar da shaidarta suna ganin ba gaskiya bace.

article_content: Antony De Malmanche, a 52-year-old New Zealander, faces the death penalty in Bali after allegedly smuggling 1.7 kilograms of crystal methamphetamine into Indonesia. De Malmanche claims he was deceived by a dating scam, stating he traveled to China, Hong Kong, and eventually Bali to meet a woman named 'Jessie' whom he met online. He says he had no knowledge of carrying drugs and believed he was traveling for personal reasons. Authorities arrested De Malmanche at Denpasar's Ngurah Rai International Airport after customs officers found him acting suspiciously while collecting his luggage. An X-ray scan of his green backpack revealed a package wrapped in clear plastic, red plastic, and brown duct tape containing 1,709 grams of methamphetamine, confirmed by a narcotics test. De Malmanche, reportedly a welfare recipient, told Indonesian authorities that he was given 'shopping money' for the trip. His friends in New Zealand, including Christine Thomas, set up an online legal fund to help with his defense, expressing concern about the harsh penalties he faces and appealing for support to bring him home. As of now, nearly $8,000 has been donated. Indonesian police officials, however, suspect De Malmanche may have played a larger role than a simple courier, though details of the smuggling plan remain unclear. Joni Lai, deputy of Bali Provincial Police Drugs Squad, stated the operation was controlled externally, and De Malmanche only admitted to receiving travel money. De Malmanche has been charged under Indonesian narcotics law, which carries a maximum penalty of death and a possible fine of one billion rupiah (about $A97,037). The New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade is aware of the case but has not been contacted for consular assistance.

De Malmanche ya ce an yaudare shi ta hanyar damfara ta yanar gizo, inda ya ce ya tafi China, Hong Kong, daga nan sai Bali don ya gana da wata mace mai suna 'Jessie' da ya hadu da ita ta intanet. Sunyi amfani da X-ray a jakarsa kore suka gano kunshin da aka nade da plastik mai gani, plastik ja, da duct tape ruwan kasa wanda ke dauke da gram 1,709 na methamphetamine, gwajin kwaya ya tabbatar da hakan. Zuwa yanzu, kusan $8,000 ne aka tara. Joni Lai, mataimakin shugaban sashin kwayoyi na 'yan sanda a Bali, ya ce an shigo da maganin ne daga waje, kuma De Malmanche ya amsa cewa an ba shi kudi na tafiya kawai. An tuhume De Malmanche bisa dokar kwayoyi ta Indonesia, wadda ke da hukuncin kisa da tara har zuwa biliyan daya rupiah (kimanin $A97,037). Ma'aikatar Harkokin Wajen New Zealand ta ce tana sane da lamarin, amma babu wanda ya tuntube ta don neman taimako zuwa yanzu.

article_content: Dani Alves, the Barcelona defender, is preparing to find a new club after Barcelona declined to extend his contract. With his deal set to end after this season, the Brazilian is now eligible to negotiate a free transfer with clubs outside Spain. According to Alves' agent, Dinorah Santana, Barcelona's silence on a contract renewal signals that the 31-year-old's tenure at the Nou Camp is coming to an end. During Barcelona Fashion Week, Alves appeared in front of the cameras, as speculation grows about his future. Santana told Spanish radio station Cadena SER, 'We haven't heard from the club. That likely means they do not want Dani Alves with them anymore, so we're beginning the search for his next team.' Alves has featured in 16 La Liga games and five Champions League matches this season but appears to be out of favor under coach Luis Enrique. Manchester United has shown interest in acquiring Alves, who originally joined Barcelona from Sevilla in 2008 for £23 million. Images show Alves in action against Villarreal and Atletico Madrid's Saul Niguez during a Copa del Rey fixture at the Vicente Calderon. Santana added, 'We won't wait around for Barcelona to decide. Alves has always acted professionally in his seven years here. With the sporting director role vacant at the club for a month, Alves is within his rights to negotiate with other teams.' (The former director of football, Andoni Zubizarreta, provided no guidance regarding Alves' status.)

Alves ya buga wasanni 16 a La Liga da wasu biyar a Champions League a wannan kakar, amma yana kallon baya ga kocinsu Luis Enrique. article_content: Bed bugs have been on the rise across Europe, prompting widespread concern. Bites typically cause itching, but the psychological effects can be more severe, with some people experiencing anxiety, insomnia, or persistent memories after an infestation. Remarkably, even just thinking or reading about bed bugs can induce itching for many—regardless of actual exposure. Dr. Heather Sequeira, a psychologist specializing in anxiety, explains this is due to the mind-body connection: the brain can associate thoughts or images with physical sensations, leading to itchiness when imagining bed bugs. This is called psychogenic itching, which has no physical cause. Dr. Sequeira says those most fearful or disgusted by the pests are more prone to these symptoms, especially when stressed or anxious. She emphasizes this reaction is normal—our bodies stay on alert for possible threats. Increased news coverage, particularly from infestations in cities like Paris and a library’s closure in west London, has raised public awareness and heightened fears. Dr. Sequeira observes more patients are reporting anxiety related to bed bugs, likely due to the intensified media attention. Dr. Angharad Rudkin, a psychologist focused on anxiety, notes that widespread news of outbreaks can validate people’s fear, making the threat seem more imminent. Dr. Rudkin adds that while mild itching is common when learning about bed bugs, individuals with anxiety disorders or high stress are more affected. The idea of the bedroom—a traditionally safe space—being threatened is particularly distressing. This reaction may be rooted in evolutionary survival instincts, making us more aware of hazards. Dr. Abigael San, a cognitive therapist, explains that mental images of bed bugs can provoke real physical responses. For some, merely picturing bugs can cause strong sensations and fear, because the parts of the brain tied to threat response are activated as if the bugs were truly present. She recounts working with a patient traumatized by bed bugs, highlighting that the distress was linked as much to the emotions around the experience as to the infestation itself. The BBC welcomes readers to share how bed bugs have impacted them.
