article_content: Stuart Lancaster, head coach of England’s rugby team, has chosen not to include Danny Cipriani in the squad for the autumn internationals. This decision sparked criticism from Steve Diamond, the director of rugby at Sale Sharks. Diamond questioned the choice of Northampton’s Stephen Myler as the third fly-half, calling it overly cautious and arguing Cipriani faces higher standards than other players. Diamond, who recruited Cipriani from the Melbourne Rebels nearly three years ago, stated, 'Danny always seems to have more to prove than others.' Although Cipriani has shown steady performances and has worked hard to rehabilitate his career, he was not selected. Diamond went so far as to suggest that Cipriani would have been included had he played for Northampton. Apart from Cipriani, Chris Ashton of Saracens and Freddie Burns of Leicester were also left out of Lancaster’s 33-man squad for the QBE Series. Lancaster defended his approach, saying that every position is judged with consistent criteria, regardless of which club a player represents. He credited Myler with consistently strong performances, and explained that Cipriani and Burns have been told that all aspects of their play matter. The England roster for the QBE Series features frontline forwards like Joe Marler (Harlequins), Matt Mullan (Wasps), and Billy Vunipola (Saracens), as well as backs including Danny Care (Harlequins), Owen Farrell (Saracens), and George Ford (Bath). Myler’s inclusion over Cipriani is seen as a risk-averse decision. Meanwhile, Ford continues to stand out for Bath, despite the team’s recent loss to Glasgow.

article_content: Fredrik Nilsson serves as Vice President of the Americas for Axis Communications, overseeing company operations across North and South America. Once technology is released, it can be challenging to control its use. However, businesses have a duty to diligently ensure their products are not used for unethical purposes. In industries such as security and surveillance, the stakes are especially high—partners with a record of abusing technology should be avoided. No business leader wants to discover that their devices have ended up with malicious actors, whether nearby or abroad. Operating responsibly can be difficult, particularly as society tackles the ethical implications of advanced AI systems, but it usually leads to long-term benefits. Trust is central to all business relationships, and a reputation for responsible behavior helps organizations secure valuable partnerships. Ethical considerations are increasingly part of modern AI legislation, reinforcing the need for responsible actions across industries. As a result, ethics cannot merely be a slogan—it must be a top priority. Governments globally have clarified many major ethical boundaries. Regulations and sanctions not only highlight national security threats but also address human rights abuses by organizations and governments. International human rights laws are strict, and compliance is both ethically and commercially sound. Navigating gray areas like data privacy can be complex, but regulations such as the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California’s Consumer Privacy Act (CPRA) have provided clearer guidelines. In the US, the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) strictly prohibits using components from certain countries considered security risks. It's critical to distinguish between 'unethical' and 'illegal.' Working with unethical companies or governments may be legal, but it can badly damage public image and future business opportunities. Companies must carefully choose their partners and monitor product usage. Training for integrators, end users, and other stakeholders helps prevent misuse and encourages proper support. Both the partners a business selects and its engagement with them are important. With the rapid rise of AI, ethics is in the spotlight. As businesses access powerful tools like machine learning and deep learning, the responsibility to deploy them fairly and safely increases. In security, for example, deep learning improves facial recognition and license plate capture, but systems must be designed to avoid bias and protect privacy. Broadly, companies face challenges with emerging technology like generative AI and must use them ethically. Governments are offering new guidance: the EU's AI Act, the world's first comprehensive AI law, defines 'unacceptable risk' in AI and imposes rules about transparency and data use. The US is also addressing AI regulation, with President Biden’s executive order aiming to ensure AI is safe and equitable. Engaging with AI ethically helps companies maintain positive reputations and adhere to evolving rules. Manufacturers, integrators, resellers, and partners all have a role in preventing misuse, especially as AI becomes more common. Businesses need to comply with regulatory frameworks and implement strong controls, including cybersecurity measures, to prevent unauthorized access. An ethical reputation boosts business growth and trust with customers. Being known for responsible conduct provides direct benefits and creates lasting value.

Idan an fito da sabuwar fasaha, yana da wahala a dakile yadda mutane za su yi amfani da ita. Duk da haka, kamfanoni suna da nauyi na tabbatar da kayayyakinsu ba a amfani da su domin aikata munanan ayyuka. A bangaren tsaro da sa ido, wannan al’amari yana da muhimmanci sosai—dole ne a guje wa abokan hulda da suka saba amfani da fasaha ta hanyar rashin da’a. Babu wani shugaba da zai so jin cewa kayansa sun fada hannun masu laifi, ko kusa ko nesa. Aiki da gaskiya ba shi da sauki musamman yanzu da duniya ke kokarin daidaita da sabbin fasahohin AI, amma hakan yana da amfani a dogon lokaci. Amana tana da muhimmanci a kowanne dangantakar kasuwanci, kuma samun suna na gaskiya zai taimaka samun abokan hulda. Ka’idojin ladabi suna kara shiga cikin doka ta AI, don haka bin ladabi bai kamata ya zama magana kawai ba—tilas ne ya zama aiki na farko. Gwamnatoci a duniya sun samar da ka’idoji masu karfi. Dokoki da takunkumi suna nuna ba kawai barazanar tsaro ba, har da ta’azzarar hakkin dan adam daga wasu kamfanoni ko gwamnatoci. Batutuwa irin su sirrin bayanai na iya zama masu sarkakiya, amma dokokin GDPR na Turai da CPRA na California sun kawo haske. A Amurka, NDAA ya hana amfani da wasu kayayyaki daga kasashen da ke da barazanar tsaro. Yana da muhimmanci a bambanta tsakanin abin da bai dace ba da wanda ke da sabawa doka. Yin hulda da kamfanoni ko gwamnatoci marasa gaskiya yana iya zama daidai da doka, amma zai lalata martaba da damar kasuwanci. Duka nau’in abokan hulda da yadda ake hulda da su na da muhimmanci. Sabon ci gaban AI ya sanya ladabi a idon jama’a. Yayin da kasuwanci ke amfani da sabbin fasahohi kamar machine learning da deep learning, nauyin yin amfani da su lafiya kuma ba tare da wariya ba ya karu. A fannin tsaro, deep learning na inganta gano fuska da lambar lasisin mota, amma dole a tabbatar tsarin bai nuna bambanci ko tauye sirri ba. Gaba ɗaya kamfanoni suna fuskantar ƙalubale tare da sabbin kayan AI kuma dole su kasance masu bin ka’ida. Gwamnatoci suna ba da sabbin jagorori: dokar AI ta EU ta bayyana abin da ke da “babban hadari” kuma ta sanya dokoki game da gaskiya da amfani da bayanai. Amurka ma tana ƙoƙarin dokar AI, inda shugaba Biden ya sanya hannu a umarni don tabbatar da AI mai lafiya da adalci. Yin amfani da AI daidai zai kuma taimakawa kamfanoni wajen kauce wa laifi da kiyaye suna mai kyau. Masu kera kayayyaki, masu shigar da su, masu sayarwa da abokan hulɗa dukkansu na da matsayi wajen hana amfani ba daidai ba—musamman yayin da AI ke yawaita. Kamfanoni su tabbata suna bin doka kuma suna ɗaukar matakai masu ƙarfi, ciki har da tsarin tsaron kwamfuta don hana masu laifi samu nasara. Kyakkyawan suna na gaskiya da ladabi na kara ci gaban kasuwanci da karfafa amana daga kwastomomi. Suna na gaskiya zai ba kamfani fa’ida da ci gaba mai dorewa.

article_content: By Leesa Smith. The first high-definition images of the Australian submarine AE2, which was lost over 99 years ago at the bottom of the Sea of Marmara in Turkey, have been captured using advanced cameras and lighting. A remotely operated camera deployed 73 metres below the surface revealed that the submarine is in surprisingly good condition after having been sunk by gunfire from the Ottoman torpedo boat Sultanhisar on 30 April 1915. The wreck was discovered by a Turkish maritime archaeologist in 1996. Since then, a joint Australian and Turkish initiative was launched to document the site carefully, with the process finally completed last month. The hatch of the AE2 was opened for the first time in 99 years to reveal its well-preserved state, despite its long submersion. Divers confirmed the wreck site in 1998 before the Silent ANZAC project began, involving Australian submariners, scientists from the Defence Science and Technology Organisation, and US remotely operated vehicle designers, SeaBotix. Rear Admiral Peter Briggs, leader of the project and Chair of the AE2 Commemorative Foundation, said the camera captured the entire length of the submarine, including its hydroplanes, rudder, and propellers. He reported that the interior was in remarkable condition, with original paint, a signalman’s shoes stowed in the flag locker in the conning tower alongside flags, and what is believed to be the battle ensign used by Lieutenant Commander Henry ‘Dacre’ Stoker, DSO, in 1915. A major find was a portable Wireless Telegraph pole and antenna wire, the subject of historical debate. Rear Admiral Briggs suggested this telegraph likely sent the message that AE2 had torpedoed an Ottoman gunboat at Çanakkale. Rear Admiral Briggs described the process as challenging, with the team practising in 12 metres of water in Corio Bay, Geelong, and later in Turkey. A wet diving bell transported divers to the seabed, taking four hours per descent and allowing just 20 minutes of work before resurfacing. The team built a mock-up of the conning tower to practise procedures, then performed dives over 10 days, losing a day to bad weather. Four buoys were used to precisely position the ship for work at different locations on the wreck. The project produced detailed high-definition footage and documentation, preserving the underwater site. Since 1998, Australian and Turkish teams have worked together to examine the wreck without disturbing it, achieving their aim last month. His Majesty's Australian Submarine AE2, built at Vickers Ltd, Barrow-in-Furness, England, was launched on 18 June 1913 and commissioned at Portsmouth on 28 February 1914 under Lieutenant Commander Henry Hugh Gordon 'Dacre' Stoker, RN. AE2 was the first Allied submarine to enter the Dardanelles at 2:30 am on 25 April 1915, as the Gallipoli Campaign began and ANZAC soldiers landed at Anzac Cove. After five days of action, AE2 was hit by Turkish gunfire, disabled, and scuttled. All crew survived and were rescued by the Sultanhisar crew before the submarine sank. The AE2 lay undiscovered until 1998, when it was found intact in 73 metres of water in the Sea of Marmara.

Na'urar daukar hoto mai sarrafa nesa da aka saukar a zurfin mita 73 ta nuna cewa jirgin har yanzu yana cikin koshin lafiya sosai, duk da mummunan harbin da jirgin yakin Ottoman Sultanhisar ya yi masa ranar 30 ga Afrilu, 1915. An gano jirgin tun 1996 daga wani masanin tarihi na ruwa daga Turkiyya. Daga nan aka kafa hadin gwiwa tsakanin Australia da Turkiyya domin tattara bayanai kan wurin ba tare da bata wurin ba, kuma wannan aiki an kammala shi a watan da ya gabata. An bude kogon AE2 karo na farko cikin shekaru 99 don tabbatar da irin koshin lafiyar da take ciki, duk da tsawon lokaci tana cikin ruwa. Masu nutso sun tabbatar da wurin a 1998 kafin fara aikin Silent ANZAC, wanda ya hada da masu jirgin ruwa daga Australia, masana kimiyya daga Defence Science and Technology Organisation, da kuma masu kirkirar na’urar ruwa daga Amurka, SeaBotix. Rear Admiral Peter Briggs, shugaban aikin kuma shugaban AE2 Commemorative Foundation, ya bayyana cewa na'urar hoto ta nuna duka tsawon jirgin, har da hydroplanes, rudder, da propeller dinsa. Ya tabbatar da cewa cikin jirgin ya samu koshin lafiya sosai, da fenti na asali, takalman signalman da ke cikin akwati na tutoci a conning tower, da kuma abin da ake zaton tutar yaki da Lieutenant Commander Henry 'Dacre' Stoker, DSO, ya yi amfani da ita a 1915. Babban abin da aka samo shi ne sandar sada zumunta ta Wireless Telegraph da wayar antena, wanda ya dade yana janyo cece-kuce tsakanin masana tarihi. Rear Admiral Briggs ya bayyana cewa wannan telegraph na iya zama ta aika sako cewa AE2 ta lalata jirgin Ottoman a Çanakkale. Rear Admiral Briggs ya ce aikin ya kasance cike da kalubale, inda tawagar ta fara atisaye a mita 12 a Corio Bay, Geelong, kafin sake atisaye tare da tawagar nutso daga Turkiyya. Aiki da wet diving bell ya kai masu nutso kasan teku, inda kowane saukowa ke daukar awa hudu amma masu aiki na mintuna 20 ne kafin komawa sama. Buoya hudu aka yi amfani da su wajen daidaita jirgin domin aiwatar da aiki a wurare daban-daban na jirgin. Aikin ya samar da bayanai masu inganci da hotuna na zamani, inda aka kiyaye wurin sosai. Tun daga 1998 kungiyar Australia da Turkiyya na aiki tare wajen nazarin jirgin ba tare da bata wurin ba, kuma sun cimma nasara a watan da ya gabata. His Majesty's Australian Submarine AE2 da aka kera a Vickers Ltd, Barrow-in-Furness, Ingila, an kaddamar da shi ranar 18 ga Yuni 1913, an kuma fara aiki da shi a Portsmouth ranar 28 ga Fabrairu 1914 karkashin Lieutenant Commander Henry Hugh Gordon 'Dacre' Stoker, RN. AE2 ne jirgin Allied na farko da ya shiga mashigin Dardanelles da misalin karfe 2:30 na safe ranar 25 ga Afrilu 1915, yayin farawa yakin Gallipoli da sojojin ANZAC suka sauka a Anzac Cove. Bayan kwana biyar, AE2 ta samu rauni saboda harbin Turkiyya, aka lalata ta. Dukkan ma’aikata sun tsira inda jami'an Sultanhisar suka ceto su kafin jirgin ya nutse a kasa. Jirgin AE2 ya kasance a boye har zuwa 1998 lokacin da aka gano shi, yana cikin koshin lafiya a mita 73 a Tekun Marmara.

article_content: Former Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger unveiled his official portrait at the California State Capitol on Monday. The large, photorealistic painting depicts Schwarzenegger standing before the official California seal. However, observers noticed a distinct splotch on the left lapel of his jacket. This blemish is reportedly where a lapel pin featuring a portrait of his then-wife, Maria Shriver, was hastily removed. When Schwarzenegger sat for the painting in 2003, he wore the pin, but it appears to have been scrubbed off before the unveiling. The unveiling took place nearly four years after Schwarzenegger left office and three years after his separation from Maria Shriver. Capitol staff and guests commented on the 'amateurish' quality of the alteration, with tour guide Richard Granis describing the mark as 'softball sized.' The timing of the pin’s removal is unclear, but the portrait was revealed shortly after media reports surfaced about Shriver’s alleged infidelity with Schwarzenegger's political strategist. Austrian artist Gottfried Helnwein, known for painting Andy Warhol and John F. Kennedy, created the oversized portrait. The artwork, which is larger than those of other modern governors, was funded by Schwarzenegger himself. At the ceremony, Schwarzenegger reflected on his journey from Austria to California, calling the state a place 'where nothing is impossible.' He joked that he might have pictured a sculpture at Muscle Beach rather than a formal portrait in the Capitol. Two of his five children, Christopher and Patrick, attended the event, along with political figures such as Willie Brown, Bob Hertzberg, Fabian Nunez, Lt. Governor Gavin Newsom, and Senate President Pro Tem Darrell Steinberg. Schwarzenegger also greeted John Masterson, a former mailroom employee with Down syndrome. The portrait unveiling followed a climate symposium hosted by the Schwarzenegger Institute at the University of Southern California, featuring Governor Jerry Brown. The event highlighted California's efforts to reduce carbon emissions, referencing Schwarzenegger’s pivotal role in passing the 2006 AB32 climate law. Brown praised his predecessor’s leadership on climate policy, saying, 'To get AB32 through the Legislature was heavy lifting, and I don’t think anyone should underestimate that.' Schwarzenegger emphasized bipartisan action on climate change, and the event was aimed at encouraging further policy progress ahead of upcoming United Nations climate conferences. During his governorship, Schwarzenegger promoted fiscal responsibility amid budget deficits and signed the landmark global-warming law. In his final days in office, he commuted the sentence of the son of political ally Fabian Nunez. After leaving office, revelations emerged about Schwarzenegger’s affair with his household staffer, which led to a son being born out of wedlock and contributed to his separation from Maria Shriver. Reports have also linked Shriver with longtime political aide Matthew Dowd.
translated_content: Tsohon Gwamna Arnold Schwarzenegger ya fito da hotonsa na hukuma a Majalisar Dokokin Jihar California ranar Litinin. Babban hoto mai kama da hoto na gaske ya nuna Schwarzenegger a gaban tambarin jihar. Duk da haka, wasu sun lura da wani tabo a gefen hagu na jaket dinsa. Ana ganin wannan tabon daga inda aka cire dan kunne mai dauke da hoton tsohuwar matarsa, Maria Shriver, a gaggauce. Lokacin da aka zana hoton a 2003, yana da dantse a jaket dinsa, amma an ce an cire shi kafin bikin nuna hoton. Nunin hoton ya faru kusan shekaru hudu bayan Schwarzenegger ya bar gwamnati da shekaru uku bayan rabuwarsa da Maria Shriver. Ma'aikatan majalisa da baƙi sun ce aikin gyaran tabon bai yi kyau ba, inda Richard Granis, jagoran yawon shakatawa, ya kwatanta gurbin da 'kamar kwallon sofbol.' Ba a san daidai lokacin da aka cire dan kunnen ba, amma an kaddamar da hoton ne bayan rahotanni sun bayyana cewa ana zargin Maria Shriver da kusanci da wani mai taimakawa Schwarzenegger a siyasa. Mai zane daga Austria, Gottfried Helnwein, wanda ya taba zana Andy Warhol da John F. Kennedy, shi ne ya zana hoton. Wannan hoton ya fi na sauran gwamnonin zamani girma, kuma Schwarzenegger ne ya biya kudinsa. A wajen taron, Schwarzenegger ya bayyana yadda ya bar Austria zuwa California, yana cewa jihar wurin ne da 'babu abin da bai yiwu ba.' Ya yi barkwanci cewa zai fi zaton an yi masa gumaka a Muscle Beach maimakon a zana masa hoto a Majalisar Dokoki. Daga cikin 'ya'yansa biyar, Christopher da Patrick ne suka halarci taron, tare da fitattun 'yan siyasa kamar Willie Brown, Bob Hertzberg, Fabian Nunez, mataimakin gwamna Gavin Newsom, da shugaban majalisar Darrell Steinberg. Schwarzenegger ya kuma gaishe da John Masterson, tsohon ma'aikacin ofishin wasiku mai fama da cutar Down syndrome. Bayan nunin hoton, cibiyar Schwarzenegger da ke Jami'ar Southern California ta shirya taron tattaunawa kan sauyin yanayi wanda Gwamna Jerry Brown ya halarta. An tattauna yadda California ke kokari rage hayakin karbon, tare da ambaton rawar Schwarzenegger wajen samar da dokar AB32 ta 2006. Brown ya yabawa Schwarzenegger saboda kokarinsa wajen samar da dokar, yana cewa 'Kawo AB32 a majalisa aiki ne mai wahala.' Schwarzenegger ya nuna mahimmancin hadin kai a fannin kare muhalli, kuma taron na nufin karfafa mataki kafin taron Majalisar Dinkin Duniya. A shekarun gwamnatinsa, Schwarzenegger ya so tabbatar da daidaito a kasafin kudi duk da matsalolin dake tattare da komawa daga gwamnati, ya kuma rattaba hannu kan dokar sauyin yanayi. A karshe kafin ya bar ofis, ya sassauta hukuncin danta na abokin siyasa Fabian Nunez. Bayan ya bar ofis, an bayyana cewa Schwarzenegger ya haifi da namiji da wata mai aiki a gidansa, abin da ya sa alaƙarsa da Maria Shriver ta mutu. Hakanan, rahotanni sun bayyana cewa Shriver ta yi hulda da Matthew Dowd, tsohon mai taimakawa mata a harkokin siyasa.

article_content: Residents and traders in Agunloye market, Ado-Odo Ota LGA, Ogun State, face severe challenges from an expanding refuse dump at the community’s center. The issue started as a minor pile and has now grown due to poor waste management, lack of awareness, and weak regulation. The refuse dump exposes residents—especially children and market traders—to health risks, including cholera. Ogun State has reported over twenty deaths from the disease, linked to poor sanitation. Traders like Musa, Mrs. Risikat Obe, Martin Owusu, and Elder Jimoh Ojugbele recount daily struggles with the odour and fear of sickness. The stench has harmed business and health, and some traders use makeshift barriers for protection. Nearby schools, such as Alamuwa Grammar School and Olaiya Primary School, are also affected. Students are regularly exposed to the dump, and efforts like burning the waste have not been sufficient. Headmaster Adesina Yahya urges immediate action. Studies confirm improper waste disposal increases disease outbreaks like cholera, especially in the rainy season. Dumps become breeding grounds for disease vectors, raising risks of malaria and diarrhoea. Experts, including Dr. Hassan Sanuth and Professor Tanimola Akande, confirm that open dumping pollutes air, land, and water. Toxic leachate contaminates wells and rivers, and burning degrades air quality. Community leaders such as Batunde Bakare, Mrs. Amoleogun, Adeyinka Adelaja, and Shafar Asade have appealed repeatedly to local authorities, but say responses have been limited by broken evacuation vehicles and unresponsive officials. Environment Commissioner Ola Oresanya acknowledges the issue and says the government plans to provide large waste containers to markets and improve waste disposal, especially in rural areas. Experts recommend public awareness campaigns, better waste management, regular removal, community cooperation with health officers, sanctions for improper disposal, and encouragement of recycling and waste-to-wealth initiatives. Proper solid waste management is essential for the health, environmental sustainability, and economic well-being of the community.
translated_content: Mazauna da ‘yan kasuwa a kasuwar Agunloye, Karamar Hukumar Ado-Odo Ota, Jihar Ogun, na fuskantar tsanani daga karuwar tarin shara a tsakiyar gari. Matsalar ta fara ne da dan karamin tarin shara, amma yanzu ta zama babba saboda matsalolin kula da shara, rashin wayar da kai da kuma raunin dokoki. Wannan tarin shara na jefa mazauna — musamman yara da ‘yan kasuwa — cikin hadarin kamuwa da cututtuka da suka hada da kwalara. Kimanin mutane ashirin sun mutu a jihar Ogun saboda cutar da ke da alaka da rashin tsafta. ‘Yan kasuwa irinsu Musa, Hajiya Risikat Obe, Martin Owusu, da Elder Jimoh Ojugbele sun bayyana yadda suke fama da warin shara da tsoron rashin lafiya kullum. Warin ya janyo cikas a kasuwanci da jin dadi, wasu ma na amfani da katanga domin kariya. Makarantu da ke kusa, kamar Alamuwa Grammar School da Olaiya Primary School, suma matsalar shara ta shafe su; dalibai na fuskantar shara akai-akai. Duk da kokarin kona shara domin rage wari, Shugaban makarantar Olaiya, Adesina Yahya, yana rokon a dauki mataki nan take. Binciken masana ya nuna rashin kula da shara yana karawa yawan barkewar cututtuka irin su kwalara, musamman lokacin damina. Taron shara na zama wurin haihuwar sauro da beraye, masu yada malaria da gudawa. Masana irin su Dr. Hassan Sanuth da Farfesa Tanimola Akande sun bayyana cewa zubar da shara a fili na gurbata iska, kasa da ruwa. Ruwa daga shara na shiga rijiyoyi da koguna, baita, sannan kona shara na dagula iskar muhalli. Shugabannin al’umma irinsu Batunde Bakare, Hajiya Amoleogun, Adeyinka Adelaja, da Shafar Asade sun sha kiran gwamnati amma ba’a samu dauki sosai ba saboda matsalar motoci da rashin mayar da martani. Kwamishinan Muhalli, Ola Oresanya ya tabbatar da matsalar kuma yace gwamnati za ta raba manyan kwantena na shara a kasuwanni da inganta kwashe shara, musamman a yankunan karkara. Masana sun ba da shawarar ci gaba da wayar da kai, gyara dabarun zubar da shara, kwashe shara akai-akai, hadin kai da jami'an lafiya, hukunta masu zubar da shara ba bisa ka'ida ba, da kuma karfafa gyaran shara da shirin sarrafa shara zuwa arziki. Ingantaccen tsarin kula da shara na da matukar mahimmanci don tabbatar da lafiya, dorewar muhalli da ci gaban tattalin arzikin al’umma.

article_content: NBC's 'The Voice' premiered its seventh season Monday night, introducing Gwen Stefani and Pharrell Williams as its newest judges. Longtime judges Adam Levine and Blake Shelton welcomed the new additions, while previous judges like Christina Aguilera, CeeLo Green, Usher, and Shakira have rotated through the panel in earlier seasons. The competition continues its format where four judges select contestants through blind auditions, forming teams of talented singers. Gwen Stefani, known for her success both as a band member and solo artist, as well as her work in fashion and beauty, attracted Taylor John Williams—whose version of 'Heartless' impressed both her and Levine—and Bryana Salaz, notable for singing 'Problem.' Pharrell Williams, recognized for his production skills, brought standout performers Luke Wade and Elyjuh Rene onto his team. Adam Levine recruited Clara Hong and Damien, a Transportation Security Administration employee whose rendition of 'It's So Hard to Say Goodbye to Yesterday' turned the chairs of all four judges. Blake Shelton added returning contestant Allison Bray and singer James David Carter—whose performance of 'Nobody Knows' was highly praised—to his team. Overall, Stefani and Williams made a strong debut as coaches, marking a lively start to the new season of 'The Voice.'

article_content: The Duke and Duchess of Cambridge's first child—a future heir to the British throne—will be welcomed with a royal announcement steeped in tradition. As was done for Prince William's birth, a proclamation signed by the attending doctors will be swiftly delivered from the hospital ward and displayed on an easel at the gates of Buckingham Palace within minutes of the birth. Kate Middleton, aged 31, has opted for the Lindo Wing at St Mary’s Hospital, just as Princess Diana did. Her private suite is expected to cost up to £10,000. This echoes the birth of Prince William, when a sign announcing his arrival was placed by Buckingham Palace on June 22, 1982. The very same easel and format will be used for this occasion. Prince William, now 30, was the first future monarch to be born in a hospital. His brother, Prince Harry, followed two years later. Although both Buckingham Palace and Clarence House have active Twitter accounts for disseminating royal news, the birth announcement will not appear first on social media. Instead, a formal notice—on cream-colored A4 Buckingham Palace letterhead and signed by the medical staff—will be transported from the Lindo Wing’s front entrance by a press officer, driven through London with a police escort, and taken to the Privy Purse Door at Buckingham Palace. There, the proclamation will be placed on the traditional easel in the palace forecourt, signaling to the public that a new royal baby has been born. A Palace spokesperson stated: 'We wanted to retain some of the theatre of the notice. It is important to us that this is done properly and with the dignity the event demands. This is the birth of a child in line to the throne; it is a rare and historic occasion.' 'It will not be announced first on Twitter, though it will appear there subsequently.' Simultaneously, Kensington Palace plans to send an electronic press release with further details, such as the baby's weight. For Prince William’s birth, information shared included his blue eyes and the fact that he cried lustily. If the baby arrives between 10:30 pm and 8 am, a press release will be issued at the time, with the easel announcement following at around 9 am. An aide explained, 'If the baby is born late at night, we would still put the notice up the next morning.' The birth will only be made public once the Queen and senior royals have been informed, as well as the Middleton family if they are not at the hospital. William himself is expected to call the Queen before anyone else, depending on the timing. 'Efforts will be made to contact the Queen soon after, and other royal family members will be told as soon as possible,' a palace source added. There are hopes that William will make a brief statement outside the hospital following the announcement, as may the Middletons, though details are yet to be finalized. 'While this is a personal and private event, the Duke and Duchess know it is a time of national celebration and acknowledge the public’s interest,' said a spokesman. Palace officials will also publicly confirm when the Duchess enters labor, shortly after she is admitted to hospital and seen by doctors. While maintaining Kate’s dignity is important, officials note that social media makes secrecy nearly impossible unless she arrives discreetly. The Queen’s Surgeon-Gynaecologist, Marcus Setchell, will lead the medical team, assisted by Alan Farthing—a consultant gynecologist at St Mary’s. Contingency plans with other hospitals, such as Royal Berkshire Hospital in Reading, have been arranged in case the Duchess begins labor while visiting her parents.
translated_content: Yaron farko na Duke da Duchess na Cambridge—mai jiran gado ga karagar mulki—za a sanar da haihuwarsa tare da cikakken bin al'ada. Kamar yadda aka yi lokacin haihuwar Prince William, za a dauko sanarwa da likitocin da suka karbi haihuwar suka sa hannu, a kawo daga asibitin cikin sauri, sannan a saka akan dutse a kofar Buckingham Palace bayan 'yan mintuna. Kate Middleton, mai shekaru 31, ta zabi Lindo Wing a St Mary's Hospital kamar yadda Princess Diana ta yi. Ana sa ran kudin dakinta mai zaman kansa zai kai har £10,000. Wannan kamar zai maimaita yadda aka sanar da haihuwar Prince William ranar 22 ga Yuni, 1982, inda aka saka sanarwa a Buckingham Palace. Za a amfani da wannan dutse da fasalin sanarwa a wannan lokaci. Prince William, yanzu mai shekaru 30, shine na farko mai jiran gado da aka haifa a asibiti. Dan uwansa Prince Harry, ya biyo bayan shekaru biyu. Duk da cewa Buckingham Palace da Clarence House suna da Twitter don yada labari, ba a nan za a fara sanarwa ba, sai an fara da takardar gargajiya mai dauke da tambarin Buckingham Palace, likitoci sun sa hannu, za a fitar daga Lindo Wing da ma'aikacin yada labarai, a kai da motar jami'an tsaro zuwa Privy Purse Door na Buckingham Palace. A can, za a saka sanarwar a kan dutse na musamman a gabar fadar, don nuna ga jama'a cewa jaririn masarauta ya iso. Kakakin fadar ya ce: 'Muna son ci gaba da wannan al'ada da mutunci. Wannan haihuwa ce ta mai jiran gado, na musamman ce kuma mai tarihi.' 'Ba za a fara sanar da haihuwa a Twitter ba, amma daga bisani za a fitar nan.' A lokaci guda, Kensington Palace na shirin fitar da sanarwar yanar gizo da ya ƙunsa karin bayani kamar nauyin jariri. Yayin haihuwar William ma, an fitar da bayanan launin idonsa da yadda ya yi kuka sosai. Idan an haife shi daga 10:30 na dare zuwa 8:00 na safe, za a fara da takaitacciyar sanarwa ta yanar gizo, sannan da safe da misalin 9:00 a saka sanarwar a dutse. Jami'i ya ce: 'Idan haihuwar ta yi dare, za mu fito da sanarwar washegari.' Sanarwa ba za ta fito ba sai an sanar da Sarauniya da manyan 'yan gida da kuma iyalan Middleton idan ba su asibitin ba. Ana sa ran William zai fara kira Sarauniya idan lokaci ya dace. 'Za a tuntubi Sarauniya ba da jimawa ba, sannan sauran 'yan gida za su samu labari da wuri,' in ji wata majiya daga masarauta. Ana sa ran William zai yi jawabi a kofar asibiti bayan sanarwa, da ma Middleton, duk da ba a gama tsari ba. 'Ko da wannan al'amari sirri ne, Duke da Duchess suna ganin lokaci ne na murnar kasa kuma sun san jama'a suna sha'awa,' cewar kakakin masarauta. Masarauta za ta bayyana cewa Duchess ta shiga nakuda da zarar an shigar da ita asibiti da likitoci sun duba ta. Duk da kiyaye mutuncin Kate na da mahimmanci, kafafen sada zumunta sun sa boye bayani ya zama wahala. Marcus Setchell, shugaban likitocin Sarauniya, zai jagoranci aikin haihuwa tare da Alan Farthing daga St Mary's. An tanadi shirye-shirye da wasu asibitoci kamar Royal Berkshire a Reading idan Duchess ta fara nakuda tana wajen iyayenta.

article_content: According to a recent survey by the industry body FICCI, growth in India's manufacturing sector is set to accelerate further following notable gains in the second quarter of the current fiscal year. Approximately 80% of surveyed companies reported higher order volumes and stronger demand during July-September 2023-24, with 79% also registering increased production levels. Average manufacturing capacity utilization now stands at 74%, a slight rise from 73% in previous quarters, indicating sustained activity across the sector. FICCI highlights that over 57% of companies plan to invest and expand operations in the next six months, reflecting an improved investment outlook compared to earlier surveys. Yet, demand—both domestically and for exports—remains a key concern. Over 40% of respondents cited insufficient demand as a significant challenge. High raw material prices, costlier financing, logistics, and supply chain disruptions were also identified as notable hurdles to expansion plans. Though cost pressures for manufacturers have moderated, 58% of respondents still experienced increased production costs this quarter—down from 77% in the prior quarter—with raw material and energy prices identified as major contributing factors. Exports have shown an uptick, as 48% of companies reported higher exports in Q2, up from 33% in Q1. The employment outlook remains steady, with around 38% of firms planning to hire more staff in the coming three months. Meanwhile, 59% observed a marginal rise in interest rates over the previous quarter. Sector-wise, Electronics and White Goods, Cement, Automotive, and Machine Tools reported robust growth, while Capital Goods, Construction Machinery, Chemicals, Textiles, Metals, and Paper saw moderate growth. Separately, the Indian Income Tax Department is investigating the local units of Apple, Google, and Amazon regarding possible unpaid taxes, focusing on their transfer pricing practices. Additionally, Indians have surpassed previous leaders as the largest buyers in Dubai's real estate market. Digital payments company Razorpay is planning to relocate its parent firm to India—a move that may result in a US tax payment of $250-300 million.
translated_content: Bisa ga wani binciken da kungiyar masana’antu ta FICCI ta gudanar, ana sa ran bunkasar masana'antar sarrafa kayayyaki a Najeriya za ta ci gaba da karuwa bayan samun cigaba a zangon biyu na shekarar kudi. Kusan kashi 80% na kamfanonin da aka tattauna da su sun bayyana kamuwa da karin oda da bukatu tsakanin Yuli zuwa Satumba 2023-24, inda kashi 79% suka ruwaito karin samarwa. Matsakaicin amfani da karfin masana’antu yanzu ya kai kashi 74%, dan tashi daga 73% a zangon baya, wanda ke nuna ci gaba a fannin. FICCI ta bayyana cewa fiye da kashi 57% na kamfanoni suna shirin kara zuba jari da fadada ayyuka cikin watanni shida masu zuwa, wannan ya nuna ingantuwar yanayin zuba jari kwatankwacin bincike na baya. Sai dai har yanzu karancin bukata, a gida ko kasashen waje, na ci gaba da zama babbar matsala. Fiye da kashi 40% na masu amsa sun fadi babu wadatacciyar bukata. Tsadar albarkatun kasa, karin kudin aro, batun sufuri, da cikas a sarkar kayayyaki suma sun kunno kai a matsayin wasu manyan matsaloli ga shirin fadada aiki. Kodayake matsin lamba wajen kudin samarwa ya dan lafa, har yanzu kashi 58% na kamfanoni suna kokawa da karin kudin samarwa a wannan zangon — kasa da kashi 77% da aka samu a zangon baya — inda tsadar albarkatun kasa da makamashi suka fi kawo haka. Fitar da kaya zuwa kasashen waje ya karu, inda kashi 48% na kamfanonin suka ce sun samu karin fitarwa a zangon biyu idan aka kwatanta da kashi 33% a zangon daya. Hasashen daukar ma’aikata ya tsaya daidai, wajen kashi 38% na kamfanoni na shirin daukar sabbin ma’aikata a watanni uku masu zuwa. Haka kuma, kashi 59% sun lura da dan karin ribar bashi idan aka kwatanta da zangon baya. A bangare-bangare, na'urorin lantarki da kayan daki, siminti, motoci da injin aiki sun nuna gagarumar cigaba, yayin da bangaren kayan aikin masana'antu, injinan gine-gine, sinadarai, masaku, karafa da takarda suka sami matsakaicin cigaba. article_content: Elon Musk’s company Neuralink is launching a groundbreaking clinical trial aimed at transforming human interaction with technology and artificial intelligence. For this trial, Neuralink is searching for a volunteer under 40 who is quadriplegic to undergo a pioneering brain-implant procedure. The surgery involves removing a small part of the skull to insert the Neuralink brain chip. A specially designed robot called R1, equipped with advanced cameras and precision needles, will implant fine threads—each thinner than a human hair—containing electrodes that gather brain activity data related to movement. The device, which houses about 1,000 electrodes, is engineered to allow the user to perform actions on a computer simply by thinking, a feature Neuralink terms 'think-and-click.' The technology’s stated goal is to give greater independence to people living with severe neurological disorders like ALS or paralysis from spinal cord injury. The level of accuracy needed to insert these threads safely exceeds human ability, requiring intricate robotic assistance to prevent damage to brain tissue. Neuralink’s journey hasn’t been without controversy; animal rights advocates criticize the company over its testing on animals such as pigs, sheep, and monkeys. Some organizations have called for investigations into Neuralink’s disclosures regarding the deaths and suffering of animal test subjects, questioning Musk’s publicly shared information. Regulatory hurdles remain significant. Neuralink’s initial request for FDA approval faced constraints, limiting the number of people allowed in early human trials due to safety concerns. While the current focus is on people with serious medical needs, Musk ultimately hopes to see brain-computer interfaces become widespread—potentially improving abilities beyond natural biology. However, many experts believe broad commercial approval is still at least ten years away, even if safety is proven.

article_content: In the city of Dortmund in western Germany, more than 20,000 people were evacuated after a gigantic bomb from World War II was found. The 4,000-pound bomb, believed to have been dropped by Allied aircraft during the Battle of the Ruhr, was discovered through analysis of historic aerial photos. A safety zone was established with everyone living within 1.5 kilometers of the site needing to leave their homes. Emergency shelters were put in place at Westfalen Hall for affected residents. Bomb disposal experts successfully defused and removed the explosive, and officials expected the evacuation to end by the afternoon. Most residents could return home once authorities cleared the area. While WWII bombs are sometimes found in Germany, bombs this large are unusual. A similar situation in Koblenz a few years ago led to 45,000 evacuations. For context, the article explains that in March 1943, Allied forces carried out extensive bombing raids on industrial centers in Germany’s Ruhr region. The aim was to weaken Germany’s ability to sustain its war effort by targeting steel and oil production facilities. These operations involved both British and American bomber planes and faced challenges like anti-aircraft defenses and thick industrial smog. To this day, German cities occasionally discover old and dangerous wartime explosives, highlighting the lingering effects of the Second World War.

article_content: From laptops to tablet computers, there is no shortage of devices to help us organize our lives. However, if you really want to remember something, it may be best to use an old-fashioned pen and paper. A recent study found that when it comes to recalling information, writing notes by hand is more effective than typing on a computer. Researchers at Princeton University discovered that taking notes by hand helped memory more than high-tech options. U.S. psychologists conducted experiments to measure how well students retained information after a lecture. They found that students who wrote notes in longhand better understood the material. Pam Mueller, who led the study at Princeton, said students who wrote with a pen could recall more information later, whether or not they reread their notes. She added that even when laptops are used solely for note-taking—not for online shopping—they may still harm academic performance. In the study, 65 students watched recorded lectures and took notes with either a pen or a laptop. Half an hour later, they answered factual and comprehension questions about the lecture. The study, published in the journal Psychological Science, found that students who used computers performed significantly worse on conceptual questions. Laptop users took nearly twice as many notes, but often transcribed the lecture word-for-word without fully processing the material.

article_content: A new perfume called Prends-moi is aiming to change the way people approach weight loss – by offering a scent that claims to curb snacking. Created by Velds and developed at the renowned French perfume house Robertet, Prends-moi is promoted as the world's first fragrance to help with slimming, drawing on both aromatherapeutic and neurocosmetic research. The formula includes caffeine, carnitine, and spirulina extract, ingredients believed to stimulate enzymes responsible for fat degradation. According to a trial conducted by the Centre of Biological Research and Cutaneous Experimentation (BIO-EC) with women aged 18 to 70 who were not on diets, 75% said the perfume helped reduce their urge to snack, while 73% reported a pleasant feeling when using the product. The perfume is designed for daily use: spritz it generously in the morning or whenever the temptation to snack hits, and for improved results, lightly massage it into specific areas of the body morning and night. Prends-moi features lively scents of bergamot, mandarin, and grapefruit and has a low alcohol content, making it suitable for year-round wear. Its popularity means more than 6,000 people are already waiting to buy it. Priced at £29.99 for 100ml, Prends-moi is available at The Fragrance Shop. Other results from the BIO-EC study after 28 days of regular use found that 82% felt comfortable after applying it, 75% enjoyed the scent enough to wear it every day, 70% felt an improvement in general well-being, and 70% noticed a positive change in their eating habits. While the reported benefits are promising, it's worth noting that most of the research and data come from the manufacturer and related studies, with little mention of independent verification.

Kamfanin Velds ne ya kirkiro shi tare da taimakon shahararren gidan turare na Faransa Robertet, wanda ke tallata Prends-moi a matsayin turaren farko a duniya da ke taimakawa rage kiba, bisa binciken aromatherapy da 'neurocosmetic'. article_content: French actor Gerard Depardieu caused a stir at a World War I commemoration in Brussels by appearing on stage visibly intoxicated. The 65-year-old was scheduled to recite poetry by the French poet-singer Barbara, a Holocaust survivor, at the historic Flagey venue. Instead, Depardieu ignored much of his prepared text, made jokes, used coarse language, and digressed into topics unrelated to the event, including Belgian politics. Some audience members responded with applause and laughter, while others described the performance as 'scandalous' and 'shameful.' The event had to be stopped after only half an hour. Reports suggested he struggled to find his place in the script, repeated sentences, and even requested a chair during his performance. Depardieu has spoken openly in the past about his heavy drinking, stating in an interview that he sometimes consumes up to 14 bottles of wine per day. Notably, in 2011, he was banned from an Air France flight following an incident where he urinated in the aisle. The actor, who took Russian citizenship in 2013 as a protest against France’s high tax rate for the wealthy, also underwent heart bypass surgery some years prior. In his autobiography 'Ca c'est fait comme ca' ('It Happened Like That'), Depardieu discusses his challenging childhood, participation in petty crime, and family difficulties. He also speaks about his work in cinema, his relationship with Russian President Vladimir Putin, and the death of his son, Guillaume, in 2008.

Dan shekara 65 yana shirin karanta baitin mawakiya kuma marubuciya daga Faransa, Barbara, wacce ta tsira daga Holocaust, a dakin tarihi na Flagey. Maimakon haka, Depardieu bai bi rubutun da aka tanada ba, ya fara yi wa mutane dariya, yana fadin kalmomi marasa da’a, sannan ya koma magana game da siyasar Belgium. A 2011, an hana shi shiga jirgin Air France bayan wani lamari na fitsari a cikin jirgi. Depardieu ya karɓi zama ɗan ƙasar Rasha a 2013 saboda rashin jin daɗin harajin masu kudi a Faransa. Ya kuma yi tiyatar zuciya shekaru da suka wuce. Ya kuma tabo aikinsa a fina-finai, hulɗarsa da shugaba Vladimir Putin, da rasuwar ɗansa Guillaume a 2008.

article_content:
On Thursday, Germany’s parliament overwhelmingly approved expanding Europe’s main bailout fund as the continent grapples with worsening debt troubles. The Bundestag voted 523 to 85 in support of increasing the European Financial Stability Facility’s resources, a step meant to calm markets and fend off deeper economic problems. The expansion will raise the fund’s lending power from about €250 billion to €440 billion, pending additional approval from other eurozone members. Austria and Finland already signed off earlier this week, but Germany’s backing is crucial as it anchors Europe’s economy. Chancellor Angela Merkel has taken a leading role throughout the crisis.

The bailout fund’s boost became necessary after the initial safety net—set up last May with Greece’s €110 billion bailout—quickly ran thin as Ireland and Portugal needed assistance, and Greece itself returned for more help. Instead of quelling fears, the crisis deepened, threatening a broader recession and global instability. With its new authority, the fund can now purchase government bonds in financial markets, a move designed to help countries struggling with debt maintain access to financing and restore market confidence.

article_content: Navratri 2023: Wishes, Images, Quotes & Status. Navratri is one of the most celebrated occasions in the Hindu calendar, dedicated to worshipping the nine forms of Goddess Durga. This vibrant festival spans nine nights and ten days, typically held in the month of Ashwin (September or October) in the Gregorian calendar. In 2023, Navratri begins on October 15 and concludes with Dussehra on October 24. There are two main Navratris: Vasanta Navratri (March-April) and Sharad Navratri (September-October). Sharad Navratri, also known as Shardiya Navratri, is celebrated with great enthusiasm across India. During this time, many devotees observe fasts throughout the nine days, each dedicated to a different form of the Goddess, known as the Nava Durga. The nine forms of Maa Durga worshipped during Navratri are: Shailputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kaalratri, Mahagauri, and Siddhidhatri. People wear traditional clothes and offer prayers to each form of the Goddess daily. As you join in the festivities, don't forget to share heartfelt wishes with your loved ones. Here are some special Navratri greetings you can send: "Wishing you a very Happy Navratri. May the happiness of Navratri stay with you always." "May this Navratri bring you new hopes and opportunities." "May Goddess Durga bless you and your family with prosperity and happiness." "Let this festival be the harbinger of joy and prosperity." "Wishing a very happy and auspicious Navratri to everyone at home." "Wishing you nine nights of devotion, spirituality, and happiness." article_content: As the federal government remains slow in enacting regulations on artificial intelligence, New York City is stepping forward. Mayor Eric Adams announced an AI Action Plan this week—a set of roughly 40 policy actions created to protect residents from risks like AI-related bias and discrimination. The plan also includes new standards for AI procured by government agencies, as well as strategies to assess potential risks in AI technologies used by city departments. Further expanding these efforts, City Council member Jennifer Gutiérrez, head of the technology committee, has proposed legislation to create an Office of Algorithmic Data Integrity. This office would allow citizens to raise concerns about automated systems within city agencies and serve as an algorithm-focused ombudsman for the city. It would also screen AI systems for bias prior to their official use. Although several US senators advocated earlier this year for a federal AI regulatory agency, Gutiérrez argues that New York cannot afford to wait, citing its role as an innovation leader. Gutiérrez backs mandatory testing for city-used algorithms, which are now being considered for tasks such as predicting child abuse risks and assessing student learning. She is also cautious about Mayor Adams' support for experimental tech like robotic dogs and AI-driven robocalls in unfamiliar languages. New York has developed a reputation as an early adopter of surveillance and AI tech, with growing use of drones and debated facial recognition systems in public areas and policing. The city has a history of regulating AI: a 2018 task force studied city AI use, and a recent law requires business hiring algorithms be tested for bias. However, some safeguards were retracted in January 2022 when Mayor Adams repealed an order setting up an Algorithms Management and Policy Officer. That office previously identified 16 types of impactful algorithms used by agencies, though it didn't evaluate all police department models. Despite these measures, Gutiérrez indicates she lacks full insight into algorithm use by city agencies. A February audit by the state comptroller found that the city’s system for AI governance is still ad hoc and incomplete, warning this could affect transparency, fairness, and accuracy.
translated_content: Yayin da gwamnatin tarayya ke jan kafa wajen kirkirar dokoki akan fasahar kere-kere na AI, birnin New York ya tashi tsaye. Gwamna Eric Adams ya gabatar da shirin AI Action Plan a wannan mako, wanda ya kunshi wasu manufofi 40 don kare mazauna daga barazanar wariya ko son kai da AI ka iya haifarwa. Shirin ya yi tanadi don kafa sabon tsari ga AI da hukumomin birni ke saya da hanyoyin gano hadarin AI da hukumomin gwamnati ke amfani da su. A kokarin faɗaɗa wadannan matakai, mamba a majalisar birnin Jennifer Gutiérrez, shugabar kwamitin fasaha, ta gabatar da kudiri na kafa Ofishin Tsare Sirrin Bayanai na Algorithmic. Wannan ofishi zai ba wa jama'a damar kai kukansu kan kayan aikin AI da hukumomin gwamnati ke amfani da su, yana aiki a matsayin mai shiga tsakanin jama'a da tsarin AI a fadin birnin. Hakanan zai duba tsarin AI don gano son kai ko wariya kafin a fara amfani da su. Ko da yake wasu sanatoci sun nemi a kafa hukumar AI ta tarayya tun wannan shekarar, Gutiérrez ta ce New York ba za ta jira Washington DC ba, tana mai nuni da muhimmancin jagoranci a fannin kirkire-kirkire. Gutiérrez na karfafa gwajin dole ga duk tsarin AI da gwamnati ke amfani da su, musamman tunda ana duba amfani da su wajen tantance hatsarin cin zarafin yara da kuma sa ido kan karatun dalibai. Hakanan tana nuna damuwa kan sha'awar Gwamna Adams na sababbin fasahohi irin su robotic dogs da AI da ke bada robocall a harsuna daban-daban. Birnin New York ya shahara wajen gwada sababbin fasahohin sa ido, daga karin amfani da jiragen drone zuwa amfani mai shakku na gano fuska a gidajen haya, filayen wasa, da wuraren 'yan sanda. Tun ma kafin wannan mako, birnin na da tarihi wajen kine-kine kan AI: kwamitin musamman ya fara aiki tun 2018 domin binciko amfani da AI a hukumomin gwamnati, sannan doka ta wajabta gwajin tsarin daukar aiki na AI don kauce wa wariya. Duk da haka, wasu matakan kariya sun ragu bayan Adams ya soke doka da ta kirkiri Ofishin Gudanar da Algorithms a Janairu 2022. Wannan ofishi ya bayyana cewa hukumomi na amfani da nau'ikan AI guda 16 masu tasiri, ko da yake ba duk tsarin ‘yan sanda na AI aka duba ba. Duk da wadannan matakai, Gutiérrez ta ce har yanzu bata da cikakkiyar fahimta kan yadda hukumomi ke amfani da AI. Bincike daga ofishin mai duba kudi na jihar a watan Fabrairu ya nuna tsarin birnin na kula da AI yana da gibi, yana gargadin hakan ka iya kawo tangarda ga gaskiya, adalci da bayyananniyar aiki.

article_content: On May 12, 2013, Education Secretary Michael Gove and Defence Secretary Philip Hammond publicly stated they would vote for Britain to leave the European Union if a referendum were held immediately. According to government sources, at least seven other senior Cabinet colleagues privately agreed. Mr. Gove remarked that life outside the EU 'would be perfectly tolerable.' When asked about his stance if significant powers could not be reclaimed from Brussels, Mr. Hammond replied, 'Yes.' Their statements increased pressure on Prime Minister David Cameron to clarify whether he would lead a campaign to exit the EU if new negotiations do not result in substantial changes to Britain's relationship with the EU. Chris Grayling, Iain Duncan Smith, Owen Paterson, Justine Greening, Francis Maude, Theresa Villiers, and Oliver Letwin were also reportedly in favor of leaving the EU if Cameron fails to negotiate a new deal. Some Conservative MPs are calling for an earlier referendum on reclaiming powers from Brussels, possibly to coincide with the European elections the following year. Within Cameron's inner circle, concern is rising that the Prime Minister’s promise of an in/out referendum in 2017—after negotiating new terms—has prompted Eurosceptics to push for even more immediate action. A proposed amendment to the Queen’s Speech calling for a referendum could be voted on soon, though it is unlikely to become law. Supporters argue that proposing such a bill would demonstrate Cameron’s commitment to a referendum. Mr. Gove said that he and other ministers would abstain from this week's vote, but Conservative backbenchers and aides were free to support it—a move he described as 'letting off steam.' Downing Street briefly considered allowing Cabinet ministers to support the amendment alongside around 100 Eurosceptic MPs, but ultimately decided it could risk a government rebellion. In interviews, Mr. Gove expressed preference for significant changes to the UK’s relationship with the EU, but said life outside of it would be manageable and could offer advantages. He argued that the best outcome would be for Britain to lead reform in Europe. Mr. Hammond echoed these sentiments and said he would currently vote to leave, but maintained that efforts should be made to reform the EU to better suit Britain’s interests. He cautioned against a defeatist attitude and favored renegotiation. Eurosceptic former Defence Secretary Liam Fox indicated he would support the amendment to the Queen's Speech, criticizing Labour for not offering the public a say on the EU issue. Boris Johnson, writing in the Daily Telegraph, also supported holding a referendum but warned that many British problems are not caused by the EU, citing issues such as short-termism, management, and underinvestment.
translated_content: A ranar 12 ga Mayu, 2013, Sakataren Ilimi Michael Gove da Sakataren Tsaro Philip Hammond sun bayyana a fili cewa da a gudanar da kuri’ar raba gardama kan ficewar Birtaniya daga Tarayyar Turai, da za su zabi ficewa. Majiyoyin gwamnati sun ce a kalla wasu ministocin majalisar ministoci guda bakwai na boye sun goyi bayan hakan. Mr. Gove ya ce rayuwa bayan ficewa daga EU "za ta zama da sauki." Aka tambayi Hammond ko zai fi son ci gaba da kasancewa idan ba a dawo da wasu iko daga Brussels ba, ya ce "Eh." Wannan furuci ya kara matsa lamba ga Firayim Minista David Cameron don ya bayyana ko zai jagoranci kokarin ficewar Birtaniya daga EU idan tattaunawa ba su kai ga samun manyan sauye-sauye ba. Chris Grayling, Iain Duncan Smith, Owen Paterson, Justine Greening, Francis Maude, Theresa Villiers, da Oliver Letwin suma ana cece-kuce suna goyon bayan ficewa idan Cameron bai kayyade sabuwar yarjejeniya mai amfani ba. Wasu 'yan majalisar Conservative na shawartar a samu wani zaben raba gardama da wuri don dawo da wasu iko daga Brussels, watakila a hada da zaben Turai mai zuwa. A cikin rukunin masu kusanci da Cameron, akwai damuwa cewa alkawarin gudanar da kuri’ar shiga/ko fita daga EU a 2017 – bayan kokarin sasanta sabuwar alaƙa – ya sa masu adawa da EU ke matsa lamba a yanzu. Wani sauyi na jawabin Sarauniya na iya zuwa don neman kuri’ar gardama, ko da ba za a samu wata doka kai tsaye ba. Masu goyon baya sun ce hakan zai nuna jajircewar Cameron. Mr. Gove ya ce shi da sauran ministoci za su kauracewa kuri’ar makon nan, amma ba a hana ‘yan Conservative da masu taimakawa su goyi bayan gyaran – ya kira hakan "fitar da zuciya." Fadar gwamnati ta yi la’akari da barin ministoci su mara baya ga gyaran tare da wasu ‘yan majalisar Eurosceptic, fiye da 100, amma daga karshe sun dakatar da wannan saboda tsoron tawaye a gwamnati. A hirarsu, Mr. Gove ya nuna fiye da so a samu manyan sauye-sauye a dangantakar Birtaniya da EU, amma ya ce za a iya jurewa idan an fita daga EU, har ma da wasu fa’ida. Ya ce mafi kyau Birtaniya ce ta jagoranci gyara a Turai. Mr. Hammond ya bayyana irin wadannan ra’ayoyi, yana cewa zai zabi ficewa yanzu amma yana mai cewa yakamata a gabatar da gyare-gyare kafin ficewa. Ya gargadi nuna rauni da gaggawa wajen ficewa. Liam Fox, tsohon Sakataren Tsaro mara goyon bayan EU, ya ce zai goyi bayan gyaran jawabin Sarauniya, yana zargin Labour da gazawa wajen bai wa jama’a damar zabe kan EU. Boris Johnson a shafinsa na Daily Telegraph ya goyi bayan kuri’ar gardama, amma ya jaddada cewa matsalolin Birtaniya ba EU kadai ke haifar da su ba, yana lissafo matsaloli irinsu rashin tunanin dogon lokaci, shugabanci, da rashin saka jari.

article_content: Lord Prescott, former deputy prime minister, is at the centre of a £75 million legal case over allegations he tried to undermine coal miners’ compensation claims due to concerns that Labour could lose union donations. Court documents seen by The Mail on Sunday allege that Prescott collaborated with Thompsons Solicitors to pressure insurance company Templeton to withdraw its offer of legal fee coverage for the miners, forcing them to drop their action. The documents suggest Prescott feared that if the miners’ claims succeeded, unions and their law firms might have to pay multimillion-pound settlements, potentially affecting the unions’ donations to the Labour Party. The miners had sought to sue more than 50 union-linked law firms found by legal watchdogs to have improperly deducted millions from compensation awards for illness claims. It is claimed that in 2006, under pressure from Thompsons Solicitors, Prescott threatened a Templeton executive with the prospect of an investigation by the Financial Services Authority if the insurer did not remove its offer of coverage. Both Lord Prescott and Thompsons Solicitors deny the allegations. Prescott states that his phone records show no such call took place, while Thompsons asserts it did not request Prescott to intervene or pressure Templeton to act unlawfully.

Takardun kotu da The Mail on Sunday ta samu sun zargi Prescott da aiki tare da Thompsons Solicitors wajen matsa wa kamfanin inshora na Templeton ya janye tayin biyan kudaden lauyoyi ga masu hakar kwal, wanda hakan ya hana su cigaba da shari’a. Takardun sun kuma nuna Prescott na fargabar cewar idan masu hakar kwal sun ci shari’ar, kungiyoyin kwadago da lauyoyinsu za su fuskanci biyan diyya mai yawa, wanda hakan zai shafi gudunmawar da kungiyoyin ke bayarwa wa jam'iyyar Labour. Masu hakar kwal sun shiryawa shari’a da sama da kamfanonin lauyoyi 50 na kungiyoyin kwadago da aka samu da aikata cire miliyoyin fam ba bisa ka’ida ba daga kudaden diyya ga wadanda ke fama da cututtukan numfashi da wasu. Ana zargin a shekarar 2006, bisa matsin lamba daga Thompsons Solicitors, Prescott ya yi barazanar za a binciki Templeton daga hukumar kula da hada-hadar kudi ta birnin Landan (Financial Services Authority) in bai janye tayin ba. Lord Prescott da Thompsons Solicitors sun musanta zargin; Prescott ya ce bayanan wayarsa ba su nuna irin hakan ba, yayin da Thompsons ta ce ba su taba bukatar Prescott ya shiga tsakanin ko matsa wa Templeton ya aikata wani abu ba bisa ka’ida ba.

article_content: Greenpeace campaigner Antony Perrett has described harsh conditions during his two-month detention in Russian prisons after attempting to hang a climate change banner on an oil rig. Perrett, a vegetarian, claims he survived largely on bread and water as prison meals typically contained low-quality meat of unknown origin. Perrett, who is from Newport, Wales, was one of the Arctic 30 – a group of environmental activists charged with hooliganism after protesting aboard the Greenpeace ship Sunrise in September. Initially accused of piracy, their charges were reduced, and Perrett was released under a new amnesty law. Reflecting on his time in custody in Murmansk and St Petersburg, Perrett recounted losing a significant amount of weight and spending up to 23 hours a day in a cell, often communicating with fellow prisoners through whistling or shouting over cell walls. Prison conditions included rodent infestations and a high risk of tuberculosis, especially on certain cell blocks. Perrett passed the time by drawing, using supplies sent in a Greenpeace parcel, and managed to connect with cellmates through these drawings despite language barriers. He also noted encounters with dangerous inmates but said he was treated well by them. After being released on November 20, Perrett returned to the UK with his girlfriend Zahara Ally, expressing joy at being home for Christmas. Fellow activist Kieron Bryan, who was imprisoned alongside Perrett, used his time in jail to plan a marriage proposal to his partner, Nancy Thorburn. Greenpeace now seeks the return of its ship Sunrise, following an order by the international court. Perrett, despite the ordeal, said he would consider protesting again in Russia if there were changes in government policy. He expressed gratitude for public support upon returning home and shared relief at no longer having to contend with prison conditions.

Perrett, wanda ba ya cin nama, ya ce ya rayu ne da burodi da ruwa saboda abincin gidan yari yakan kunshi naman da ba a tantance asalinsa. Perrett, daga garin Newport a Wales, yana cikin ‘yan Arctic 30 – gamayyar masu kare muhalli da aka kama bisa zanga-zangar da suka yi a kan jirgin ruwa na Greenpeace ‘Sunrise’ a watan Satumba. Da farko an tuhume shi da fashi, amma daga bisani aka sauya laifin zuwa hargitsi, kuma aka sakeshi bisa dokar afuwa. Yayin da yake tunawa da lokacin da ya shafe a Murmansk da St Petersburg, Perrett ya ce ya ragu da yawa a jiki kuma akasari yana cikin daki na tsawon awanni 23 a rana, yana mu’amala da fursunoni ta busa sarewa ko ihun magana. Gidan yari yana fama da barazanar beraye da cutar tarin fuka, musamman a wasu sassan gidan. Perrett ya shafe lokaci yana zana hoto da kayan da Greenpeace ta aiko masa, kuma hakan ya taimaka masa wajen sadarwa da sauran fursunoni ko da ba su fahimci juna. Ya kara da cewa wasu daga cikin fursunonin masu hatsari ne, amma sun nuna masa kyakkyawar mu’amala. Bayan an sakeshi a 20 ga Nuwamba, Perrett ya dawo Ingila tare da budurwarsa Zahara Ally, yana bayyana farin cikinsa da dawowa gida kafin bikin Kirsimeti. Dan kungiyar Kieron Bryan, wanda aka rufe tare da Perrett, ya yi amfani da lokacin gidan yari wajen tsara yadda zai bukaci auren masoyiyarsa, Nancy Thorburn. Greenpeace na kokarin dawo da jirginta Sunrise bayan kotu ta bayar da umarnin hakan. Duk da kuncin da ya sha, Perrett ya ce zai iya sake zanga-zanga a Rasha matukar gwamnati ta sauya. Ya nuna godiya da irin goyon bayan da ya samu bayan dawowarsa gida, tare da jin dadin komawa rayuwar yau da kullum bayan tsarewa.

article_content: Paul the psychic octopus recently received a medal and a soccer jersey after gaining fame for his accurate World Cup predictions. Earlier this month, Paul correctly predicted that Spain would defeat the Netherlands in the World Cup finals. Almost two weeks later, a delegation from Carballino, Spain, visited Paul in his hometown of Oberhausen, Germany, bringing a gift basket that included a bronze statue, the symbol of Carballino. The statue made Paul an honorary 'best friend of the town.' The Spanish delegation, led by Carballino's mayor, Carlos Alberto Montes Marques, and including several local businessmen such as Manuel Pazo, also presented Paul with an official Spanish soccer jersey. Pazo has previously expressed interest in purchasing Paul to serve as the town’s mascot. Carballino will celebrate Paul again on August 8 during its 43rd 'festival of the octopus.' Paul not only predicted Spain's win over the Netherlands but also their semifinal victory over Germany. He accurately foretold all five of Germany’s earlier match results, and also picked Germany to defeat Uruguay in the third-place play-off. Paul finished the tournament with a perfect eight-for-eight record. For each prediction, two acrylic boxes filled with mussels and labeled with the competing teams' flags were placed in Paul's tank. Paul would select a box, indicating the country he predicted to win. Sea Life, where Paul resides, has announced his retirement from predictions, though offers for Paul have come in from around the world. Spain has shown interest, and a Russian bookmaking company has reportedly offered 100,000 euros (about $129,800) for him.
translated_content: Paul, kugun octopus mai hangen nesa, kwanan nan ya karɓi lambar yabo da rigar kwallon kafa bayan ya shahara wajen yin hasashen sakamakon gasar cin kofin duniya daidai. A farkon wannan watan, Paul ya hango cewa Spain za ta doke Netherlands a wasan karshe na cin kofin duniya, kuma hakan ya tabbata. Kusan makonni biyu bayan haka, wata tawaga daga garin Carballino, Spain, ta ziyarci Paul a garinsa na Oberhausen, Jamus, tare da kawo masa kwandon kyauta da ke ɗauke da ƙaramin gumaka mai siffar Carballino. Wannan gumaka ta sa aka karrama Paul da matsayin 'aboki na musamman na garin.' Tawagar daga Spain, karkashin jagorancin shugaban garin Carballino, Carlos Alberto Montes Marques, tare da wasu 'yan kasuwa ciki har da Manuel Pazo, sun kuma bawa Paul rigar kwallon kafa ta Spain hukuma. Pazo a baya ya nuna sha'awarsa ta sayen Paul domin ya zama abin kwatance ga garin. Za a sake karrama Paul a Carballino ranar 8 ga Agusta a lokacin biki na 43 na 'festival of the octopus.' Ba wai kawai Paul ya hango nasarar Spain akan Netherlands ba, har ma da nasarar su a wasan kusa da na karshe da Jamus. Ya kuma hango sakamakon dukkan wasa biyar da Jamus ta buga a baya daidai, da kuma nasarar Jamus akan Uruguay a wasan neman matsayi na uku. Paul ya kammala gasar tare da sakamakon da ya dace guda takwas cikin takwas. A kowane hasashe, ana ajiye akwatuna biyu na roba cike da mussel sannan a sa tutar ƙasashen da ke fafatawa a saman kowanne akwatin a cikin tankin Paul. Paul zai zaɓi akwatin daya, wanda hakan ke nuna ƙasar da yake hango nasara gare ta. Hukumar Sea Life, inda Paul ke zama, ta sanar da janyewarsa daga yin hasashe, ko da yake an samu tayin siya daga sassa daban-daban na duniya. Spain na nuna sha’awa ga Paul, kuma wata kamfanin caca daga Rasha ta bayar da tayin euro 100,000 (kimanin dala 129,800) domin samun Paul.

article_content: The High Court has directed the BBMP Chief Commissioner and the e-governance secretary to create a system for verifying the identity of deceased persons using e-KYC, Aadhaar, and similar digital methods. This initiative is intended to prevent errors in hospital records and during the issuance of death certificates. The Court further stressed that birth and death certificates should be digitized and credentialed to allow electronic verification through platforms like DigiLocker, enabling third parties to easily confirm their authenticity. Justice Suraj Govindaraj gave these orders while offering relief to Sai Lakshmi from Bagepalli town, Chikkaballapura district. Lakshmi's husband, Lakshmi Kantha SP, a government school teacher, died on November 22, 2022, at the Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences and Research in Bengaluru. His death was registered by the hospital on November 30, 2022, and the BBMP issued the death certificate on December 9, 2022. Sai Lakshmi discovered errors in the certificate: her own name and her husband’s parents’ names were incorrectly spelled. She submitted an application for corrections on January 9, 2023, but the BBMP rejected her request on January 23, 2023, reasoning that corrections could only be made with a court order since the original details were provided by the hospital. Sai Lakshmi subsequently challenged this decision in the High Court. Justice Govindaraj clarified that the registrar has adequate powers to check documents and correct mistakes in death certificates, stating that treating hospital records as unchangeable could result in more errors and possible misuse. Recent related legal decisions include the Uttar Pradesh government banning halal certification of products intended for domestic sale and the Bombay High Court ruling that caste scrutiny panels cannot reopen previous decisions regarding caste certificate validity.
translated_content: Babbar kotu ta umarci Shugaban BBMP da sakataren e-gwamnati su samar da tsarin tabbatar da sahihancin marigayi, ta amfani da e-KYC, Aadhaar da sauran hanyoyin zamani. Wannan zai taimaka wajen kawar da kuskure a bayanan asibiti da lokacin fitar da takardar shaidar mutuwa. Kotun ta nanata cewa takardun haihuwa da mutuwa su zama na zamani domin a duba ingancinsu ta yanar gizo ta hanyar DigiLocker, domin kowa ya iya tabbatar da sahihancinsu cikin sauki. Mai shari’a Suraj Govindaraj ya bayar da wannan umarni yayin da yake taimakawa Sai Lakshmi daga Bagepalli, cikin gundumar Chikkaballapura. Mijinta, Lakshmi Kantha SP, malamin makarantar gwamnati ne, wanda ya rasu a ranar 22 ga Nuwamba, 2022, a Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences and Research dake Bengaluru. Asibitin ya rubuta mutuwarsa a ranar 30 ga Nuwamba, 2022, sannan BBMP ta fitar da takardar mutuwa a ranar 9 ga Disamba, 2022. Sai Lakshmi ta gano cewar an yi kuskure a takardar mutuwar: an rubuta sunanta da sunan iyayen mijinta ba daidai ba. Ta rubuta bukatar gyara a ranar 9 ga Janairu, 2023, amma BBMP ta ki amincewa a ranar 23 ga Janairu, 2023, tana cewa sai da umarnin kotu aka iya yin gyara tunda bayanan daga asibiti suka fito. Sai Lakshmi ta shigar da kara zuwa kotu. Mai shari’a Govindaraj ya bayyana cewa mai rajista na da karfin iko ya duba takardu ya kuma gyara kuskure a takardar mutuwa, yana mai cewa daukar bayanan asibiti a matsayin wadanda ba za a taba gyarawa ba, na iya haifar da karin kuskure da yiwuwar amfani da bayanan ba daidai ba. Wasu hukuncin kotu da kwanan nan aka yanke sun hada da haramta shaidar halal a cikin kayan masarufi na kasuwar cikin gida a jihar Uttar Pradesh, da kuma hukuncin Babbar Kotun Bombay wanda ya ce kwamitin tantance kabilu ba zai iya sake dubawa ko soke shaidar kabilar da aka bayar a baya ba.

article_content: Chelsea enters their next Premier League fixture against Arsenal unbeaten and leading the league. However, manager Jose Mourinho expresses doubt that his team or any other will ever mirror Arsenal’s iconic undefeated season from 2003-04. The Gunners’ unique achievement had only ever been matched by Preston North End over a century ago. Mourinho remarked that achieving an unbeaten league campaign is unlikely in the modern era’s competitive environment. He pointed to Chelsea’s 6-0 win over Arsenal in 2014, which marked Wenger’s 1,000th game, as an example of how rare such outcomes are. As both teams maintain unbeaten records so far this season, Mourinho acknowledges the difficulty Arsenal poses—especially since Cesc Fabregas, a former Arsenal captain, now orchestrates Chelsea’s midfield. Mourinho remembered the intense previous match at Stamford Bridge, noting the controversial moment when referee Andre Marriner mistakenly sent off Kieran Gibbs for Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain’s handball. Despite the past, he expects a tighter contest this time. Mourinho enjoys the heightened stakes of derby matches and believes his squad relishes the challenge. He insists the team’s focus is on tactical preparation rather than emotional motivation. For Fabregas, this fixture marks the first time he faces his former team as a Chelsea player.

Wannan nasarar ta dabam, tazo ne bayan Preston North End ta yi irinta sama da shekara dari da ta wuce. Mourinho ya bayyana cewa irin rinjayen gida na Premier League a yau na nufin wuya a sake samun wannan nasara. Ya kuma kawo misalin yadda Chelsea tasa ta ci Arsenal 6-0 a 2014, lokacin da Wenger ya jagoranci wasansa na 1,000. A yanzu haka, Chelsea da Arsenal dukkaninsu ba su sha kashi ba a wannan sabuwar kakar, Mourinho ya jinjinawa ƙalubalen Arsenal, musamman ganin cewa Cesc Fabregas, tsohon ƙyaftin din Arsenal, yanzu yana taka muhimmiyar rawa a tsakiya ga Chelsea. Mourinho ya tuna da wasan baya a Stamford Bridge, inda aka samu kuskuren alkali Andre Marriner, ya kori Kieran Gibbs saboda hannun kwallo da Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain ya yi. Duk da abubuwan baya, Mourinho ya sa ran zakaran gwajin dafi a wannan lokaci. Yana bayyana yadda ke jin daɗin girman wasannin hamayya da bambancin kalubale, yana mai cewa 'yan wasansa sun fi kowa shiryawa idan irin wannan babbar gasa ta zo. Ya kara da cewa, mahimmanci da aka fi mayar da hankali a kai shine irin dabarun da ake tsara wa ba wai ta bangaren motsa zuciya ba. Fabregas zai kara da tsohuwar kungiyarsa Arsenal a karo na farko a matsayin dan Chelsea.

article_content: Film star and martial arts icon Jackie Chan has been invited to offer advice to China's leaders during significant political meetings in Beijing. Chan, who starred in the Rush Hour films, joins other notable Chinese figures such as former NBA player Yao Ming and Nobel Prize-winning author Mo Yan in advising the ruling Communist Party during the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC). Chan's involvement has drawn criticism in his hometown of Hong Kong, especially after he reportedly suggested in a magazine interview that protests there should be subject to regulations. In December, Chan told Southern People Weekly, 'There should be regulations on what can and cannot be protested. We Hong Kong residents do not like repression. We value freedom, but you cannot do whatever you want.' The CPPCC is an advisory body composed of prominent individuals—including film stars, writers, athletes, business people, and religious leaders—and is separate from the National People's Congress, which acts as China's parliament. Thousands of delegates from across China have assembled in Beijing for the annual meetings, with security visibly present in areas like Tiananmen Square. Communist Party chief Xi Jinping has emphasized tackling corruption, inequality, environmental issues, and reforms as urgent priorities for the party’s future. He warned that the Communist Party may not reach its 100th anniversary if these problems are not addressed. During the annual meeting, Xi formally takes over as China’s president, facing multiple challenges such as domestic inequality and international tensions. Xi has referred to the importance of learning lessons from the collapse of the Soviet Union and has called for strengthening party discipline and capability. The concept of 'two 100 years' refers to both the centenary of the Communist Party (2021) and the People's Republic of China (2049), which Xi highlighted as major milestones. In the wake of mounting protests and social tensions, Xi has launched anti-corruption efforts and urged the People’s Liberation Army to maintain readiness and discipline. Observers note that ensuring the party's survival to its centenary is viewed as one of Xi Jinping's top priorities.
translated_content: Fitaccen jarumin fina-finai kuma kwararren fasihin dama Jackie Chan an gayyace shi domin bada shawara ga shugabannin kasar Sin a yayin muhimman tarurrukan siyasa a Beijing. Chan, wanda ya shahara a fina-finan Rush Hour, yana cikin sauran shahararrun 'yan kasar Sin irin su tsohon dan kwallon NBA Yao Ming da kuma marubuci mai lambar yabo ta Nobel, Mo Yan, wajen ba da shawarwari ga jam’iyyar Kwaminis a yayin Taron Ba da Shawara na Jama'ar Sin (CPPCC). Shiga Chan a taron ya jawowa kansa suka daga wasu mutanen birnin dake Hong Kong, musamman bayan da aka rahoto cewa ya bada shawarar a takaita yawan zanga-zanga a wani hira da mujallar kasar. A watan Disamba, Chan ya shaida wa mujallar Southern People Weekly cewa, 'Ya kamata a samar da dokoki game da abin da za a iya yin zanga-zanga a kai da wanda ba za a yi ba. Mu mazauna Hong Kong ba ma son danniya. Muna kaunar yanci, amma ba za ka iya yin komai kawai yadda kake so ba.' CPPCC na daga cikin kwamitocin bayar da shawarwari da ke kunshe da fitattun mutane—jaruman fina-finai, marubuta, ‘yan wasa, ‘yan kasuwa da shugabannin addini—kuma daban ne da Majalisar Jama'ar Kasa, wacce ke aiki a matsayin majalisar dokoki a kasar. Dubban wakilai daga ko’ina cikin kasar sun hallara a Beijing domin wannan babban taro na shekara-shekara, inda jami’an tsaro suke a ko’ina musamman a wuraren kamar Tiananmen Square. Shugaban jam’iyyar Kwaminis Xi Jinping ya jaddada bukatar yaki da cin hanci da rashawa, rashin daidaito, matsalolin muhalli, da kuma sauye-sauye a matsayin manyan abubuwan da ke bukatar kulawa don makomar jam’iyyar. Ya gargaɗi cewar jam’iyyar na iya kasa kaiwa shekara ta 100 idan ba a warware wadannan matsaloli ba. A yayin wannan taron shekara-shekara, Xi ya karbi ragamar shugabancin kasar Sin a hukumance, yana fuskantar kalubale da dama irin su bambancin arziki a cikin gida da kuma sabani da kasashen waje. Xi ya sha nanata muhimmancin daukar darasi daga rushewar Tarayyar Soviet tare da kiran a kara daidaito da kwarewa a cikin jam’iyyar. Kalmar 'shekaru dari biyu' na nufin cika shekaru dari na Jam’iyyar Kwaminis (2021) da na Jamhuriyar Jama’ar Sin (2049), wadanda Xi ya jaddada a matsayin manyan abubuwan tarihi. A kokarin kauracewa yawaitar zanga-zanga da matsin lamba a cikin al’umma, Xi ya kaddamar da yakar rashawa tare da umurtar Sojojin ‘Yantarwa su kasance cikin shiri da tsari. Masana na ganin tabbatar da jam’iyyar ta kai shekaru dari na daya daga cikin manyan abubuwan da Xi Jinping ke mai da hankali.
