article_content: Earth has one moon, Uranus has 27, and Saturn has over 50, while Venus has none. A bold new theory presented at a Royal Society conference suggests that Earth might have captured its only moon from Venus. The theory, introduced by Caltech University professor Dave Stevenson, proposes that Earth pulled a moon away from Venus' orbit and into our own. Professor Stevenson explained at the Origin of the Moon conference in London that the size of our moon relative to Earth makes this scenario plausible. "The reason it's interesting is that Earth and Venus are close to each other," Stevenson told Space.com. "They have similar mass and likely formed in similar ways." However, there is a significant flaw with this idea: geological similarities between rock samples from Earth and the moon support the more accepted 'giant impact' theory. This theory proposes that the moon formed about 4.56 billion years ago, when a Mars-sized body collided with Earth. Venus is slightly smaller than Earth but has nearly the same mass. It’s the second closest planet to the sun, about 108 million kilometers away. A day on Venus is as long as 243 Earth days, and its thick, toxic atmosphere is mostly carbon dioxide and nitrogen, with clouds of sulfuric acid. There's no evidence of life on Venus, and its surface temperature, nearly 480 degrees Celsius, makes life as we know it unlikely. "So the question is, if Earth and Venus formed in similar ways, how come Earth has a moon and Venus doesn't?" Professor Stevenson said. He noted he isn't convinced by the new theory, but finds it an interesting possibility. In the 'giant impact' model, most simulations suggest about 80 percent of the moon came from the impactor and 20 percent from Earth itself. A separate controversial theory, by planetary scientist Wim van Westrenen, suggests that a giant explosion equivalent to 40 billion atomic bombs erupting from Earth's core formed the moon about 4.5 billion years ago. Van Westrenen claims that evidence suggests the moon originated as part of the Earth that was blasted into space by this colossal explosion.
translated_content: Duniya tana da wata guda, Uranus na da wata 27, Saturn kuma sama da 50, yayin da Venus ba shi da ko daya. Wani sabon ra'ayi mai ban sha'awa da aka gabatar a taron Royal Society yana cewa Duniya na iya kwace watanta daga Venus. Ra'ayin, wanda Farfesa Dave Stevenson daga jami'ar Caltech ya gabatar, yana nuna cewa Duniya ta ja wata daga zagayen Venus zuwa nata. Farfesa Stevenson ya bayyana a taron Origin of the Moon a birnin London cewa girman watarmu idan aka kwatanta da Duniya yana iya nuna wannan yana iya faruwa. "Abin da ke sa wannan abin sha'awa shi ne Duniya da Venus suna kusa da juna," inji Stevenson ga Space.com. "Suna da nauyin kusan daya kuma an yi zaton an kirkire su a hanya daya." Amma akwai babbar matsala: kamanceceniya a kimiyyar kasa tsakanin samfurorin dutsen Duniya da na wata tana kara karfafa ra'ayin 'bugu da hamada' da aka fi amincewa da shi. Wannan ra'ayi na cewa an kirkiri wata kusan shekaru biliyan 4.56 da suka gabata lokacin da wani duniyar girman Mars ya buga da Duniya. Venus kadan ya fi karami da Duniya amma yana da nauyi kusan daya. Shi ne na biyu mafi kusa da rana, yana da tazarar kimanin kilomita miliyan 108. Ranar daya a kan Venus tana da tsawon kwana 243 a Duniya, kuma yanayinsa mai kauri da guba yana dauke da carbon dioxide da nitrogen, da gajimare cike da iskar sulfuric acid. Babu wata hujja da ke nuna akwai rai a Venus, kuma zafin saman sa kusan 480°C yana sa rayuwa a cikinsa ba ta yiwuwa. "Don haka tambayar ita ce, tun da Duniya da Venus sun samu iri daya, me yasa Duniya ke da Wata amma Venus ba ta da shi?" inji Farfesa Stevenson. Ya kara da cewa ba ya da tabbacin wannan sabon ra'ayi, amma yana ganin yana da ban sha'awa. A ra'ayin 'bugu da hamada', yawancin gwaje-gwaje na kwamfuta sun nuna kusan kaso 80 cikin 100 na watar ya fito daga wanda ya buga da Duniya, kashi 20 daga Duniya kanta. Wani sabon ra'ayi na daban, daga mai nazarin duniyoyi Wim van Westrenen, yana cewa wata babbar fashewa kamar ta bama-baman atomik biliyan 40 daga cikin zuciyar Duniya ne ya haifar da wata kusan shekaru biliyan 4.5 da suka wuce. Van Westrenen yana cewa hujjoji sun nuna wata da Duniya asali guda ne da aka fitar da wani bangarensa zuwa sararin samaniya bayan wata gagarumar fashewa.

article_content: Sebastian Kinasiewicz, a 32-year-old Polish military officer, died after falling near the summit of Oregon's Mount Hood. He went missing after not returning from his climb last Sunday, prompting his roommate to report him missing the following day. Authorities discovered his car at a trailhead, but initial searches along two climbing routes found no trace of him. The search resumed with a helicopter that could detect international cellphone signals, according to Sergeant Pete Hughes of the Hood River County sheriff's office. Kinasiewicz brought water and warm clothing but lacked a sleeping bag and food, so he was unprepared for an overnight stay. Weather conditions were not immediately hazardous, with hypothermia and moisture risk being low, Hughes said. Kinasiewicz was considered an inexperienced climber but had some survival training. Search teams—including one with 13 members—and a National Guard helicopter participated in the effort. He was in the U.S. for drone training at Insitu Inc. in Bingen, Washington. After confirmation of his death, Insitu spokeswoman Jill Vacek extended condolences to his family. Mount Hood is Oregon's tallest mountain and the fourth-highest in the Cascade Range. While popular with climbers, the mountain is notoriously dangerous—especially in summer when melting ice destabilizes rocks. Since at least 2003, there have been more than 130 climbing-related deaths on Mount Hood. Recently, the mountain saw more fatalities: professional snowboarder Collin Backowski of Colorado died in August after getting trapped in a collapsed ice tunnel, and Salem dentist Dr. Kinley K. Adams was found dead near the summit in June after a failed climbing attempt.

Ya bace ne bayan bai dawo daga hawansa ba a ranar Lahadi, abokin zamansa ya kai rahoto ranar da ta biyo baya. Jami’ai sun gano motarsa a bakin hanyar hawa dutsen, amma binciken farko a hanyoyi biyu bai kai zuwa gare shi ba. Binciken ya ci gaba da jirgin sama mai gano siginar wayar kasashe, a cewar Sajan Pete Hughes daga ofishin sheriff na Hood River County. Yanayi bai kawo barazana kai tsaye ba, saboda garwashi ko danshi ba suna daga cikin hadarin, inji Hughes. Kinasiewicz ba babba ko gogaggen mai hawa dutsen bane amma yana da dan horo na tsira daga hatsari. Kungiyoyin ceto, har da wata tawaga mai mutum 13, da National Guard jirgin sama suka shiga binciken. Bayan tabbatar da rasuwarsa, Jill Vacek, mai magana da yawun Insitu, ta mika ta’aziyya ga iyalinsa. Mount Hood shi ne mafi tsawon dutse a Oregon kuma na hudu mafi tsawo a jerin tsaunukan Cascade. Adams, kusa da kolo bayan hawan da bai dawo ba.

article_content: Research from Whichairline.com shows that Pegasus Airlines, based in Turkey, currently offers the most affordable average flight prices in Europe at around £51.60 per ticket. Notably, Pegasus holds onto this top spot even when factoring in the cost of checking a 20kg bag. In contrast, Ryanair's rank falls behind carriers like Air Lituanica, Vueling, germanwings, and Wizz Air once baggage fees are included. For travelers searching for the absolute cheapest deals, Asia is the place to look. The Malaysian airline Firefly boasts the lowest total fares worldwide — including checked baggage — at less than half the price of Pegasus’s average fare. Other budget Asian airlines such as AirAsia and Tiger are mentioned among the global top ten, though they don’t take the top two spots. When judged purely on ticket price, Pegasus ranks ninth among all low-cost airlines globally but moves up to seventh place once the 20kg luggage fee is added. Meanwhile, with luggage, Ryanair drops down to nineteenth in the worldwide low-cost carrier ranking. The whichairline.com rankings also provide average price details among leading European budget airlines: Wizz Air, Volotea, Air Lituanica, Vueling, germanwings, Air One, Blue Air, easyJet, and flybe, with fares ranging from just over £51 to nearly £88 per flight.
translated_content: Binciken Whichairline.com ya nuna cewa Pegasus Airlines daga Turkiyya ce ke da mafi arha farashin tikitin jirgi a Turai, inda matsakaicin tikiti ke kusan £51.60. Pegasus ta ci gaba da zama kan gaba har da kudin akwati mai nauyin kilo 20. Amma Ryanair, idan aka ƙara kuɗin jakar kaya, sai yake bayan Air Lituanica, Vueling, germanwings, da Wizz Air. Ga masu neman mafi rahusa, Asiya ce babban zaɓi. Jirgin sama na Firefly daga Malaysia ya fi kowa araha a duniya: Tikitin da akwati ya kasance bai kai rabin na Pegasus ba. Kamar AirAsia da Tiger suma suna cikin goma mafi araha a duniya, duk da ba su na farko ba. Idan aka duba farashin tikiti kaɗai, Pegasus tana matsayi na tara a duniya; idan aka haɗa kuɗin kayan kilo 20, sai ta hau na bakwai. Ryanair kuwa, idan an ƙara kaya, tana fāɗuwa har zuwa matsayi na goma sha tara a jerin kamfanonin masana'ar jirgin sama masu rahusa a duniya. Jerin daga Whichairline.com ya kuma fayyace matsakaitan farashin tikiti na manyan kamfanonin jirgin sama masu rahusa a Turai kamar Wizz Air, Volotea, Air Lituanica, Vueling, germanwings, Air One, Blue Air, easyJet da flybe — inda farashin ke tsakanin £51 zuwa £88 kowanne balaguro.
post_content: Looking for Europe’s cheapest flights? Pegasus tops the list, but you’ll save even more in Asia — Malaysia’s Firefly has the lowest fares (including baggage)! #TravelSmart #CheapFlights

article_content: Retailers are intensifying efforts to attract holiday shoppers, offering deep discounts as Black Friday launches after Thanksgiving. While this tradition is spreading in Europe and other markets, this year's event occurs amid ongoing economic uncertainty and persistent inflation. Consequently, stores are under pressure to lure US shoppers wary after ongoing inflation and the lingering effects of the COVID-19 pandemic. Black Friday is followed by Cyber Monday, with both days aiming to attract bargain hunters in stores and online. On Friday morning, crowds rushed through the doors at Macy's flagship Manhattan store after a 6 a.m. opening, eager for deals and the festive mood. Shopper Sandee Foster, 74, remarked, 'It's Black Friday, and there are great sales. There's no better place than Manhattan to go shopping at Christmas time.' Another customer, Cristina Carradero, 30, from Puerto Rico, described her tradition of shopping with her mother, saying, 'We're just having a different kind of version here in New York.' Meanwhile, Amazon faced strikes at locations in the UK, Germany, and Italy, as workers demanded improved wages and conditions during the shopping surge. The National Retail Federation (NRF) forecasts that more than 182 million US consumers will shop in stores and online this weekend, surpassing last year's turnout by 16 million and marking a record since tracking began in 2017. Retailers began Black Friday promotions earlier than ever—some as early as October—illustrating fierce competition for consumer attention online. Many experts predict shoppers will be cautious, prioritizing discounted items. Hot products include Lego, Hot Wheels, Barbie, popular game consoles, virtual reality headsets like Meta Quest 3, and the latest iPhones and tablets. Randy Allen, senior lecturer at Cornell's SC Johnson College of Business, stated, 'Consumers will not sit out, but they will spend less.' Some are likely to hold off on major purchases, waiting for deeper discounts closer to Christmas. Experts suggest the best deals might emerge in December. Neil Saunders, managing director at GlobalData, noted that shoppers are selective, focusing on things they truly want or need. Retailers are targeting discounts to specific products instead of widespread markdowns. Economists have voiced concerns about a potential US recession, but consumer spending has shown resilience. The NRF expects holiday sales growth of 3 to 4 percent, returning to pre-pandemic trends. Although inflation has cooled compared to last year, interest rates remain at a 22-year high, making credit card debt more expensive. Reduced household savings and resumed student loan payments have tightened budgets further. Despite a strong job market with unemployment under 4%, recent layoffs and smaller bonuses in sectors like consulting, banking, and technology could affect retail sales.
translated_content: ’Yan kasuwa suna ƙara ƙoƙari wajen ja hankalin masu siyan kyautar hutu, suna samar da rangwame masu yawa yayin da aka fara Black Friday bayan bikin Thanksgiving. Yayin da wannan al’ada ke ƙara bazuwa a Turai da wurare masu yawa, bana ta kasance cikin yanayin rashin tabbas na tattalin arziki da hauhawar farashi. Saboda haka, shaguna suna fama da matsin lamba don jan hankalin ‘yan Amurka da ke jinkirta kashe kudi saboda hauhawar farashi da tasirin COVID-19. Black Friday na biyo bayan Cyber Monday, inda kowanne ke jan hankalin masu neman ragi a shaguna da yanar gizo. Da safiyar Juma'a, mutane sun yi cunkoso don shiga shagon Macy’s a Manhattan bayan karin 6 na safe, suna neman ragi da jin dadin yanayi na karkaruwa. Sandee Foster mai shekara 74 ta ce, “Black Friday ne, ana kuma da ragi mai yawa. Babu wuri da ya fi Manhattan kyau don siyan kayayyakin Kirsimeti.” Wata kwastoma, Cristina Carradero mai shekara 30 daga Puerto Rico, ta ce al’ada ce a wajenta da mahaifiyarta zarce siyayyar Black Friday, tana mai cewa, “Muna yin salo dabam a nan New York.” A daya bangaren, kamfanin Amazon ya fuskanci yajin aiki a wurare daban-daban a Birtaniya, Jamus da Italiya yayin da ma’aikata ke neman karin albashi da kyakkyawan yanayin aiki a wannan lokacin siyayya. Kungiyar National Retail Federation (NRF) na hasashen fiye da mutane miliyan 182 a Amurka za su yi siyayya a shaguna da yanar gizo a karshen mako—adadi wanda ya fi na bara da miliyan 16 kuma ya sa tarihi tun bayan fara kididdiga a 2017. ’Yan kasuwa sun fara tallata Black Friday tun da wuri – wasu tun Oktoba – abin da ke nuna gasa mai tsanani wajen ja hankalin masu siyayya a yanar gizo. Masana na ganin mafi yawan masu siyayya za su tsaya ne kan kayayyakin da ke da rangwame. Kayayyakin da suka fi daukar hankali sun hada da Lego, Hot Wheels, Barbie, na’urorin wasa, Meta Quest 3, da sabbin iPhones da tablets. Masana na ganin mafi kyawun rangwame na fitowa Disamba. Neil Saunders, babban darakta a GlobalData, ya ce masu siyayya za su fi tantance kayayyaki – su sayi abin da suke so ko bukata kawai. article_content: In Sanford, Florida, George Zimmerman told his attorneys he whispered the word 'punks,' not a racial slur, in the moments before he shot Trayvon Martin, according to a statement they gave CNN on Thursday. Some listeners believe portions of Zimmerman's 911 call suggest the shooting was racially motivated, but his attorneys, Hal Ulrig and Craig Sonner, said their client clarified that he said, 'f---ing punks.' Forensic audio expert Tom Owen, after analyzing the 911 recordings, agreed that the disputed word was 'punks,' not the slur that some people thought they heard. Using software to reduce cell phone interference, Owen found the word became clearer. He consulted with linguists and said he became convinced Zimmerman said 'punks.' CNN received a copy of this processed audio. CNN enhanced the 911 audio further, and reviews by several members of CNN’s editorial staff could not reach a consensus on whether Zimmerman used a slur. Trayvon Martin’s family and supporters allege Zimmerman, who is Hispanic, profiled Martin, a black teenager, as 'suspicious' and disregarded a dispatcher’s instruction not to follow him. Martin did not live in Sanford, but was visiting with his father, whose fiancée resides in Zimmerman’s neighborhood. Zimmerman, aged 28, shot Martin, 17, fatally on February 26. The incident ignited a national debate on Florida’s 'Stand Your Ground' law, racial profiling, and race relations. While Zimmerman's lawyers welcome Owen’s analysis, they disagree with some of his conclusions regarding another 911 call. Zimmerman has maintained, supported by family members and police reports, that he was shouting for help, as reported first by The Orlando Sentinel and later confirmed by Sanford police. However, Martin’s relatives, including his cousin Ronquavis Fulton, have repeatedly stated they are sure the yelling voice on the call is Martin’s. Audio experts Tom Owen and Ed Primeau both analyzed the call for the Sentinel using different methods and concluded it is unlikely the screams belonged to Zimmerman. Their analysis compared those screams to Zimmerman’s voice from his earlier 911 call about a 'suspicious' black male. 'There’s a strong chance this is not Zimmerman’s voice,' said Primeau, an experienced audio engineer recognized by the American College of Forensic Examiners International. Owen also doubted the screams were Zimmerman's, but said he could not compare them to Martin's voice as he did not have a sample. Using voice analysis software, Owen found a 48% likelihood it was Zimmerman, but said at least 60% is needed to be confident in a match. Both experts, who have testified in court about audio evidence, said they cannot definitively identify who was screaming. Reporting contributed by CNN’s Martin Savidge and Tristan Smith.

Wasu sun fahimta daga kiran 911 da Zimmerman ya yi cewa harbin yana da alaka da wariyar launin fata, amma lauyoyinsa, Hal Ulrig da Craig Sonner, sun ce abokin aikinsu ya fayyace ya ce, 'f---ing punks.' Kwararren masanin sauti, Tom Owen, bayan ya binciki rikodin kiran 911, ya yarda kalmar da ake gardama ita ce 'punks', ba kalmar nuna wariya ba kamar wasu ke zargi. Ta amfani da na'ura domin rage jita-jitar kiran waya, Owen ya ce kalmar ta fi bayyana. Ya tuntubi masu ilimin harshe kuma ya ce hakan ya sa ya tabbatar Zimmerman ya ce 'punks.' Iyalai da masoya Trayvon Martin na zargin Zimmerman, wanda ke da asalin Hispanic, da nuna wariyar launi ga Martin, matashi bakar fata, tare da yin watsi da umarnin jami’in ‘dispatcher’ na kada ya bi Martin. Martin bai zama a Sanford ba, amma ya je wurin mahaifinsa, wanda matar da zai aura na zama a unguwar Zimmerman. Zimmerman, mai shekaru 28, ya harbi Martin, dan shekaru 17, har lahira a ranar 26 ga Fabrairu. Wannan lamari ya tada muhawara a faɗin Amurka kan dokar 'Stand Your Ground' ta Florida, batun nuna wariya, da kuma zamantakewar addini da launin fata. Kodayake lauyoyin Zimmerman na maraba da nazarin Owen, sun saba wa wasu daga cikin ra’ayoyin sa dangane da wani kiran 911 daban. Zimmerman ya dage, tare da goyon bayan iyalinsa da rahoton ‘yan sanda, cewa shi ne yake kururuwa neman agaji, kamar yadda The Orlando Sentinel ta fara ruwaito, daga bisani kuma ‘yan sandan Sanford suka tabbatar. Sun kwatanta kururuwar da muryar Zimmerman daga kiran da ya yi a baya da ya bayyana wani matashi bakar fata a matsayin mai zargi. 'Babban yiwuwa ba muryar Zimmerman ba ce,' a cewar Primeau, gogaggen masanin sauti da American College of Forensic Examiners International ta gane da shi. Owen ma ya ce yana zargin ba muryar Zimmerman ba ce, amma bai da samfurin muryar Martin dan kwatanta. Ta amfani da manhajar binciken murya, Owen ya gano yiwuwa kashi 48% cewa muryar Zimmerman ce, amma ya ce akalla 60% ake bukata don tabbatar da kama. Dukkanin kwararrun da suka yi shaida a kotu kan binciken sauti sun ce ba za su iya tabbatar da wa ya kururu ba. Rahoton ya samu gudunmawar Martin Savidge da Tristan Smith na CNN.

article_content: The United States government is suspending most financial assistance to Gabon after a military coup earlier this year overthrew President Ali Bongo Ondimba, whose family led the country for over five decades, according to the State Department. The formal designation of a coup d'état comes nearly two months after Bongo's ousting. State Department spokesperson Matthew Miller stated Monday, 'We underscore that our humanitarian, health, and education assistance will continue to benefit the people of Gabon.' Foreign aid to Gabon had already been temporarily paused as of September 26, the statement noted. "We will resume our assistance alongside concrete actions by the transitional government toward establishing democratic rule," Miller added. Ali Bongo Ondimba had served two presidential terms starting in 2009 after the death of his father, who ruled Gabon for 41 years. In 2019, another group of mutinous soldiers attempted a coup but was quickly subdued. Once a French colony, Gabon is a member of OPEC, but most of its oil wealth is held by a small elite. Around 40% of Gabonese aged 15 to 24 were unemployed in 2020, according to the World Bank. Earlier this month, the U.S. similarly suspended counterterrorism aid and military training to Niger more than two months after soldiers there seized power.

Sunan juyin mulki na hukuma ya zo kusan watanni biyu bayan kifar da Bongo. Mai magana da yawun Ma'aikatar Harkokin Waje, Matthew Miller, ya bayyana a ranar Litinin: 'Muna jaddada cewa tallafin jin ƙai, lafiya da ilimi zai ci gaba da amfani ga al'ummar Gabon.' An riga an dakatar da tallafin wucin gadi ga Gabon tun ranar 26 ga Satumba, kamar yadda sanarwar ta bayyana. "Za mu dawo da tallafinmu idan gwamnatin rikon kwarya ta ɗauki matakai na gaskiya don kafa mulkin dimokiradiyya," in ji Miller. Ali Bongo Ondimba ya yi wa'adi biyu tun daga 2009 bayan rasuwar mahaifinsa wanda ya shugabanci Gabon na tsawon shekaru 41. A 2019 wasu sojojin tawaye suma sun yi ƙoƙarin yin juyin mulki amma aka ci galaba a kansu da sauri. Gabon tsohuwar mallakar Faransa ce kuma memba a OPEC, amma mafi yawan arzikin man fetur yana hannun wasu kaɗan. Kusan kashi 40% na matasan Gabon masu shekaru 15 zuwa 24 basu da aikin yi a 2020, a cewar Bankin Duniya. A farkon wannan wata, Amurka ta kuma dakatar da tallafin yaki da ta’addanci da horon soji ga Nijar fiye da watanni biyu bayan sojoji suka kwace mulki.

article_content: A massive, coordinated operation involving 14 specialist teams and 45 days of surveillance led to the arrest of Colombia’s infamous crime boss Daniel 'El Loco' Barrera in Venezuela, according to Venezuelan officials. Venezuelan Justice and Interior Minister Tareck El Aissami outlined the operation in San Cristobal, revealing it kicked off after Colombian authorities shared Barrera’s whereabouts with Venezuela on August 6. In response, Venezuelan intelligence units spread out across multiple states and the capital, focusing efforts on tracking his movements. The investigation included monitoring 69 public phones, believed to be used by Barrera’s associates to conduct drug business, since he scarcely made calls himself. The arrest was publicly confirmed by Colombian President Juan Manuel Santos, who called Barrera one of the last of Colombia’s notorious drug bosses. Santos credited US, British, Colombian, and Venezuelan agencies for the successful operation, highlighting international cooperation. However, Venezuela’s justice minister referred only to domestic and Colombian involvement, omitting mention of the US and UK. Relations between the US and Venezuela over anti-drug collaboration remain strained after Venezuela expelled DEA agents in 2005, with American authorities often critical of Venezuela’s enforcement efforts. El Aissami claimed this high-profile operation demonstrates Venezuela's commitment to fighting drug trafficking. Barrera was found carrying a fake passport under the name 'Jose Tomas Lucumi Popo', and is believed to have had plastic surgery several times to alter his appearance and evade capture. In 2010, Colombian authorities seized over $29 million and 17 million euros from Barrera’s houses, the nation's biggest cash haul from drug-related crime to date. Barrera is considered by US authorities as a major international drug trafficker. The US Treasury offered a $2.5 million reward for his capture, and federal prosecutors in Florida charged him with plotting to manufacture and distribute narcotics destined for the US—a conviction could see him sentenced to life in prison.
translated_content: Babbar aiki ce da aka hada kai da tawaga 14 na kwararru da bincike na tsawon kwanaki 45, wanda ya kai ga kama shahararren shugaban laifi daga Colombia, Daniel 'El Loco' Barrera, a Venezuela, in ji jami'an Venezuela. Ministan shari'a da cikin gida, Tareck El Aissami, ya bayyana yadda aka aiwatar da aikin a birnin San Cristobal, yana cewa an fara komawa bayan hukumomin Colombia sun samar wa Venezuela da bayanan inda Barrera yake tun daga 6 ga watan Agusta. Bayan haka, hukumomin leken asiri na Venezuela suka bazu a jihohi daban-daban da babban birni, suna kai dauki don gano inda yake. Sun kuma saka idanu kan layukan waya 69 na jama'a da ake zargin abokan aikinsa ke amfani da su wajen gudanar da harkokin miyagun kwayoyi, tun da shi Barrera baya yin kira da kansa. Shugaban Colombia, Juan Manuel Santos, ya bayyana kama Barrera da cewa shi ne daya daga cikin manyan shugabannin miyagun kwayoyi na karshe. Santos ya ce aiki ne da hadin kan hukumomin Amurka, Burtaniya, Colombia, da Venezuela, yana mai nuna cewar hadin kai ya taka rawa. Amma ministan Venezuela bai ambaci Amurka da Burtaniya ba, yana kallon shi a matsayin iho tsakanin Colombia da Venezuela kadai. Dangantaka tsakanin Amurka da Venezuela na ci gaba da fuskantar matsala musamman tun bayan korar jami'an DEA a shekarar 2005, inda Amurka ke sukar matakan yaki da kwayoyi na Venezuela. El Aissami ya ce kama Barrera alama ce ta hangen nesa da jajircewar Venezuela wajen yaki da safarar miyagun kwayoyi. An samu Barrera da fasfotin bogi mai suna 'Jose Tomas Lucumi Popo', kuma an yi zargin ya sha tiyata don canza fuska a kasashen biyu don tserewa hukuma. A 2010, jami'an Colombia sun kwace fiye da dala miliyan 29 da euro miliyan 17 daga gidajen Barrera, wanda aka ce shine mafi girman kudin da aka taba kwato daga safarar miyagun kwayoyi a kasar. Barrera yana cikin jerin manyan masu safarar miyagun kwayoyi a duniya a cewar hukumomin Amurka. An saka lada dala miliyan 2.5 kan wanda ya bayar da bayanan da zai kai ga kama shi, yayin da kotun tarayya ta Florida ta gurfanar da shi bisa zargin hada kai wajen samarwa da safarar kwaya zuwa Amurka—idan aka same shi da laifi, zai iya fuskantar hukuncin daurin rai da rai.

article_content: A wedding became especially memorable when Reverend Roger Scoones, who was officiating, tripped over the bride's dress train and broke his arm right before the couple’s walk down the aisle at St Mary's Church in Stockport. Both the guests and the newlyweds, Katie and Jon-Paul Stoddard, were momentarily alarmed, initially fearing something more serious. Despite his injury, the 66-year-old vicar was assisted up by Jon-Paul and bravely finished the ceremony before heading to the hospital for his broken arm. The accident, which almost led to an embarrassing dress mishap for Katie, quickly became a source of jokes once everyone knew the vicar would be fine. Katie, who works as an administrator, shared her anxiety over the situation and noted her relief that it wasn’t worse. Reverend Scoones later received a cast and faces six weeks of recovery. The couple, who have been together eight years and have two children, had chosen both Reverend Scoones and Reverend Ken Kenrick to conduct the ceremony. By the evening, the vicar’s tumble was the talk of the party, with playful speculation about whether the second vicar had a hand in the mishap. Reverend Scoones later made light of the incident, just happy he could laugh at himself, and described the day as truly unforgettable.

Baki da ma'auratan, Katie da Jon-Paul Stoddard, sun firgita nan take, suna tunanin wani abu mafi tsanani ya faru. Duk da raunin, mai shekara 66, Jon-Paul ya taimaka masa ya mike kuma Reverend ya kammala bikin kafin a kai shi asibiti. Daga baya Reverend Scoones ya dauki komai da wasa, yana mai cewa yana iya yin dariya da kansa, kuma ya bayyana ranar a matsayin abin da ba za a manta da shi ba.

article_content: England may have secured the bragging rights in Tuesday night's friendly at Celtic Park, but the senior team isn't the only Three Lions side facing Scotland this week. The Under-16s will play their final Sky Sports Victory Shield match of the season against Scotland on Thursday evening at Yeovil's Huish Park, with an opportunity to lift the trophy. So far in the tournament, Steve Cooper's young England side lost 1-0 to Wales in Bangor and then beat Northern Ireland 1-0, thanks to a goal from Ipswich Town midfielder Andre Dozzell. The team is currently third in the standings, but a win combined with a favorable result in the Northern Ireland vs Wales game would secure England the Victory Shield for the 36th time since its inception in 1946. Coach Steve Cooper's main priority is to provide his players with valuable international experience and entertain the expected large crowd in Somerset. He has emphasized the importance of both individual development and team bonding among the young squad. For this match, Cooper has called up several players from the previous games against Wales and Northern Ireland, and given first call-ups to Manchester City defender Diego Lattie and Arsenal forward Reiss Nelson. The squad includes familiar footballing surnames such as Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea), brother of Nathaniel (on loan at Burnley), and Joe Willock (Arsenal), the younger brother of Chris Willock. England captain Wayne Rooney, who recently earned his 100th international cap, once played in the 2001 Victory Shield and scored his first goal for the England youth team in this competition, providing inspiration for the current squad. Both Thursday night’s Victory Shield matches will be broadcast live on Sky Sports 5: Northern Ireland vs Wales at 6pm, and England vs Scotland at 8pm. Tickets for the England match at Huish Park cost £3 for adults and £1 for concessions, available by phone (01935 847888), email (ticketoffice@ytfc.net), or at the door. article_content:
Dutch photographer Bas Losekoot uniquely explores the interactions of people in busy urban settings through candid photography. He is interested in how life in crowded cities influences human behavior and emotions. Using his classical training and inspiration from cinematic lighting, Losekoot employs small, portable flashes, often mounting them on available street fixtures, to dramatize spontaneous city scenes and ordinary moments.

His fascination with city life grew when global urbanization accelerated, an era marked by the United Nations' 2007 announcement that over half of the world’s population lived in cities. Beginning in New York, Losekoot took his project to Sao Paulo, Seoul, Mumbai, and Hong Kong, choosing each location for its density, economic activity, and urban growth. Currently based in London, he continues his photography while pursuing a master's degree in photography and urban cultures.

For Losekoot, the city streets become a stage. He tries to remain unnoticed so he can capture authentic interactions, with everyday people naturally becoming subjects in his visual storytelling. By focusing on places with high population density, he seeks to uncover the subtle ways people connect or withdraw amid the fast-paced city environment.

His images encourage reflection on how urbanization shapes our relationships and identities. Although his photographs don't provide concrete answers, they invite viewers to think about what our gestures and interactions reveal about urban life. Losekoot’s work transforms fleeting moments on the street into powerful visual stories that question how we adapt to—and coexist in—modern cities.
translated_content:
Bas Losekoot, mai daukar hoto daga kasar Holland, yana binciko rayuwar mutane a birane ta hanyar daukar hotunan da ba a tsara ba. Yana nazarin yadda cinkoson birane ke shafar halayen mutane da yadda suke bayyana abubuwan da suke ji. Da horo na gargajiya da fasaha daga fina-finai, Losekoot yana amfani da kananan fitilu a tituna, yana dasa su a sanduna ko karafa don daukar hotuna masu ban sha’awa na lokuta na yau da kullum.

Sha’awarsa game da birane ta karu lokacin da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta sanar a 2007 cewa fiye da rabin al’ummar duniyan suna rayuwa a birane. Ya fara aikin a New York, sannan ya yada zuwa Sao Paulo, Seoul, Mumbai, da Hong Kong, yana zaɓen biranen saboda yawan jama’a, karfin tattalin arziki da saurin ci gaba. Yanzu haka yana London yana ci gaba da aikin da karatun digiri na biyu a fannin daukar hoto da al’adun birane.

A wajen Losekoot tituna suna zama dandali; yana sauya kansa don kama halayen mutane wajen shigarsu titin. Ta hankali ga wuraren masu yawan jama’a, yana kokarin fahimtar yadda mutane ke yin hulda da juna cikin hayaniyar gari.

Hotunansa suna sa mu tunani game da yadda rayuwar birane ke shafar alakar mu da juna. Ko da yake hotunan ba sa ba da amsa kai tsaye, suna gayyata ga masu kallo suyi nazari akan abubuwan da mu’amala ke nuna mana game da rayuwar birni. Aikin Losekoot na sauya lokutan yau da kullum na titi zuwa manyan labarai da ke tambayar yadda muke zaune a cikin sabbin biranenmu.

article_content:
James Alexander Gordon, one of the BBC's most recognisable voices over the last forty years, is retiring from reading the classified football results on radio after surgery to remove his larynx due to throat cancer. At 77, Gordon has captivated and moved listeners on Radio 2 and later on Radio 5 Live with his distinctive delivery, but after his surgery, his voice is no longer strong enough for broadcasting.

Known affectionately as JAG, Gordon joined the BBC in 1972 and became a household name on British radio. "It's with great sorrow that I have to give up the most exciting part of my career, the classified football results," said the Edinburgh-born presenter. "They have been my life."

Listeners often grew to anticipate the fortunes of their favourite football teams simply by the inflection in Gordon’s reading, though he readily admitted he knew little about football aside from the scores. Just last year, he insisted he had no plans to step down: "I keep telling the BBC they will have to carry me out on a stretcher. I'll die with the microphone in my hand," he quipped in an interview.

However, following his successful surgery, the BBC announced, "sadly his voice is now not strong enough to broadcast." Richard Burgess, head of BBC Radio Sport, said, "This is desperately sad news for everyone at BBC Sport and we know our sadness will be shared by many millions of listeners. Saturdays at 5pm will never be the same again without James's warm, melodious voice after the Sports Report theme on BBC Radio 5 Live. His voice has been recognised around the world through the BBC World Service, embodying authority, clarity, and charm. For so many, James has been a reliable and reassuring weekly presence — a broadcasting legend."

Fellow presenter Mark Pougatch remarked, "Even those who aren’t interested in football know who James is, whether they realise it or not. His unique style, inflections, and emphasis meant even the uninitiated could tell the outcome after the home team’s score. Nobody else delivers ‘Wolverhampton Wanderers’ quite like him. To us at BBC Radio Sport, he’s JAG — an institution, a legend, and a gentleman."

Gordon contracted polio as a child and required leg supports until his late teens. He officially retired from the BBC years ago but continued working as a freelancer, having originally joined the BBC as an announcer and newsreader after a career in music publishing. He began reading the football results in 1974.

James Alexander Gordon, ɗaya daga cikin sanannun muryoyin BBC sama da shekaru arba’in, ya yi ritaya daga karanta sakamakon wasannin ƙwallon kafa a rediyo bayan an cire masa hanjin makogwaro saboda cutar sankarar makogwaro. Yana da shekaru 77, Gordon ya burge da kuma faranta wa masu sauraro a Radio 2 da daga baya a Radio 5 Live ta hanyar irin lafazi da salonsa na musamman, amma bayan tiyatar, muryarsa ba ta ƙara da ɗaukar nauyin watsa shirye-shirye ba.

Ana kiransa JAG, Gordon ya shiga BBC a 1972 kuma ya yi suna a rediyon Burtaniya. "Cike da bakin ciki nake sanar da cewa dole ne in daina mafi daɗin sashen aikina, karatun sakamakon ƙwallo," in ji Gordon, dan Edinburgh. "Wannan ne ya zama rayuwata."

Wasu masu sauraro kan gane labarin ƙungiyarsu daga yadda Gordon ke karantawa, kodayake ya taba fadar cewa shi ba ya da sani sosai game da ƙwallo face sakamakon. Har bara ma ya ce bashi da niyyar dainawa: "Ina ta fadawa BBC sai dai su fito da ni a gadon asibiti. Zan mutu da makirufo a hannu," in ji shi a hira.

Amma bayan tiyatar da aka samu nasara, BBC ta ce, "abin takaici, muryarsa yanzu ba ta da ƙarfi don ci gaba da watsa labarai." Richard Burgess, shugaban BBC Radio Sport, ya ce, "Wannan labari ne mai matuƙar tausayi ga kowa a BBC Sport kuma mun san da dama daga cikin masu sauraro za su damu kamar yadda mu ke ji. Asabar da karfe 5 na yamma ba za ta kasance iri daya ba ba tare da muryar James mai daɗin ji bayan taken Sports Report a BBC Radio 5 Live ba. Muryarsa ta shahara a duniya ta BBC World Service, tana nuna iko, tsabta, da ƙayatarwa. Ga da dama, James ginshiƙi ne mai tabbaci a kowane mako – gwarzo a watsa labarai."

Mark Pougatch, mai gabatarwa a 5 Live Sport, ya ce, "Ko waɗanda ba sa sha’awar ƙwallo ma suna sanin waye James, koda ba su sani ba. Salo da lafazi da kawowa tasa duk wanda ya ji zai iya gane yadda sakamakon ya kasance. Ba wanda zai iya fadar ‘Wolverhampton Wanderers’ kamar yadda Gordon ke fadi. A BBC Radio Sport, JAG ne – ginshiƙi, gwarzo, kuma mutum mai kirki."

A ƙuruciyarsa, Gordon ya sha fama da shan inna (polio) har sai bayan samartaka. Ya yi ritaya daga BBC shekara da suka wuce amma ya ci gaba da aiki da kansa, bayan ya soma a BBC a matsayin mai karanta labarai daga baya bayan aiki a wallafar waƙoƙi. Ya fara karanta sakamakon ƙwallo tun 1974.

article_content: Hundreds gathered outside the Israeli embassy in Manila to protest the Philippine government's decision to abstain from a United Nations General Assembly vote calling for a humanitarian pause in Gaza. Mohamed Amir, a 20-year-old Filipino-Palestinian, traveled from Pampanga to join others in supporting Palestinians, expressing grave concern for his family members currently in Gaza. Health officials report that over 8,300 Palestinians, including more than 3,400 children, have died in Gaza since October 7. Israeli authorities state that more than 1,400 people, mainly civilians, were killed during the initial Hamas attack. The demonstration followed the Philippine government’s abstention from the UNGA vote on a truce, making the country the only Southeast Asian nation not to back the resolution. The Philippines is also among the top purchasers of Israeli military equipment in the region. Liza Maza, secretary-general of the International League of Peoples' Struggle, strongly criticized President Ferdinand Marcos Jr’s administration for remaining silent on the situation in Gaza and for continuing to buy weapons from Israel. Protesters confronted police and tore Israeli flags, while some participants like University of the Philippines professor Sol Iglesias urged the government to prioritize humanitarian values and civilian protection. The Department of Foreign Affairs said the abstention was due to wanting the UNGA resolution to also condemn Hamas’s attacks, noting the deaths of three Filipino citizens. President Marcos Jr. has previously voiced support for Israel’s right to defend itself. The Philippines often aligns its foreign policy with the United States, which, along with Israel, holds military agreements with the country. Data from the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute states that the Philippines purchased $275 million in military equipment from Israel between 2018 and 2022.
translated_content: Daruruwan mutane sun taru a kofar ofishin jakadancin Isra’ila a Manila domin nuna adawa da matakin gwamnatin Philippines na kin jefa kuri’a a zaben Majalisar Dinkin Duniya wanda ke kira a dakatar da farmakin soja a Gaza. Mohamed Amir, matashi dan shekara 20 dan asalin Palasdinawa-Philippines, ya taho daga Pampanga domin marawa Palasdinawa baya, yana nuna damuwa sosai kan iyalinsa da ke Gaza. Rahotanni daga hukumar lafiya sun ce fiye da Palasdinawa 8,300 ciki har da yara sama da 3,400 ne suka mutu tun daga 7 ga Oktoba. Hukumomin Isra’ila sun nuna cewa fiye da mutane 1,400, mafi yawansu fararen hula, sun mutu a harin farko da Hamas ta kai. An gudanar da wannan zanga-zanga ne bayan gwamnatin Philippines ta kaurace wa zaben UNGA kan neman tsagaita wuta, wanda hakan ya sa Philippines ta zama kadai kasar kudu maso gabashin Asiya da ba ta goyi bayan kudurin. Masu zanga-zangar sun fuskanci ‘yan sanda tare da yayyaga tuta Isra’ila, yayin da wasu irinsu Farfesa Sol Iglesias daga Jami’ar Philippines suka bukaci gwamnati ta fifita jin kai da kare rayukan fararen hula. article_content: Chirag, the public health awareness initiative of Grewal Eye Institute in Chandigarh, organized a programme on Tuesday to mark World Diabetes Day. The event aimed to highlight major health issues, particularly how diabetes can affect vision. The session featured renowned ophthalmologists: Dr. Jagat Ram (former Director, PGIMER), Dr. M. R. Dogra (former Head of Eye Department, PGIMER), and Dr. S. P. S. Grewal (CEO, GEI). Their goal was to educate the public about diabetes-related vision problems, which can result in partial or total blindness. Doctors underscored the critical importance of regular, comprehensive fundus (retinal) examinations, recommending that the first such exam be done as soon as diabetes is initially diagnosed. They warned that India is experiencing a concerning rise in diabetes cases, which they attribute to longer average lifespans and increasingly sedentary lifestyles. Type 2 diabetes, the most common form and typically diagnosed in people over 30, can be managed with lifestyle changes, medications, or insulin. Diabetic retinopathy—a complication that damages the eye’s retina—is a leading cause of blindness in India. About one-third of individuals with diabetes develop this complication, and one-fifth of those cases progress to vision-threatening diabetic retinopathy (VTDR). Overall, India has an estimated 3 to 4.5 million people living with VTDR. Dr. Jagat Ram addressed the issue of cataract surgery for people with diabetes. He stressed that blood sugar must be controlled prior to surgery to reduce risks, especially for those with diabetic retinopathy. Multifocal intraocular lenses are not recommended for these patients due to higher chances of vision decline. The doctors highlighted the value of proactive treatments—such as anti-VEGF injections, steroids, or laser therapy—both before and after cataract surgery for diabetic retinopathy. These measures, combined with continued, intensive follow-up care, can improve vision and help prevent further loss. They cautioned that delayed detection and intervention for diabetic retinopathy can still lead to lasting vision loss or blindness, even when treatment is available.
translated_content: Chirag, shirin wayar da kan jama'a daga Grewal Eye Institute a Chandigarh, ta shirya wani taro a ranar Talata don bikin Ranar Diabetes ta Duniya. Manufar taron ita ce haskaka muhimman matsalolin lafiya, musamman yadda ciwon suga ke iya shafar gani. Shahararrun likitocin ido ne suka jagoranci zaman: Dr. Jagat Ram (tsohon Darakta, PGIMER), Dr. M. R. Dogra (tsohon Shugaban Sashen Ido, PGIMER), da Dr. S. P. S. Grewal (Shugaba, GEI). Burinsu shi ne ilmantar da jama’a kan matsalolin gani da ciwon suga ke kawo wa, wadanda na iya haifar da rage gani ko makanta gaba ɗaya. Likitocin sun jaddada muhimmancin gwajin ciki na ido (fundus) akai-akai, inda suka ce a fara duba idon tun da farko da an gano mutum na da ciwon suga. Sun bayyana cewa akwai ƙaruwa mai saurin gaske na masu fama da ciwon suga a Indiya, dalilinta kuwa tsawon rayuwa da kuma rashin motsa jiki. Nau’in ciwon suga na biyu da ya fi yawa ga wadanda suka zarce shekaru 30, yana iya samun sauki da gyarawa ta hanyar sauya rayuwa, shan magunguna ko allurar insulin. Diabetic retinopathy—wata matsala da ke lalata kwayar ido—tana cikin manyan dalilan makanta a Indiya. Kusan kashi guda cikin uku na masu ciwon suga na samun wannan matsala, inda kashi daya cikin biyar ke shiga cikin matsanancin yanayi mai barazana ga gani (VTDR). A Indiya, an kiyayata cewa akwai mutane miliyan 3 zuwa 4.5 da ke fama da VTDR. Dr. Jagat Ram ya yi bayani kan tiyatar hazo ga masu ciwon suga. Ya jaddada bukatar a tabbatar daidaiton sukari kafin ayi tiyata, musamman ga masu diabetic retinopathy. Ba a son a yi amfani da tabarau masu raba hangen nesa (multifocal lenses) ga irin wadannan marasa lafiya saboda yawan haɗarin saukar gani. Likitocin sun bayyana amfanin jiga-jigan magunguna—kamar anti-VEGF, steroids ko laser—a kafin da bayan tiyatar hazo ga masu dauke da diabetic retinopathy. Wadannan hanyoyin, tare da kulawa mai tsawo bayan tiyata, na inganta gani da hana asarar gani gaba ɗaya. Sun yi gargaɗi cewa jika da jinkirta gano ko duba diabetic retinopathy kan iya sa a rasa gani ko makanta har abada, koda kuwa an yi jiyya.

Kino Lorber has introduced a new streaming service named Kino Film Collection, offering U.S. subscribers a wide array of films for $6 per month via Prime Video Channels. This subscription presents a blend of recently released movies in theaters and hundreds of curated selections from Kino Lorber’s sizable film library.

Kino Lorber also operates Kino Now, which focuses on rentals and purchases of independent and specialty films. The company has been expanding its digital reach: it acquired MHz Choice in 2022 and recently brought on experienced executives Ed Carroll and Lisa Schwartz. Furthermore, Kino Lorber established a joint venture with First Look Media, facilitating the operation of MHz Choice and Topic streaming platforms.

The new Kino Film Collection, directed by Chief Revenue Officer Lisa Schwartz, launches with highlights that include state-of-the-art 4K restorations of classic films such as The Conformist, as well as acclaimed work by modern filmmakers like Yorgos Lanthimos (Dogtooth), Jafar Panahi (Taxi), and Todd Haynes (Poison). The platform’s archive also features historic works like Metropolis and Battleship Potemkin.

Viewers can expect monthly updates, introducing new theatrical releases such as Chile ‘76, Framing Agnes, and Brainwashed: Sex-Camera-Power, mixed with cult classics and restored favorites. December’s lineup features a restored Millennium Mambo and titles like Songs My Brothers Taught Me, Close to Vermeer, Final Cut, Bacurau, Tokyo Pop, and Two Small Bodies.

Kino Lorber’s leadership underlines their mission to bring distinctive and innovative films from international directors to American audiences. President Richard Lorber says the Kino Film Collection is designed to connect movie lovers with both future classics and celebrated films from the past. Lisa Schwartz highlights the importance of a dedicated hub for rare and independent films, ensuring ongoing accessibility as streaming services evolve.

Wannan sabis na biyan kuɗi yana haɗa sabbin fina-finai da aka nuna a sinima da tarin daruruwan fina-finai daga babbar majallarsu.

Hakanan, suna da dandali mai suna Kino Now da ke mai da hankali kan haya da saye na fina-finai masu zaman kansu da na musamman. Kamfanin ya ci gaba da zuba jari a fannin dijital, inda ya sayi MHz Choice a shekarar 2022 tare da ɗaukar kwararrun shugabanni kamar Ed Carroll da Lisa Schwartz. Sannan, sun kafa haɗin gwiwa da First Look Media domin gudanar da MHz Choice da Topic tare.

Lisa Schwartz, Chief Revenue Officer, ce ke jagorantar wannan sabuwar gidauniya ta Kino Film Collection. Yana dauke da fina-finai masu inganci irin su sabon gyaran 4K na The Conformist, da ayyuka daga sanannun daraktoci kamar Yorgos Lanthimos (Dogtooth), Jafar Panahi (Taxi), da Todd Haynes (Poison). Fina-finan watan Disamba sun haɗa da Millennium Mambo da aka sake gyarawa da Songs My Brothers Taught Me, Close to Vermeer, Final Cut, Bacurau, Tokyo Pop da Two Small Bodies.

Shugabannin Kino Lorber sun mai da hankali wajen kawo fina-finai na musamman da ke cike da ƙirar zamani daga mashahuran daraktoci na duniya ga masu kallo a Amurka. Shugaban kamfanin, Richard Lorber, ya bayyana cewa an ƙirƙiri Kino Film Collection domin ba wa masu son fina-finai damar ganin sababbin fina-finai masu tasowa da tsofaffin fina-finai masu daraja. article_content: Dozens of residents in the small Cape Cod town of Falmouth, Massachusetts, have filed lawsuits alleging that three large wind turbines near their homes are harming their health. In the summer of 2010, the town of Falmouth and Notus Clean Energy installed three 400-foot-tall, 1.63 megawatt wind turbines approximately 1,600 feet from residential properties. Shortly after installation, Sue Hobart, a 57-year-old wedding florist, began experiencing insomnia, dizziness, tinnitus, and severe headaches. She noticed her symptoms disappeared whenever she was away from home. In 2011, a Harvard Medical School physician diagnosed Hobart with 'wind turbine syndrome,' a term for a disputed set of symptoms believed by some to be caused by wind turbines. This syndrome is not recognized by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Dr. Nina Pierpont, a pediatrician, coined the term and self-published a 2009 book documenting case studies of those reporting illnesses due to proximity to turbines. Her work has faced criticism for small sample sizes, lack of control groups, and absence of peer review. Sue Hobart and her husband filed a nuisance claim against Notus Clean Energy in February, seeking $150,000–$300,000 in damages for decreased property value and medical expenses. Dan Webb, owner of Notus, maintains the turbines met rigorous regulatory review, and attorney Michael O'Neill stated that scientific studies show such turbines do not cause significant adverse health effects. Notus claims that over three years, their turbines have prevented more than 7,000 tons of carbon dioxide emissions compared to traditional power plants. The company also states that their nearest turbine is at least 1,700 feet from the nearest home, farther than state requirements. Wind turbines harness wind energy to generate electricity, with large ones able to power up to 600 homes. Wind energy production has quadrupled globally from 2000-2006, and turbines are a major renewable energy source worldwide. A Massachusetts state study and a 2010 Australian study found minimal or no evidence of adverse health impacts from wind turbines, describing them as an 'annoyance' at most. Neil and Betsy Anderson, former green energy supporters in Falmouth, also reported symptoms such as tinnitus, migraines, and palpitations after turbines were installed nearby. They insist their symptoms are physical, while some experts suggest psychological explanations. After going public with her complaints, Sue Hobart reported her home's value dropped by half, and she was forced to move. The debate over health effects of wind turbines continues, with conflicting viewpoints from residents, health authorities, and industry representatives.
translated_content: Dimbin mazauna garin Falmouth, Cape Cod, Massachusetts, sun shigar da kara suna zargin cewa turbin din iska guda uku da ke kusa da gidajensu na cutar su. A bazarar 2010, garin Falmouth da kamfanin Notus Clean Energy sun kafa manyan turbin din iska guda uku masu tsawon kafa 400, kowanne na samar da megawatt 1.63, kimanin kafa 1,600 daga gidajen mutane. Bayan dan lokaci kadan da aka kafa turbin din, Sue Hobart, mai shekaru 57 wacce ke aikin tsara furanni a bikin aure, ta fara fama da rashin barci, jiri, masasaukin karar kunne, da matsanancin ciwon kai. Ta lura cewa wadannan alamun sai idan tana gida suke faruwa. A 2011 wani likita daga Harvard Medical School ya tabbatar da cewa Sue na fama da ‘wind turbine syndrome’, wata cuta da ake cece-kuce kan gaskiyarta da wasu ke dangantawa da turbin din iska. Wannan ba cuta ce da hukumar CDC ke gane ta ba. Dr. Nina Pierpont, likita mai kula da yara, ita ce ta kirkiro sunan cutar kuma ta rubuta littafi a 2009 mai dauke da labaran wadanda suka ce turbin din iska ya sa sun kamu da rashin lafiya. An soki wannan bincike kan karancin sahihiyar hanya da rashin gwaji da yawa. Sue Hobart da mijinta sun shigar da kara nuisance akan Notus Clean Energy a watan Fabrairu, suna neman diyya tsakanin dalar Amurka 150,000 zuwa 300,000 saboda ragin darajar gida da kudin magani. Dan Webb, wanda shi ne mai Notus, yace turbin din sun cika duk sharuddan doka, yayin da lauyar kamfanin, Michael O'Neill, yake cewa binciken kimiyya ya nuna turbin din basa haifar da matsalolin lafiya masu muni. Kamfanin Notus ya ce a cikin shekaru uku, turbin dinsu sun rage fitar da hayaki mai guba (carbon dioxide) har tan 7,000 fiye da tsofaffin injuna. Sun kara da cewa mafi kusa da gidansu da turbin shida kafa 1,700 ne, fiye da buƙatar dokar jihar. Turbin din iska na amfani da iska domin samar da wutar lantarki, inda manyan turbin za su iya samar wa har gidaje 600 wutar lantarki. Yawan samar da makamashin iska ya ninka hudu a duniya daga shekarar 2000 zuwa 2006. Nazarin hukumar lafiyar Massachusetts da kungiyar lafiya ta Australia a 2010 ya nuna cewa turbin din iska kan sa damuwa ne kawai ga mutane fiye da matsanancin illa. Neil da Betsy Anderson, wadanda a da ke goyon bayan makamashi mai tsafta a Falmouth, suma sun ce sun soma fama da karar kunne, ciwon kai da bugun zuciya bayan turbin din da ke kusa da gidajensu sun fara aiki. Suna dagewa cewa alamunsu daga jikinsu suke, ko da masana wasu na ganin hakan daga kwakwalwa ne. Bayan ta bayyana damuwarta a fili, Sue Hobart ta ce farashin gidanta ya fadi da rabi, hakan yasa dole ta bar garin. Har yanzu ana tattaunawa tsakanin mazaunan gari, hukumomin lafiya da masana’antu game da tasirin turbin din iska ga lafiyar mutane.

article_content: Few individuals have influenced Pep Guardiola’s celebrated coaching career as profoundly as Juan Manuel Lillo, whom Guardiola regards as his mentor. As Barcelona’s manager, Guardiola secured 14 trophies in just four seasons, crediting much of his success to Lillo. Starting his coaching at age 16, Lillo managed numerous teams over 19 years, including UD Salamanca—where he achieved promotion to Spain’s top division at 29—and Dorados Sinaloa, where Guardiola played his last matches. Their friendship began around the time Salamanca reached the first division under Lillo’s leadership. Lillo’s most recent stint in La Liga ended after an 8-0 loss to Guardiola’s Barcelona while managing Almeria, but he remains a respected football thinker. In a recent CNN World Sport interview, Lillo spoke about his closeness with Guardiola and shared his thoughts on Guardiola’s new challenge at Bayern Munich. When questioned about Guardiola’s possible accomplishments at Bayern, Lillo emphasized that it’s uncertain if trophies will come, but he’s confident the team will benefit from Guardiola’s influence in both gameplay and personal development. Lillo values growth over mere wins. Regarding Bayern as Guardiola’s choice, Lillo said that the club’s existing talent, similar playing style, and strong resources match Pep’s philosophy. He acknowledged Bayern’s significant history and robust squad as positive factors. Recalling Guardiola’s playing career, Lillo admired his tactical awareness and team-oriented mentality, noting these qualities shaped Guardiola’s transition into coaching. Lillo was not surprised by Guardiola’s achievements at Barcelona, pointing out Pep’s gradual progression and contribution to the club’s identity. He noted that while elite players and luck aid success, Guardiola’s leadership and style were crucial. On Guardiola’s motivations for choosing Bayern over other clubs like Chelsea, Lillo believed Pep’s decision was guided by attraction to Bayern’s qualities rather than by others’ shortcomings, emphasizing Guardiola’s authentic approach. As for the future, Lillo stated that Guardiola’s decisions aren’t solely tied to success or challenges; whether he stays or moves on depends on his deeper personal beliefs and values.

A matsayinsa na kocin Barcelona, Guardiola ya lashe kofuna 14 a cikin shekaru hudu, yana danganta nasarorinsa da Lillo. article_content: In Paris, a weathered and cracked bicorne hat that once belonged to Napoleon Bonaparte sold for $2.1 million at a recent auction featuring the French emperor’s memorabilia. The distinct black hat—one of the few confirmed to have been worn by Napoleon during his 19th-century reign and military campaigns—was initially valued between 600,000 and 800,000 euros ($650,000–$870,000). This item was the centerpiece at an auction in Fontainebleau, with objects collected by the late French industrialist Jean-Louis Noisiez. Spirited bidding sent the price swiftly above expectations, and Jean Pierre Osenat, president of the Osenat auction house, eventually announced the victorious bid, prompting applause in the room. "We are at 1.5 million (euros) for Napoleon’s hat ... for this major symbol of the Napoleonic epoch," he declared. The purchaser’s identity has not been disclosed. Factoring in a 28.8% commission, the final cost amounts to approximately 1.9 million euros ($2.1 million). Napoleon was known for wearing his bicorne hats with the points facing his shoulders—a style called “en bataille”—which made it easier for his troops to spot him in the chaos of battle. Auctioneers noted that the hat was initially recovered by Col. Pierre Baillon, quartermaster to Napoleon, and subsequently passed through various hands until it was acquired by Noisiez. Noisiez spent more than fifty years assembling a collection of Napoleonic-era artifacts, including weapons and coins, before his passing in 2022. The auction coincided with heightened interest in Napoleon’s legacy due to the imminent release of Ridley Scott’s film “Napoleon,” featuring Joaquin Phoenix in the lead role.

Ita ce ta fi daukar hankali a kasuwar da aka yi a Fontainebleau, inda aka sayar da kayayyakin Jean-Louis Noisiez, wani attajiri ƴan masana'antu da ya rasu kwanan nan. Farashin ya yi sama sosai, inda shugaban gidan ciniki Osenat, Jean Pierre Osenat, ya sanar da wanda ya ci, abin da ya sa aka yi tafi da murna a dakin. article_content: Schalke took a playful jab at their fierce local rivals Borussia Dortmund after Jurgen Klopp’s side dropped to the bottom of the Bundesliga over the weekend. On its official Twitter account, Schalke posted a doctored league table showing the club in sixth place and Dortmund in 18th, but the post was quickly deleted. Bayern Munich, the current league leaders, also appeared on the table. The post included the caption: 'Keep scrolling. You'll see them soon #MindTheGap,' making light of Dortmund's recent struggles. Dortmund manager Jurgen Klopp was seen consoling Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang following their latest defeat. Schalke’s social media post mocked Dortmund’s league position, highlighting the intensity of the Ruhr derby—a rivalry dating back to 1925. Schalke have enjoyed recent bragging rights, having won the most recent encounter 2-1 in September. Dortmund have picked up just 11 points from 13 games this season. Even the club’s loyal fans began to boo the team after their defeat to Eintracht Frankfurt. On Sunday evening, Borussia Dortmund director of sport Michael Zorc admitted the club is 'in the middle of a relegation fight,' stressing the need for Klopp to quickly turn around their fortunes. Ex-Chelsea manager Roberto Di Matteo is now in charge at Schalke, who have capitalized on their rivals' struggles. Dortmund’s players approached their supporters after their recent defeat, aware of the crisis facing the team. Relegation would be disastrous for the club, so Dortmund must work to lift themselves out of the Bundesliga’s bottom spots.

article_content: Wycombe Wanderers climbed back to the summit of Sky Bet League Two with a narrow 1-0 victory over Hartlepool United, courtesy of Fred Onyedinma’s first-half goal. Onyedinma, currently on loan from Millwall, struck in the 37th minute after collecting possession on the right and firing past Hartlepool’s goalkeeper Scott Flinders. The defeat leaves Hartlepool rooted to the bottom of the table, ten points adrift from safety, with their woes compounded when substitute Lewis Hawkins received a late red card. In other results, Burton Albion rose to second place by defeating Shrewsbury Town—who held the top spot beforehand—1-0, thanks to young defender George Taft’s maiden career goal. Taft found the net with a half-volley from a Matt Palmer corner on the hour mark. Newport County made it up to fourth after overturning a deficit to beat Carlisle United 2-1 at Rodney Parade. Courtney Meppen-Walter gave Carlisle an early lead, but Adam Chapman equalized with a penalty before Lee Minshull clinched the win for Newport. Elsewhere, Southend United’s draw with Northampton Town ended 1-1. Shaquile Coulthirst opened the scoring just after halftime, but Lawson D’Ath equalized to earn Northampton their first point in six matches. Plymouth Argyle, sitting in sixth place, were held to a goalless contest by York City, who had to play with ten men after Stephane Zubar was sent off midway through the first half. Bury’s bid for a play-off spot suffered a setback as they lost 1-0 at Dagenham & Redbridge, who moved out of the relegation zone with Rhys Murphy’s second-half strike—their first league goal in seven hours. Cheltenham Town fans had something to celebrate at last, as Liverpool loanees Jack Dunn and Kevin Stewart each scored on their debuts to secure a 2-1 win over Oxford United. Wes Burns had earlier put Oxford ahead, but Cheltenham’s new signings helped deliver a first league victory in ten games and a maiden win under new manager Paul Buckle. Morecambe’s Jack Redshaw missed from the spot in a stalemate with Stevenage, while Accrington Stanley claimed all three points against Exeter City with Tom Aldred’s dramatic winner in the final minute.

article_content: Physicists at the National University of Singapore (NUS) have developed a new approach to induce and directly measure spin splitting in two-dimensional materials. Using this innovative method, the team achieved strong tunability and high spin-polarization in graphene—a discovery that could significantly advance two-dimensional spintronics and enable the creation of low-power electronic devices. Joule heating, which occurs when electrical current raises a material’s temperature, is a major challenge in modern electronics such as computers and smartphones. One proposed solution is to leverage the ‘spin’ of electrons rather than electrical charge in circuits, which could potentially reduce power consumption and increase speed by minimizing Joule heating. This concept drives the field of spintronics. Graphene is an ideal 2D material for spintronics, with long spin diffusion lengths and long spin lifetimes at room temperature. While not naturally spin-polarized, graphene can display spin-splitting when placed near magnetic materials. However, researchers have faced challenges in directly measuring spin-splitting energy and tuning graphene’s spin properties. A team led by Professor Ariando at NUS developed a new way to directly quantify spin-splitting energy in magnetic graphene using the Landau fan shift—a shift in intercept seen when plotting linear fits of oscillation frequencies against charge carriers in a magnetic field. This technique allows for detailed studies of fundamental material properties. Furthermore, the induced spin-splitting energy can be tuned over a wide range using field cooling. The team observed high spin polarization in graphene and demonstrated its tunability, signaling promise for future 2D spintronic devices aimed at reducing power consumption. Their results have been published in Advanced Materials. To validate their approach, the researchers created a magnetic graphene structure by layering monolayer graphene on the magnetic insulator Tm3Fe5O12 (TmIG). This unique configuration enabled them to use the Landau fan shift to directly measure a spin-splitting energy of 132 meV in magnetic graphene. Further experiments, including field cooling and X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) at the Singapore Synchrotron Light Source, provided deeper insight into spin polarization origins. According to Dr. Junxiong Hu, the paper’s lead author, the work resolves longstanding debates in 2D spintronics by establishing a direct measurement method for spin splitting. Collaboration with Professor Zhenhua Qiao's theoretical group at the University of Science and Technology of China led to first-principles calculations confirming experimental findings. The team also used machine learning to model experimental data, offering greater understanding of tuning spin-splitting energy via field cooling. Professor Ariando emphasized that the research offers a robust platform for generating, detecting, and controlling electron spin in atomically thin materials and demonstrates practical use of artificial intelligence for materials science. He noted that their findings may extend to a variety of other 2D magnetic systems, especially as interest in 2D magnets grows. Looking ahead, the researchers plan to explore how spin current can be manipulated at room temperature, aiming to apply their findings to the development of 2D spin-based logic circuits and magnetic memory or sensory devices. The ability to efficiently tune spin polarization could pave the way for all-electric spin field-effect transistors, promising a new generation of ultrafast, low-power electronics.
translated_content: Masana kimiyya a Jami’ar National University of Singapore (NUS) sun samar da wata sabuwar hanya don cirewa da auna bambance-bambancen tudu (spin splitting) kai tsaye a cikin kayan-noma masu siffar shimfidar takarda (2D materials). Ta amfani da wannan dabarar, tawagar ta samu damar canza tsarin tudu da samun cikakken rarraba tudu sosai a graphene—wannan ya nuna alwashin kawo gagarumin ci gaba a fannin spintronics na 2D, kuma zai taimaka wajen samar da na'urori masu amfani da ƙarancin wuta. Damar zafi (Joule heating), wanda ke faruwa idan wutar lantarki ta daga zafin jikin kayan aiki, kalubale ne na zamani a na’urorin fasaha kamar kwamfutoci da wayoyin hannu. Daya daga cikin mafita shine amfani da ‘tudu’ maimakon caji a cikin zagayen na’ura—wannan zai iya rage amfani da wuta da kara sauri ta hanyar rage ko kawar da damar zafi. Wannan dabarar ce ke kafa tubali ga fannin spintronics. Graphene wani kayan 2D ne mai matukar dacewa da spintronics, saboda yana da nisan yaduwar tudu mai tsawo da kuma dogon rayuwar tudu har a dakin zafi. Ko da yake asalin graphene ba ya da rarraba tudu kai tsaye, ana iya sa shi ya nuna bambancin tudu idan an ajiye shi kusa da kayan da ke da sifa na magnetic. Amma masana sun fuskanci kalubale wajen auna bambancin tudu kai tsaye da kuma daidaita halayen tudu na graphene. Tawagar da Farfesa Ariando daga NUS ke jagoranta ta kirkiro wata dabara don auna bambancin tudu kai tsaye a magnetic graphene ta hanyar wani fasali da ake kira Landau fan shift—wanda ke nuna bambanci lokacin da ake zana jadawalin mitar juyin lokaci da yawan masu dauke da cajin lantarki a cikin filin maganadisu. Wannan hanya tana taimakawa wajen bincike mai zurfi na halayen kayan aiki. Haka kuma, ana iya daidaita bambancin tudu da aka samar cikin faɗi ta hanyar amfani da field cooling. Sun lura da babban rarraba tudu a graphene tare da iyawa wajen daidaita wannan halayen, abinda ke nuna alfanu ga ci gaban na'urorin spintronics na 2D masu amfani da ƙarancin wuta. Sakamakon binciken an wallafa shi a mujallar Advanced Materials. Domin tabbatar da wannan dabarar, masana sun kirkiri tsarin magnetic graphene ta hanyar shimfida monolayer graphene a kan insulator mai maganadisu Tm3Fe5O12 (TmIG). Wannan tsari ya ba su damar amfani da Landau fan shift don auna bambancin tudu kai tsaye na 132 meV a magnetic graphene. Karin bincike da suka hada da field cooling da X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) a cibiyar Singapore Synchrotron Light Source sun kara bayani kan asalin rarraba tudu. Bisa ga Dr. Junxiong Hu, babban marubuci, wannan aikin ya warware muhawara mai tsawo a fannin spintronics na 2D ta hanyar samar da hanyar auni kai tsaye. Hadin gwiwar da kungiyar Farfesa Zhenhua Qiao daga University of Science and Technology of China ya kai ga lissafin farko da suka tabbatar da sakamakon gwaje-gwajen. Sun kuma yi amfani da machine learning wajen daidaita bayanan gwaji, domin kara fahimtar daidaita bambancin tudu ta hanyar field cooling. Farfesa Ariando ya jaddada cewa wannan bincike ya samar da dandalin da ya dace na haifar da, ganowa da sarrafa tudu na electrons a cikin kayan da ke da kauri matukar kankanta, tare da nuna amfanin basirar fasaha a fannin kimiyyar kayan aiki. Ya bayyana cewa, sakamakon ﬁndings din su zai iya fadada zuwa wasu nau’o’in kayan 2D masu sifa na maganadisu yayinda sha’awarsu ke karuwa. Iko daidaita tudu yadda ya kamata zai bude sabon babi na spin field-effect transistor na lantarki, wanda ke nufin samuwar sabuwar zamani na na’ura mai saurin aiki da ƙarancin amfani da wuta.

Toni Kroos has described joining Real Madrid as a 'step up' from Bayern Munich and said his move to Spain is driven by his desire to win more trophies. The former Bayern Munich midfielder signed with Real Madrid for a fee reported to be around £24 million after contract extension talks with Bayern broke down. At 24 years old, Kroos has already won 13 major trophies, including the World Cup, Champions League, Club World Cup, and Bundesliga title.

Speaking to Marca, Kroos emphasized his commitment to success: 'I know how important it is for Real Madrid to win titles, and I'm here to help achieve that.' Despite his impressive record, he says he's eager for more success with his new team, calling the pursuit of trophies an exciting challenge.

Kroos expressed gratitude to both clubs, thanking Bayern Munich for his development and Real Madrid for offering him what he called the chance to join 'the biggest club in the world.' He also paid tribute to Real Madrid legend Alfredo Di Stefano following his passing.

Kroos clarified that his decision to leave Bayern Munich was not influenced by his relationship with Pep Guardiola. He explained that transfer talks had been ongoing but were delayed due to the World Cup: 'There has been contact for a long time, but the World Cup was my main priority. I knew Real were interested, and I wanted to join them.' He added that he informed Germany coach Joachim Löw about his intentions; Löw congratulated him and supported the move to such a 'top-class club.' Kroos reiterated he had no issues with Guardiola, noting the manager's playing style suited him.
translated_content:
Toni Kroos ya bayyana komawarsa Real Madrid a matsayin "mataki gaba" daga Bayern Munich, yana mai cewa koma Spaniya ya yi don samun karin kofuna. Tsohon dan wasan tsakiya na Bayern Munich ya rattaba hannu da Real Madrid kan kudi kimanin £24 miliyan bayan tattaunawar tsawaita kwantiragi da Bayern ta kasa samun masalaha. Kroos, mai shekara 24 kacal, ya riga ya lashe manyan kofuna guda 13, ciki har da Fifa World Cup, Champions League, Club World Cup, da Bundesliga.

A wata hira da jaridar Marca, Kroos ya jaddada cewa: "Na san samun kofi yana da muhimmanci ga Real Madrid, kuma na zo nan ne don in taimaka a kai ga hakan." Duk da gagarumar nasarar da ya riga ya samu, ya ce har yanzu yana sha'awar lashe karin kofuna tare da sabuwar kungiyarsa, yana kiran hakan babban kalubale mai kayatarwa.

Kroos ya nuna godiya ga duka kungiyoyin, inda ya gode wa Bayern Munich saboda taimakonsa a cigaban aikinsa, sannan ya gode wa Real Madrid saboda bas hi damar shiga abinda ya kira 'babbar kungiya a duniya.' Ya mika ta'aziyya ga iyalan shahararren tsohon dan wasa Alfredo Di Stefano bayan rasuwarsa.

Kroos ya bayyana cewa ba alakar sa da Pep Guardiola ta sa ya bar Bayern Munich ba. Ya bayyana an fara tattaunawa tun da dadewa, sai dai an daga lamarin saboda Kofin Duniya: "Tun tuni ana tattauna maganar, amma Kofin Duniya ya fi min muhimmanci a lokacin. Na san cewa Real Madrid ta nuna sha'awa kuma ni ma ina da sha'awa". Ya ce ya sanar da mai horar da Jamus, Joachim Löw, wannan buri; Löw ya aika masa da fatan alheri ya kuma yaba masa a kan komawa irin wannan babbar kungiya. Kroos ya kara nanatawa cewa ba shi da wata matsala da Guardiola, daga ma yana ganin salon wasan kocin ya taimaka masa.

article_content: Kat Von D, a renowned tattoo artist, views her body art as a reflection of her life experiences, visible on her arms, legs, shoulders, and stomach. Tattoos are increasingly accepted in mainstream society. A May poll by NBC News and The Wall Street Journal found that 40% of American households have someone with a tattoo, compared to 21% fifteen years ago. Forbes magazine also noted that tattoos are becoming less controversial in the workplace. Despite this trend, visible tattoos—especially on the face, head, and neck—remain frowned upon in many workplaces. A 2011 Career Builder survey reported that 31% of employers believed visible tattoos hindered an employee’s chances of being promoted. In 2014, the U.S. Army updated regulations to prohibit tattoos on the head, face, neck, wrists, hands, and fingers. Alivia Foley, a tattoo artist in Seattle, has observed increased acceptance but acknowledges visible tattoos, particularly on the face and neck, still draw judgment. Potential employers, law enforcement, and landlords may hold negative perceptions of these tattoos. Foley highlights that highly visible tattoos are often not accepted in professional environments. While celebrities like Mike Tyson, Gucci Mane, Lil Wayne, Rihanna, and David and Victoria Beckham have prominent tattoos, everyday people may still face stigma for similar ink. Tattooing has transitioned from a subculture activity to a widespread trend, but social consequences persist for those with highly visible tattoos. There have been notable moments illustrating this issue. Rapper Drake was upset when a fan tattooed his name on her forehead. Jeremy Meeks, known as the 'Hot Felon,' has had his teardrop tattoo digitally removed in some online images due to negative associations. Foley stresses the importance of tattoo artists discussing consequences with clients considering facial tattoos. She only tattoos faces of clients already heavily tattooed, ensuring they understand the potential social risks. However, some untrained individuals still perform face, head, and neck tattoos. Vin Los, a 24-year-old aspiring model from Montreal, chose facial tattoos after facing repeated rejection from modeling agencies due to his height. Now with over 30 words inked on his body, including twelve on his face, he sees his tattoos as a form of self-expression. Although he faces public scrutiny and has not yet signed with a modeling agency, Los feels more like himself and currently works in a grocery store. Michael Mantell, a psychologist from San Diego, explains that those with visible tattoos often closely identify with their body art, though their boldness may sometimes reflect rebellion more than self-assurance. Mantell and Foley encourage careful thought before getting highly visible tattoos because of society’s ongoing reservations. For people like Los, tattoos are an essential mode of expressing identity—even if society doesn't fully accept them.
translated_content: Kat Von D, shahararriyar mai zane a jiki, tana ganin zanen jikinta a matsayin madubin rayuwarta, wanda ke bayyana a hannaye, ƙafafu, kafadu, da ciki. Yin zane a jiki yana samun karɓuwa sosai yanzu cikin al’umma. Wani binciken NBC News da The Wall Street Journal a watan Mayu ya nuna kaso 40% na gidajen Amurka na da mai zane a gida, idan aka kwatanta da kaso 21% shekaru 15 da suka gabata. Forbes ta ce samun zane a jiki yanzu yana da sauƙi a wurin aiki. Sai dai wuraren aiki da dama na kallon zane musamman a fuska, kai, da wuya da rashin kyau. Binciken Career Builder na 2011 ya ce kaso 31% na masu daukar aiki suna ganin zane a fili zai iya hana karin girma. A shekarar 2014, sojojin Amurka sun samar da doka da ke hana zane a fuska, kai, wuya, wuyan hannu, hannu da yatsu. Alivia Foley, kwararriyar mai zane daga Seattle, ta ce an kara yarda da zane, amma har yanzu zane a fili — musamman a fuska da wuya — na sa jama'a su yi hukunci. Masu daukar aiki, ‘yan sanda, da masu haya na iya duba masu irin wannan zane da rashin kyau. Foley ta bayyana cewa ba kowanne wurin aiki ne ke karɓar zane a fili ba. Duk da cewa shahara da zane irin su Mike Tyson, Gucci Mane, Lil Wayne, Rihanna, da David da Victoria Beckham na iya karɓuwa, talakawa na iya fuskantar wariya. Zane a jiki yanzu ya zama gama-gari, amma matsalolin zamantakewa ga masu zane a fili har yanzu akwai. Wasu misalai sun nuna haka — kamar yadda mafi so mawaki Drake bai ji daɗi ba lokacin da wata masoyarsa ta zana sunansa a goshi; ko hotuna na Jeremy Meeks ('Hot Felon') da aka cire masa zanen hawaye saboda alaƙa da munanan dabi'u. Foley ta jaddada muhimmancin fahimta da bayani ga masu son yin zanen fuska. Tana zana fuska ne kawai ga wadanda har suna da zane a jiki kuma tana tabbatar da sun san illolin zamantakewa. Amma, wasu har yanzu na samun wannan zane daga wadanda ba su da kwarewa. Vin Los, matashi dan shekara 24 mai burin zama samfurin kaya daga Montreal, ya zabi zane a fuska bayan ya samu ƙin amincewa daga kamfanoni saboda gajerensa. Yanzu da fiye da kalmomi 30 a jikinsa, ciki da guda goma sha biyu a fuska, yana cewa hakan hanya ce ta bayyana kansa. Duk da yawan hukunci da bai samu aikin da ya so ba, Los yana jin daɗin kansa kuma yana aiki a shago. Michael Mantell, likitan kwakwalwa daga San Diego, ya ce masu zane a fili sun daɗe suna danganta kansu da zanensu sosai, sai dai wannan jarumta na iya zama tawaye fiye da gamsuwa da kai. Mantell da Foley suna ba da shawara a yi tunani sosai kafin yin zane a fuska ko wurare masu bayyani saboda kallo daga al’umma. Ga irin su Los, zane a jiki muhimmin only na bayyana kansa ne—ko da al’umma ba ta karba ba sosai.

Nearly two-thirds of children aged 9 to 11 now own mobile phones, making it increasingly challenging to control what they view online. In response, YouTube is reportedly developing a child-friendly version of its video platform specifically for children aged 10 and under. According to multiple sources cited by The Information, this version would exclusively feature videos and comments considered appropriate for young children. Parents would have control over access to the site.

There is currently no confirmed launch date, and details about how the service will work—including whether it will feature advertising—remain unclear. The platform might be accessible via a separate app or a locked channel, and YouTube has already reached out to video producers about creating original child-appropriate content for exclusive release.

Presently, YouTube offers a parental control feature called Safety Mode, which users can enable from any page. This mode filters out videos flagged as inappropriate and activates Google SafeSearch, which filters search results. Additionally, established child-friendly channels like Sesame Street and the Disney Channel, as well as YouTube EDU, provide a wide range of content specifically designed for children and educational purposes. The planned platform would further emphasize safety by also filtering comments to remove explicit language and adult content.
