Saboda haka, rahotanni sun ce YouTube na shirye-shiryen kaddamar da wani sabon shafin bidiyonsa na musamman ga yara ‘yan shekara 10 da kasa. A cewar majiyoyi daban-daban da jaridar The Information ta ruwaito, wannan sabon shafi zai ƙunshi bidiyo da sharhi ne kawai da aka tabbatar sun dace da yara. Iyaye za su iya sarrafa izinin shiga wannan sabon shafi.

Har yanzu ba a bayyana ranar da za a kaddamar ko yadda sabis ɗin zai yi aiki ba, har da ko za a nuna talla ko ba za a nuna ba. Ana tsammanin za a iya samun wannan shafi ne ta wata sabuwar manhaja ko kuma kulle-kullen tashar, kuma YouTube ta riga ta fara tuntubar masu kirkirar bidiyo domin samar da abubuwan da suka dace da yara musamman akan shafin.

A yanzu, YouTube na da wata hanya ta iyaye wato Safety Mode, wanda za a kunna daga kowanne shafi. Wannan yanayin yana cire bidiyoyin da aka nuna ba su dace ba sannan yana kunna Google SafeSearch, wanda ke tace sakamakon bincike. Haka kuma, akwai tashoshin yara kamar Sesame Street da Disney Channel, da kuma YouTube EDU wadanda ke cike da bidiyon yara da na ilimi. Zuwan sabon dandalin zai ƙara tsananta tsaro ta hanyar tace sharhi mai maganganu marasa dacewa ko batutuwan manya.

article_content: A Drug Enforcement Administration agent stationed in Cartagena, Colombia, arranged for a prostitute to meet a U.S. Secret Service agent shortly before President Obama's visit, the Justice Department's inspector general found. One agent confessed to setting up the encounter; another claimed he was too intoxicated to remember his role, while a third attended dinner but was not involved further. All three later acknowledged paying for sexual services in Colombia. Although the inspector general and a U.S. Attorney saw no grounds for criminal prosecution, disciplinary action for the agents remains possible. Senator Susan Collins of Maine pressed DEA Administrator Michele Leonhart for clarity and action regarding the delay in administrative measures, citing the severity of the misconduct. The DEA stated that its Board of Professional Conduct was reviewing the matter and treats such incidents seriously, while the Secret Service declined to comment. The issue surfaced as President Obama prepared for an April 2012 summit in Cartagena, where several Secret Service agents were discovered drinking and bringing women back to their hotel rooms. Some women were paid, but a dispute over payment led one woman to call the police. As a result, nine agents resigned or retired, and three were cleared. Though prostitution is legal in Colombia, revelations that U.S. agents engaged in such activities during official duty prompted security concerns and damaged the Secret Service’s reputation.

Jami’in ya amsa laifin shirya haduwar, wani kuma ya ce ya sha giya sosai ya kasa tuna rawar da ya taka, yayin da na uku ya halarci cin abinci amma bai shiga lamarin ba. Karshe, dukkan su ukun sun amsa cewa sun biya kudin jima’i a Colombia. Duk da haka, mai binciken cikin gida na Ma’aikatar Shari’a tare da wani Lauyan Gwamnati ba su ga alasan gurfanar da su a kotu ba, sai dai ana iya hukunta jami’an. Sanata Susan Collins daga jihar Maine ta matsa wa Sufeto Janar na DEA, Michele Leonhart, wajen neman bayani da daukar mataki kan jinkirin hukunci, tana bayyana cewa laifin da aka aikata yana da muni. Hukumar DEA ta ce kwamitin ladabtar da ma’aikata tana nazarin lamarin kuma suna daukar irin wadannan al’amura da muhimmanci, yayinda hukumar Secret Service ta ki cewa komai. Lamarin ya kunno kai ne yayin da ake shirin karbar Shugaba Obama zuwa taron koli a Cartagena a watan Afrilu 2012, inda wasu jami’an Secret Service suka sha giya suka kuma kawo mata otal din su. Ko da yake karuwanci halal ne a Colombia, bayyanar yadda jami’an Amurka suka yi irin wannan a lokacin aiki ya haifar da damuwa kan tsaro kuma ya bata sunan hukumar Secret Service.

article_content: Indian private sector banks made their largest single-session purchase of government bonds in seven years on Friday, including a significant investment on behalf of a corporate client, according to traders. These banks collectively bought bonds with a net worth of 83.43 billion rupees ($1 billion), marking the highest single-day purchase since November 15, 2016, as reported by the Clearing Corp of India. This surge pushed total government bond buying in November above 200 billion rupees, following net sales of 101 billion rupees in October. Traders indicated that a major corporate likely bought around 50 billion rupees of benchmark securities via a private sector bank. A senior treasury official at a private bank explained that beyond constituent transactions, private banks are increasing their own bond holdings because they need to reinvest funds from maturing securities. Nearly 1.7 trillion rupees in funds will be freed up over the next month as the 8.83%, 4.56%, and 7.68% 2023 government securities mature. Most of this money is being reinvested in liquid assets, particularly five-year and benchmark ten-year government bonds, another treasury official noted. Improving macroeconomic conditions and falling US Treasury yields are also supporting the increase in bond purchases. Alok Singh, Group Treasury Head at CSB Bank, observed that recent US economic data has weakened, leading to lower US Treasury yields and signaling that the rate cycle may have peaked. This trend has encouraged more trading activity by private sector banks, Singh added. The 10-year US Treasury yield dropped over 55 basis points in November, nearing 4.45%. Traders also said buying sentiment improved as expectations of further debt sales from the Reserve Bank of India have waned, owing to tight liquidity. For the week ending November 10, the RBI did not conduct sales in the secondary market, after selling 185 billion rupees in the previous ten weeks.

Wadannan bankuna sun sayi takardun gwamnati da darajarsu ta kai rupees biliyan 83.43 ($1 biliyan), wanda ya zama mafi girman siye da aka taba samu tun ranar 15 ga Nuwamba, 2016, a cewar Clearing Corp of India. Wannan ya sa gaba ɗaya cinikin takardun gwamnati na watan Nuwamba ya haura rupees biliyan 200, bayan sayar da rupees biliyan 101 a watan Oktoba. ‘Yan kasuwa sun ce wani babban kamfani ya yi siyan takardu kusan rupees biliyan 50 ta hannun wani bankin masu zaman kansu. Wani babban jami’in kula da kudade a wani bankin masu zaman kansu ya bayyana cewa, baya ga tallafin abokan hulda, bankunan na kara zuba jari a cikin takardun gwamnati saboda suna bukatar dawo da kudin da suka fito daga takardun da suka cika. Kusan rupees tiriliyan 1.7 za su shiga jari a cikin wata mai zuwa yayin da takardun gwamnati na 8.83%, 4.56%, da 7.68% na shekarar 2023 suka cika. Yawancin wadannan kudade ana sake zuba su ne a cikin kadarori masu sauki, musamman takardun gwamnati na shekaru biyar da na shekaru goma, in ji wani jami’in kula da kudade. Kyautatuwar tattalin arziki da kuma faduwar ribar US Treasury suna taimakawa wajen karuwar kasuwancin takardun gwamnati. Alok Singh, shugaban sashen kula da kudade a CSB Bank, ya ce bayanan tattalin arzikin Amurka na baya-bayan nan sun nuna raguwa, wanda ya fitar da ribar US Treasury kasa tare da nuna yiwuwar hawan ribar ya tsaya. Singh ya kara da cewa wannan ya karfafa kasuwancin cinikayya daga bankunan masu zaman kansu. Ribar takardun gwamnati na shekaru goma na Amurka ta ragu da maki 55 a watan Nuwamba, tana kusan 4.45%. ‘Yan kasuwa sun kuma ce yanayin saye ya inganta tun da ake tunanin RBI ba za ta sake fitar da sabon bashi ba saboda karancin ruwa a kasuwa. A makon da ya kare 10 ga Nuwamba, RBI ba ta yi sayarwa a kasuwa ba, bayan ta sayar da rupees biliyan 185 a makonni goma da suka wuce.

article_content: The July 20 shooting at a midnight showing of 'The Dark Knight Rises' in Aurora, Colorado, appears to have had a relatively minor impact on the film’s box office success. However, the tragedy has had a significant effect on Warner Bros.' plans for their upcoming film, 'Gangster Squad.' Immediately after the shooting, Warner Bros. pulled trailers for the film that—shockingly echoing the real life tragedy—showed a scene of mobsters firing into a crowded movie theater. In the days that followed, the studio and director Ruben Fleischer ('Zombieland') decided to remove or significantly alter that scene. Since the movie-theater-shooting sequence is central to the plot of 'Gangster Squad'—which stars Josh Brolin and Ryan Gosling as police officers pursuing 1940s Los Angeles crime boss Mickey Cohen (played by Sean Penn)—reworking it means rewriting parts of the script and reshooting scenes. As a result, the film’s planned September 7 release is now in jeopardy. According to a studio source, Warner Bros. is removing 'Gangster Squad' from its fall schedule, and while a new release date hasn’t been set, January is being considered. The studio declined to comment, but the changes are intended to give filmmakers time to modify the movie and allow the studio to restart its marketing campaign, which was disrupted by unforeseen and tragic events. For more details, visit EW.com.

Amma wannan mummunar al’amarin ya yi tasiri matuka kan shirye-shiryen Warner Bros. game da sabon fim dinsu, 'Gangster Squad.' Da zarar abin ya faru, Warner Bros. sun dakatar da tallan fim din wanda, cikin rashin dacewa, ya nuna wasu ‘yan daba suna bude wuta cikin dakin kallo cike da mutane – abin da ya yi kama da abinda ya faru da gaske. Bayan wasu kwanaki, darakta Ruben Fleischer ('Zombieland') da kamfanin suka yanke shawarar cire ko sauya wannan sashi sosai. Saboda wannan harin a gidan kallo muhimmin bangare ne na labarin fim din – inda Josh Brolin da Ryan Gosling ke taka rawa a matsayin ‘yan sanda suna bin bayan mafiyan birnin Los Angeles na shekarun 1940, Mickey Cohen (Sean Penn ke gabatar da rawar). Saboda haka, dole ne a sake rubuta wasu sashe da sake daukar wasu sahun, wanda ke nuna cewa fim din ba zai fito ranar 7 ga Satumba ba kamar yadda aka tsara. Wani majiya daga kamfanin ya tabbatar da cewa Warner Bros. sun janye 'Gangster Squad' daga hukumar fina-finai a wannan kaka, kuma har yanzu ba a fitar da sabuwar rana ba, amma ana duba wata Janairu a matsayin yiwuwar lokaci. Kamfanin ya ki yin tsokaci kan wannan shawarar, amma duk wadannan canje-canjen akwai nufin ba wa masu fim din lokaci su gyara fim din da kuma sake farawa da tallace-tallace, wadanda bala’in da ba a zata ba ya kawo tsaiko. Don karin bayani, kai ziyara EW.com.

article_content: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un has hailed the successful launch of the country's first military spy satellite, the "Malligyong-1," marking what he described as a "new era of a space power," according to state media on Friday. The launch, conducted on Tuesday, was North Korea's third attempt to place a military reconnaissance satellite into orbit following failures in May and August. Following the launch, North Korean authorities claimed that Kim was already reviewing images captured by the satellite, including photographs of US military bases in Guam. During his visit to North Korea’s national space agency, Kim characterized the operation as a legitimate exercise of the nation's right to self-defense. He stated the satellite would help defend North Korea against hostile and aggressive actions from other countries, and that it represented a significant technological milestone. South Korea confirmed the successful launch but expressed skepticism regarding whether the satellite was functioning as North Korea claimed. Photographs released by North Korean media showed Kim with scientists and workers at the National Aerospace Technology Administration (NATA), accompanied by his daughter Ju Ae. Kim, wearing a black leather coat, was seen smiling and waving at uniformed staff who responded with enthusiastic cheers. Other images showed him celebrating with NATA staff, military and political officials, along with his daughter and wife, Ri Sol Ju. Those present wore matching T-shirts with "NATA" printed in English to commemorate the occasion. The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) described the celebrations as a heartfelt expression of gratitude towards Kim for achieving the satellite launch, highlighting his support and 'paternal love' for the scientists. In response to the launch, South Korea partially suspended a military agreement with the North and deployed additional surveillance and reconnaissance assets near the border. North Korea replied by announcing its full suspension of the agreement, describing South Korea’s action as reckless and affirming it would no longer observe the deal. Experts note that having an operational spy satellite would greatly enhance North Korea's intelligence-gathering capacity, particularly concerning South Korea, and provide valuable military data in case of conflict.

article_content: A demanding bodyguard training camp for women is taking place on the beaches of Sanya, Hainan province, China. Among the trainees—most of whom are college graduates—the program features physical drills such as crawling through sand, being splashed with seawater, and working together to carry heavy logs. Tianjiao Special Guard Consultant Ltd, a professional security firm, leads this four-week program, which is China's first open group training specifically for female bodyguards. The overall course involves ten months of learning, covering reconnaissance, martial arts, anti-terrorism tactics, and business etiquette. The top trainee is eligible for further specialization at the International Security Academy in Israel. As China’s economy expands, both male and female bodyguards are in increasing demand, but female bodyguards are especially sought after due to their ability to fill multiple roles, including secretary or nanny. Female bodyguards often enjoy higher pay, sometimes earning as much as $100 per day, which is significantly higher than the national average income of roughly $1,500 per year. Moreover, their discretion and versatility make them the preferred choice for both wealthy businessmen and businesswomen concerned about their privacy and security. This training highlights the intense preparation required and underscores the growing presence of women forging strong careers in China’s private security sector.

Maza da mata masu kudi na bukatar irin waɗannan mata da za su kula da tsaronsu da sirrinsu. Wannan horo yana nuna irin matakin da ake bukata kuma yana bayyana yadda mata ke samun damammaki a bangaren aikin tsaro a China.

article_content: Harlequins held up their end in the European Champions Cup but were eliminated due to results elsewhere. Amid heavy snowfall in southern France, coach Conor O’Shea and his staff watched on a laptop as Leinster’s failure to beat Wasps in Coventry ended their quarter-final hopes. The final score, with Harlequins scoring seven tries to Castres’ three, sends the club’s England internationals — Joe Marler, Chris Robshaw, Nick Easter, Danny Care, and Mike Brown — to Pennyhill Park with mixed emotions, as the west London side finished third in Pool 2. Harlequins flanker Chris Robshaw watched his team exit the tournament on Saturday, while Nick Easter passed the ball during the match against Castres. ‘We did what we could, but unfortunately, we couldn’t control anything else,’ said O’Shea. ‘At the end, we watched on a laptop as Leinster missed drop goals and penalties. Ian Madigan, normally an 80-90% kicker, converted just three from seven. We could only control our own game. You can’t rely on other results, and that’s the position we put ourselves in. I thought we played well in tough conditions.’ Just 6,802 fans braved the freezing temperatures, but Castres supporters reacted strongly when Marler scored the opening try in the 12th minute. Harlequins pursued a four-try bonus point, turning down a kick at goal so Nick Evans could kick for the corner. A serious knee injury to Will Collier forced his withdrawal, but Harlequins’ forwards rallied, with Marler finishing a maul from the lineout. A miscommunication between Charlie Walker and Mike Brown nearly gifted Castres a try, just before scrum-half Antoine Dupont scored to level the match. Walker then used his speed and agility to beat Remi Tales for Harlequins’ third try, but Castres equalized through centre Romain Cabannes. Thomas Combezou was sin-binned before halftime, and Quins took advantage to score through Danny Care and Jack Clifford. Castres, missing star player Rory Kockott, struggled, and when Remy Grosso received the game’s second yellow card, Quins pressed their advantage with scores from Mark Lambert and Marland Yarde. However, it was ultimately in vain. Johnnie Beattie and George Lowe traded late tries, but Harlequins’ fate was already sealed. Despite a conclusive victory, they exited the tournament. Key moments included Harlequins’ physical play, several yellow cards shown, and a resilient effort under difficult conditions.
translated_content: Harlequins sun taka rawar gani a gasar Zakarun Turai amma rashin nasara a wasu wasanni yasa aka cire su daga gasar. A cikin hazo mai nauyi a kudu na Faransa, koci Conor O’Shea da ma'aikatansa sun kalli yadda Leinster ta kasa doke Wasps a Coventry, wanda ya kawo karshen burinsu na zuwa zagaye na gaba. Sakamakon karshe, inda Harlequins suka ci tries guda bakwai yayin da Castres suka ci uku, ya sa 'yan wasan Ingila na kulob din — Joe Marler, Chris Robshaw, Nick Easter, Danny Care, da Mike Brown — suka koma Pennyhill Park da zuciya biyu, yayin da kungiyarsu ta kammala a mataki na uku a Pool 2. Dan wasan gefe na Harlequins, Chris Robshaw, ya kalli yadda tawagarsa ta fice daga gasar a ranar Asabar, inda Nick Easter ya wuce kwallo yayin wasan da Castres. ‘Mun yi abin da ya kamata, amma abin takaici ba mu iya sarrafa sauran wasanni ba,’ in ji O’Shea. ‘A ƙarshe, mun kalli yadda Leinster ta rasa bugun tashi ƙwallaye da bugun fanareti daga laptop. Ian Madigan yawanci yana cin nasara fiye da kaso 80 zuwa 90, amma yau uku kawai daga bakwai. Mun iya sarrafa namu kawai. Ba za ka iya dogara da sakamakon wasu ba, kuma hakan shi ne yanayin da muka tsinci kanmu. Ina ganin mun buga kwallo sosai a mawuyacin hali.’ Kawai magoya baya 6,802 ne suka fito a cikin sanyin rana mai tsanani, amma magoya bayan Castres sun nuna farin ciki lokacin da Marler ya ci try na farko a minti na 12. Harlequins sun nemi maki na tries hudu, suka ki bugun kwallo domin Nick Evans ya jefa gefen fili. Rauni mai tsanani na gwiwa ya sa aka cire Will Collier daga wasa, amma yan wasan gaba sun hada kai, Marler ya kammala da ci daga layin zura kwallo. Fahimta ta bace tsakanin Charlie Walker da Mike Brown har sun kusa baiwa Castres dama, kafin Antoine Dupont ya jefa wa Castres kwallo don daidaita wasan. Daga baya, Walker ya yi amfani da sauri da dabara wajen doke Remi Tales don ci na uku ga Harlequins, amma Castres suka sake daidaita ta hannun Romain Cabannes. Thomas Combezou ya tashi daga wasa kafin rabin lokaci, Quins suka amfana ta jefa kwallo ta hannun Danny Care da Jack Clifford. Castres ba tare da tauraron su Rory Kockott ba, sun sha wahala. Bayan Remy Grosso ya samu jan kati na biyu, Quins suka ci gaba da jefa kwallo ta hannun Mark Lambert da Marland Yarde. Sai dai hakan bai wadatar ba. Johnnie Beattie da George Lowe sun jefa kwallaye a karshen wasa, amma tun farko an riga an san makomar Harlequins. Duk da samun nasara, sun bar gasar. Manyan lokuta sun hada da karfin Harlequins, jan kati da yawa, da kuma saurin da suka nuna a mawuyacin hali.

article_content: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has presented certificates of return to the Governor-Elect of Kogi State, Usman Ododo, and his deputy, Joel Salifu. The presentation was held at INEC headquarters in Lokoja, the state capital, on Friday, attended by a large crowd of jubilant supporters. Usman Ododo, the candidate of the All Progressives Congress (APC), won the November 11 off-cycle governorship election in Kogi State with 446,237 votes. He defeated Murtala Ajaka of the Social Democratic Party (SDP), who secured 259,052 votes, and Dino Melaye of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), who obtained 46,362 votes. After receiving his certificate, Ododo expressed gratitude to the people of Kogi State for their strong support at the polls. He pledged to build on the achievements of Governor Yahaya Bello, maintain unity in the state, and ensure his administration continues youth and women empowerment, job creation, and makes education a top priority. "My administration will run an all-inclusive government where everyone, regardless of tribe, religion, or political party, will be involved," Ododo stated. "My victory is for all Kogites, and I am committed to justifying the trust placed in me." Governor Yahaya Bello was present at the ceremony and called on Kogi residents to support Ododo's government, highlighting the importance of maintaining unity and the state's development. Kogi State Resident Electoral Commissioner, Gabriel Longpet, stated that the certificate presentation was part of INEC’s mandate and confirmed that Ododo met all constitutional requirements.

An gudanar da bikin a hedkwatar INEC da ke Lokoja, babban birnin jihar, ranar Juma’a tare da dimbin magoya baya suna murna. Usman Ododo, dan takarar jam’iyyar All Progressives Congress (APC), ya lashe zaben gwamna da aka gudanar a ranar 11 ga Nuwamba a Jihar Kogi da kuri’u 446,237. Ya kayar da Murtala Ajaka na jam’iyyar Social Democratic Party (SDP), wanda ya samu kuri’u 259,052, sai Dino Melaye na Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), wanda ya samu kuri’u 46,362. Bayan karɓar takardar shaidarsa, Ododo ya nuna godiya ga mutanen Kogi bisa irin goyon bayan da suka nuna masa. Ya sha alwashin ci gaba da manyan ayyukan da Gwamna Yahaya Bello ya gudanar, tabbatar da hadin kai da dorewar shirye-shiryen tallafa wa matasa da mata, samar da ayyukan yi da ba da fifiko ga ilimi. "Gwamnatina za ta kasance mai hadin kai da kowa, ba tare da la’akari da kabila, addini ko jam’iyya ba," in ji Ododo. "Nasara ta ta na kowa ce a Kogi, kuma zan tabbatar da amincewar da aka nuna min." Gwamna Yahaya Bello ya halarci taron kuma ya kira al’ummar jihar da su mara wa sabuwar gwamnatin Ododo baya, inda ya ja hankalinsu da su ci gaba da zaman lafiya da hadin kai. Kwamishinan Zabe na INEC a Jihar Kogi, Gabriel Longpet, ya bayyana cewa mika takardar nasara wani bangare ne na aikin INEC, kuma Ododo ya cika duk sharuddan da doka ta gindaya.

article_content: Meta announced on Thursday that users can now create polls and insert GIFs directly from the Threads post composer. Later, Instagram head Adam Mosseri shared that the company is testing view counts on Threads posts, as well as pinned posts on profiles and within replies. These new polls and GIF features are being rolled out, with CEO Mark Zuckerberg demonstrating both in recent posts. While these additions are fairly small, they represent features long available on X (formerly Twitter). Zuckerberg’s poll demonstration allowed for three options, but users can include up to four. Each poll includes a countdown timer showing how much time is left for voting in real-time. Notably, to see poll results, users must cast their vote, and Threads sends notifications when a poll concludes. To make sharing GIFs easier, a new GIF icon lets you search for GIFs from Giphy. The picker displays trending GIFs, and users can search for specific ones using the search bar. Threads is also testing the ability to pin replies and display view counts, features familiar to X users. X launched view counts for all users in December, a concept Mosseri supports, suggesting view counts offer more transparency and helpful feedback. While pinned posts are common on X, Threads is innovating by allowing users to pin replies to their posts. According to Mosseri, both view counts and pinned post tests are currently live for a limited group of users. Threads launched in July, and according to Zuckerberg during Wednesday’s earnings call, the app now boasts just under 100 million monthly active users. Update October 26th, 7:06PM ET: Added details about the new Threads tests.

Daga baya, shugaban Instagram, Adam Mosseri, ya bayyana cewa kamfanin na gwada lissafin adadin masu kallon sakonni a Threads da kuma saka sakon da aka cece a kan bayanan martaba da kuma a cikin amsoshin ku. Wadannan sababbin fasaloli na kuri’u da hotunan GIF suna fara fitowa, inda Shugaba Mark Zuckerberg ya nuna duka biyun a cikin sabbin sakonninsa. A gwajin kuri’ar Zuckerberg, an ba da zaɓuɓɓuka guda uku, amma masu amfani na iya ƙara har zuwa hudu. Kowace kuri’a na dauke da agogon ƙidayar lokaci don nuna lokacin da ya rage a kuriyar. Abin lura, domin ganin sakamakon kuri’a, dole ne ka yi zabe, kuma Threads zai turo maka da sanarwa idan aka gama kuri’ar. Duk da cewa saka sakonni mafi muhimmanci (pinned posts) al’ada ne a X, Threads na kawo sauyi ta hanyar barin masu amfani su saka amsa a sama a cikin sakon su. A cewar Mosseri, duk gwaje-gwajen lissafin kallo da pin yanzu suna aiki ne ga ƴan masu amfani kaɗan. Threads ta fara aiki a watan Yuli, kuma a cewar Zuckerberg yayin kiran ribar ranar Laraba, app din na da kusan mutane miliyan 100 masu amfani a kowane wata. article_content: A little over a week ago, comedian Russell Brand was spotted having an intimate dinner with millionairess Jemima Khan in London. For their date, Russell wore low-slung distressed jeans and a sleeveless top that showed off his tattooed arms. Jemima, aged 39, looked casual yet chic in fitted blue jeans and a crisp white shirt, paired with grey heeled boots. She left her long hair loose and tousled. As they walked together in the sunshine, Russell seemed enamored with Jemima and wasn't shy about putting his arm around her while they enjoyed a conversation. article_content: NEW DELHI: The Indian Air Force (IAF) scrambled its Rafale fighter aircraft soon after receiving reports of unidentified flying objects (UFOs) near Imphal airport on Sunday afternoon. The sighting, which occurred around 2:30 pm, led to some commercial flight disruptions. "Once information about the UFO was received, a Rafale fighter jet from a nearby airbase was dispatched to search the area," defence sources told ANI. "The aircraft, equipped with advanced sensors, conducted low-level flights over the suspected area but did not find anything." After the first jet returned, another Rafale was sent to continue the search, but the UFO was not spotted again. Relevant agencies are investigating the sighting, and video recordings of the object over the airport are being reviewed. Following safety checks, Imphal airport resumed normal flight operations. The Indian Air Force's Eastern Command, headquartered in Shillong, confirmed it activated its Air Defence response mechanism, but did not provide further details. In a post on 'X' (formerly Twitter), Eastern Command stated, "IAF activated its Air Defence response mechanism based on visual inputs from Imphal airport. The small object was not seen thereafter." Rafale fighters are based at Hashimara air base in West Bengal and are frequently deployed to various air bases in the eastern sector near the China border. The jets recently participated in the large-scale Poorvi Akash exercise alongside other major Air Force assets and Army troops near the China border.

article_content: Yes Bank has updated the penalty for premature withdrawal from fixed deposits (FDs). The revised penalty rates became effective on November 3, 2023. For most customers, premature withdrawal of FDs now attracts a penalty of 0.75% for FDs up to 181 days (up from 0.5%), and 1% for FDs of 182 days and above (up from 0.75%). However, for fixed deposits with values less than Rs 5 crore, the penalty structure remains at 0.25% for all tenures and value buckets. Senior citizens will not incur premature withdrawal penalties on FDs booked or renewed on or after May 16, 2022. Penalties apply to both partial and full withdrawals. Premature penalties are applicable for all customer types, including individuals and non-individuals. Yes Bank has also increased interest rates on FDs below Rs 2 crore by up to 25 basis points for select durations. Regular resident FDs now offer interest rates from 3.25% to 7.75% after the adjustment. Senior citizens can earn between 3.75% and 8.25%, with the highest interest rate of 8.25% available for tenures of 18 months to less than 24 months. The new FD interest rates are effective from November 21, 2023.

article_content: Mississippi State Representative Gene Alday faces widespread criticism after making remarks suggesting that all Black residents of his hometown depend on welfare and food assistance. Alday, who previously served as Walls' mayor and joined the House in 2011, made these comments in a discussion about education policy and the potential of electing school superintendents. He described his community as one where, according to him, 'all the blacks are getting food stamps and welfare crazy checks,' and claimed these individuals do not work. He further spoke about healthcare in Desoto County, recalling a personal emergency room experience that he said was delayed because Black patients were being treated for gunshot wounds. The remarks quickly drew backlash, prompting fellow Republicans and House representatives to distance themselves and call for Alday's resignation. Officials held a press conference voicing their concerns about his language. Addressing the controversy in the Mississippi House, Alday issued an apology, saying his comments were taken out of context and maintained he is not racist. He affirmed his support for civil rights and noted his participation in local civil rights events. Despite public and political pressure to step down, Alday stated he would seek re-election. His apology was met with applause in the House.

Alday, tsohon shugaban karamar hukumar Walls kuma wakili tun 2011, ya fadi wannan a tattaunawa kan siyasar ilimi da yiwuwar zaben shugabannin makaranta. article_content: Firefighters in Williamstown, New Jersey, are facing criticism from officials and residents after displaying a banner reading: 'Show us your t**s.' The all-volunteer fire company hung the inappropriate sign below its emblem during the state's Fireman's Convention in Wildwood last weekend. Former EMT Shawn Rutter saw the banner and sent a photo to the South Jersey Times. Many residents expressed shock and disappointment at the display. 'I think it's demoralizing and insulting to women,' Rutter told the newspaper. 'Many children look up to firefighters, and this is not a good example.' Monroe Township Mayor Michael Gabbianelli said the sign does not reflect the values of Gloucester County or the town. 'We're investigating,' he told NBC4. 'Once we have all the information, someone will be suspended. It's embarrassing for everybody.' Williamstown resident Rebecca Budney told reporters she found the sign completely inappropriate and distasteful. Another resident, Heather Camperchioli, said the firefighters had set a poor example for children. Rutter, who took the photo, praised first responders but said this incident demonstrated poor judgment and should not happen again. In response to the public outcry, Williamstown Fire Company President Joseph Kurz and Chief Michael Jacobi posted a public apology on the company's website. 'We sincerely apologize to those offended by the inappropriate banner,' the statement read, explaining that a few individuals exercised poor judgment. The fire company's leaders emphasized their long-standing tradition of honorable service and asked the public to judge the organization by its commitment, not one mistake. An investigation is ongoing to ensure it does not happen again.

article_content: Turkey scored a dramatic last-minute goal to defeat Euro 2008 co-hosts Switzerland 2-1 in Basel on Wednesday night, keeping their hopes of reaching the quarterfinals alive. The rain-soaked match at St Jakob Park provided challenging conditions, with both teams struggling to defend properly. Switzerland took the lead in the 32nd minute after Hakan Yakin finished from close range, following a well-worked move involving Eren Derdiyok and Philippe Senderos. Turkey responded in the 57th minute when substitute Semih Senturk headed home the equalizer, beating goalkeeper Diego Benaglio. The weather played a significant role, as heavy rain caused flooding on the field and made play difficult throughout the first half. Despite the conditions, Turkey continued to press forward. In added time, Arda Turan struck the decisive goal with a deflected shot, securing the victory and setting up a crucial final group match against the Czech Republic to determine who advances to the next round. After the game, Turkey coach Fatih Terim expressed pride in his team’s resilience, while Swiss coach Koebi Kuhn didn’t blame any individual for the loss, describing the defeat as unlucky. Switzerland faces likely elimination if Austria loses to Poland in their upcoming match.

article_content: At a global climate summit, President George W. Bush reaffirmed the United States’ commitment to fighting climate change, noting that the nation takes greenhouse gas emissions seriously. Addressing the Major Economies Meeting on Energy Security and Climate Change, he called on leading economies—both developed and developing—to work together toward a shared long-term reduction goal. Bush also announced that the US would convene a summit with world leaders by next summer to finalize these objectives and develop a system for transparently measuring progress. Bush stressed the importance of allowing each country to craft its own approach to achieving emission reductions, highlighting advances in clean coal, biofuels, nuclear, wind, and solar power as critical technological solutions. He countered the notion that economic growth and environmental protection are incompatible, referencing preliminary Energy Department data showing that US energy-related carbon dioxide emissions fell by 1.3% in 2006 despite 2.9% economic growth. He acknowledged earlier claims about lowering 'emissions intensity'—the ratio of emissions to economic output—even as total emissions increased in previous years of his administration. The Bush administration has faced criticism at home and abroad, particularly for pulling out of the 1997 Kyoto Protocol, which set binding emissions reductions for industrialized nations. Bush reiterated his support for voluntary, flexible climate policies instead of rigid global mandates. Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice reinforced this approach, maintaining that tackling climate change demands global teamwork, with economic development, clean energy, and environmental stewardship advancing together. Delegates from 16 nations, the United Nations, and the European Union attended the two-day event, focused on finding common ground for addressing global warming after the Kyoto Protocol.

article_content:
A recent study indicates that children’s struggles with math may be linked in part to their genes. Researchers from Ohio State University found that children already having difficulty with math could experience increased math anxiety if they are genetically predisposed.

To explore this, scientists studied twins, comparing levels of math anxiety to determine the influence of genetics versus environment. The study revealed that about 40% of the risk for math anxiety comes from genetic factors, while the rest is due to school, family, and social environments.

Notably, math anxiety tends to be specific to math—children don’t typically feel the same stress about other subjects, such as reading. Professor Stephen Petrill, the study's lead, noted that genetic risk combined with negative math experiences can worsen the problem, highlighting the importance of considering both when helping students.

Over 500 pairs of twins took part, completing assessments on general anxiety, math anxiety, math ability, and reading comprehension as part of a larger ongoing Ohio study. The results demonstrated that both genes and the environment affect math anxiety and, as a result, student performance.

Separately, a review of over a million students worldwide has debunked the stereotype that boys are better at math and science. The data—from more than 300 studies over nearly a century—show girls have outperformed boys in all subjects, with the smallest difference in math.

Professor Petrill emphasizes that identifying the causes of math anxiety could lead to better interventions to support struggling students.

Don wannan bincike, masana sun kalli tagwaye, suna kwatanta yadda suka bambanta da damuwa a lissafi don fahimtar tasirin gado da kuma muhalli. Sakamakon ya nuna cewa kusan kashi 40% na damuwar lissafi daga gado ne, sauran daga al'amuran makaranta, gida da abokai.

Abu na musamman shine damuwar lissafi ta fi fitowa kan lissafi—akalla yara ba sa jin irinta a darussan da suka shafi karatu. Farfesa Stephen Petrill, shugaba a binciken, ya ce haɗin gado da mummunan kwarewa a lissafi na ƙara tsananta matsalar, suna buƙatar duba duka biyun wajen taimakawa yara.

article_content: Neil Redfearn, Leeds United's head coach and a lifelong fan, expresses pride in the club’s rich FA Cup history and hopes to create new memories when Leeds faces Sunderland on Sunday. As a boy, Redfearn experienced both the highs and lows of the competition, recalling Leeds’ iconic 1972 victory over Arsenal, secured by Allan Clarke's goal, and the following year's dramatic loss to Sunderland. Once a powerhouse in English football, Leeds now finds itself near the bottom of the Championship and has undergone a significant transformation, with a multinational squad assembled under owner Massimo Cellino. Despite these changes, Redfearn insists the club’s focus on FA Cup success is as strong as during the Don Revie era, when Leeds were frequent Wembley visitors. Redfearn remembers eagerly watching FA Cup coverage as a child, inspired by legendary players like Clarke, Peter Lorimer, and Billy Bremner, whose contributions deepened Leeds’ connection to the tournament. He emphasizes the importance of giving a strong account against Sunderland. Leeds and Sunderland last met in the FA Cup final in 1973—a result that still lingers for some Leeds supporters, according to Redfearn. Many long-time affiliates of the club uphold the traditions established by Don Revie and may view Sunday’s tie as an opportunity for redemption. On Sunday, Leeds could field a squad with players from up to nine different countries. While adaptation to the Championship has been tough for some, Redfearn is confident his “foreign legion” appreciates the FA Cup’s prestige and the imperative to win at Leeds United. Although Leeds’ recent form has led to speculation about Redfearn’s future, there is reportedly no immediate plan for a managerial change. The coach and Cellino recently finalized transfer targets, with Italian striker Leonardo Pavoletti of Sassuolo expected to join on loan.

A lokacin yana saurayi, Redfearn ya fuskanci duka nasarori da kasawa a gasar, inda ya tuna da babban nasarar Leeds a 1972 inda suka doke Arsenal da kwallo daya kacal da Allan Clarke ya ci, sannan a shekara ta gaba aka doke su da mamaki a hannun Sunderland a wasan karshe. Leeds ta taba kasancewa daya daga cikin manyan kungiyoyi a kwallon kafa ta Ingila, amma yanzu tana kokarin tsira daga kasa na Championship, tare da canje-canje masu yawa ciki har da 'yan wasa daga kasashe daban-daban karkashin shugabancin wani sabon mai kungiyar, Massimo Cellino. Duk da wadannan canje-canjen, Redfearn na ganin kishin FA Cup bai sauya ba, kamar yadda yake a zamanin Don Revie, lokacin da Leeds ke yawan zuwa Wembley. Redfearn ya ce yana da babban tunani akan gasar FA Cup tun yana karami, yana samun girmamawa daga fitattun 'yan wasa kamar Allan Clarke, Peter Lorimer, da Billy Bremner, wadanda gudummawarsu ta kara dankon zumunci tsakanin Leeds da FA Cup. Ya jaddada muhimmancin su gina martaba mai kyau a wasan da zasu kara da Sunderland. Wasan karshe da Leeds da Sunderland suka buga a FA Cup shine na 1973 — wanda Redfearn ke ganin har yanzu yana daga cikin zukatan masu goyon bayan Leeds. Wasu daga cikin masu alaka da kungiyar har yanzu na mutunta koyarwar Don Revie, kuma za su iya kallon wannan wasan a matsayin damar ramawa. A wasansu na Lahadi, Leeds za ta iya kawo 'yan wasan daga kasashe tara. Duk da cewa wasu daga cikinsu sun fuskanci kalubale a Championship, Redfearn na da tabbacin cewa 'yan wasan na fahimtar girman FA Cup da kuma kishin samun nasara a kulub din Leeds United. Ko da yake rashin nasara a wasannin baya ya haifar da rade-radi kan makomar Redfearn, babu shirin gaggawa na sauya masa gurbin aiki. Shi da Cellino sun tattauna kan sabbin ‘yan wasa, inda ake saran Leonardo Pavoletti daga Sassuolo zai shiga kungiyar aro.
